entries.example: The meeting ended abruptly when the manager felt sick.
entries.exampleZh: 经理感到不舒服，会议就突然结束了。

entries.example: Dry soil can absorb a lot of rain very fast.
entries.exampleZh: 干燥的土壤能很快吸收大量雨水。

entries.example: You should never abuse your power over weaker people.
entries.exampleZh: 你绝不应该滥用权力欺负弱者。

entries.example: Her academic work at the university is going well.
entries.exampleZh: 她在大学的学术工作进展顺利。

entries.example: Students can access the library computers after class.
entries.exampleZh: 学生课后可以使用图书馆的电脑。

entries.example: The new library is accessible to everyone in our small town.
entries.exampleZh: 这座新图书馆对小镇上的每个人都开放使用。

entries.example: This hotel can accommodate up to two hundred guests.
entries.exampleZh: 这家酒店最多能容纳两百位客人。

entries.example: We can accomplish a lot if we work together.
entries.exampleZh: 如果我们齐心协力，就能完成很多事情。

entries.example: Dust will accumulate quickly if you never clean the shelves.
entries.exampleZh: 如果你从不清理架子，灰尘很快就会堆积起来。

entries.example: Her report was accurate and easy to understand.
entries.exampleZh: 她的报告准确又易懂。

entries.example: You can achieve your goals with hard work and patience.
entries.exampleZh: 只要努力并有耐心，你就能实现自己的目标。

entries.example: Please acknowledge my message as soon as you can.
entries.exampleZh: 请尽快回复确认收到我的消息。

entries.example: Children acquire language skills very quickly at this age.
entries.exampleZh: 孩子们在这个年龄学习语言技能非常快。

entries.example: Dogs are known for their acute sense of smell.
entries.exampleZh: 狗以敏锐的嗅觉而闻名。

entries.example: Plants adapt slowly to changes in the weather.
entries.exampleZh: 植物会慢慢适应天气的变化。

entries.example: His addiction to video games worried the whole family.
entries.exampleZh: 他对电子游戏的上瘾让全家人都很担心。

entries.example: We need additional chairs for the meeting tomorrow morning.
entries.exampleZh: 明天早上的会议我们还需要额外的椅子。

entries.example: The mayor promised to address the traffic problem soon.
entries.exampleZh: 市长承诺很快解决交通问题。

entries.example: The small lamp gives adequate light for reading.
entries.exampleZh: 这盏小灯的光线足够看书用。

entries.example: The administration plans to build a new school here.
entries.exampleZh: 政府计划在这里建一所新学校。

entries.example: She handles all the administrative work in our office.
entries.exampleZh: 我们办公室的所有行政工作都由她负责。

entries.example: I really admire her patience with young children.
entries.exampleZh: 我真的很钦佩她对小孩子的耐心。

entries.example: He looked at the old painting with great admiration.
entries.exampleZh: 他满怀钦佩地看着那幅旧画。

entries.meaning: 准许进(加)入；入场费；承认
entries.example: Admission to the museum is free on Sunday mornings.
entries.exampleZh: 星期天上午博物馆免费入场。

entries.example: I must admit that I forgot your birthday.
entries.exampleZh: 我必须承认我忘了你的生日。

entries.example: We booked our tickets in advance to get better seats.
entries.exampleZh: 我们提前订票，以便买到更好的座位。

entries.example: She takes an advanced math class at her new school.
entries.exampleZh: 她在新学校上一门高级数学课。

entries.example: Her new job offers good chances for advancement.
entries.exampleZh: 她的新工作提供了良好的晋升机会。

entries.example: My teacher gave me some useful advice about studying.
entries.exampleZh: 老师给了我一些关于学习的有用建议。

entries.example: The travel advisory warns people about the heavy storms.
entries.exampleZh: 这份旅行警告提醒人们注意强风暴。

entries.example: She is a strong advocate for clean water in villages.
entries.exampleZh: 她是村庄清洁用水的有力倡导者。

entries.example: He became an advocator of healthy eating at school.
entries.exampleZh: 他成了学校里健康饮食的倡导者。

entries.example: My grandmother is a warm and affectionate person.
entries.exampleZh: 我的祖母是个温暖而深情的人。

entries.example: Her smile was a quiet affirmation of my idea.
entries.exampleZh: 她的微笑是对我想法的一种无声肯定。

entries.example: I can affirm that the report is completely true.
entries.exampleZh: 我可以断言这份报告完全属实。

entries.example: We cannot afford a new car this year.
entries.exampleZh: 今年我们买不起新车。

entries.example: The travel agency booked a hotel for us.
entries.exampleZh: 旅行社为我们订了一家酒店。

entries.meaning: 挑衅的，好斗的；有上进心的
entries.example: The dog became aggressive when strangers came near.
entries.exampleZh: 陌生人靠近时，那条狗变得凶狠。

entries.example: She put old photos in a beautiful album.
entries.exampleZh: 她把旧照片放进一本漂亮的相册里。

entries.example: This drink contains no alcohol, so children can have it.
entries.exampleZh: 这种饮料不含酒精，所以孩子们可以喝。

entries.example: Please alert me if the train time changes.
entries.exampleZh: 如果火车时间有变，请提醒我。

entries.example: We had to alter our plans because of the rain.
entries.exampleZh: 因为下雨，我们不得不改变计划。

entries.example: The plane is flying at a high altitude now.
entries.exampleZh: 飞机现在正在高空飞行。

entries.example: She is an ambitious young woman with big dreams.
entries.exampleZh: 她是个胸怀大志、梦想远大的年轻女性。

entries.example: Scientists analyze the data to find a cure.
entries.exampleZh: 科学家分析数据以寻找治疗方法。

entries.example: We saw ancient walls and old towers during our trip to Rome.
entries.exampleZh: 我们在罗马旅行时看到了古老的城墙和高塔。

entries.example: The school will announce the winners of the contest tomorrow morning.
entries.exampleZh: 学校明天早上将宣布比赛的获胜者。

entries.example: Our annual school trip takes place in the mountains every spring.
entries.exampleZh: 我们一年一度的学校旅行每年春天在山上举行。

entries.example: The club meets annually to choose a new leader for the group.
entries.exampleZh: 这个俱乐部每年聚会一次，为小组选出新的负责人。

entries.example: We anticipate a lot of visitors at the museum this weekend.
entries.exampleZh: 我们预计这个周末博物馆会有很多游客。

entries.example: She bought an antique at the market near her grandmother's house.
entries.exampleZh: 她在祖母家附近的市场买了一件古董。

entries.example: Their new apartment has a big kitchen and a small balcony.
entries.exampleZh: 他们的新公寓有一个大厨房和一个小阳台。

entries.example: The idea of living abroad has great appeal for many young people.
entries.exampleZh: 到国外生活的想法对许多年轻人很有吸引力。

entries.example: Her appearance changed a lot after she started working outdoors.
entries.exampleZh: 她开始户外工作后，外表改变了很多。

entries.example: The long walk gave the children a big appetite for dinner.
entries.exampleZh: 长途步行让孩子们吃晚饭时胃口大开。

entries.example: Each applicant must send two letters of support with the form.
entries.exampleZh: 每位申请人必须随表格寄来两封推荐信。

entries.example: Please send your application to the office before the end of May.
entries.exampleZh: 请在五月底之前把申请寄到办公室。

entries.example: You can apply for a student card at the front desk.
entries.exampleZh: 你可以在前台申请一张学生卡。

entries.meaning: 任命，委派；约定，确定，指定
entries.example: The manager will appoint a new team leader next week.
entries.exampleZh: 经理下周将任命一位新的团队负责人。

entries.example: I have an appointment with the dentist at three this afternoon.
entries.exampleZh: 我今天下午三点和牙医有个预约。

entries.example: I really appreciate your help with my homework last night.
entries.exampleZh: 我非常感谢你昨晚帮我做作业。

entries.example: She wrote a short note to show her appreciation for the gift.
entries.exampleZh: 她写了一张简短的便条，对这份礼物表示感谢。

entries.example: The best approach to this problem is to ask for help.
entries.exampleZh: 解决这个问题的最好办法是寻求帮助。

entries.example: My parents will not approve of my plan to travel alone.
entries.exampleZh: 我父母不会赞成我独自旅行的计划。

entries.example: The new plan needs the approval of the school director.
entries.exampleZh: 新计划需要校长的批准。

entries.example: The trip takes approximately three hours by train.
entries.exampleZh: 坐火车这段旅程大约需要三个小时。

entries.example: The architect drew a plan for our new school.
entries.exampleZh: 这位建筑师为我们的新学校画了一张设计图。

entries.example: The old letters are kept in the city archive.
entries.exampleZh: 那些旧信件保存在市档案馆里。

entries.example: Please arrange these books by subject on the shelf.
entries.exampleZh: 请把这些书按科目整理到书架上。

entries.example: The police came to arrest the thief last night.
entries.exampleZh: 警察昨晚来逮捕了那个小偷。

entries.example: She felt ashamed after shouting at her little brother.
entries.exampleZh: 她对弟弟大喊之后感到很羞愧。

entries.example: We must assemble the new table before dinner.
entries.exampleZh: 我们必须在晚饭前把新桌子组装好。

entries.example: The workers finished the assembly of the machine today.
entries.exampleZh: 工人们今天完成了这台机器的装配。

entries.example: Her calm voice is a great asset in this job.
entries.exampleZh: 她沉着的声音在这份工作中是一大优势。

entries.example: The teacher will assign each group a different task.
entries.exampleZh: 老师会给每个小组分配一项不同的任务。

entries.example: I must finish my history assignment before Friday.
entries.exampleZh: 我必须在星期五之前完成历史作业。

entries.example: I always associate this song with my summer holiday.
entries.exampleZh: 我总是把这首歌和我的暑假联系在一起。

entries.example: Let us assume the train arrives on time today.
entries.exampleZh: 我们假定火车今天准时到达吧。

entries.example: Your assumption about the price may be wrong.
entries.exampleZh: 你对价格的假设可能是错的。

entries.example: The magic show will astonish the young children.
entries.exampleZh: 这场魔术表演会让小孩子们大为惊讶。

entries.example: The small cafe has a warm and friendly atmosphere.
entries.exampleZh: 这家小咖啡馆有一种温暖友好的气氛。

entries.example: He made a brave attempt to climb the wall.
entries.exampleZh: 他勇敢地尝试爬那堵墙。

entries.example: The doors are automatic, so you need not push.
entries.exampleZh: 这些门是自动的，所以你不用推。

entries.meaning: 可利用的，现有的；可获得的
entries.example: Free tickets are available at the front desk.
entries.exampleZh: 免费门票可在前台领取。

entries.example: His quick thinking did not avail him in the end.
entries.exampleZh: 他的快速反应最终并没有帮到他。

entries.example: His marks in maths are just average this year.
entries.exampleZh: 他今年的数学成绩只是中等水平。

entries.example: My uncle works in aviation and loves his job.
entries.exampleZh: 我叔叔从事航空业，他很喜欢自己的工作。

entries.example: The young pilot learned to aviate safely in strong winds.
entries.exampleZh: 这位年轻的飞行员学会了在强风中安全驾驶飞机。

entries.example: We left home early to avoid the heavy traffic.
entries.exampleZh: 我们早早离开家以避开拥挤的交通。

entries.example: She won an award for her beautiful painting.
entries.exampleZh: 她因一幅美丽的画作而获奖。

entries.example: The campaign raises awareness about saving water at home.
entries.exampleZh: 这项活动提高了人们在家中节约用水的意识。

entries.example: The mountains in the background look beautiful today.
entries.exampleZh: 今天背景中的群山看起来很美。

entries.example: He took one step backward and smiled at me.
entries.exampleZh: 他向后退了一步，对我笑了。

entries.example: Many countries ban smoking in public places now.
entries.exampleZh: 如今许多国家禁止在公共场所吸烟。

entries.example: The small company went bankrupt last year.
entries.exampleZh: 这家小公司去年破产了。

entries.example: Their bargain over the price lasted ten minutes.
entries.exampleZh: 他们就价格的讨价还价持续了十分钟。

entries.example: The battle ended before the sun came up.
entries.exampleZh: 这场战役在太阳升起前结束了。

entries.example: The children behave very well when guests visit.
entries.exampleZh: 客人来访时孩子们表现得很好。

entries.example: Regular exercise is beneficial for your heart and mind.
entries.exampleZh: 经常锻炼对你的心脏和心智有益。

entries.example: These new rules will benefit every student in our school.
entries.exampleZh: 这些新规定将有益于我们学校的每一位学生。

entries.example: His bid for the old painting was too low.
entries.exampleZh: 他对那幅旧画作的出价太低了。

entries.example: Please do not blame me for the late bus.
entries.exampleZh: 请不要因为公交车晚点而责怪我。

entries.example: May God bless you and your whole family.
entries.exampleZh: 愿上帝保佑你和你的全家。

entries.example: Dark clouds block the sun on rainy days.
entries.exampleZh: 乌云在雨天挡住了太阳。

entries.example: The guard found a bogus ticket in his bag.
entries.exampleZh: 警卫在他包里发现了一张假票。

entries.example: A short holiday can boost your mood and give you new energy.
entries.exampleZh: 短暂的假期能提振你的情绪，给你新的活力。

entries.example: Sorry to bother you, but could you help me for a minute?
entries.exampleZh: 抱歉打扰你，你能帮我一下吗？

entries.example: The river is very broad here, so the bridge is quite long.
entries.exampleZh: 这里的河面很宽，所以这座桥相当长。

entries.example: We must plan our budget carefully before the trip next month.
entries.exampleZh: 下个月旅行前我们必须仔细规划预算。

entries.example: Caring for three children alone is a heavy burden for her.
entries.exampleZh: 独自照顾三个孩子对她来说是沉重的负担。

entries.example: The travel bureau on Main Street opens at nine every morning.
entries.exampleZh: 主街上的旅行社办事处每天早上九点开门。

entries.example: Please calculate the total cost before you pay the bill.
entries.exampleZh: 付账之前请先计算一下总费用。

entries.example: Our school started a campaign to collect books for the library.
entries.exampleZh: 我们学校发起了一场为图书馆捐书的活动。

entries.example: They had to cancel the picnic because of the heavy rain.
entries.exampleZh: 由于大雨，他们不得不取消野餐。

entries.meaning: 申请求职者；投考者；候选人
entries.example: Each candidate will speak for five minutes at the meeting.
entries.exampleZh: 每位候选人将在会上发言五分钟。

entries.example: We usually eat lunch in the school canteen at noon.
entries.exampleZh: 我们通常中午在学校食堂吃午饭。

entries.example: She is a capable worker and finishes every task on time.
entries.exampleZh: 她是个能干的员工，每项任务都按时完成。

entries.example: The caregiver helps my grandmother walk in the garden each day.
entries.exampleZh: 这位照料者每天帮助我奶奶在花园里散步。

entries.example: His careless mistake cost the team an important point.
entries.exampleZh: 他粗心的失误让球队丢掉了一分。

entries.example: He wore casual clothes to the party last Saturday evening.
entries.exampleZh: 上周六晚上他穿着随便的衣服去参加聚会。

entries.example: Please catalogue these new books before the shop opens.
entries.exampleZh: 请在商店开门前把这些新书编入目录。

entries.example: Please use caution when you cross this busy road.
entries.exampleZh: 过这条繁忙的马路时请小心。

entries.example: Be cautious when you walk on the wet floor.
entries.exampleZh: 走在湿滑的地板上时要小心。

entries.example: The wedding ceremony took place in a small old church.
entries.exampleZh: 婚礼仪式在一座古老的小教堂里举行。

entries.example: Learning a new language is a big challenge for many adults.
entries.exampleZh: 学习一门新语言对许多成年人来说是个巨大的挑战。

entries.example: That young chap helped me carry my bags to the station.
entries.exampleZh: 那个小伙子帮我把包搬到了车站。

entries.example: My favourite character in this book is a brave young girl.
entries.exampleZh: 这本书里我最喜欢的角色是一个勇敢的小女孩。

entries.example: Large windows and bright colours characterize this new library.
entries.exampleZh: 大窗户和明亮的颜色是这座新图书馆的特色。

entries.example: She gives her old clothes to charity every spring.
entries.exampleZh: 她每年春天都把旧衣服捐给慈善机构。

entries.example: A small tear ran slowly down her left cheek.
entries.exampleZh: 一滴小小的泪水慢慢流下她的左脸颊。

entries.example: The chef in this small restaurant cooks wonderful fish soup.
entries.exampleZh: 这家小餐馆的厨师做的鱼汤很棒。

entries.meaning: 化学的 n. 化学制品
entries.example: Farmers here must not use chemical sprays near the river.
entries.exampleZh: 这里的农民不得在河边使用化学喷剂。

entries.example: Too much smoke can choke a person very quickly.
entries.exampleZh: 太多的烟会很快使人窒息。

entries.example: Under no circumstance should you open this door alone.
entries.exampleZh: 在任何情况下你都不应独自打开这扇门。

entries.example: Please cite the name of the writer in your report.
entries.exampleZh: 请在你的报告里引用这位作者的名字。

entries.example: Every citizen should vote in the local election.
entries.exampleZh: 每位公民都应该在地方选举中投票。

entries.example: The soldiers helped every civilian leave the dangerous area.
entries.exampleZh: 士兵们帮助每一位平民离开了危险地区。

entries.example: Talking calmly is the civilized way to solve a problem.
entries.exampleZh: 冷静交谈是解决问题的文明方式。

entries.example: Scientists classify these animals by the food they eat.
entries.exampleZh: 科学家根据这些动物所吃的食物对它们进行分类。

entries.example: The classification of these plants takes a long time.
entries.exampleZh: 对这些植物进行分类需要很长时间。

entries.example: Our client wants to see the new plan today.
entries.exampleZh: 我们的客户今天想看看新方案。

entries.example: The small clinic near my house opens at eight.
entries.exampleZh: 我家附近那家小诊所八点开门。

entries.example: He is a bit clumsy when he dances.
entries.exampleZh: 他跳舞的时候有点笨拙。

entries.example: Our coach told us to run faster in the second half.
entries.exampleZh: 教练让我们在下半场跑得更快。

entries.example: My colleague helped me finish the report on Friday.
entries.exampleZh: 我的同事周五帮我完成了这份报告。

entries.example: The collision damaged both cars near the school gate.
entries.exampleZh: 这场碰撞损坏了学校大门附近的两辆车。

entries.example: We can combine our ideas to make a better plan.
entries.exampleZh: 我们可以把各自的想法结合起来，制定一个更好的计划。

entries.example: Her comment about my cooking made everyone laugh.
entries.exampleZh: 她对我做的菜的评论让大家都笑了。

entries.example: He refused to commit to such a long project.
entries.exampleZh: 他拒绝承诺参与这么长期的项目。

entries.example: Her commitment to the team helped us win the game.
entries.exampleZh: 她对球队的承诺帮助我们赢得了比赛。

entries.example: The committee will meet on Friday to discuss the plan.
entries.exampleZh: 委员会将于周五开会讨论这个计划。

entries.example: Please compare these two pictures and tell me the differences.
entries.exampleZh: 请比较这两张图片，然后告诉我不同之处。

entries.example: The bad weather may compel us to stay at home.
entries.exampleZh: 恶劣的天气可能迫使我们待在家里。

entries.example: Nothing can compensate for the loss of a good friend.
entries.exampleZh: 失去一位好朋友，什么都无法弥补。

entries.example: The company offered him money as compensation for the damage.
entries.exampleZh: 公司给他钱，作为对损坏的补偿。

entries.example: Small shops often compete with big stores for customers.
entries.exampleZh: 小商店常常为了顾客与大店竞争。

entries.example: The new training program improved our team's competitiveness.
entries.exampleZh: 新的培训项目提高了我们团队的竞争力。

entries.example: Each competitor must wear a number during the race.
entries.exampleZh: 每位参赛者在比赛时都必须佩戴号码。

entries.example: There is no room for complacency after one good result.
entries.exampleZh: 取得一次好成绩之后没有自满的余地。

entries.example: Some people complain about the noise from the street.
entries.exampleZh: 有些人抱怨街上的噪音。

entries.example: The manager listened carefully to every customer complaint.
entries.exampleZh: 经理认真听取了每位顾客的投诉。

entries.example: Please complete the form and give it to the teacher.
entries.exampleZh: 请填完这张表格，然后交给老师。

entries.example: This map is too complicated for a young child.
entries.exampleZh: 这张地图对小孩子来说太复杂了。

entries.example: All visitors must comply with the safety rules here.
entries.exampleZh: 所有访客都必须遵守这里的安全规定。

entries.example: Trust is an important component of any good friendship.
entries.exampleZh: 信任是任何良好友谊的重要组成部分。

entries.example: Good concentration helps you finish your homework much faster.
entries.exampleZh: 良好的专注力能帮你更快地完成作业。

entries.example: The idea of freedom is a difficult concept for young children.
entries.exampleZh: 自由这一观念对小孩子来说是个很难的概念。

entries.example: These new rules concern every student in our school.
entries.exampleZh: 这些新规定关系到我们学校的每一位学生。

entries.example: After a long talk, we reached the same conclusion.
entries.exampleZh: 经过长谈，我们得出了相同的结论。

entries.example: She speaks English with a lot of confidence now.

entries.example: You cannot exclude him from the team meeting.
entries.exampleZh: 你不能把他排除在团队会议之外。

entries.example: The company plans to expand into three new markets.
entries.exampleZh: 公司计划扩展到三个新市场。

entries.example: They want to exploit the coal under these hills.
entries.exampleZh: 他们想要开采这些山下面的煤。

entries.example: Let us explore the old town on foot tomorrow.
entries.exampleZh: 明天我们步行去探索这座老城吧。

entries.example: A loud explosion woke everyone in the building last night.
entries.exampleZh: 昨晚一声巨大的爆炸把大楼里的每个人都惊醒了。

entries.example: Do not expose your skin to the sun for too long.
entries.exampleZh: 不要让你的皮肤在阳光下暴露太久。

entries.example: Long exposure to loud music can harm your hearing.
entries.exampleZh: 长时间暴露在嘈杂的音乐中会损害你的听力。

entries.example: Her expressiveness on stage made the story feel very real.
entries.exampleZh: 她在舞台上的表现力让整个故事显得非常真实。

entries.example: Please call my extension if you need any help today.
entries.exampleZh: 如果你今天需要任何帮助，请打我的分机。

entries.example: She joins extracurricular activities every week after her classes end.
entries.exampleZh: 她每周下课后都会参加课外活动。

entries.example: The new sports facility opens to students next Monday morning.
entries.exampleZh: 新的体育设施下周一早上向学生开放。

entries.example: I have great faith in your ability to pass this exam.
entries.exampleZh: 我非常相信你有能力通过这次考试。

entries.example: This song sounds very familiar to me for some reason.
entries.exampleZh: 不知为什么，这首歌听起来对我很熟悉。

entries.example: Sometimes I fantasize about living on a quiet island.
entries.exampleZh: 有时我会幻想住在一个安静的小岛上。

entries.example: Space and stars fascinate my little brother every single night.
entries.exampleZh: 太空和星星每晚都让我弟弟着迷。

entries.example: Her fascination with old maps began when she was ten.
entries.exampleZh: 她对旧地图的着迷始于十岁那年。

entries.example: That one mistake proved fatal to the whole plan.
entries.exampleZh: 那一个错误对整个计划来说是致命的。

entries.example: Nobody knows what fate has planned for our small town.
entries.exampleZh: 没有人知道命运为我们的小镇安排了什么。

entries.example: After the long hike, fatigue made every step feel heavy.
entries.exampleZh: 长途徒步之后，疲劳让每一步都变得沉重。

entries.example: The teacher gave a favorable comment on my new essay.
entries.exampleZh: 老师对我的新文章给予了赞同的评语。

entries.example: Is it feasible to finish this project by Friday afternoon?
entries.exampleZh: 在周五下午之前完成这个项目可行吗？

entries.example: The best feature of this phone is its small size.
entries.exampleZh: 这部手机最大的特点是它体积小。

entries.example: Please send me your feedback about the new class.
entries.exampleZh: 请把你对新课程的反馈发给我。

entries.example: She reads fiction every night before going to sleep.
entries.exampleZh: 她每晚睡觉前都会读小说。

entries.example: The main figure in the story is a brave young girl.
entries.exampleZh: 故事里的主要人物是一个勇敢的小女孩。

entries.example: The company shared its financial report with all the workers.
entries.exampleZh: 公司把它的财务报告分享给了所有员工。

entries.example: He studies finance at a large university in the north.
entries.exampleZh: 他在北方的一所大型大学学习财政。

entries.example: The police can fine you for parking in this space.
entries.exampleZh: 警察可能会因为你把车停在这个位置而罚款。

entries.example: Regular exercise is important for your fitness and health.
entries.exampleZh: 经常锻炼对你的健康和体能很重要。

entries.example: My work hours are flexible, so I can start early.
entries.exampleZh: 我的工作时间很灵活，所以我可以早点开始。

entries.meaning: 立足处（攀登时脚踩的地方）
entries.example: He found a safe foothold on the rock and climbed higher.
entries.exampleZh: 他在岩石上找到一个安全的立足处，然后继续往上爬。

entries.example: The team will formulate a new plan for next year.
entries.exampleZh: 团队将为明年制定一个新计划。

entries.example: Fortunately, nobody was hurt in the accident this morning.
entries.exampleZh: 幸运的是，今天早上的事故中没有人受伤。

entries.example: Workers poured concrete for the foundation of the new house.
entries.exampleZh: 工人们为新房子的地基浇筑了混凝土。

entries.example: Loud noises can frighten small animals in the forest.
entries.exampleZh: 巨大的噪音会吓到森林里的小动物。

entries.example: Soldiers guard the frontier between the two countries.
entries.exampleZh: 士兵们守卫着两国之间的边境。

entries.example: This button has a special function on the new machine.
entries.exampleZh: 这个按钮在新机器上有一个特殊功能。

entries.example: The school set up a fund to help poor students.
entries.exampleZh: 学校设立了一项基金来帮助贫困学生。

entries.example: Please do not make a fuss about such a small problem.
entries.exampleZh: 请不要为这么小的问题大惊小怪。

entries.example: Gambling is illegal in some countries and can cause problems.
entries.exampleZh: 赌博在一些国家是非法的，而且会带来问题。

entries.example: There is a small gap between the door and the floor.
entries.exampleZh: 门和地板之间有一条小缝隙。

entries.example: Dad parked the car in the garage and closed the door.
entries.exampleZh: 爸爸把车停在车库里，然后关上了门。

entries.example: The mechanic checked every gear in the old engine.
entries.exampleZh: 技工检查了旧发动机里的每一个齿轮。

entries.example: The form asks for your name, age and gender.
entries.exampleZh: 这张表格要求填写你的姓名、年龄和性别。

entries.example: It is a generalization to say all cats hate water.
entries.exampleZh: 说所有的猫都讨厌水是一种一概而论的说法。

entries.example: My generation grew up with the internet and mobile phones.
entries.exampleZh: 我们这一代人是伴随着互联网和手机长大的。

entries.example: Her generosity helped many families during the difficult winter.
entries.exampleZh: 她的慷慨帮助许多家庭度过了那个艰难的冬天。

entries.example: My aunt is very generous with her time and money.
entries.exampleZh: 我姑姑在时间和金钱上都非常慷慨。

entries.example: This bag is made of genuine leather, not plastic.
entries.exampleZh: 这个包是真皮做的，不是塑料的。

entries.example: I bought a small gift for my mother's birthday.
entries.exampleZh: 我给妈妈买了一份小小的生日礼物。

entries.example: The sky looks gloomy, so take an umbrella with you.
entries.exampleZh: 天空看起来很阴沉，你带把伞吧。

entries.example: We had a glorious day at the beach last Sunday.
entries.exampleZh: 上周日我们在海滩度过了美好的一天。

entries.example: Please grab a seat before the show starts.
entries.exampleZh: 请在演出开始前赶快找个座位。

entries.example: I stopped at the grocery store to buy milk and bread.
entries.exampleZh: 我在杂货店停下来买了牛奶和面包。

entries.example: She accused him groundlessly, and he felt very hurt.
entries.exampleZh: 她无缘无故地指责了他，他感到很受伤。

entries.example: I cannot guarantee that the train will arrive on time.
entries.exampleZh: 我无法保证火车会准时到达。

entries.example: Please read the safety guideline before you use this machine.
entries.exampleZh: 使用这台机器之前，请先阅读安全指导原则。

entries.example: He felt a deep sense of guilt about the lie.
entries.exampleZh: 他对那个谎言感到深深的内疚。

entries.example: I go to the gym three times a week.
entries.exampleZh: 我每周去健身房三次。

entries.example: She can handle this difficult job without any help.
entries.exampleZh: 她能不要任何帮助就处理这份艰难的工作。

entries.example: Our new teacher is patient, kind and very hardworking.
entries.exampleZh: 我们新来的老师耐心、友善，而且非常勤勉。

entries.example: Too much sun can harm your skin in summer.
entries.exampleZh: 夏天过多的阳光会伤害你的皮肤。

entries.example: Smoking is harmful to your health and to others.
entries.exampleZh: 吸烟对你的健康和他人的健康都有害。

entries.example: The two families live together in peace and harmony.
entries.exampleZh: 这两个家庭安宁和睦地生活在一起。

entries.example: The winter here is long and very harsh.
entries.exampleZh: 这里的冬天漫长而非常严酷。

entries.example: Ice on the road is a serious hazard for drivers.
entries.exampleZh: 路上的冰对司机来说是个严重的危险。

entries.example: The highlight of our trip was the boat ride.
entries.exampleZh: 我们旅行中最精彩的部分是乘船游览。

entries.example: The shop will hire two new workers next week.
entries.exampleZh: 这家商店下周将雇用两名新工人。

entries.example: My aunt is a homemaker and takes care of three children.
entries.exampleZh: 我姑姑是个主妇，要照顾三个孩子。

entries.example: Her honesty about the mistake made everyone trust her more.
entries.exampleZh: 她对这个错误的诚实让大家更加信任她。

entries.example: We will honor the soldiers who gave their lives for us.
entries.exampleZh: 我们将纪念那些为我们献出生命的士兵。

entries.example: The doctors had to hospitalize him after the bad accident.
entries.exampleZh: 那场严重的事故之后，医生们不得不送他住院。

entries.example: Our household has five people and two small dogs.
entries.exampleZh: 我们一家有五口人和两只小狗。

entries.example: The teacher said humanity must work together to save the planet.
entries.exampleZh: 老师说人类必须共同努力拯救地球。

entries.example: The two sisters wore identical dresses to the party.
entries.exampleZh: 两姐妹穿着完全相同的裙子去参加聚会。

entries.example: Can you identify the man in this old photograph?
entries.exampleZh: 你能认出这张老照片里的那个男人吗？

entries.meaning: 鉴定，识别；认同；身份证明
entries.example: Please bring some identification when you come to the office.
entries.exampleZh: 你来办公室时请带上身份证明。

entries.example: The police are trying to find out his true identity.
entries.exampleZh: 警察正试图查明他的真实身份。

entries.example: His ignorance of the rules caused a lot of trouble.
entries.exampleZh: 他对规则的无知引起了很多麻烦。

entries.example: Please do not ignore my calls when you are busy.
entries.exampleZh: 你忙的时候请别不接我的电话。

entries.example: It is illegal to park your car here on Sundays.
entries.exampleZh: 星期天在这里停车是违法的。

entries.example: Let me illustrate my idea with a simple drawing.
entries.exampleZh: 让我用一幅简单的图来说明我的想法。

entries.example: The company wants a better image among young people.
entries.exampleZh: 这家公司想在年轻人中树立更好的形象。

entries.example: The little girl told us about her imaginary friend.
entries.exampleZh: 那个小女孩跟我们讲了她想象中的朋友。

entries.example: The heavy stone table is immobile and cannot be moved.
entries.exampleZh: 那张沉重的石桌固定不动，搬不起来。

entries.example: The new law had a big impact on small businesses.
entries.exampleZh: 这项新法律对小企业有很大的影响。

entries.meaning: 非永久（性）的；不持久的，暂时的
entries.example: Fame is often impermanent and can disappear very quickly.
entries.exampleZh: 名气往往并不持久，可能很快就会消失。

entries.example: The teacher spoke about the impermanency of fame and success.
entries.exampleZh: 老师谈到了名声与成功的非永久性。

entries.example: The school will implement the new rules next month.
entries.exampleZh: 学校将在下个月实施新规定。

entries.example: I do not mean to imply that you are wrong.
entries.exampleZh: 我不是想暗示你错了。

entries.example: The country must import most of its oil each year.
entries.exampleZh: 这个国家每年必须进口大部分石油。

entries.example: Please do not impose your views on other people.
entries.exampleZh: 请不要把你的看法强加给别人。

entries.example: It is improper to wear shorts to a formal dinner.
entries.exampleZh: 穿短裤参加正式晚宴是不合适的。

entries.example: The old computer is inadequate for this new software.
entries.exampleZh: 这台旧电脑对于这个新软件来说不够用。

entries.example: That joke was inappropriate for a family dinner.
entries.exampleZh: 那个玩笑在家庭聚餐上不合适。

entries.example: The price does not include breakfast or evening meals.
entries.exampleZh: 这个价格不包含早餐和晚餐。

entries.example: The view from the mountain top was incredible.
entries.exampleZh: 从山顶看到的景色令人难以置信。

entries.example: The dark clouds indicate that rain is coming soon.
entries.exampleZh: 乌云表明很快就要下雨了。

entries.example: A good dictionary is indispensable for serious language learners.
entries.exampleZh: 一本好词典对认真的语言学习者来说必不可少。

entries.example: Each individual in the group must pay ten dollars.
entries.exampleZh: 团体中的每个人都必须付十美元。

entries.example: Nothing could induce him to change his mind.
entries.exampleZh: 什么也不能诱使他改变主意。

entries.example: After such heavy rain, floods are inevitable in this area.
entries.exampleZh: 这么大的雨后，这个地区洪水是不可避免的。

entries.example: The universe seems infinite to the human mind.
entries.exampleZh: 宇宙对人类的心智而言似乎是无限的。

entries.example: High inflation makes everyday food much more expensive.
entries.exampleZh: 高通货膨胀使日常食物贵了很多。

entries.example: We used a small pump to inflate the tires.
entries.exampleZh: 我们用一个小气泵给轮胎充了气。

entries.example: His teacher had a strong influence on his choice.
entries.exampleZh: 他的老师对他的选择有很大的影响。

entries.example: She is one of the most influential writers today.
entries.exampleZh: 她是当今最有影响力的作家之一。

entries.example: Flour is the main ingredient in this simple bread recipe.
entries.exampleZh: 面粉是这个简单面包配方的主要原料。

entries.example: She will inherit her grandmother's small house next spring.
entries.exampleZh: 明年春天她将继承她祖母的小房子。

entries.example: The school will initiate a new reading program next month.
entries.exampleZh: 学校下个月将发起一项新的阅读计划。

entries.example: Our team took the initiative to clean the park on Sunday.
entries.exampleZh: 我们队主动在周日清理了公园。

entries.example: He did not want to injure his back again.
entries.exampleZh: 他不想再次伤到自己的背。

entries.example: The judge said the young man was innocent of the crime.
entries.exampleZh: 法官说那个年轻人无罪。

entries.example: This small phone shows real innovation in its simple design.
entries.exampleZh: 这款小手机在其简洁设计中展现了真正的创新。

entries.example: The old wooden bridge looks insecure to most drivers.
entries.exampleZh: 那座旧木桥在大多数司机看来不安全。

entries.example: Her book gives useful insight into village life in China.
entries.exampleZh: 她的书让人深入了解中国的乡村生活。

entries.example: The quiet lake was a great inspiration for his new song.
entries.exampleZh: 那片安静的湖是他新歌的巨大灵感来源。

entries.example: Good teachers inspire students to ask more questions in class.
entries.exampleZh: 好老师激励学生在课堂上多提问。

entries.example: We plan to install a new fan in the kitchen.
entries.exampleZh: 我们打算在厨房里装一台新风扇。

entries.example: The installation of the new lights took two full days.
entries.exampleZh: 新灯的安装花了整整两天。

entries.example: He pays for the car in a monthly installment.
entries.exampleZh: 他按月分期付款买这辆车。

entries.meaning: 立即的；紧急的；速溶的，方便的
entries.example: This instant soup is ready in just three minutes.
entries.exampleZh: 这种速溶汤只需三分钟就能做好。

entries.example: They plan to institute a new rule about phone use.
entries.exampleZh: 他们打算制定一条关于使用手机的新规定。

entries.meaning: 社会公共机构；制度，习俗；设立，制定
entries.example: The old library is an important institution in our town.
entries.exampleZh: 那座老图书馆是我们镇上重要的公共机构。

entries.example: Please read the instruction on the box before you start.
entries.exampleZh: 开始前请阅读盒子上的说明。

entries.example: The coach will instruct the young players on safe running.
entries.exampleZh: 教练将指导年轻球员安全跑步。

entries.example: The doctor cleaned the small instrument before using it.
entries.exampleZh: 医生在使用前把那个小器械擦干净了。

entries.example: Too much sugar intake can harm your health over time.
entries.exampleZh: 摄入过多糖分长期下来会损害你的健康。

entries.example: Engineers checked the structural integrity of the old bridge.
entries.exampleZh: 工程师们检查了那座旧桥的结构完整性。

entries.example: She showed great intelligence when solving the difficult math problem.
entries.exampleZh: 她在解那道数学难题时表现出很高的智慧。

entries.example: My phone has a very intelligent camera system.
entries.exampleZh: 我的手机有一个非常智能的相机系统。

entries.example: We intend to visit our grandparents next weekend.
entries.exampleZh: 我们打算下周末去看望祖父母。

entries.example: These small roads interconnect to form a busy network.
entries.exampleZh: 这些小道路相互连接，形成一个繁忙的网络。

entries.example: The interdependence of these two countries helps their economies grow.
entries.exampleZh: 这两个国家的相互依赖帮助它们的经济增长。

entries.example: Can you interpret these strange symbols for me?
entries.exampleZh: 你能为我解释这些奇怪的符号吗？

entries.example: Their interracial marriage was accepted by both families.
entries.exampleZh: 他们的跨种族婚姻得到了双方家庭的接受。

entries.example: The doctor's quick intervention saved the patient's life.
entries.exampleZh: 医生的迅速干预挽救了病人的生命。

entries.example: I have a job interview tomorrow morning at nine.
entries.exampleZh: 我明天早上九点有一场工作面试。

entries.example: Soldiers from the north tried to invade the small town.
entries.exampleZh: 来自北方的士兵试图入侵这个小镇。

entries.example: Your ticket is invalid because the date has passed.
entries.exampleZh: 你的票无效，因为日期已经过了。

entries.example: They plan to invest more money in clean energy.
entries.exampleZh: 他们计划在清洁能源上投入更多资金。

entries.example: The new project will involve a lot of extra work.
entries.exampleZh: 这个新项目将包含很多额外的工作。

entries.example: He acted irrationally and shouted at his best friend.
entries.exampleZh: 他行为不理性，对着最好的朋友大喊大叫。

entries.example: Loud noises really irritate me in the morning.
entries.exampleZh: 早上的吵闹声真的让我很烦。

entries.example: The magazine will issue a special edition next month.
entries.exampleZh: 这本杂志下个月将发行一期特刊。

entries.example: Please read every item on the list carefully.
entries.exampleZh: 请仔细阅读清单上的每一项。

entries.example: The two schools started a joint music program.
entries.exampleZh: 这两所学校启动了一个联合音乐项目。

entries.example: She watched the match keenly and noticed every small mistake.
entries.exampleZh: 她敏锐地观看比赛，注意到了每一个小错误。

entries.example: They plan to launch a new satellite next month.
entries.exampleZh: 他们计划下个月发射一颗新卫星。

entries.example: The laundry room is on the second floor of our building.
entries.exampleZh: 洗衣房在我们这栋楼的二楼。

entries.example: You should ask a lawyer about the legal side of this deal.
entries.exampleZh: 你应该向律师咨询这笔交易的法律方面。

entries.example: In her leisure time she enjoys reading and walking in the park.
entries.exampleZh: 在空闲时间，她喜欢读书和在公园散步。

entries.example: After a lengthy discussion, the group finally reached an agreement.
entries.exampleZh: 经过漫长的讨论，这群人终于达成了协议。

entries.example: The company accepted liability for the damage to the cars.
entries.exampleZh: 公司承担了车辆损坏的责任。

entries.example: She studies English literature at a university in the north.
entries.exampleZh: 她在北方的一所大学学习英国文学。

entries.example: He took out a bank loan to buy his first house.
entries.exampleZh: 他办了一笔银行贷款来买第一套房子。

entries.example: Please help me locate the nearest bus stop on this map.
entries.exampleZh: 请帮我在这张地图上找到最近的公交车站。

entries.example: We will lodge in a small hotel near the station tonight.
entries.exampleZh: 今晚我们将住在车站附近的一家小旅馆。

entries.example: I cannot follow the logic of his argument at all.
entries.exampleZh: 我完全跟不上他论证的逻辑。

entries.example: Her loyalty to the team never changed during those hard years.
entries.exampleZh: 在那些艰难的岁月里，她对球队的忠诚从未改变。

entries.example: This idea has slowly entered the mainstream of modern science.
entries.exampleZh: 这个想法慢慢进入了现代科学的主流。

entries.example: It is hard to maintain a friendship across long distances.
entries.exampleZh: 远距离维持友谊很难。

entries.example: Traffic is a major problem in most large cities today.
entries.exampleZh: 交通是如今大多数大城市的主要问题。

entries.example: The majority of students voted for a shorter lunch break.
entries.exampleZh: 大多数学生投票支持缩短午休时间。

entries.example: She put on some makeup before the party started.
entries.exampleZh: 她在聚会开始前化了一点妆。

entries.example: A technical malfunction stopped the train for almost two hours.
entries.exampleZh: 一次技术故障使火车停了将近两个小时。

entries.example: They manufacture these bicycles in a factory near the coast.
entries.exampleZh: 他们在海岸附近的一家工厂生产这些自行车。

entries.exampleZh: 工业革命改变了数百万人的生活。

entries.exampleZh: 她因为找到了丢失的钥匙而得到了一点小奖励。

entries.exampleZh: 狂暴的人群向警察扔瓶子并大喊大叫。

entries.exampleZh: 火箭今天清晨飞入了太空。

entries.example: The nurses routinely check each patient every two hours.
entries.exampleZh: 护士们照例每两小时检查一次每位病人。

entries.example: Many people visit the church to pray to this saint.
entries.exampleZh: 许多人来教堂向这位圣人祈祷。

entries.example: We should save water when we wash the dishes.

entries.exampleZh: 我这周的日程表排得很满。

entries.example: She won a scholarship to study in Canada.
entries.exampleZh: 她获得了去加拿大学习的奖学金。

entries.example: The scope of this project is quite large.
entries.exampleZh: 这个项目的范围相当大。

entries.exampleZh: 我的车门上有一道长长的划痕。

entries.example: Doctors screen patients for this disease every year.
entries.exampleZh: 医生每年都会对病人进行这种疾病的筛查。

entries.exampleZh: 请用一把结实的锁把你的自行车锁好。

entries.exampleZh: 他很少在外面吃饭，因为他喜欢做饭。

entries.exampleZh: 这所学校在招收学生方面非常挑剔。

entries.exampleZh: 他拿了最后一个座位，真是自私。

entries.example: My skin is very sensitive to strong sunlight.
entries.exampleZh: 我的皮肤对强烈的阳光很敏感。

entries.exampleZh: 请把每件礼物分别包好，然后再放进盒子里。

entries.exampleZh: 上午的会议九点在大厅开始。

entries.exampleZh: 这场暴风雨给许多小房子造成了严重的损坏。

entries.exampleZh: 这个坏消息会让他全家感到震惊。

entries.exampleZh: 我们穿过公园抄近路以节省时间。

entries.example: His showmanship made the simple magic trick very exciting.
entries.exampleZh: 他的表演技巧让这个简单的魔术变得非常精彩。

entries.example: We went sightseeing around the old city all day.
entries.exampleZh: 我们一整天都在老城区观光。

entries.example: The phone signal is weak inside this building.
entries.exampleZh: 这栋楼里手机信号很弱。

entries.example: This test is a significant part of your final grade.
entries.exampleZh: 这次考试占你期末成绩的重要部分。

entries.example: These two blue jackets look very similar, but their prices are different.
entries.exampleZh: 这两件蓝色夹克看起来非常相似，但它们的价格不同。

entries.exampleZh: 她答案的简单让教室里的每个人都很惊讶。

entries.example: The new school site is near the river and the park.
entries.exampleZh: 新校址靠近河流和公园。

entries.example: This situation is difficult, but we can solve it together.
entries.exampleZh: 这种情况很困难，但我们可以一起解决它。

entries.example: Prices for fresh fruit skyrocket during the cold winter months.
entries.exampleZh: 寒冷冬季的几个月里，新鲜水果的价格猛涨。

entries.example: The museum shows how one slave escaped and found freedom.
entries.exampleZh: 博物馆展示了一名奴隶如何逃脱并获得自由。

entries.example: We often socialize with our neighbors at the weekend market.
entries.exampleZh: 我们常在周末市场与邻居交往。

entries.exampleZh: 这个问题的简单解决办法也许能为我们节省时间。

entries.example: Do you have any spare time after work on Friday?
entries.exampleZh: 周五下班后你有空闲时间吗？

entries.example: Many doctors specialize in helping children with sleep problems.
entries.exampleZh: 许多医生专门帮助有睡眠问题的儿童。

entries.example: Please give me a specific example so I can understand.
entries.exampleZh: 请给我一个具体的例子，这样我就能理解。

entries.exampleZh: 请具体说明我们下次会议的时间和地点。

entries.example: A local bank will sponsor the school sports day this year.
entries.exampleZh: 一家本地银行将赞助今年的学校运动会。

entries.example: Her spontaneous laugh made everyone in the room feel happy.
entries.exampleZh: 她自发的笑声让房间里的每个人都感到快乐。

entries.example: Good news can spread quickly through a small town.
entries.exampleZh: 好消息能在小镇里迅速传播。

entries.example: The company wants to standardize its forms across all offices.
entries.exampleZh: 公司希望把所有办公室的表格标准化。

entries.example: Loud noises at night can startle the baby and wake her.
entries.exampleZh: 夜里的巨响会吓到婴儿并把她吵醒。

entries.example: The patient is making steady progress after the operation.
entries.exampleZh: 手术后病人正在稳步好转。

entries.example: Someone tried to steal my bag on the crowded bus.
entries.exampleZh: 有人试图在拥挤的公交车上偷我的包。

entries.example: You must steer the boat carefully around the large rocks.
entries.exampleZh: 你必须小心地驾驶小船绕过巨石。

entries.example: That idea about lazy students is just an unfair stereotype.
entries.exampleZh: 那种认为学生懒惰的看法只是一种不公平的刻板印象。

entries.example: Good teachers can stimulate real interest in every subject.
entries.exampleZh: 好老师能激发学生对每门科目的真正兴趣。

entries.example: The store has plenty of stock in the back room.
entries.exampleZh: 这家店后面的房间里有很多库存。

entries.example: Our teacher shared a simple strategy for learning new words.
entries.exampleZh: 我们老师分享了一个学习新单词的简单策略。

entries.meaning: 充满著压力的，充满著紧张的

entries.exampleZh: 考试前的那一周对我来说总是压力很大。

entries.example: Too much stress can make it hard to sleep.
entries.exampleZh: 压力太大会让人难以入睡。

entries.example: Our teacher is strict but always fair to everyone.
entries.exampleZh: 我们的老师很严格，但对每个人总是很公平。

entries.example: The structure of the essay is clear and simple.
entries.exampleZh: 这篇文章的结构清晰又简单。

entries.example: Many young plants struggle in cold, dry weather.
entries.exampleZh: 许多幼苗在寒冷干燥的天气里难以存活。

entries.example: The city will subsidize bus fares for students.
entries.exampleZh: 市政府将为学生的公交车费提供补贴。

entries.example: She gave a substantial amount of money to charity.
entries.exampleZh: 她向慈善机构捐了一大笔钱。

entries.example: Many people suffer from headaches after long hours online.
entries.exampleZh: 许多人在长时间上网后会头痛。

entries.example: We have sufficient food for the whole week.
entries.exampleZh: 我们有足够的食物够吃整整一周。

entries.meaning: 上级的，较高的；上级，长官
entries.example: My superior asked me to finish the report today.
entries.exampleZh: 我的上级要求我今天完成这份报告。

entries.example: Young children need close supervision near the swimming pool.
entries.exampleZh: 幼儿在游泳池附近需要密切看护。

entries.example: I suppose we should leave before the traffic gets bad.
entries.exampleZh: 我想我们应该在交通变糟之前离开。

entries.example: They love to surf on the big waves near the beach.
entries.exampleZh: 他们喜欢在海滩附近的大浪上冲浪。

entries.example: The school survey asked about our favorite after-school activities.
entries.exampleZh: 学校的调查询问了我们最喜欢的课外活动。

entries.example: I suspect the keys are somewhere on the kitchen table.
entries.exampleZh: 我怀疑钥匙就在厨房桌子上的某个地方。

entries.example: Farmers need healthy soil to sustain good crops each year.
entries.exampleZh: 农民需要健康的土壤才能每年维持好收成。

entries.example: Our new farm uses sustainable methods to grow healthy food.
entries.exampleZh: 我们的新农场采用可持续的方法种植健康食品。

entries.example: The team made a swift recovery after the long journey.
entries.exampleZh: 长途旅行之后，队伍迅速地恢复了体力。

entries.example: Please switch off the lights before you leave the room.
entries.exampleZh: 离开房间前请把灯关掉。

entries.example: The white dove is a symbol of peace around the world.
entries.exampleZh: 白鸽是全世界和平的象征。

entries.example: She felt deep sympathy for the family after the fire.
entries.exampleZh: 那场火灾之后，她对这家人深感同情。

entries.exampleZh: 这座城市必须处理垃圾过多的问题。

entries.example: We can tailor the course to meet your own needs.
entries.exampleZh: 我们可以调整课程来满足你自己的需求。

entries.exampleZh: 那架飞机的起飞晚了整整两个小时。

entries.example: The car's tank was almost empty on the highway.
entries.exampleZh: 在高速公路上，汽车的油箱几乎空了。

entries.example: The soup was tasteless and needed a little salt.
entries.exampleZh: 这汤没什么味道，需要加一点盐。

entries.exampleZh: 他问了一个关于新机器的技术问题。

entries.exampleZh: 经过几个月的练习，她的绘画技巧提高了很多。

entries.exampleZh: 一位技师来修理我们坏掉的洗衣机。

entries.exampleZh: 用手抄写所有这些数字是件单调沉闷的工作。

entries.exampleZh: 她抵挡住了吃掉最后一块巧克力蛋糕的诱惑。

entries.exampleZh: 那件事之后，你能感觉到房间里的紧张气氛。

entries.example: We put up our tent beside a quiet little river.
entries.exampleZh: 我们把帐篷搭在一条安静的小河边。

entries.example: I am terribly sorry for being late this morning.
entries.exampleZh: 今天早上迟到了，我非常抱歉。

entries.example: The doctor said this new therapy could help her walk.
entries.exampleZh: 医生说这种新疗法能帮助她走路。

entries.example: The angry dog began to threaten the small children.
entries.exampleZh: 那只愤怒的狗开始威胁那些小孩子。

entries.example: The tide comes in quickly along this quiet beach.
entries.exampleZh: 潮水沿着这片安静的海滩很快涌上来。

entries.example: Please tighten the lid on that bottle before you leave.
entries.exampleZh: 离开前请把那个瓶子上的盖子拧紧。

entries.exampleZh: 一只小鸟停在我窗外的墙上。

entries.exampleZh: 我们应该对想法不同的人多一些宽容。

entries.exampleZh: 我牙疼得厉害，什么都吃不下。

entries.example: The dog followed the track of a deer through the snow.
entries.exampleZh: 狗顺着雪地里鹿的足迹走。

entries.example: Honesty is the most important trait in a good friend.
entries.exampleZh: 诚实是一个好朋友最重要的品质。

entries.exampleZh: 银行不到一分钟就办完了我的交易。

entries.example: I need to transfer some money to my sister today.
entries.exampleZh: 我今天需要给妹妹转一些钱。

entries.example: Public transportation in this city is cheap and very fast.
entries.exampleZh: 这座城市的公共交通便宜又非常快。

entries.example: The doctor said my treatment would take about three weeks.
entries.exampleZh: 医生说我的治疗大约需要三周。

entries.example: Her hands began to tremble when she saw the big dog.
entries.exampleZh: 她看到那只大狗时，双手开始颤抖。

entries.example: Winning the final match was a great triumph for our team.
entries.exampleZh: 赢得决赛对我们队来说是一次巨大的胜利。

entries.example: The tuition for that college is too high for us.
entries.exampleZh: 那所大学的学费对我们来说太高了。

entries.example: The doctor found a small tumor in his left lung.
entries.exampleZh: 医生在他的左肺里发现了一个小肿瘤。

entries.example: She tried many jobs and ultimately became a famous cook.
entries.exampleZh: 她做过很多工作，最终成了一位有名的厨师。

entries.example: Houses in the city center are unaffordable for young families.
entries.exampleZh: 市中心的房子对年轻家庭来说负担不起。

entries.exampleZh: 我不确定我们下次会议的日期。

entries.example: Constant criticism can undermine a child's confidence over time.
entries.exampleZh: 不断的批评会慢慢破坏一个孩子的自信。

entries.exampleZh: 这个小村庄有着独特的古老房屋风格。

entries.meaning: 普遍的，宇宙的，全世界的
entries.example: Music is a universal language that brings people together.
entries.exampleZh: 音乐是一种把人们聚在一起的通用语言。

entries.example: Her strict upbringing taught her to respect other people.
entries.exampleZh: 她严格的教养教会她尊重他人。

entries.example: Please update the software before you use it again.
entries.exampleZh: 请在你再次使用它之前更新软件。

entries.example: Your ticket is valid for the whole day.
entries.exampleZh: 你的票一整天都有效。

entries.example: I value your help more than you know.
entries.exampleZh: 我比你想象的更重视你的帮助。

entries.exampleZh: 太阳很快就会消失在云层后面。

entries.example: A large vehicle blocked the road for ten minutes.
entries.exampleZh: 一辆大型车辆把路堵了十分钟。

entries.example: This new version of the game is much faster.
entries.exampleZh: 这个游戏的新版本快多了。

entries.example: Many people view him as a fair leader.
entries.exampleZh: 许多人把他看作一位公正的领导者。

entries.example: Drivers who violate the speed limit may pay a fine.
entries.exampleZh: 违反限速规定的司机可能要交罚款。

entries.example: Our team has virtually finished the work for today.
entries.exampleZh: 我们团队今天的工作差不多完成了。

entries.example: A new virus made many people stay at home.
entries.exampleZh: 一种新病毒使许多人待在家里。

entries.example: Heavy fog reduced visibility on the highway this morning.
entries.exampleZh: 今天早上浓雾降低了高速公路上的能见度。

entries.example: The mountain is clearly visible from my bedroom window.
entries.exampleZh: 从我的卧室窗户可以清楚地看到那座山。

entries.example: Sleep is vital for good health and clear thinking.
entries.exampleZh: 睡眠对健康和清晰的思考至关重要。

entries.example: Reading every day helps you build a larger vocabulary.
entries.exampleZh: 每天阅读能帮助你积累更大的词汇量。

entries.exampleZh: 公民可以在下周的选举中投票。

entries.exampleZh: 徒步前查看天气是明智的。

entries.exampleZh: 唯一的目击者从她的车里看到了那起事故。

entries.example: If he does not rest, his cough may worsen tonight.
entries.exampleZh: 如果他不休息，他的咳嗽今晚可能会加重。

entries.example: It is worthwhile to check the bus times before you leave.
entries.exampleZh: 出发前查一下公交车时刻表是值得的。

entries.example: The farmers hope for a good yield of rice this year.
entries.exampleZh: 农民们希望今年稻谷有个好收成。

entries.example: She gave a comprehensive report on the new school plan.
entries.exampleZh: 她就新的学校计划做了一份全面的报告。

entries.example: This jacket is made of cheap synthetic material.
entries.exampleZh: 这件夹克是用便宜的合成材料做的。

entries.example: All new students must undergo a short health check.
entries.exampleZh: 所有新生都必须接受一次简短的健康检查。

entries.exampleZh: 我们在乡村集市上买了新鲜的奶酪。

entries.example: The bakery near my house opens at six.
entries.exampleZh: 我家附近的面包店六点开门。

entries.exampleZh: 猫坐在她的膝盖上睡着了。

entries.example: He turned his head sideways to hear her better.
entries.exampleZh: 他把头侧过去，想更清楚地听她说话。

entries.exampleZh: 请用一杯水把这片药吞下去。

entries.exampleZh: 这双旧靴子的耐用程度让大家都感到惊讶。

entries.exampleZh: 在许多文化中，白鸽象征和平与希望。

entries.example: They believe in everlasting love and happy endings.
entries.exampleZh: 他们相信永恒的爱情和幸福的结局。

entries.example: My cousin's wedding will take place next month.
entries.exampleZh: 我表哥的婚礼将在下个月举行。

entries.example: An excess of salt can harm your health.
entries.exampleZh: 盐分过量会损害你的健康。

entries.exampleZh: 例如，许多鸟类在冬天飞往南方。

entries.example: The room is slightly cold, so please close the window.
entries.exampleZh: 房间有点冷，请把窗户关上。

entries.exampleZh: 我们计划明年开展一项小型研究。

entries.exampleZh: 她读那封信时开始皱起眉头。

entries.exampleZh: 出租车司机想因为我们这段短途多收钱。

entries.exampleZh: 暴风雨损坏了整个地区的输电网。

entries.exampleZh: 镇上两家商店的价格差别很大。

entries.exampleZh: 这个小变化是一个漫长进化过程的一部分。

entries.exampleZh: 心理学家问了我很多关于睡眠的问题。

entries.exampleZh: 你可以用蜂蜜作为糖的替代品。

entries.exampleZh: 我的老板明天上午将下达新的规定。

entries.exampleZh: 他们住在新公园附近一个安静的住宅分区。

entries.exampleZh: 公用事业公司这个月又提高了我们的账单。

entries.exampleZh: 市中心的房子对年轻家庭来说贵得让人难以承受。

entries.exampleZh: 这本书用简单的语言解释了生殖系统。

entries.exampleZh: 长时间的学习能让最优秀的学生也筋疲力尽。

entries.exampleZh: 这个机场同时处理国内和国际航班。

entries.exampleZh: 你能帮我拿一杯水吗？

entries.exampleZh: 公司将重新培训所有员工使用新系统。

entries.exampleZh: 科学家研究动植物的生物钟。

entries.example: Our perception of time changes when we are very busy.
entries.exampleZh: 当我们很忙的时候，我们对时间的感知会改变。

entries.exampleZh: 这些旧机器耗电太多了。
