entries.exampleZh: 这个决定完全基于测试结果。

entries.example: Patience is an important characteristic of a good teacher.
entries.exampleZh: 耐心是一位优秀教师的重要特点。

entries.example: The instructions for this new game are too complex for me.
entries.exampleZh: 这个新游戏的说明对我来说太复杂了。

entries.example: I sent him a message but got no response.
entries.exampleZh: 我给他发了消息，但没有收到回复。

entries.example: The birth rate in this country has fallen in recent years.
entries.exampleZh: 这个国家的出生率近年来下降了。

entries.example: She has a solid knowledge of English grammar.
entries.exampleZh: 她的英语语法知识很扎实。

entries.example: We need to prepare dinner before our guests arrive.
entries.exampleZh: 我们需要在客人到之前准备好晚饭。

entries.example: He was unwilling to answer the difficult question.
entries.exampleZh: 他不愿意回答那个难题。

entries.example: He is very mature for his age and rarely argues.
entries.exampleZh: 就他的年纪来说，他非常成熟，很少争吵。

entries.example: The deadline for the report is next Friday morning.
entries.exampleZh: 这份报告的最后期限是下周五上午。

entries.example: My grandfather is enjoying his retirement in the countryside.
entries.exampleZh: 我祖父正在乡下享受他的退休生活。

entries.example: The idea of working from home sounds very appealing to me.
entries.exampleZh: 在家工作的主意对我来说听起来很有吸引力。

entries.example: I could barely hear his voice on the phone.
entries.exampleZh: 我在电话里几乎听不见他的声音。

entries.example: The heat in this room is almost unbearable.
entries.exampleZh: 这个房间里的高温几乎让人无法忍受。

entries.example: They placed fresh flowers on the old grave.
entries.exampleZh: 他们在那座旧坟墓上放了鲜花。

entries.example: She did not understand the implication of his words.
entries.exampleZh: 她不明白他话里的含义。

entries.example: Could we please see the menu for dinner tonight?
entries.exampleZh: 我们今晚能看一下晚餐的菜单吗？

entries.example: From my standpoint, this plan needs more work.
entries.exampleZh: 从我的立场来看，这个计划还需要改进。

entries.example: People marched in the streets to demand justice for all.
entries.exampleZh: 人们上街游行，要求让人人享有公正。

entries.example: The film did not meet our expectation at all.
entries.exampleZh: 这部电影完全没有达到我们的期望。

entries.example: You should ask a professional lawyer for advice.
entries.exampleZh: 你应该向一位专业律师咨询。

entries.example: The old town has changed radically over the past ten years.
entries.exampleZh: 这座老城在过去十年里发生了彻底的变化。

entries.example: Her help was completely voluntary, and nobody asked her to do it.
entries.exampleZh: 她的帮助完全出于自愿，没有人要求她这么做。

entries.example: She learned to play the piano independently, without any teacher.
entries.exampleZh: 她自学弹钢琴，没有请任何老师。

entries.example: I favor the blue design because it looks simpler and cleaner.
entries.exampleZh: 我更偏爱蓝色的设计，因为它看起来更简洁、更清爽。

entries.example: His answer was puzzling, and nobody in the room understood it.
entries.exampleZh: 他的回答令人困惑，屋里没有人听得懂。

entries.example: The small team did a tremendous job on the project last month.
entries.exampleZh: 这个小团队上个月在这个项目上干得非常出色。

entries.example: Be careful not to strain your back when you lift that box.
entries.exampleZh: 抬那个箱子时小心别拉伤你的背。

entries.example: We saw a wonderful exhibition of old photographs at the museum.
entries.exampleZh: 我们在博物馆看了一个很棒的老照片展览。

entries.example: The new gallery downtown shows paintings by young local artists.
entries.exampleZh: 市中心的新美术馆展出本地年轻艺术家的画作。

entries.example: Teachers evaluate our writing twice a term and give useful advice.
entries.exampleZh: 老师每学期两次评价我们的作文，并给出有用的建议。

entries.example: There is a lot of dust on the shelves in this room.
entries.exampleZh: 这个房间的架子上有很多灰尘。

entries.example: I will accompany my grandmother to the hospital tomorrow morning.
entries.exampleZh: 明天早上我会陪祖母去医院。

entries.example: Please submit your form before Friday if you want to join.
entries.exampleZh: 如果你想参加，请在星期五之前提交你的表格。

entries.example: The weather was awful, so we stayed at home all day.
entries.exampleZh: 天气很糟糕，所以我们一整天都待在家里。

entries.example: We often chat about music while we walk to school.
entries.exampleZh: 我们常常在走去学校的路上聊音乐。

entries.example: The teacher wanted to underline the importance of daily practice.
entries.exampleZh: 老师想强调每天练习的重要性。

entries.example: Clean water is very important for the survival of these animals.
entries.exampleZh: 干净的水对这些动物的存活非常重要。

entries.example: It is dishonest to copy someone's work and say it is yours.
entries.exampleZh: 抄袭别人的作品并说成自己的，这是不诚实的。

entries.example: Some drivers neglect the safety rules and cause serious accidents.
entries.exampleZh: 有些司机忽视安全规则，造成严重的事故。

entries.example: I treasure the letters my grandfather wrote to me.
entries.exampleZh: 我珍爱祖父写给我的那些信。

entries.example: Our teacher is rigorous about spelling and checks every word we write.
entries.exampleZh: 我们老师对拼写要求很严格，会检查我们写的每一个词。

entries.example: She asked for counseling after the difficult year at work.
entries.exampleZh: 在艰难的工作一年之后，她寻求了咨询服务。

entries.example: He is a competent driver and never takes silly risks.
entries.exampleZh: 他是个有能力的司机，从不冒愚蠢的风险。

entries.example: The old temple is a quiet and divine place for prayer.
entries.exampleZh: 那座古庙是一个安静而神圣的祈祷之地。

entries.example: Teachers assess our writing every month with a short test.
entries.exampleZh: 老师每个月用一次简短的测验来评价我们的写作。

entries.example: We need to reassess our plan before the busy season starts.
entries.exampleZh: 在旺季开始前，我们需要重新评估我们的计划。

entries.example: It is rude to talk loudly on the phone in a library.
entries.exampleZh: 在图书馆里大声打电话是粗鲁的。

entries.example: The final question was really tough, so I guessed the answer.
entries.exampleZh: 最后一道题真的很难，所以我猜了答案。

entries.example: How can you justify spending so much money on one pair of shoes?
entries.exampleZh: 你怎么能证明花这么多钱买一双鞋是正当的呢？

entries.example: Her persistent questions finally made the manager explain the new rules.
entries.exampleZh: 她坚持不懈的提问最终让经理解释了新规定。

entries.example: Our team hopes to surpass last year's score in the final game.
entries.exampleZh: 我们队希望在决赛中超过去年的分数。

entries.example: I face a real dilemma about which job offer to accept.
entries.exampleZh: 面对该接受哪份工作邀请，我陷入了真正的困境。

entries.example: Solar panels on the roof generate enough power for the house.
entries.exampleZh: 屋顶上的太阳能板能为这所房子产生足够的电力。

entries.example: Our primary goal this year is to improve student reading skills.
entries.exampleZh: 我们今年的主要目标是提高学生的阅读能力。

entries.example: It is vitally important to drink water during a long race.
entries.exampleZh: 在长跑比赛中喝水极其重要。

entries.example: Loud noise and bright lights often confuse the small children here.
entries.exampleZh: 嘈杂的声音和明亮的灯光常常让这里的小孩感到困惑。

entries.example: They will reframe the old picture and hang it in the hall.
entries.exampleZh: 他们会把那幅旧画重新装裱，然后挂在走廊里。

entries.example: We received a polite inquiry about the price of the rooms.
entries.exampleZh: 我们收到了一份关于房间价格的礼貌询问。

entries.example: My intention is to finish the report before Friday morning.
entries.exampleZh: 我的打算是在周五早上之前完成报告。

entries.example: The engine of the old boat stopped in the middle of the lake.
entries.exampleZh: 那条旧船的发动机在湖中央熄火了。

entries.example: Her birthday is a special occasion for the whole family.
entries.exampleZh: 她的生日是全家人的一个重要场合。

entries.example: She has travelled extensively across Asia during the past five years.
entries.exampleZh: 过去五年里，她的足迹遍及亚洲各地。

entries.example: He writes a weekly column about food for the local newspaper.
entries.exampleZh: 他为当地报纸写一个关于美食的每周专栏。

entries.example: The snow will melt quickly in this warm spring sunshine.
entries.exampleZh: 在温暖的春日阳光下，雪很快就会融化。

entries.example: It is sensible to carry an umbrella when the sky looks dark.
entries.exampleZh: 天空看起来阴沉时带把伞是明智的。

entries.example: Clean water is essential for every village in this dry region.
entries.exampleZh: 在这个干旱的地区，干净的水对每个村庄都必不可少。

entries.example: We must solve this problem before the meeting starts tomorrow.
entries.exampleZh: 我们必须在明天会议开始前解决这个问题。

entries.example: The police will seize the goods if the papers are false.
entries.exampleZh: 如果证件是假的，警方会没收这些货物。

entries.example: If the bus is late, our only alternative is a taxi.
entries.exampleZh: 如果公交车晚点，我们唯一的选择是出租车。

entries.example: Trade brought great prosperity to the small port town.
entries.exampleZh: 贸易给这个小港口城镇带来了巨大的繁荣。

entries.example: The group works on conservation of wild birds in the north.
entries.exampleZh: 这个小组在北方从事野生鸟类的保护工作。

entries.example: Be careful, the wet floor is very slippery near the door.
entries.exampleZh: 小心，门边湿漉漉的地板很滑。

entries.example: The storm caused terrible destruction across the whole island.
entries.exampleZh: 暴风雨给整个岛屿造成了可怕的破坏。

entries.example: Museums preserve old objects so future visitors can enjoy them.
entries.exampleZh: 博物馆保存古老的物品，让未来的参观者也能欣赏。

entries.example: Her paintings are abstract and hard for some people to enjoy.
entries.exampleZh: 她的画很抽象，有些人难以欣赏。

entries.example: The strange light in the forest remains a mystery to us.
entries.exampleZh: 森林里那道奇怪的光对我们来说仍是个谜。

entries.example: The team will refine the plan after hearing your comments.
entries.exampleZh: 听取你的意见后，团队会改进这个计划。

entries.example: He began his speech with a quotation from an old poem.
entries.exampleZh: 他以一首古诗中的引文开始了演讲。

entries.example: How did your parents react when they saw the broken window?
entries.exampleZh: 看到破了的窗户时，你父母是怎么反应的？

entries.example: The shop sent a replacement for the broken coffee machine.
entries.exampleZh: 商店为坏掉的咖啡机寄来了一个替换品。

entries.example: It rained hard, and consequently the match was cancelled.
entries.exampleZh: 雨下得很大，因此比赛被取消了。

entries.example: House prices soar in big cities every spring.
entries.exampleZh: 每年春天，大城市的房价都会猛增。

entries.example: I incline to believe her story about the missing keys.
entries.exampleZh: 我倾向于相信她关于钥匙丢失的说法。

entries.example: We made only minor changes to the final report.
entries.exampleZh: 我们只对最终报告做了很小的改动。

entries.example: Her face showed deep grief after the sad news.
entries.exampleZh: 听到那个悲伤的消息后，她脸上露出深深的悲痛。

entries.example: Soft music can facilitate a calm and friendly discussion.
entries.exampleZh: 轻柔的音乐能促进平静友好的讨论。

entries.example: Please simplify your explanation so everyone can understand it.
entries.exampleZh: 请把你的解释简化一下，好让每个人都能听懂。

entries.example: The safety procedure must be followed in every lab.
entries.exampleZh: 每个实验室都必须遵守这一安全程序。

entries.example: Telling him a lie would be a great disservice.
entries.exampleZh: 对他撒谎会是很大的伤害。

entries.example: This strange phenomenon has puzzled scientists for many years.
entries.exampleZh: 这种奇怪的现象多年来一直让科学家们困惑不解。

entries.example: Careless driving can endanger both drivers and walkers.
entries.exampleZh: 粗心驾驶会危及司机和行人的安全。

entries.example: The team won by an overwhelming majority last night.
entries.exampleZh: 昨晚那支队伍以压倒性的多数获胜。

entries.example: Drivers must observe the speed limit near every school.
entries.exampleZh: 司机在学校附近必须遵守限速规定。

entries.example: The hotel offers music and entertainment for every guest.
entries.exampleZh: 这家酒店为每位客人提供音乐和娱乐。

entries.example: She stays optimistic even when her plans go wrong.
entries.exampleZh: 即使计划出了问题，她依然保持乐观。

entries.example: He faced great adversity but never gave up hope.
entries.exampleZh: 他面对巨大的逆境，但从未放弃希望。

entries.example: False ads often misguide people into buying useless things.
entries.exampleZh: 虚假广告常常误导人们购买无用的东西。

entries.example: Our new teacher is young, funny and very energetic.
entries.exampleZh: 我们的新老师年轻、风趣，而且非常精力充沛。

entries.example: The new rule had an unintended effect on small shops.
entries.exampleZh: 新规定对小店铺产生了意想不到的影响。

entries.example: The setting of this story is a quiet Italian village.
entries.exampleZh: 这个故事的环境背景是一个安静的意大利村庄。

entries.example: The chocolate cake in the shop window looks very tempting.
entries.exampleZh: 商店橱窗里的巧克力蛋糕看起来很诱人。

entries.example: Sorry for the interruption, but your taxi is waiting outside.
entries.exampleZh: 抱歉打扰一下，您的出租车在外面等着。

entries.example: The doctor gave me a prescription for some cough medicine.
entries.exampleZh: 医生给我开了一些止咳药的处方。

entries.example: It is a paradox that the richest man never buys anything.
entries.exampleZh: 最富有的人从不买东西，这是个悖论。

entries.example: Only one student passed the exam, namely my cousin.
entries.exampleZh: 只有一个学生通过了考试，也就是我的表弟。

entries.example: She is undoubtedly the best singer in our class.
entries.exampleZh: 她无疑是我们班最好的歌手。

entries.example: Her voice has a distinctive quality that everyone notices.
entries.exampleZh: 她的嗓音有一种人人都注意到的独特质感。

entries.example: When the enemy advanced, the soldiers decided to retreat quickly.
entries.exampleZh: 敌人推进时，士兵们决定迅速撤退。

entries.meaning: 使具有权利，使具有资格
entries.example: This ticket will entitle you to a free drink.
entries.exampleZh: 这张票将使你有权获得一杯免费饮料。

entries.meaning: 大惊小怪的，小题大做的
entries.example: My brother is very fussy about the food he eats.
entries.exampleZh: 我弟弟对他吃的东西非常挑剔。

entries.example: Please put all the dirty plates in the dishwasher.
entries.exampleZh: 请把所有脏盘子放进洗碗机里。

entries.example: I found the answer on an online forum last night.
entries.exampleZh: 我昨晚在一个网上论坛上找到了答案。

entries.example: The report points out the inadequacy of our old equipment.
entries.exampleZh: 报告指出了我们旧设备的不足。

entries.example: We waited for our friends in the hotel lobby.
entries.exampleZh: 我们在酒店大堂里等朋友。

entries.example: Our travel agent booked a nice hotel for us.
entries.exampleZh: 我们的旅行代理给我们订了一家不错的酒店。

entries.example: It was hard to convince him to change his mind.
entries.exampleZh: 很难说服他改变主意。

entries.example: This job offers great flexibility about working hours.
entries.exampleZh: 这份工作在上班时间上提供了很大的灵活性。

entries.example: She drank water from a small plastic bottle.
entries.exampleZh: 她用一个小塑料瓶喝水。

entries.example: He put a photo of his family in a wooden frame.
entries.exampleZh: 他把一张全家福放进了木相框里。

entries.example: We spread a groundsheet under the tent before sleeping.
entries.exampleZh: 睡觉前我们在帐篷下铺了一块防潮布。

entries.example: She studies the geographic features of the island near her home.
entries.exampleZh: 她研究她家附近那座岛屿的地理特征。

entries.example: The two countries found a diplomatic solution to the water problem.
entries.exampleZh: 两国就水资源问题找到了外交解决办法。

entries.example: In my judgement, this plan is safer than the other one.
entries.exampleZh: 依我的判断，这个方案比另一个更安全。

entries.example: He keeps his private letters in a small wooden box.
entries.exampleZh: 他把私人信件放在一个小木盒里。

entries.example: Her little room is warm and cozy in the winter months.
entries.exampleZh: 冬天的时候，她的小房间温暖又舒适。

entries.example: My uncle works at a paper mill near the river.
entries.exampleZh: 我叔叔在河边的一家造纸厂工作。

entries.example: This new app will enable students to study at home.
entries.exampleZh: 这款新应用将使学生能够在家学习。

entries.example: Copying the whole book by hand was a laborious task.
entries.exampleZh: 手抄整本书是一项费力的工作。

entries.example: The children shouted with delight when the snow began.
entries.exampleZh: 开始下雪时，孩子们高兴地欢呼起来。

entries.example: The scale of the old castle surprised every visitor last summer.
entries.exampleZh: 去年夏天，那座古老城堡的规模让每位游客都很惊讶。

entries.example: His amusing story made the whole class laugh loudly.
entries.exampleZh: 他那有趣的故事让全班同学都大声笑了。

entries.example: The panic crowd ran towards the exit when the lights went out.
entries.exampleZh: 灯灭时，恐慌的人群朝出口跑去。

entries.example: He lost consciousness for a few seconds after the fall.
entries.exampleZh: 摔倒后他失去意识了几秒钟。

entries.example: The statistics show that fewer people walk to work now.
entries.exampleZh: 数据显示，现在步行上班的人更少了。

entries.example: The bride wore a simple white dress at the ceremony.
entries.exampleZh: 新娘在仪式上穿了一条简单的白色连衣裙。

entries.example: Three students were absent from class because of the storm.
entries.exampleZh: 因为暴风雨，有三名学生缺课。

entries.example: Loud music late at night can annoy the neighbors.
entries.exampleZh: 深夜大声放音乐会惹邻居厌烦。

entries.example: I insist on paying for the coffee this time.
entries.exampleZh: 这次我一定要付咖啡的钱。

entries.example: She pointed at the map with her right forefinger.
entries.exampleZh: 她用右手食指指着地图。

entries.example: The actors bow to the audience at the end of the show.
entries.exampleZh: 演出结束时，演员们向观众鞠躬。

entries.example: She made a friendly gesture with her hand.
entries.exampleZh: 她用手做了一个友好的手势。

entries.example: The farmers are happy with this year's harvest.
entries.exampleZh: 农民们对今年的收成很满意。

entries.example: My hands are sticky after eating that sweet cake.
entries.exampleZh: 吃完那块甜蛋糕后我的手黏黏的。

entries.example: The new rule met strong resistance from the workers.
entries.exampleZh: 这项新规定遭到了工人们的强烈抵制。

entries.example: Some bacteria in the water can make people very sick.
entries.exampleZh: 水里的一些细菌会让人病得很重。

entries.example: A tiny particle of dust got into my eye.
entries.exampleZh: 一粒微小的灰尘进了我的眼睛。

entries.example: My gum hurts when I drink cold water.
entries.exampleZh: 我喝冷水时牙龈会疼。

entries.example: You really resemble your mother in that old photo.
entries.exampleZh: 在那张老照片里，你真的很像你母亲。

entries.example: The police found no trace of the missing car.
entries.exampleZh: 警方没有找到那辆失踪汽车的踪迹。

entries.example: She spoke out against discrimination at her workplace.
entries.exampleZh: 她公开反对工作场所的歧视。

entries.example: It is pointless to argue with him about it.
entries.exampleZh: 为这件事和他争论是没有意义的。

entries.example: The rental for this flat is quite high.
entries.exampleZh: 这套公寓的租金相当高。

entries.example: He seemed indifferent to the needs of his team.
entries.exampleZh: 他对团队的需求似乎漠不关心。

entries.example: These photos reflect the happy life of our family.
entries.exampleZh: 这些照片反映了我们一家人的幸福生活。

entries.example: The town celebrated its liberation with music and dancing.
entries.exampleZh: 全镇用音乐和舞蹈庆祝解放。

entries.example: Taking the bus is a cheap option for us.
entries.exampleZh: 坐公交车对我们来说是个便宜的选择。

entries.example: Initially, I did not like the taste of coffee.
entries.exampleZh: 起初，我不喜欢咖啡的味道。

entries.example: They attribute the success to hard work and luck.
entries.exampleZh: 他们把成功归因于努力和运气。

entries.example: The car began to accelerate as the light turned green.
entries.exampleZh: 绿灯亮时，汽车开始加速。

entries.example: The moon looks like a perfect sphere in the sky.
entries.exampleZh: 月亮在天空中看起来像一个完美的球体。

entries.example: The use of mobile phones is widespread among young people today.
entries.exampleZh: 如今，手机的使用在年轻人中非常普遍。

entries.example: New technology can transform the way we learn and work.
entries.exampleZh: 新技术能改变我们学习和工作的方式。

entries.example: Her help during that difficult year was immeasurable.
entries.exampleZh: 在那段艰难的日子里，她的帮助是无法估量的。

entries.example: Waste from the factory may contaminate the river nearby.
entries.exampleZh: 工厂排出的废物可能会污染附近的河流。

entries.example: This land has been our territory for hundreds of years.
entries.exampleZh: 这片土地几百年来一直是我们的领土。

entries.example: The students met in a virtual classroom last Monday.
entries.exampleZh: 学生们上周一在一个虚拟教室里见了面。

entries.example: He is invariably late for our morning meetings.
entries.exampleZh: 我们早上的会议他总是一再迟到。

entries.example: After months away, I long to see my family again.
entries.exampleZh: 离家几个月后，我渴望再次见到我的家人。

entries.example: The company cares about the welfare of its workers.
entries.exampleZh: 这家公司关心员工的福利。

entries.example: These small steps can lessen the stress of daily life.
entries.exampleZh: 这些小小的举措能减轻日常生活的压力。

entries.example: There was serious unrest in the city last month.
entries.exampleZh: 上个月这座城市发生了严重的动荡。

entries.example: Her book is an authoritative guide to local birds.
entries.exampleZh: 她的书是一本关于本地鸟类的权威指南。

entries.example: The judge tried to stay neutral during the discussion.
entries.exampleZh: 讨论期间，法官尽量保持中立。

entries.example: The report says the law is racially unfair.
entries.exampleZh: 报告称这项法律在种族上是不公平的。

entries.example: The team's result on Sunday was very disappointing for fans.
entries.exampleZh: 球队周日的成绩让球迷非常失望。

entries.example: My uncle works at a car plant near the river.
entries.exampleZh: 我叔叔在河边的一家汽车厂工作。

entries.example: The inspector checked every room before the new term began.
entries.exampleZh: 新学期开始前，检查员检查了每一个房间。

entries.example: The firm decided to headquarter its new office in Berlin.
entries.exampleZh: 这家公司决定把新办公室的总部设在柏林。

entries.example: The singer is known worldwide for her powerful voice.
entries.exampleZh: 这位歌手以其有力的嗓音闻名世界。

entries.example: The city council will meet on Tuesday to discuss plans.
entries.exampleZh: 市议会将于周二开会讨论各项计划。

entries.example: The police found an important clue near the old house.
entries.exampleZh: 警察在那座老房子附近发现了一条重要线索。

entries.example: You should never cheat during a test at school.
entries.exampleZh: 在学校考试时你绝不应该作弊。

entries.example: Please do not insult your classmates with those unkind words.
entries.exampleZh: 请不要用那些刻薄的话侮辱你的同学。

entries.example: The bad news may distress her very much.
entries.exampleZh: 这个坏消息可能会让她非常痛苦。

entries.example: Do not let one failure discourage you from trying again.
entries.exampleZh: 不要让一次失败使你气馁而不再尝试。

entries.example: Small shops can prosper when the local economy grows.
entries.exampleZh: 当当地经济增长时，小商店能够繁荣起来。

entries.example: The company hopes to retain its best young workers.
entries.exampleZh: 公司希望留住最优秀的年轻员工。

entries.example: She won first prize in the singing contest last night.
entries.exampleZh: 她在昨晚的歌唱比赛中获得了一等奖。

entries.example: The manager read our new proposal with great interest.
entries.exampleZh: 经理很有兴趣地读了我们新的提议。

entries.example: This dish is a tasty combination of rice and fresh vegetables.
entries.exampleZh: 这道菜是米饭和新鲜蔬菜的美味结合。

entries.example: The store sent a promotional email about weekend sales.
entries.exampleZh: 商店发了一封关于周末促销的电子邮件。

entries.example: The baby's skin felt soft and smooth after the bath.
entries.exampleZh: 洗完澡后，宝宝的皮肤摸起来又软又光滑。

entries.example: The runners felt intense heat during the long race.
entries.exampleZh: 跑步者在漫长的比赛中感受到了强烈的炎热。

entries.example: His sleep became irregular after he started working nights.
entries.exampleZh: 他开始上夜班后，睡眠变得不规律了。

entries.example: The incidence of flu rises during cold winter months.
entries.exampleZh: 在寒冷的冬季月份，流感的发病率会上升。

entries.example: We sat in the cool shade of a large tree.
entries.exampleZh: 我们坐在一棵大树的凉爽阴凉处。

entries.example: My grandfather receives a small pension every month.
entries.exampleZh: 我祖父每个月领取一笔小额的养老金。

entries.example: Reading good books can deepen your understanding of life.
entries.exampleZh: 读好书能加深你对生活的理解。

entries.example: Fresh herbs complement the rich taste of this soup.
entries.exampleZh: 新鲜的香草补充了这汤浓郁的味道。

entries.example: Please squeeze the lemon gently into the warm water.
entries.exampleZh: 请把柠檬轻轻地挤到温水里。

entries.example: Ancient Egypt was a great civilization with a long and rich history.
entries.exampleZh: 古埃及是一个拥有悠久丰富历史的伟大文明。

entries.example: Her performance in the school play last night was truly extraordinary.
entries.exampleZh: 她昨晚在学校话剧中的表演确实非同凡响。

entries.example: Some wild mushrooms are poisonous and can make you very sick.
entries.exampleZh: 有些野生蘑菇有毒，会让你病得很重。

entries.example: We recycle old bottles and paper at our school every week.
entries.exampleZh: 我们每周在学校回收旧瓶子和纸张。

entries.example: I called the hotel to inquire about the room price.
entries.exampleZh: 我打电话给酒店询问房间的价格。

entries.example: She tried to mask her disappointment with a quick smile.
entries.exampleZh: 她试着用快速的微笑掩饰自己的失望。

entries.example: A high fever is a common symptom of this illness.
entries.exampleZh: 高烧是这种疾病常见的症状。

entries.example: Money problems plague many young families in this city.
entries.exampleZh: 金钱问题困扰着这座城市的许多年轻家庭。

entries.example: He had to twist the lid hard to open the jar.
entries.exampleZh: 他不得不使劲扭瓶盖才打开那个罐子。

entries.example: We met at the bus terminal near the city center.
entries.exampleZh: 我们在市中心附近的公交终点站见了面。

entries.example: He watched passively as the others cleaned the whole room.
entries.exampleZh: 别人打扫整个房间时，他消极地看着。

entries.example: Nobody could predict the outcome of the final match.
entries.exampleZh: 没有人能预测决赛的结果。

entries.example: Please write your signature at the bottom of this page.
entries.exampleZh: 请在这页纸的底部写下你的签名。

entries.example: Cleaning the kitchen is a task nobody in our house enjoys.
entries.exampleZh: 打扫厨房是我们家没人喜欢的任务。

entries.example: His excuse for being late was not very convincing.
entries.exampleZh: 他迟到的借口不太令人信服。

entries.example: The company plans to downsize and close two small offices.
entries.exampleZh: 这家公司计划裁员并关闭两个小办公室。

entries.example: We see no problems in the foreseeable future.
entries.exampleZh: 在可预见的未来，我们看不到任何问题。

entries.example: Her new job gave her a higher status in the company.
entries.exampleZh: 她的新工作使她在公司里的地位更高了。

entries.example: The hotel treats its regular guests preferentially during busy seasons.
entries.exampleZh: 在旺季，这家酒店会优先照顾常客。

entries.example: The internet is a useful source of information for students.
entries.exampleZh: 互联网是学生获取信息的有用来源。

entries.example: The riot in the city center lasted for two days.
entries.exampleZh: 市中心的暴乱持续了两天。

entries.example: Farmers store grain in large baskets after the harvest ends.
entries.exampleZh: 收割结束后，农民把谷物储存在大篮子里。

entries.example: The retailer sold warm coats to families during the cold winter.
entries.exampleZh: 在寒冷的冬天，这家零售商把保暖外套卖给了许多家庭。

entries.example: The tricks of the young magician always amaze the crowd.
entries.exampleZh: 这位年轻魔术师的戏法总是让观众吃惊。

entries.example: The origin of this old story remains a mystery today.
entries.exampleZh: 这个古老故事的起源至今仍是个谜。

entries.example: Her family came from far away to attend the commencement.
entries.exampleZh: 她的家人从很远的地方赶来参加毕业典礼。

entries.example: Small teams often innovate faster than large slow companies.
entries.exampleZh: 小团队往往比大型的慢公司创新得更快。

entries.example: The new song became a big hit across the whole country.
entries.exampleZh: 这首新歌在全国上下成了大热门。

entries.example: Clean water is crucial for every village and growing child.
entries.exampleZh: 干净的水对每个村庄和成长中的孩子都至关重要。

entries.example: Scientists announced a major breakthrough in cancer treatment last week.
entries.exampleZh: 科学家上周宣布了癌症治疗方面的一项重大突破。

entries.example: The writer spent many years in exile far from home.
entries.exampleZh: 这位作家在远离家乡的流放中度过了许多年。

entries.example: Trust is the most important element of any good friendship.
entries.exampleZh: 信任是任何良好友谊中最重要的要素。

entries.example: Her interpretation of the poem surprised the whole class.
entries.exampleZh: 她对这首诗的阐释让全班都很惊讶。

entries.example: You must accustom yourself to the noise of this street.
entries.exampleZh: 你必须使自己习惯这条街的噪音。

entries.example: His superficial knowledge of the topic failed to impress anyone.
entries.exampleZh: 他对这个话题的肤浅了解没能打动任何人。

entries.example: Tom and Anna won gold and silver, respectively, at the games.
entries.exampleZh: 汤姆和安娜在运动会上分别获得了金牌和银牌。

entries.example: The two plans are fundamentally different in cost and speed.
entries.exampleZh: 这两个方案在成本和速度上根本不同。

entries.example: The cruelty of the old king shocked the entire village.
entries.exampleZh: 老国王的残暴震惊了整个村庄。

entries.example: Elected leaders govern the city with help from many advisers.
entries.exampleZh: 选出的领导人依靠许多顾问的帮助来管理这座城市。

entries.example: Heavy rain may hinder our plans for the school trip.
entries.exampleZh: 大雨可能会阻碍我们的学校旅行计划。

entries.example: Never undervalue the small efforts you make each day.
entries.exampleZh: 不要低估你每天做出的小小努力。

entries.example: The teacher's evaluation of my essay was fair and helpful.
entries.exampleZh: 老师对我作文的评价公正而有帮助。

entries.example: Can you define this word in a simple way?
entries.exampleZh: 你能用简单的方式给这个词下定义吗？

entries.example: Without practice, your English may backslide over the summer.
entries.exampleZh: 不练习的话，你的英语在夏天可能会退步。

entries.example: Stealing is a serious offense in every country.
entries.exampleZh: 偷窃在每个国家都是严重的罪行。

entries.example: The jury did not convict him because the proof was weak.
entries.exampleZh: 由于证据不足，陪审团没有判定他有罪。

entries.example: We should never marginalize people who speak a different language.
entries.exampleZh: 我们不应该排斥说不同语言的人。

entries.example: Please do not desert your friends when they need help.
entries.exampleZh: 朋友需要帮助时，请不要抛弃他们。

entries.example: The judge will sentence the man tomorrow morning.
entries.exampleZh: 法官明天上午将对这名男子宣判。

entries.example: I would like to reserve a table for two tonight.
entries.exampleZh: 我想预订今晚两个人的一张桌子。

entries.example: Lying often brings a penalty you did not expect.
entries.exampleZh: 说谎常常会带来你意想不到的惩罚。

entries.meaning: 合乎情理地，符合逻辑地
entries.example: She explained her plan logically, so everyone agreed with her.
entries.exampleZh: 她合乎逻辑地解释了自己的计划，所以每个人都同意她的看法。

entries.example: Fresh water is abundant in this part of the country.
entries.exampleZh: 在这个国家的这一带，淡水很丰富。

entries.example: I think you overstate the danger of this simple game.
entries.exampleZh: 我认为你夸大了这个简单游戏的危险性。

entries.example: I usually eat a small snack after school.
entries.exampleZh: 我放学后通常会吃一点小吃。

entries.example: We sent the photos to Grandma via email.
entries.exampleZh: 我们通过电子邮件把照片发给了奶奶。

entries.example: The bright colors will fade after a few hot summers.
entries.exampleZh: 这些鲜艳的颜色在几个炎热的夏天之后会逐渐褪去。

entries.example: This new material is resistant to water and heat.
entries.exampleZh: 这种新材料防水又耐热。

entries.example: His theory about the moon sounds strange but interesting.
entries.exampleZh: 他关于月球的理论听起来很奇怪，但很有趣。

entries.example: Many students protest against the new school rules.
entries.exampleZh: 许多学生抗议新的校规。

entries.example: The manager may reject our plan if the costs are too high.
entries.exampleZh: 如果费用太高，经理可能会否决我们的计划。

entries.example: One small flaw in the design caused the whole machine to fail.
entries.exampleZh: 设计中的一个小缺陷导致整台机器出了故障。

entries.example: The seemingly simple task took us three whole hours to finish.
entries.exampleZh: 这个看似简单的任务花了我们整整三个小时才完成。

entries.example: My main objection to the plan is its very high cost.
entries.exampleZh: 我对这个计划的主要反对意见是它的成本太高。

entries.example: They stayed in a fancy hotel near the river for two nights.
entries.exampleZh: 他们在河边一家别致的酒店住了两晚。

entries.example: This city is a busy hub for trade between two large regions.
entries.exampleZh: 这座城市是两个大地区之间繁忙的贸易中心。

entries.example: Her skill at painting is incomparable among the young artists here.
entries.exampleZh: 她的绘画技艺在这里的年轻画家中无可匹敌。

entries.example: The bonus is a strong incentive for the workers to finish early.
entries.exampleZh: 奖金是促使工人们早点完成工作的强大动力。

entries.example: The startup of the program was delayed by two whole months.
entries.exampleZh: 这个项目的启动被整整推迟了两个月。

entries.example: These small animals can reproduce quickly in warm and wet places.
entries.exampleZh: 这些小动物在温暖潮湿的地方能迅速繁殖。

entries.example: There is a distinct difference between these two kinds of tea.
entries.exampleZh: 这两种茶之间有明显的区别。

entries.example: The company has a large stake in this risky deal.
entries.exampleZh: 公司在这笔有风险的交易中承担着很大的风险。

entries.example: She gave the children moral support during their difficult exams.
entries.exampleZh: 在孩子们艰难的考试期间，她给了他们精神上的支持。

entries.example: He shook hands with his opponent after the long chess game.
entries.exampleZh: 漫长的国际象棋比赛结束后，他与对手握了手。

entries.example: The teacher explicitly told us not to use phones in class.
entries.exampleZh: 老师明确地告诉我们上课时不要用手机。

entries.example: Our biggest rival opened a new shop across the street.
entries.exampleZh: 我们最大的对手在街对面开了一家新店。

entries.example: A serious confrontation between the two groups was avoided by police.
entries.exampleZh: 警方避免了两伙人之间的一场严重冲突。

entries.example: His jokes are stale and nobody laughs at them anymore.
entries.exampleZh: 他的笑话毫无新意，再也没有人笑了。

entries.example: These new facts reinforce our belief that the plan will work.
entries.exampleZh: 这些新事实强化了我们对该计划会成功的信念。

entries.example: The boxer stepped into the ring with a calm, quiet smile.
entries.exampleZh: 拳击手带着平静的微笑走进了拳击台。

entries.example: Her attendance at every class surprised all the teachers.
entries.exampleZh: 她每节课都出席，这让所有老师都很惊讶。

entries.example: The river's flow is very slow in the dry season.
entries.exampleZh: 旱季时这条河的流速很慢。

entries.example: Music can change your mood after a long, hard day.
entries.exampleZh: 漫长辛苦的一天过后，音乐能改变你的心情。

entries.example: The two leaders reached a mutually helpful agreement yesterday.
entries.exampleZh: 两位领导人昨天达成了一项互利的协议。

entries.example: Let's review these new words before the test tomorrow.
entries.exampleZh: 明天考试前我们复习一下这些新词吧。

entries.example: She wore an elegant dress to the dinner party.
entries.exampleZh: 她穿了一条优雅的连衣裙去参加晚宴。

entries.example: Our hosts were very hospitable and gave us warm tea.
entries.exampleZh: 我们的主人非常热情好客，还给我们端来了热茶。

entries.example: Ten small islands constitute this beautiful new country.
entries.exampleZh: 十座小岛组成了这个美丽的新国家。

entries.example: My sister works as a programmer for a big company.
entries.exampleZh: 我姐姐在一家大公司做程序员。

entries.example: This sophisticated machine can solve many hard problems quickly.
entries.exampleZh: 这台复杂的机器能很快解决许多难题。

entries.example: I was completely ignorant about using this new software.
entries.exampleZh: 我对使用这个新软件完全一无所知。

entries.example: Children often imitate the way their parents speak at home.
entries.exampleZh: 孩子们常常模仿父母在家说话的方式。

entries.example: Loud noise can trigger a strong headache for my father.
entries.exampleZh: 巨大的噪音可能会引发我父亲的剧烈头痛。

entries.example: Please write the code carefully and check it twice today.
entries.exampleZh: 请仔细写这段代码，今天再检查两遍。

entries.example: The police will investigate the strange fire near our school.
entries.exampleZh: 警方将调查我们学校附近的这场怪火。

entries.example: My cousin is outgoing and makes friends very easily.
entries.exampleZh: 我表哥很开朗，很容易交到朋友。

entries.example: The evolution of these birds took millions of years.
entries.exampleZh: 这些鸟的进化花了数百万年。

entries.example: She is a resourceful girl and always finds clever answers.
entries.exampleZh: 她是个机智的女孩，总能想出聪明的办法。

entries.example: This old myth about the moon is still very popular.
entries.exampleZh: 这个关于月亮的古老神话仍然很受欢迎。

entries.example: The legend of that brave hero lives on today.
entries.exampleZh: 那位勇敢英雄的传奇故事流传至今。

entries.example: The old philosopher asked my class a very difficult question about life.
entries.exampleZh: 那位年老的哲学家向我们班提了一个关于人生的难题。

entries.example: Please give me a concrete example so I can understand your plan.
entries.exampleZh: 请给我一个具体的例子，这样我才能理解你的计划。

entries.example: The sun will emerge from behind the clouds in a few minutes.
entries.exampleZh: 几分钟后太阳将从云层后面露出来。

entries.example: Stir the soup slowly for two minutes before you add salt.
entries.exampleZh: 加盐之前请把汤慢慢搅动两分钟。

entries.example: The bus is free for every senior in this small town.
entries.exampleZh: 在这座小镇，每位老年人都可以免费乘坐公交车。

entries.example: Fresh vegetables and fruit are very nutritious for growing children.
entries.exampleZh: 新鲜蔬菜和水果对成长中的孩子很有营养。

entries.example: She is expert at fixing old clocks and small machines.
entries.exampleZh: 她修理旧钟表和小型机器很在行。

entries.example: The carpenter built a strong wooden table for our kitchen.
entries.exampleZh: 木匠为我们的厨房做了一张结实的木桌。

entries.example: Heavy rain did not dampen the spirit of the young players.
entries.exampleZh: 大雨并没有打击年轻球员们的士气。

entries.example: The school will grant her a scholarship for the next year.
entries.exampleZh: 学校将授予她下一年度的奖学金。

entries.example: Airport security checked every bag before the passengers walked to the plane.
entries.exampleZh: 机场安保在乘客走向飞机之前检查了每个包。

entries.example: The price of fresh fruit has had a steep rise this year.
entries.exampleZh: 今年新鲜水果的价格急剧上涨。

entries.example: The implementation of the new rules begins next Monday morning.
entries.exampleZh: 新规则的实施将于下周一开始。

entries.example: Too much rain can weaken the walls of an old house.
entries.exampleZh: 过多的雨水会削弱老房子的墙壁。

entries.example: This question continues to puzzle the best students in class.
entries.exampleZh: 这道题一直让班里最优秀的学生感到困惑。

entries.example: I need to memorize ten new words before the test tomorrow.
entries.exampleZh: 明天考试前我需要记住十个新单词。

entries.example: The hotel tries to cater to the needs of young families.
entries.exampleZh: 这家酒店努力迎合年轻家庭的需求。

entries.example: They had to abandon the game because of the heavy storm.
entries.exampleZh: 因为大暴风雨，他们不得不放弃比赛。

entries.example: Her ability to stay calm helps the whole team a lot.
entries.exampleZh: 她保持冷静的能力对整个团队帮助很大。

entries.example: Will you be able to finish the report by Friday?
entries.exampleZh: 你周五之前能完成这份报告吗？

entries.example: His test results were abnormal, so the doctor asked him to return.
entries.exampleZh: 他的检查结果不正常，所以医生让他再来一趟。

entries.example: All passengers must come aboard before the ship leaves the port.
entries.exampleZh: 所有乘客必须在船离港前上船。

entries.example: We talked about the new teacher for almost an hour.
entries.exampleZh: 我们谈论新老师谈了将近一个小时。

entries.example: The clock hangs above the door in our classroom.
entries.exampleZh: 钟挂在我们教室门的上方。

entries.example: My sister wants to study abroad next year.
entries.exampleZh: 我姐姐想明年出国留学。

entries.example: His absence from class today worried the teacher a little.
entries.exampleZh: 他今天没来上课，这让老师有点担心。

entries.example: She has absolute trust in her best friend.
entries.exampleZh: 她对最好的朋友有着绝对的信任。

entries.example: I am absolutely sure that I locked the door.
entries.exampleZh: 我完全确定我锁了门。

entries.example: My cousin studies music at a famous academy in London.
entries.exampleZh: 我表哥在伦敦一所著名的专科院校学习音乐。

entries.example: The car showed great acceleration on the straight road.
entries.exampleZh: 那辆车在直路上加速性能很好。

entries.example: She speaks English with a soft French accent.
entries.exampleZh: 她说英语带着柔和的法国口音。

entries.example: I hope you will accept my small gift.
entries.exampleZh: 我希望你会接受我的小礼物。

entries.example: This old shirt is still acceptable for work in the garden.
entries.exampleZh: 这件旧衬衫在花园里干活时穿还是可以的。

entries.example: Her acceptance of the job surprised all of us.
entries.exampleZh: 她接受这份工作让我们大家都很惊讶。

entries.example: The police said he was an accessary to the crime.
entries.exampleZh: 警方说他是这起罪案的同谋。

entries.example: There was a small accident near the school this morning.
entries.exampleZh: 今天早上学校附近发生了一起小事故。

entries.example: The fire was accidental, not caused by anyone.
entries.exampleZh: 那场火是偶然发生的，不是任何人造成的。

entries.example: We found cheap accommodation near the beach for two nights.
entries.exampleZh: 我们在海滩附近找到了两晚的便宜住处。

entries.example: His words do not accord with the facts we know.
entries.exampleZh: 他的话与我们了解的事实不一致。

entries.example: In accordance with the rules, please sign this form.
entries.exampleZh: 按照规则，请在这张表格上签名。

entries.example: The rules are simple, so please plan your work accordingly.
entries.exampleZh: 规则很简单，所以请照此安排你的工作。

entries.example: She gave a clear account of what happened that night.
entries.exampleZh: 她清楚地讲述了那天晚上发生的事情。

entries.example: The accuracy of these numbers is very important for our report.
entries.exampleZh: 这些数字的准确性对我们的报告非常重要。

entries.example: Please do not accuse him before you hear the whole story.
entries.exampleZh: 在听完整个故事之前，请不要指责他。

entries.example: I am not accustomed to getting up so early in winter.
entries.exampleZh: 我不习惯冬天这么早起床。

entries.example: A dull ache in my back kept me awake last night.
entries.exampleZh: 昨晚我背上隐隐的疼痛让我睡不着。

entries.example: Winning that prize was a great achievement for our small school.
entries.exampleZh: 赢得那个奖对我们这所小学校来说是一项巨大的成就。

entries.example: Lemon juice contains a weak acid that can hurt your teeth.
entries.exampleZh: 柠檬汁含有一种弱酸，会伤害你的牙齿。

entries.example: She is an old acquaintance from my first year at college.
entries.exampleZh: 她是我大学一年级时的一位老相识。

entries.example: They grow corn on every acre of their small family farm.
entries.exampleZh: 他们在自家小农场的每一英亩土地上种玉米。

entries.example: We walked across the bridge and then sat by the river.
entries.exampleZh: 我们走过那座桥，然后坐在河边。

entries.example: We must act quickly before the rain ruins the whole crop.
entries.exampleZh: 我们必须赶快行动，免得大雨毁了整片庄稼。

entries.example: His quick action saved the little boy from the cold water.
entries.exampleZh: 他迅速的行动把那个小男孩从冷水里救了出来。

entries.example: My grandmother stays active by walking in the park every morning.
entries.exampleZh: 我奶奶每天早上在公园散步，保持活跃。

entries.example: Reading is a quiet activity that I enjoy after dinner.
entries.exampleZh: 阅读是我晚饭后喜欢的一项安静的活动。

entries.example: The young actor forgot his lines during the first scene.
entries.exampleZh: 那位年轻男演员在第一场戏里忘了台词。

entries.example: My favourite actress plays the mother in that new film.
entries.exampleZh: 我最喜欢的女演员在那部新电影里演母亲。

entries.example: The actual cost was much higher than the shop told us.
entries.exampleZh: 实际花费比店家告诉我们的要高得多。

entries.example: I actually forgot my keys and had to wait outside.
entries.exampleZh: 我竟然忘了带钥匙，只好在外面等。

entries.example: Please add some salt to the soup before you serve it.
entries.exampleZh: 在你上汤之前，请往汤里加一些盐。

entries.example: In addition to English, she studies French and music.
entries.exampleZh: 除了英语，她还学习法语和音乐。

entries.example: The word happy is an adjective in this short sentence.
entries.exampleZh: 在这个短句里，“快乐”这个词是形容词。

entries.example: You can adjust the seat before the long car trip.
entries.exampleZh: 长途汽车旅行前你可以调整座椅。

entries.example: They plan to adopt a small dog from the shelter.
entries.exampleZh: 他们打算从收容所领养一只小狗。

entries.example: Every adult in the room agreed with the new plan.
entries.exampleZh: 房间里的每位成年人都同意这个新计划。

entries.example: One big advantage of this flat is the quiet street.
entries.exampleZh: 这套公寓的一大优点就是安静的街道。

entries.example: Their trip to the mountains turned into a real adventure.
entries.exampleZh: 他们的山区之行变成了一次真正的冒险。

entries.example: Please add an adverb to make this sentence more clear.
entries.exampleZh: 请加一个副词，让这个句子更清楚。

entries.example: I saw a funny advertisement for shoes on the bus.
entries.exampleZh: 我在公交车上看到一个有趣的鞋子广告。

entries.example: It is advisable to book your seats a week early.
entries.exampleZh: 最好提前一周订座位。

entries.example: I advise you to take an umbrella today.
entries.exampleZh: 我建议你今天带把伞。

entries.example: The aeroplane landed smoothly at the small island airport.
entries.exampleZh: 飞机平稳地降落在小岛机场。

entries.example: The school party was a quiet family affair this year.
entries.exampleZh: 今年的学校聚会是一场安静的家庭活动。

entries.example: Loud music can affect your sleep at night.
entries.exampleZh: 大声的音乐会影响你夜间的睡眠。

entries.example: She shows great affection for her little cousin.
entries.exampleZh: 她非常疼爱她的小表弟。

entries.example: I am afraid of big dogs in the park.
entries.exampleZh: 我害怕公园里的大狗。

entries.example: My uncle lived in Africa for three years.
entries.exampleZh: 我叔叔在非洲住了三年。

entries.example: An African friend taught me a few songs last summer.
entries.exampleZh: 一位非洲朋友去年夏天教了我几首歌。

entries.example: We went home after the long film ended.
entries.exampleZh: 电影很长，结束后我们就回家了。

entries.example: She drinks tea every afternoon at four o'clock.
entries.exampleZh: 她每天下午四点喝茶。

entries.example: We ate dinner and went for a walk afterward.
entries.exampleZh: 我们吃完晚饭，然后去散了步。

entries.example: Please say that again because I did not hear you.
entries.exampleZh: 请再说一遍，因为我没听见你说的话。

entries.example: He put the ladder against the wall and climbed up.
entries.exampleZh: 他把梯子靠在墙上，然后爬了上去。

entries.example: She started to learn the piano at the age of six.
entries.exampleZh: 她六岁开始学钢琴。

entries.example: We moved to this city three years ago.
entries.exampleZh: 我们三年前搬到了这座城市。

entries.example: His broken leg gave him great agony all night.
entries.exampleZh: 他断了的腿让他整夜疼痛难忍。

entries.example: I agree with you about the new school rules.
entries.exampleZh: 关于新的校规，我同意你的看法。

entries.example: The two countries signed a peace agreement last week.
entries.exampleZh: 这两个国家上周签署了一项和平协议。

entries.example: Agriculture is very important for this small country.
entries.exampleZh: 农业对这个面积不大的国家非常重要。

entries.example: Look ahead and you will see the tall tower.
entries.exampleZh: 往前看，你就会看到那座高塔。

entries.example: The nurse gave first aid to the injured boy.
entries.exampleZh: 护士给那个受伤的男孩做了急救。

entries.example: Please aim the camera at the flowers and press this button.
entries.exampleZh: 请把相机对准那些花，然后按这个按钮。

entries.example: The air in the mountains feels fresh and cool.
entries.exampleZh: 山里的空气让人感觉清新凉爽。

entries.example: The aircraft landed safely at the small airport.
entries.exampleZh: 这架飞机安全降落在那个小机场。

entries.example: My uncle works for a big airline in Asia.
entries.exampleZh: 我叔叔在亚洲的一家大航空公司工作。

entries.example: The airplane flew over our house at noon.
entries.exampleZh: 中午时分，那架飞机从我们的房子上方飞过。

entries.example: We arrived at the airport two hours early.
entries.exampleZh: 我们提前两小时到达了机场。

entries.example: The fire alarm woke everyone in the building.
entries.exampleZh: 火警警报把楼里的每个人都吵醒了。

entries.example: The two young brothers look very much alike.
entries.exampleZh: 这两兄弟看起来非常像。

entries.example: The old tree is still alive after the cold winter.
entries.exampleZh: 经过寒冬之后，那棵老树依然活着。

entries.example: All the students in my class passed the math test.
entries.exampleZh: 我们班所有学生都通过了数学考试。

entries.example: My parents allow me to play outside after I finish my homework.
entries.exampleZh: 我父母允许我写完作业后在外面玩。

entries.example: This knife is made from a strong alloy of steel and iron.
entries.exampleZh: 这把刀是用一种坚固的钢铁合金制成的。

entries.example: It is almost time for the school bus to arrive.
entries.exampleZh: 校车差不多要到了。

entries.example: She lives alone in a small house near the river.
entries.exampleZh: 她独自住在河边的一间小房子里。

entries.example: We walked along the beach and looked at the boats.
entries.exampleZh: 我们沿着海滩散步，看着那些船。

entries.example: Please read the story aloud so everyone can hear you.
entries.exampleZh: 请把故事大声读出来，让大家都能听见。

entries.example: Children learn the alphabet before they start to read words.
entries.exampleZh: 孩子们在开始读单词之前先学字母表。

entries.example: I have already finished my homework and cleaned my room.
entries.exampleZh: 我已经写完作业，还打扫了房间。

entries.example: She speaks French and also a little bit of German.
entries.exampleZh: 她会说法语，还会一点德语。

entries.example: Although it was raining, we still went out for a walk.
entries.exampleZh: 虽然下着雨，我们还是出去散步了。

entries.example: That trip cost us two hundred dollars altogether.
entries.exampleZh: 那次旅行总共花了我们两百美元。

entries.example: This pan is light because it is made of aluminium.
entries.exampleZh: 这个锅很轻，因为它是用铝做的。

entries.example: He always arrives at the office before eight in the morning.
entries.exampleZh: 他总是早上八点前到办公室。

entries.example: Her ambition is to become a doctor and help poor people.
entries.exampleZh: 她的志向是成为一名医生，帮助穷人。

entries.example: The ambulance arrived in five minutes and took him to hospital.
entries.exampleZh: 救护车五分钟就到了，把他送去了医院。

entries.example: My uncle has lived in America for more than ten years.
entries.exampleZh: 我叔叔在美国住了十多年了。

entries.example: My American friend teaches English at a school in Beijing.
entries.exampleZh: 我的美国朋友在北京一所学校教英语。

entries.example: She found a letter among the old books on the shelf.
entries.exampleZh: 她在书架上那些旧书中间发现了一封信。

entries.example: The little house stood amongst tall trees near the lake.
entries.exampleZh: 那座小屋坐落在湖边的高树之间。

entries.example: The amount of water in the bottle is small.
entries.exampleZh: 瓶子里水的量很少。

entries.example: One ampere is a unit used to measure electric current.
entries.exampleZh: 一安培是用来测量电流的一个单位。

entries.example: We can amplify the sound with this small machine.
entries.exampleZh: 我们可以用这台小机器把声音放大。

entries.example: The funny clown tried to amuse the children.
entries.exampleZh: 那个滑稽的小丑努力逗孩子们开心。

entries.example: Scientists analyse the data before they write the report.
entries.exampleZh: 科学家们在写报告之前会分析数据。

entries.example: Her analysis of the problem was clear and helpful.
entries.exampleZh: 她对问题的分析清晰又有帮助。

entries.example: My ancestor came to this city many years ago.
entries.exampleZh: 我的祖先很多年前来到这座城市。

entries.example: The heavy anchor kept the small boat safe.
entries.exampleZh: 沉重的锚让小船保持安全。

entries.example: Tom and his sister walk to school together.
entries.exampleZh: 汤姆和他妹妹一起走路去上学。

entries.example: The child drew a big angel with white wings.
entries.exampleZh: 那个孩子画了一个长着白色翅膀的大天使。

entries.example: He could not hide his anger at the news.
entries.exampleZh: 听到这个消息，他无法掩饰自己的愤怒。

entries.example: The teacher asked us to measure each angle carefully.
entries.exampleZh: 老师让我们仔细测量每一个角。

entries.example: My father was angry when I broke the window.
entries.exampleZh: 我打破窗户时，父亲很生气。

entries.example: The lion is a strong animal in the wild.
entries.exampleZh: 狮子是野外一种强壮的动物。

entries.example: She hurt her left ankle while playing football.
entries.exampleZh: 她踢足球时伤了左脚踝。

entries.example: The announcer read the news in a clear voice.
entries.exampleZh: 播音员用清晰的声音读了这条新闻。

entries.example: Would you like another cup of hot tea now?
entries.exampleZh: 你现在想再来一杯热茶吗？

entries.example: Please answer my question quickly before the class ends.
entries.exampleZh: 请在课结束前快点回答我的问题。

entries.example: A tiny ant carried a piece of bread home.
entries.exampleZh: 一只小蚂蚁把一块面包搬回了家。

entries.example: Her anxiety about the test kept her awake.
entries.exampleZh: 她对考试的焦虑让她睡不着觉。

entries.example: She felt anxious about the exam results last night.
entries.exampleZh: 她昨晚为考试成绩感到焦虑。

entries.example: Do you have any questions about the lesson?
entries.exampleZh: 关于这节课你们还有什么问题吗？

entries.example: Anybody can join the club if they pay the fee.
entries.exampleZh: 只要交会费，任何人都能加入这个俱乐部。

entries.example: It was raining, but we went out anyhow.
entries.exampleZh: 当时在下雨，但我们还是出去了。

entries.example: Does anyone know the answer to this question?
entries.exampleZh: 有人知道这道题的答案吗？

entries.example: I didn't eat anything before the long trip.
entries.exampleZh: 长途旅行之前我什么都没吃。

entries.example: The shop was closed, so we went home anyway.
entries.exampleZh: 商店关门了，所以我们还是回家了。

entries.example: I can't find my keys anywhere in this room.
entries.exampleZh: 我在这个房间里哪儿都找不到我的钥匙。

entries.example: The two old houses stand ten meters apart.
entries.exampleZh: 那两栋老房子相距十米。

entries.example: You should apologize to your sister for being rude.
entries.exampleZh: 你应该为自己的无礼向姐姐道歉。

entries.example: He sent a short apology for missing the meeting.
entries.exampleZh: 他为错过会议发了一封简短的道歉信。

entries.example: The lab has a new apparatus for testing water.
entries.exampleZh: 实验室有一台测试水质的新仪器。

entries.example: It was apparent that she enjoyed the concert.
entries.exampleZh: 很明显她很喜欢这场音乐会。

entries.example: A strange light began to appear in the sky.
entries.exampleZh: 一道奇怪的光开始出现在天空中。

entries.example: She ate a red apple after lunch today.
entries.exampleZh: 她今天午饭后吃了一个红苹果。

entries.example: This small kitchen appliance makes cooking much easier for us.
entries.exampleZh: 这个小厨房电器让我们做饭容易多了。

entries.example: These rules are applicable to all new students.
entries.exampleZh: 这些规定适用于所有新生。

entries.example: Please wear appropriate clothes for the job interview.
entries.exampleZh: 请穿合适的衣服去参加工作面试。

entries.example: The approximate cost of the trip is fifty dollars.
entries.exampleZh: 这次旅行的近似费用是五十美元。

entries.example: My birthday is in April, near the end of the month.
entries.exampleZh: 我的生日在四月，接近月底的时候。

entries.example: My uncle told us an Arabian story about a clever fox.
entries.exampleZh: 我叔叔给我们讲了一个关于聪明狐狸的阿拉伯故事。

entries.example: The teacher made an arbitrary rule about hats in class.
entries.exampleZh: 老师在课堂上随意定了一条关于帽子的规定。

entries.example: She studies architecture at a famous university in the north.
entries.exampleZh: 她在北方一所著名大学学习建筑学。

entries.example: This area of the city is very quiet at night.
entries.exampleZh: 城市的这个区域在夜里非常安静。

entries.example: They often argue about small things at the dinner table.
entries.exampleZh: 他们常常在餐桌上为小事争论。

entries.example: Their argument about money lasted for almost two hours.
entries.exampleZh: 他们关于钱的争论持续了将近两个小时。

entries.example: Small problems often arise when people do not plan ahead.
entries.exampleZh: 人们不提前计划时，小问题常常会出现。

entries.example: My little brother is learning simple arithmetic at school now.
entries.exampleZh: 我弟弟现在在学校学习简单的算术。

entries.example: He broke his left arm while playing football last week.
entries.exampleZh: 他上周踢足球时摔断了左臂。

entries.example: Her older brother joined the army after finishing high school.
entries.exampleZh: 她哥哥高中毕业后参了军。

entries.example: We walked around the old lake and took many photos.
entries.exampleZh: 我们绕着那个老湖走了一圈，拍了很多照片。

entries.example: Loud noises at night can arouse fear in small children.
entries.exampleZh: 夜里的巨响会引起小孩子的恐惧。

entries.example: The flower arrangement on the table looks simple and beautiful.
entries.exampleZh: 桌上的插花看起来简单又漂亮。

entries.example: Her arrival at the party surprised all of her friends.
entries.exampleZh: 她到达聚会时让她所有的朋友都很意外。

entries.example: Please call me when you arrive at the train station.
entries.exampleZh: 你到达火车站时请给我打电话。

entries.example: The red arrow on the sign points to the exit.
entries.exampleZh: 标志上的红色箭头指向出口。

entries.example: She loves art and spends every free hour drawing.
entries.exampleZh: 她热爱艺术，每个空闲时间都在画画。

entries.example: I read an interesting article about healthy food this morning.
entries.exampleZh: 今天早上我读了一篇关于健康饮食的有趣文章。

entries.example: The park has a small artificial lake near the gate.
entries.exampleZh: 公园大门附近有一个小型人工湖。

entries.example: The young artist painted a picture of the sea.
entries.exampleZh: 这位年轻的艺术家画了一幅海的画。

entries.example: She has an artistic way of arranging flowers on the table.
entries.exampleZh: 她有一种很有艺术感的摆花方式。

entries.example: The fire left only grey ash on the cold ground.
entries.exampleZh: 大火只在冰冷的地上留下了灰色的灰烬。

entries.example: My cousin will travel to Asia next summer with friends.
entries.exampleZh: 我表哥明年夏天要和朋友们去亚洲旅行。

entries.example: An Asian student sat next to me in class today.
entries.exampleZh: 今天上课时，一个亚洲学生坐在我旁边。

entries.example: She stepped aside to let the old man pass.
entries.exampleZh: 她往旁边让了一步，让那位老人过去。

entries.example: I will ask the teacher for help after class.
entries.exampleZh: 下课后我会向老师求助。

entries.example: The baby fell asleep in her mother's arms.
entries.exampleZh: 宝宝在妈妈怀里睡着了。

entries.example: We discussed every aspect of the plan this morning.
entries.exampleZh: 今天上午我们讨论了这个计划的各个方面。

entries.example: Two nurses assist the doctor during the long operation.
entries.exampleZh: 两名护士在漫长的的手术中协助医生。

entries.example: My assistant will answer the phone while I travel.
entries.exampleZh: 我出差期间，我的助手会接电话。

entries.example: The local football association meets every month in our town.
entries.exampleZh: 当地的足球协会每个月都在我们镇上开会。

entries.example: I assure you that the tickets are completely safe.
entries.exampleZh: 我向你保证这些票完全安全。

entries.example: The astronaut described his long journey into space.
entries.exampleZh: 这位宇航员描述了他漫长的太空旅程。

entries.example: Every athlete must train hard before the big race.
entries.exampleZh: 每个运动员都必须在大赛前刻苦训练。

entries.example: They crossed the Atlantic by boat many years ago.
entries.exampleZh: 很多年前他们乘船横渡了大西洋。

entries.example: Scientists measure atmospheric pressure with special tools.
entries.exampleZh: 科学家用专门的工具测量大气压力。

entries.example: Every atom in your body came from ancient stars.
entries.exampleZh: 你身体里的每一个原子都来自古老的恒星。

entries.example: The plant produces atomic energy for the whole city.
entries.exampleZh: 这座工厂为整座城市生产原子能。

entries.example: Please attach the photo to your application form.
entries.exampleZh: 请把照片附在你的申请表上。

entries.example: The sudden attack surprised everyone in the small village.

entries.exampleZh: 她就她的新工作做了简短的讲话。

entries.exampleZh: 早上厨房明亮又干净。

entries.exampleZh: 她为学校的演出想出了一个绝妙的主意。

entries.exampleZh: 她打算明年去英国学习。

entries.exampleZh: 我们观看了那场足球比赛的现场直播。

entries.exampleZh: 那扇破窗户让冷空气整夜灌进来。

entries.exampleZh: 公园里的那座旧雕像是用青铜做的。

entries.exampleZh: 母鸡把一窝小鸡护在翅膀下取暖。

entries.exampleZh: 一条小溪从我们房子后面流过，又经过农场。

entries.example: Please use this broom to sweep the kitchen floor.
entries.exampleZh: 请用这把扫帚扫一下厨房地板。

entries.exampleZh: 我哥哥每周六早上和朋友们踢足球。

entries.exampleZh: 他用毛巾擦去额头上的汗水。

entries.exampleZh: 她用刷子把鞋上的泥刷掉了。

entries.exampleZh: 在故事里，那个巨人举止像个凶残的畜生。

entries.exampleZh: 一个肥皂泡飘了起来，在窗边破掉了。

entries.exampleZh: 他把水桶装满水，然后洗了车。

entries.exampleZh: 今天早上树上冒出了一个小小的绿芽。

entries.example: They plan to build a new school near the river.
entries.exampleZh: 他们计划在河边建一所新学校。

entries.exampleZh: 我们的办公室在那栋高楼的顶层。

entries.exampleZh: 厨房的灯泡昨晚不亮了。

entries.exampleZh: 大部分工作已经完成了。

entries.exampleZh: 农夫在那片地里养着一头黑色的大公牛。

entries.exampleZh: 警察在门附近的地上发现了一颗子弹。

entries.exampleZh: 他送给母亲一束黄色的花。

entries.exampleZh: 他把一捆旧报纸放在门边。

entries.exampleZh: 小心那个滚烫的锅，不然会烫伤你的手。

entries.exampleZh: 如果今晚水结冰，那根旧管子可能会爆裂。

entries.exampleZh: 他们决定把那条老狗埋在树下。

entries.example: I take the bus to school every morning.
entries.exampleZh: 我每天早上坐公共汽车去学校。

entries.example: A small bird is singing in the bush near our window.
entries.exampleZh: 一只小鸟正在我们窗边的灌木丛里唱歌。

entries.exampleZh: 我叔叔在市中心经营一家小生意。

entries.example: The shop is very busy on Saturday afternoons.
entries.exampleZh: 这家店在星期六下午非常忙。

entries.exampleZh: 我本想出去，但是开始下雨了。

entries.exampleZh: 屠夫把肉切成小块给我们。

entries.exampleZh: 她在热面包片上涂了一些黄油。

entries.exampleZh: 一只鲜艳的蝴蝶落在我们花园里的黄花上。

entries.exampleZh: 请按红色按钮启动机器。

entries.exampleZh: 下班后我需要买些牛奶和鸡蛋。

entries.example: My mother cooks cabbage with pork and rice for dinner.
entries.exampleZh: 我妈妈晚饭做卷心菜配猪肉和米饭。

entries.example: We stayed in a small wooden cabin near the lake.
entries.exampleZh: 我们住在湖边一间小木屋里。

entries.exampleZh: 杯子放在厨房的橱柜里。

entries.example: A long cable connects the computer to the wall.
entries.exampleZh: 一根长电缆把电脑连到墙上。

entries.example: We had coffee and cake at a small cafe yesterday.
entries.exampleZh: 昨天我们在一家小咖啡馆喝了咖啡、吃了蛋糕。

entries.example: Students eat lunch in the school cafeteria every day.
entries.exampleZh: 学生们每天在学校自助食堂吃午饭。

entries.example: The bird sang happily inside its new cage.
entries.exampleZh: 那只鸟在它的新笼子里快乐地歌唱。

entries.example: My mother baked a chocolate cake for my birthday.
entries.exampleZh: 我妈妈为我的生日烤了一个巧克力蛋糕。

entries.exampleZh: 他对总费用的计算是正确的。

entries.exampleZh: 我用一个小计算器完成了数学作业。

entries.exampleZh: 她在墙上的日历上标出了考试日期。

entries.exampleZh: 你今晚到家后请给我打电话。

entries.exampleZh: 暴风雨过后，海面非常平静。

entries.exampleZh: 一只高大的骆驼缓慢地走过炎热的沙漠。

entries.example: He took a photo with his new camera.
entries.exampleZh: 他用他的新照相机拍了一张照片。

entries.example: We set up our camp beside the quiet river.
entries.exampleZh: 我们在安静的河边搭起了营地。

entries.example: The new library is in the middle of our campus.
entries.exampleZh: 新图书馆在我们校园的中间。

entries.example: She opened a can of soup for lunch.
entries.exampleZh: 她打开了一罐汤当午饭。

entries.exampleZh: 我表哥去年为了工作搬到了加拿大。

entries.exampleZh: 我的老师在课堂上给我们看了一张加拿大地图。

entries.exampleZh: 小船沿着狭窄的运河缓慢行驶。

entries.exampleZh: 医生们正在努力寻找治疗癌症的方法。

entries.exampleZh: 一支蜡烛照亮了这间小黑屋。

entries.example: The children ate too much candy at the party.
entries.exampleZh: 孩子们在聚会上吃了太多糖果。

entries.example: The old cannon stands in front of the museum.
entries.exampleZh: 那门旧大炮立在博物馆前面。

entries.example: We paddled a small canoe down the quiet river.
entries.exampleZh: 我们划着一只小独木舟沿安静的河而下。

entries.exampleZh: 她买了一块帆布来画那个旧港口。

entries.exampleZh: 他在外面戴着一顶蓝色帽子和一件暖和的夹克。

entries.example: This small bottle has a capacity of only two cups.
entries.exampleZh: 这个小瓶子只有两杯的容量。

entries.exampleZh: 巴黎是法国的首都，也是一座著名的城市。

entries.example: The captain told his team to run faster today.
entries.exampleZh: 队长让他的队员们今天跑得更快一些。

entries.exampleZh: 那个俘虏整晚安静地坐在火堆旁。

entries.example: They plan to capture the wild bird with a net.
entries.exampleZh: 他们打算用网捕获那只野鸟。

entries.exampleZh: 我父亲星期天早上洗了他的新车。

entries.example: Diamonds are a form of carbon found in nature.
entries.exampleZh: 钻石是自然界中存在的一种碳。

entries.exampleZh: 她在一张生日卡片上写了几句简短的话。

entries.exampleZh: 今天下午请照顾好你的小妹妹。

entries.exampleZh: 她的音乐生涯从她年轻时开始。

entries.example: Be careful with the hot soup on the table.
entries.exampleZh: 小心桌上那碗热汤。

entries.exampleZh: 那艘船载着大米和茶叶等重货。

entries.exampleZh: 大厅里的旧地毯摸起来又软又暖。

entries.exampleZh: 我们坐在慢车的最后一节车厢里。

entries.exampleZh: 这辆自行车后轮上方有个小货架。

entries.exampleZh: 他把一根胡萝卜切成小块放进汤里。

entries.exampleZh: 你能把这个重箱子搬上楼吗？

entries.exampleZh: 农夫拉着一辆装满苹果的木车。

entries.exampleZh: 他喜欢用软木雕刻小动物。

entries.exampleZh: 那样的话，我们应该早点离开聚会。

entries.exampleZh: 我身上没带现金，只有银行卡。

entries.exampleZh: 她在床下的盒子里找到一盘旧磁带。

entries.example: The fisherman will cast his net into the river.
entries.exampleZh: 渔夫会把网撒进河里。

entries.example: The old castle stands on top of a green hill.
entries.exampleZh: 那座古老的城堡矗立在一座绿色的小山上。

entries.exampleZh: 我的猫整个下午都睡在温暖的沙发上。

entries.exampleZh: 我在商店的目录里查找价格。

entries.exampleZh: 市中心的那座古老的大教堂非常漂亮。

entries.exampleZh: 那个农民在他的大农场里养牛和羊。

entries.exampleZh: 这场火灾的主要原因是电线断裂。

entries.exampleZh: 熊在冬天常常睡在黑暗的洞穴里。

entries.exampleZh: 大雨一直下到深夜才停。

entries.exampleZh: 白色的天花板上有一道小裂缝。

entries.exampleZh: 我们会用一个大大的蛋糕庆祝她的生日。

entries.exampleZh: 我们身体里的每个细胞都需要水和食物。

entries.exampleZh: 他把旧酒和箱子存放在黑暗的地下室里。

entries.exampleZh: 工人们把沙子和水泥混合起来砌墙。

entries.exampleZh: 这颗小糖果在那家店里只要一分钱。

entries.exampleZh: 昨晚气温降到了五摄氏度。

entries.exampleZh: 这条线只比另一条长一厘米。

entries.exampleZh: 我们的旅馆位于车站附近一个中心位置。

entries.exampleZh: 我们在老城区的中心见了面。

entries.example: This old church was built in the last century.
entries.exampleZh: 这座古老的教堂建于上个世纪。

entries.exampleZh: 我确信她会通过考试。

entries.exampleZh: 他星期五一定会来参加你的聚会。

entries.exampleZh: 这个计划能否奏效并没有把握。

entries.exampleZh: 她在前台出示了她的出生证明。

entries.example: He keeps his bike chain clean and dry.
entries.exampleZh: 他让他的自行车链条保持干净干燥。

entries.exampleZh: 请把你的包放在门边的椅子上。

entries.exampleZh: 主席以一段简短的讲话宣布会议开始。

entries.exampleZh: 老师用粉笔把新单词写在黑板上。

entries.exampleZh: 成员们在大厅后面的一个小房间里开会。

entries.exampleZh: 她二十岁时成为了世界冠军。

entries.exampleZh: 再给我一次机会解释我的想法。

entries.exampleZh: 我付了咖啡钱后，他找给我一些零钱。

entries.exampleZh: 这个电视频道每周日晚上播放老电影。

entries.exampleZh: 请在下周一之前读完第一章。

entries.exampleZh: 酒店会另外向你收取早餐费。
