entries.exampleZh: 烟从老房子的烟囱里升起。

entries.example: My little brother touched his chin and smiled at me.
entries.exampleZh: 我弟弟摸了摸下巴，冲我笑了。

entries.example: China has many beautiful places that tourists love to visit.
entries.exampleZh: 中国有许多游客喜欢游览的美丽地方。

entries.example: My sister is studying Chinese at a university in Shanghai.
entries.exampleZh: 我姐姐在上海的一所大学学习中文。

entries.example: She gave me a box of chocolate for my birthday.
entries.exampleZh: 她送了我一盒巧克力作为生日礼物。

entries.example: You have a choice between tea and coffee.
entries.exampleZh: 你可以在茶和咖啡之间选一个。

entries.example: Please choose one book from the shelf before you leave.
entries.exampleZh: 离开前请从书架上挑一本书。

entries.example: He had to chop the wood for the fire.
entries.exampleZh: 他得把木头劈开用来生火。

entries.example: Her uncle is a christian who prays every morning.
entries.exampleZh: 她的叔叔是个基督徒，每天早上都祈祷。

entries.example: We visit our grandparents every christmas and stay for a week.
entries.exampleZh: 我们每年圣诞节都去看望祖父母，并住上一周。

entries.example: The old church stands at the end of our street.
entries.exampleZh: 那座古老的教堂立在我们街道的尽头。

entries.example: He lit a cigaret and walked slowly to the door.
entries.exampleZh: 他点了一支烟，慢慢朝门口走去。

entries.example: We went to the cinema to see a new film.
entries.exampleZh: 我们去电影院看了一部新片子。

entries.example: The children sat in a circle on the floor.
entries.exampleZh: 孩子们在地板上围坐成一个圆圈。

entries.example: A broken circuit stopped the machine from working.
entries.exampleZh: 一个断了的电路使这台机器无法运转。

entries.example: The table in the kitchen is small and circular.
entries.exampleZh: 厨房里的那张桌子又小又是圆的。

entries.example: The fan helps to circulate cool air in the room.
entries.exampleZh: 风扇有助于让凉空气在房间里循环。

entries.example: We measured the circumference of the tree with a rope.
entries.exampleZh: 我们用绳子量了那棵树的周长。

entries.example: My sister moved to a big city last year.
entries.exampleZh: 我姐姐去年搬到了一座大城市。

entries.example: The civil servants work in that old building near the river.
entries.exampleZh: 那些公务员在河边那栋旧楼里工作。

entries.example: Teachers hope to civilize young students through good books and stories.
entries.exampleZh: 老师们希望通过好书和故事让年轻学生变得文明。

entries.example: Some people claim that this old bridge is over two hundred years old.
entries.exampleZh: 有些人声称这座旧桥有两百多年历史。

entries.example: The children clap their hands when the song ends.
entries.exampleZh: 歌曲结束时孩子们拍手。

entries.example: Could you clarify what you mean by that last sentence?
entries.exampleZh: 你能澄清一下你最后那句话的意思吗？

entries.example: The clasp on her gold necklace broke this morning.
entries.exampleZh: 她金项链上的扣子今天早上断了。

entries.example: Our class is going to the science museum on Friday.
entries.exampleZh: 我们班周五要去科学博物馆。

entries.example: My mother enjoys classical music while she cooks dinner.
entries.exampleZh: 我妈妈做饭时喜欢听古典音乐。

entries.example: My classmate lent me a pencil during the math test.
entries.exampleZh: 数学考试时我的同班同学借给我一支铅笔。

entries.example: Please keep the classroom tidy after your art lesson.
entries.exampleZh: 美术课后请保持教室整洁。

entries.example: The cat hurt its claw while climbing the tall tree.
entries.exampleZh: 那只猫爬高树时伤了爪子。

entries.example: The children made small animals out of wet clay.
entries.exampleZh: 孩子们用湿黏土做了小动物。

entries.example: Her hands were clean after she washed them carefully.
entries.exampleZh: 她仔细洗手后手很干净。

entries.example: The sky is clear, so we can see many stars.
entries.exampleZh: 天空很晴朗，所以我们可以看到许多星星。

entries.example: She spoke clearly so everyone in the back could hear.
entries.exampleZh: 她说得很清楚，后面的人都能听见。

entries.example: The clerk at the front desk helped us find our room.
entries.exampleZh: 前台职员帮我们找到了房间。

entries.example: That clever girl solved the puzzle in a few minutes.
entries.exampleZh: 那个聪明的女孩几分钟就解开了谜题。

entries.example: We stood on the cliff and watched the waves below.
entries.exampleZh: 我们站在悬崖上看着下面的海浪。

entries.example: This island has a warm climate all year round.
entries.exampleZh: 这个岛全年气候温暖。

entries.example: They plan to climb the mountain early next Saturday morning.
entries.exampleZh: 他们计划下周六一早去爬那座山。

entries.example: She wore a red cloak over her dress.
entries.exampleZh: 她在连衣裙外面穿了一件红色斗篷。

entries.example: The clock on the wall is five minutes fast.
entries.exampleZh: 墙上的钟快了五分钟。

entries.example: Please close the window before you leave the room.
entries.exampleZh: 离开房间前请把窗户关上。

entries.example: The two teams worked closely together on the project.
entries.exampleZh: 这两个团队在这个项目上紧密合作。

entries.example: She wiped the table with a clean cloth.
entries.exampleZh: 她用一块干净的布擦了桌子。

entries.example: Parents must feed and clothe their young children.
entries.exampleZh: 父母必须给年幼的孩子提供食物和衣服。

entries.example: My clothes are wet because of the heavy rain.
entries.exampleZh: 因为下大雨，我的衣服湿了。

entries.example: Warm clothing is necessary during the winter months.
entries.exampleZh: 在冬季的几个月里，保暖的衣物是必需的。

entries.example: A dark cloud moved slowly across the sky.
entries.exampleZh: 一朵乌云慢慢地飘过天空。

entries.example: It was cloudy all day, so we stayed home.
entries.exampleZh: 一整天都是多云，所以我们待在家里。

entries.example: He joined a chess club at his new school.
entries.exampleZh: 他在新学校加入了一个国际象棋俱乐部。

entries.example: They burned coal to heat the old house.
entries.exampleZh: 他们烧煤来给这座老房子取暖。

entries.example: The coarse sand felt rough under my feet.
entries.exampleZh: 粗糙的沙子踩在我脚下感觉很粗。

entries.example: We drove along the coast and watched the waves.
entries.exampleZh: 我们沿着海岸开车，看着海浪。

entries.example: Put on your warm coat before going outside.
entries.exampleZh: 出门前穿上你暖和的外套。

entries.example: The cock crowed loudly at sunrise and woke the farmer.
entries.exampleZh: 公鸡在日出时大声打鸣，把农夫吵醒了。

entries.example: I drink a cup of hot coffee every morning.
entries.exampleZh: 我每天早上喝一杯热咖啡。

entries.example: He wound the long rope into a tight coil.
entries.exampleZh: 他把长绳子卷成紧紧的一卷。

entries.example: She found an old coin under the sofa.
entries.exampleZh: 她在沙发下面发现了一枚旧硬币。

entries.example: The water in the lake is very cold today.
entries.exampleZh: 今天湖里的水非常冷。

entries.example: The old bridge could collapse during the heavy storm.
entries.exampleZh: 那座旧桥在暴风雨中可能会坍塌。

entries.example: The dog wore a red collar around its neck.
entries.exampleZh: 那只狗脖子上戴着一个红色的项圈。

entries.example: My sister likes to collect stamps from many countries.
entries.exampleZh: 我妹妹喜欢收集来自许多国家的邮票。

entries.example: His collection of old coins is very valuable.
entries.exampleZh: 他的旧硬币收藏品非常珍贵。

entries.example: The team made a collective decision after a long talk.
entries.exampleZh: 经过长时间的讨论，团队做出了集体决定。

entries.example: She studies art at a college near her home.
entries.exampleZh: 她在离家不远的一所学院学习艺术。

entries.example: The colonel gave orders to his soldiers before dawn.
entries.exampleZh: 上校在黎明前向他的士兵下达了命令。

entries.example: This small island was once a French colony.
entries.exampleZh: 这个小岛曾经是法国的殖民地。

entries.example: What color is the new carpet in your room?
entries.exampleZh: 你房间里的新地毯是什么颜色的？

entries.example: She found a small comb in her coat pocket.
entries.exampleZh: 她在外套口袋里找到了一把小梳子。

entries.example: Please come to my house for dinner on Friday.
entries.exampleZh: 星期五请来我家吃晚饭。

entries.example: The soft music gave her great comfort after a hard day.
entries.exampleZh: 在辛苦一天之后，轻柔的音乐给了她很大的安慰。

entries.example: This chair is very comfortable for long hours of reading.
entries.exampleZh: 这把椅子长时间看书非常舒适。

entries.example: The general can command a large army in wartime.
entries.exampleZh: 在战时，这位将军能指挥一支庞大的军队。

entries.example: The commander told his troops to rest for an hour.
entries.exampleZh: 指挥官让他的部队休息一个小时。

entries.example: The city grew rich through trade and commerce.
entries.exampleZh: 这座城市因贸易和商业而变得富裕。

entries.example: The film was a great commercial success last year.
entries.exampleZh: 这部电影去年在商业上取得了巨大成功。

entries.example: The government set up a commission to study the problem.
entries.exampleZh: 政府成立了一个委员会来研究这个问题。

entries.example: Colds are a common problem in winter for many people.
entries.exampleZh: 感冒是许多人冬天常见的问题。

entries.example: This plant is commonly found near rivers in our country.
entries.exampleZh: 这种植物在我国的河边很常见。

entries.example: We communicate with our teacher by email every day.
entries.exampleZh: 我们每天通过电子邮件和老师联系。

entries.example: Good communication makes every team work much better.
entries.exampleZh: 良好的沟通能让每个团队工作得更好。

entries.example: They studied the history of communism in their class.
entries.exampleZh: 他们在课上学习了共产主义的历史。

entries.example: The old man said he was a communist in his youth.
entries.exampleZh: 那位老人说他年轻时是个共产党员。

entries.example: Our community holds a small market every Saturday morning.
entries.exampleZh: 我们社区每周六上午办一个小集市。

entries.example: My dog is a loyal companion on every long walk.
entries.exampleZh: 我的狗在每次长途散步时都是忠实的伙伴。

entries.example: She works for a small company near the river.
entries.exampleZh: 她在河边一家小公司工作。

entries.example: This year's results show a comparative improvement in reading.
entries.exampleZh: 今年的结果显示阅读方面有相对提高。

entries.example: The teacher made a comparison between the two short stories.
entries.exampleZh: 老师对这两个短篇故事进行了比较。

entries.example: He used a compass to find the right way home.
entries.exampleZh: 他用指南针找到了回家的正确路线。

entries.example: Our school holds a singing competition every spring.
entries.exampleZh: 我们学校每年春天举办歌唱比赛。

entries.example: They will compile a list of useful books for us.
entries.exampleZh: 他们将为我们编写一份有用的书单。

entries.example: I completely forgot about the meeting this morning.
entries.exampleZh: 我完全忘了今天上午的会议。

entries.example: Please do not complicate a simple plan with extra rules.
entries.exampleZh: 请不要用额外的规则把简单的计划弄复杂。

entries.example: The team will compose a new song for the show.
entries.exampleZh: 团队将为演出创作一首新歌。

entries.example: Her composition about city life won first prize.
entries.exampleZh: 她关于城市生活的作文获得了一等奖。

entries.example: Water is a simple compound of hydrogen and oxygen.
entries.exampleZh: 水是一种由氢和氧组成的简单化合物。

entries.example: The reading test checks our comprehension of short texts.
entries.exampleZh: 阅读测试考查我们对短篇文章的理解。

entries.example: You can compress the files to save some space.
entries.exampleZh: 你可以压缩这些文件来节省一些空间。

entries.example: The class will comprise twenty students from different towns.
entries.exampleZh: 这个班将由来自不同城镇的二十名学生组成。

entries.example: Both sides finally reached a compromise after a long talk.
entries.exampleZh: 双方在长时间商谈后终于达成了妥协。

entries.example: Please compute the total cost of these tickets for me.
entries.exampleZh: 请帮我计算这些票的总费用。

entries.example: My new computer is much faster than the old one.
entries.exampleZh: 我的新电脑比旧的那台快多了。

entries.example: He stood by his comrade through every difficult year.
entries.exampleZh: 在每一个艰难的岁月里，他都陪伴着他的同志。

entries.example: She tried to conceal the small gift behind her back.
entries.exampleZh: 她试着把小礼物藏在身后。

entries.example: I cannot concentrate with all this noise around me.
entries.exampleZh: 周围这么吵，我无法集中注意力。

entries.example: I have a question concerning tomorrow's morning meeting.
entries.exampleZh: 我有一个关于明天上午会议的问题。

entries.example: We went to a lovely concert in the park last night.
entries.exampleZh: 昨晚我们去公园听了一场很棒的音乐会。

entries.example: From these facts we can conclude that he was right.
entries.exampleZh: 从这些事实我们可以推断出他是对的。

entries.example: Many people strongly condemn violence of any kind.
entries.exampleZh: 许多人强烈谴责任何形式的暴力。

entries.example: Please condense your long report into two short pages.
entries.exampleZh: 请把你的长篇报告压缩成两页短文。

entries.example: The old bridge is still in good condition today.
entries.exampleZh: 这座老桥今天状况依然良好。

entries.example: His conduct during the meeting surprised all of us.
entries.exampleZh: 他在会议上的举止让我们所有人吃惊。

entries.example: The conductor checked our tickets before the train left.
entries.exampleZh: 列车员在火车开动前检查了我们的车票。

entries.example: She will speak at a conference in Beijing next week.
entries.exampleZh: 她下周将在北京的一个会议上发言。

entries.example: He had to confess that he lost the key.
entries.exampleZh: 他不得不承认自己弄丢了钥匙。

entries.example: She feels confident about the exam on Friday.
entries.exampleZh: 她对周五的考试感到自信。

entries.example: Doctors had to confine him to bed for a week.
entries.exampleZh: 医生不得不让他卧床一周。

entries.example: The sudden change caused a lot of confusion among us.
entries.exampleZh: 突然的变化在我们中间引起了很多混乱。

entries.example: I want to congratulate you on your new job.
entries.exampleZh: 我想祝贺你找到了新工作。

entries.example: I sent him a letter of congratulation after the race.
entries.exampleZh: 比赛结束后我给他寄了一封祝贺信。

entries.example: A large medical congress will take place in our city next month.
entries.exampleZh: 一个大型医学大会下个月将在我们城市举行。

entries.example: A conjunction joins two words or parts of a sentence.
entries.exampleZh: 连词用来连接两个词或句子的两个部分。

entries.example: This new bridge will connect the two small villages.
entries.exampleZh: 这座新桥将连接这两个小村庄。

entries.example: There is a strong connection between diet and good health.
entries.exampleZh: 饮食与健康之间有着密切的联系。

entries.example: It took the climbers ten years to conquer this mountain.
entries.exampleZh: 登山者花了十年时间才征服这座山。

entries.example: The conquest of the city took only three days.
entries.exampleZh: 攻占这座城市只用了三天。

entries.example: She was not conscious of the danger behind her.
entries.exampleZh: 她没有意识到身后的危险。

entries.example: Please consider my idea carefully before you say no.
entries.exampleZh: 在你说不之前，请认真考虑一下我的想法。

entries.example: After careful consideration, they chose the smaller apartment.
entries.exampleZh: 经过仔细考虑，他们选择了那套较小的公寓。

entries.example: The club wrote a new constitution last winter.
entries.exampleZh: 俱乐部去年冬天写了一份新章程。

entries.example: Workers will construct a new library near the park.
entries.exampleZh: 工人们将在公园附近建造一座新图书馆。

entries.example: This box may contain some old photos of us.
entries.exampleZh: 这个盒子里可能有我们的一些旧照片。

entries.example: Please put the rice into a clean container.
entries.exampleZh: 请把米放进一个干净的容器里。

entries.example: He looked at the broken chair with contempt.
entries.exampleZh: 他轻蔑地看着那把破椅子。

entries.example: Africa is the second largest continent in the world.
entries.exampleZh: 非洲是世界第二大洲。

entries.example: The continual noise from the street kept me awake all night.
entries.exampleZh: 街上不断的噪音让我整夜没睡。

entries.example: We will continue our lesson after a short break.
entries.exampleZh: 短暂休息后我们将继续上课。

entries.example: The machine makes a continuous low sound all day.
entries.exampleZh: 这台机器整天发出持续的低沉声音。

entries.example: There is a clear contradiction between his words and actions.
entries.exampleZh: 他的言行之间有明显矛盾。

entries.example: The weather was cold, contrary to what the forecast said.
entries.exampleZh: 天气很冷，与预报所说的相反。

entries.example: She found it hard to control her anger during the meeting.
entries.exampleZh: 她发现在会议期间很难控制自己的怒火。

entries.example: Please reply at your earliest convenience and let us know your plans.
entries.exampleZh: 请您尽早回复，并告诉我们您的计划。

entries.example: It is a local convention to eat dumplings on that day.
entries.exampleZh: 那天吃饺子是当地的一种习俗。

entries.example: We had a long conversation about our future plans last night.
entries.exampleZh: 昨晚我们就未来的计划进行了长时间的交谈。

entries.example: Some people enjoy city life; conversely, my sister prefers quiet villages.
entries.exampleZh: 有些人喜欢城市生活；相反，我妹妹更喜欢安静的村庄。

entries.example: The conversion of the old factory into a library took two years.
entries.exampleZh: 把这座旧工厂改建成图书馆花了两年时间。

entries.example: They plan to convert the empty room into a small office.
entries.exampleZh: 他们打算把那间空房改成一个小办公室。

entries.example: My father can cook wonderful meals with very simple things.
entries.exampleZh: 我父亲能用很简单的东西做出美味的饭菜。

entries.example: The evening air felt cool after the long, hot day.
entries.exampleZh: 漫长炎热的一天过后，傍晚的空气感觉很凉爽。

entries.example: Both teams must cooperate closely to finish this project on time.
entries.exampleZh: 两个团队必须密切合作才能按时完成这个项目。

entries.example: She will coordinate the travel plans for our whole group.
entries.exampleZh: 她将为我们全组的旅行计划做协调。

entries.example: Many small shops find it hard to cope with rising costs.
entries.exampleZh: 许多小商店觉得难以应付不断上涨的成本。

entries.example: The old pot is made of copper and still looks beautiful.
entries.exampleZh: 这口旧锅是铜制的，看上去依然很美。

entries.example: Could you make a copy of this page for me?
entries.exampleZh: 你能帮我把这一页复印一份吗？

entries.example: He tied the box with a strong cord before mailing it.
entries.exampleZh: 寄出之前，他用一根结实的绳子把箱子捆好了。

entries.example: Our host gave us a cordial welcome and hot tea.
entries.exampleZh: 主人热情诚恳地欢迎了我们，还端上了热茶。

entries.example: The core of the problem is a lack of clear rules.
entries.exampleZh: 问题的核心是缺少明确的规则。

entries.example: Farmers here grow corn and beans in the same field.
entries.exampleZh: 这里的农民在同一块地里种植玉米和豆子。

entries.example: A small bookshop sits on the corner of that street.
entries.exampleZh: 那条街的拐角处有一家小书店。

entries.example: She works for a large corporation in the city center.
entries.exampleZh: 她在市中心一家大公司工作。

entries.example: Please correct the mistakes on the last page.
entries.exampleZh: 请改正最后一页上的错误。

entries.example: The teacher made a small correction in red ink.
entries.exampleZh: 老师用红笔做了一个小小的修改。

entries.example: These numbers should correspond with the ones in our report.
entries.exampleZh: 这些数字应该与我们报告中的数字相符。

entries.example: Our correspondent in Beijing sent this report yesterday.
entries.exampleZh: 我们驻北京的通讯员昨天发来了这篇报道。

entries.example: Please write your name in the corresponding box below.
entries.exampleZh: 请把你的名字写在下面相应的方框里。

entries.example: The students walked quietly down the long corridor.
entries.exampleZh: 学生们安静地走过长长的走廊。

entries.example: The cost of the trip was higher than we expected.
entries.exampleZh: 这次旅行的费用比我们预想的要高。

entries.example: That mistake was a costly one for the whole team.
entries.exampleZh: 那个错误对整个团队来说代价很大。

entries.example: They spent the summer in a small cottage by the sea.
entries.exampleZh: 他们夏天住在海边的一间小屋里。

entries.example: He wore a soft cotton shirt to the meeting.
entries.exampleZh: 他穿着一件柔软的棉质衬衫去开会。

entries.example: Her cough got worse during the cold night.
entries.exampleZh: 在那个寒冷的夜晚，她的咳嗽加重了。

entries.example: When I was young, I could swim very fast.
entries.exampleZh: 我小的时候能游得很快。

entries.example: Please count the chairs before the guests arrive.
entries.exampleZh: 请在客人到来之前数一下椅子。

entries.example: She paid the bill at the front counter.
entries.exampleZh: 她在前台付了账。

entries.example: China is a large country with a long history.
entries.exampleZh: 中国是一个历史悠久的辽阔国家。

entries.example: We drove through the green countryside on Sunday.
entries.exampleZh: 星期天我们开车穿过绿色的乡村。

entries.example: He lives in a quiet county near the coast.
entries.exampleZh: 他住在一个靠近海岸的安静县里。

entries.example: It takes courage to speak in front of everyone.
entries.exampleZh: 在所有人面前讲话需要勇气。

entries.example: She is taking a cooking course this autumn.
entries.exampleZh: 她今年秋天在上一门烹饪课程。

entries.example: The judge asked everyone in the court to stand up.
entries.exampleZh: 法官让法庭里的每个人都站起来。

entries.example: My cousin lives in a small town near the sea.
entries.exampleZh: 我的表姐住在海边的一个小镇上。

entries.example: Please cover the food before you put it in the fridge.
entries.exampleZh: 把食物放进冰箱前请先盖上。

entries.example: The cow is eating grass in the green field.
entries.exampleZh: 那头母牛正在绿色的田野里吃草。

entries.example: Nobody wants to be called a coward in front of friends.
entries.exampleZh: 没人愿意在朋友面前被叫做懦夫。

entries.example: There is a long crack in the wall near the window.
entries.exampleZh: 窗户附近的墙上有一道长长的裂缝。

entries.example: She learned the craft of making paper flowers from her aunt.
entries.exampleZh: 她从姑妈那里学会了做纸花的手艺。

entries.example: A huge crane lifted the heavy boxes onto the ship.
entries.exampleZh: 一台巨大的起重机把沉重的箱子吊上了船。

entries.example: The baby can crawl across the room very fast.
entries.exampleZh: 这个婴儿能很快地爬过房间。

entries.example: That crazy idea made everyone in the room laugh.
entries.exampleZh: 那个疯狂的想法让房间里的每个人都笑了。

entries.example: I like to put cream and sugar in my coffee.
entries.exampleZh: 我喜欢在咖啡里加奶油和糖。

entries.example: Our teacher asked us to create a poster about water.
entries.exampleZh: 老师让我们制作一张关于水的海报。

entries.example: She is a creative writer with many interesting stories.
entries.exampleZh: 她是一位有创造力的作家，写了许多有趣的故事。

entries.example: A small creature was hiding under the old wooden bench.
entries.exampleZh: 一只小生物躲在旧木长椅下面。

entries.example: She paid for the meal with her credit card.
entries.exampleZh: 她用信用卡付了这顿饭钱。

entries.example: The cat likes to creep quietly behind the sofa.
entries.exampleZh: 这只猫喜欢悄悄地爬到沙发后面。

entries.example: The whole crew worked hard to keep the ship clean.
entries.exampleZh: 全体船员努力保持船上清洁。

entries.example: We watched a cricket match on the grass after lunch.
entries.exampleZh: 午饭后我们在草地上看了一场板球比赛。

entries.example: Stealing a bike is a crime in every country.
entries.exampleZh: 偷自行车在每个国家都是犯罪。

entries.example: The police caught the criminal near the train station.
entries.exampleZh: 警察在火车站附近抓住了那个罪犯。

entries.example: The old cripple sat by the gate and asked for bread.
entries.exampleZh: 那位年老的跛子坐在门边乞讨面包。

entries.example: Heavy rain ruined the rice crop last summer.
entries.exampleZh: 去年夏天的大雨毁掉了水稻作物。

entries.example: Look both ways before you cross the busy street.
entries.exampleZh: 过繁忙的街道前，要左右看看。

entries.example: A black crow sat on the fence and looked at us.
entries.exampleZh: 一只黑乌鸦停在栅栏上看着我们。

entries.example: A large crowd waited outside the stadium for the players.
entries.exampleZh: 一大群人在体育场外等着球员们。

entries.example: The queen wore a golden crown at the ceremony.
entries.exampleZh: 女王在典礼上戴着一顶金色的王冠。

entries.example: They built a crude shelter from wood and old cloth.
entries.exampleZh: 他们用木头和旧布搭了一个简陋的棚子。

entries.example: It is cruel to leave a dog alone all day.
entries.exampleZh: 把狗整天独自留在家里是残忍的。

entries.example: Do not crush the eggs in your bag.
entries.exampleZh: 不要压碎你包里的鸡蛋。

entries.example: My little brother never eats the crust of his bread.
entries.exampleZh: 我弟弟从来不吃面包皮。

entries.example: The baby began to cry when the lights went out.
entries.exampleZh: 灯灭的时候，婴儿开始哭了起来。

entries.example: She found a clear crystal near the river bank.
entries.exampleZh: 她在河岸边发现了一块透明的水晶。

entries.example: Put one ice cube in my glass, please.
entries.exampleZh: 请往我杯子里放一块冰块。

entries.example: This box has a volume of two cubic metres.
entries.exampleZh: 这个箱子的体积是两立方米。

entries.example: She cut a cucumber and added it to the salad.
entries.exampleZh: 她切了一根黄瓜，加进沙拉里。

entries.example: Food is an important part of every culture.
entries.exampleZh: 食物是每一种文化中重要的一部分。

entries.example: The cunning fox escaped from the farmer's trap.
entries.exampleZh: 那只狡猾的狐狸从农夫的陷阱里逃走了。

entries.example: Would you like a cup of hot tea?
entries.exampleZh: 你想要一杯热茶吗？

entries.example: The plates are in the cupboard above the sink.
entries.exampleZh: 盘子在洗碗池上方的碗柜里。

entries.example: Doctors are still looking for a cure for this illness.
entries.exampleZh: 医生们仍在寻找这种病的治疗方法。

entries.example: She has a soft curl of hair above her ear.
entries.exampleZh: 她耳朵上方有一小卷柔软的头发。

entries.example: People say a curse hangs over the old house.
entries.exampleZh: 人们说那座老房子上笼罩着诅咒。

entries.example: Please close the curtain before you turn on the light.
entries.exampleZh: 开灯前请先把窗帘拉上。

entries.example: The road makes a wide curve near the river.
entries.exampleZh: 这条路在河边拐了一个大弯。

entries.example: There is a soft cushion on the wooden chair.
entries.exampleZh: 木椅子上有一个柔软的靠垫。

entries.example: It is a local custom to share food at the festival.
entries.exampleZh: 在节日里分享食物是当地的风俗。

entries.example: The customer asked for a glass of cold water.
entries.exampleZh: 那位顾客要了一杯冷水。

entries.example: Please cut the cake into eight small pieces.
entries.exampleZh: 请把蛋糕切成八小块。

entries.example: He rides his cycle to school every morning.
entries.exampleZh: 他每天早晨骑自行车上学。

entries.example: Reading the daily news helps me start my morning.
entries.exampleZh: 读日报能帮我开启新的一天。

entries.example: The dairy sells fresh milk and cheese every day.
entries.exampleZh: 那家牛奶场每天出售新鲜牛奶和奶酪。

entries.example: A large dam holds the water above the village.
entries.exampleZh: 一座大水坝把水挡在村子上方。

entries.example: The storm did a lot of damage to our roof.
entries.exampleZh: 暴风雨对我们的屋顶造成了很大损坏。

entries.example: My shoes are still damp from the rain.
entries.exampleZh: 我的鞋子淋了雨，现在还是潮的。

entries.example: They dance together in the park every Sunday.
entries.exampleZh: 他们每周日在公园里一起跳舞。

entries.example: The thin ice is a real danger for children.
entries.exampleZh: 薄冰对孩子们来说是真正的危险。

entries.example: It is dangerous to swim in this cold river.
entries.exampleZh: 在这条冰冷的河里游泳很危险。

entries.example: I dare you to touch that small spider.
entries.exampleZh: 我谅你不敢碰那只小蜘蛛。

entries.example: The daring boy climbed the tall tree alone.
entries.exampleZh: 那个大胆的男孩独自爬上了那棵高树。

entries.example: The room was dark, so we turned on a lamp.
entries.exampleZh: 房间里很暗，所以我们打开了一盏灯。

entries.example: Happy birthday, darling, and thank you for the lovely cake.
entries.exampleZh: 生日快乐，亲爱的，谢谢你做的可爱蛋糕。

entries.example: He made a dash for the bus and caught it.
entries.exampleZh: 他冲向公交车，赶上了。

entries.example: The scientist wrote all the data in a small notebook.
entries.exampleZh: 那位科学家把所有数据写在一个小本子里。

entries.example: Please write the date at the top of your page.
entries.exampleZh: 请把日期写在你这页纸的顶部。

entries.example: My daughter plays the piano every evening after dinner.
entries.exampleZh: 我女儿每天晚饭后弹钢琴。

entries.example: We left the house at dawn to catch the early train.
entries.exampleZh: 我们黎明时离开家去赶早班火车。

entries.example: It was a cold day, so I wore my warm coat.
entries.exampleZh: 那天很冷，所以我穿上了暖和的外套。

entries.example: We could see the mountain clearly in the bright daylight.
entries.exampleZh: 在明亮的日光下，我们能清楚地看到那座山。

entries.example: The old tree in our garden is dead now.
entries.exampleZh: 我们花园里的那棵老树现在死了。

entries.example: That snake has a deadly bite, so stay far away.
entries.exampleZh: 那条蛇咬人致命，所以要离得远远的。

entries.example: My grandfather is deaf, so we talk with our hands.
entries.exampleZh: 我祖父耳聋，所以我们用手势交谈。

entries.example: We made a good deal with the fruit seller.
entries.exampleZh: 我们和卖水果的人做成了一笔好买卖。

entries.example: Dear sir, thank you for your kind letter last week.
entries.exampleZh: 亲爱的先生，谢谢您上周的亲切来信。

entries.example: His sudden death made the whole village very sad.
entries.exampleZh: 他的突然去世让整个村子都很难过。

entries.example: The students had a long debate about school rules.
entries.exampleZh: 学生们就校规进行了长时间的辩论。

entries.example: My uncle lived in Japan for almost a decade.
entries.exampleZh: 我叔叔在日本住了将近十年。

entries.example: The old wooden bridge slowly began to decay.
entries.exampleZh: 那座旧木桥慢慢开始腐烂。

entries.example: His kindness was pure deceit, and we felt hurt.
entries.exampleZh: 他的好意纯粹是欺骗，我们感到很受伤。

entries.example: Do not deceive your friends with clever, untrue stories.
entries.exampleZh: 不要用巧妙的不实故事欺骗你的朋友。

entries.example: We will visit our grandparents in December for the holidays.
entries.exampleZh: 我们将在十二月去看望祖父母过节。

entries.example: We must decide where to go for our holiday this year.
entries.exampleZh: 我们必须决定今年去哪里度假。

entries.example: Making a quick decision is sometimes better than waiting too long.
entries.exampleZh: 有时候迅速做出决定比等太久更好。

entries.example: The children stood on the deck and watched the boats.
entries.exampleZh: 孩子们站在甲板上看着那些船。

entries.example: The manager will declare the results at noon tomorrow.
entries.exampleZh: 经理明天中午将宣布结果。

entries.example: There was a small decrease in prices last month.
entries.exampleZh: 上个月价格有小幅下降。

entries.example: From these facts we can deduce the cause of the problem.
entries.exampleZh: 从这些事实中我们可以推断出问题的原因。

entries.example: His kind deed helped many families in our town.
entries.exampleZh: 他的善举帮助了我们镇上的许多家庭。

entries.example: The river is too deep for young children to swim in.
entries.exampleZh: 这条河对小孩子来说太深了，不能在里面游泳。

entries.example: We saw a young deer near the edge of the forest.
entries.exampleZh: 我们在森林边上看到了一只小鹿。

entries.example: Our team hopes to defeat the champions next Saturday.
entries.exampleZh: 我们队希望下周六战胜冠军队。

entries.example: This old phone has one small defect in its screen.
entries.exampleZh: 这部旧手机屏幕上有一个小缺陷。

entries.example: The city spent more money on defence last year.
entries.exampleZh: 这座城市去年在防御上花了更多钱。

entries.example: Soldiers are ready to defend the bridge at any time.
entries.exampleZh: 士兵们随时准备保卫这座桥。

entries.example: We need a definite answer before Friday morning.
entries.exampleZh: 我们需要在周五上午之前得到一个明确的答复。

entries.example: I will definitely come to your party on Sunday.
entries.exampleZh: 星期天我一定会来参加你的聚会。

entries.example: A small delegation from Japan visited our school today.
entries.exampleZh: 今天一个来自日本的小代表团参观了我们学校。

entries.example: Please delete these old files from the shared computer.
entries.exampleZh: 请从共用电脑上删除这些旧文件。

entries.example: She carried the delicate glass bowl with both hands.
entries.exampleZh: 她用双手捧着那个易碎的玻璃碗。

entries.example: My grandmother makes delicious soup every Sunday afternoon.
entries.exampleZh: 我奶奶每个星期天下午都会做美味的汤。

entries.example: The delivery of our new sofa will take three days.
entries.exampleZh: 我们新沙发的送货需要三天时间。

entries.example: In a democracy, people choose their leaders through fair elections.
entries.exampleZh: 在民主制度下，人们通过公平的选举来选择领导人。

entries.example: The forest is so dense that sunlight cannot reach the ground.
entries.exampleZh: 这片森林非常密集，阳光照不到地面。

entries.example: She cannot deny that she made a mistake yesterday.
entries.exampleZh: 她无法否认她昨天犯了一个错误。

entries.example: The train will depart from the station at six tomorrow morning.
entries.exampleZh: 火车明天早上六点从车站出发。

entries.example: Her sudden departure surprised all of her friends.
entries.exampleZh: 她的突然离开让所有朋友都很惊讶。

entries.example: Many old people depend on their children for daily help.
entries.exampleZh: 许多老人依靠子女提供日常帮助。

entries.example: The baby is still dependent on his mother for food.
entries.exampleZh: 这个婴儿仍然依赖母亲获得食物。

entries.example: Please deposit your money at the bank before noon.
entries.exampleZh: 请在中午前把钱存入银行。

entries.example: Rainy days always depress me and make me feel tired.
entries.exampleZh: 阴雨天总是让我沮丧，让我感到疲倦。

entries.example: The depth of the lake surprised the young swimmers.
entries.exampleZh: 这个湖的深度让年轻的游泳者感到惊讶。

entries.example: We slowly descend the stairs to the kitchen every morning.
entries.exampleZh: 每天早上我们慢慢走下楼梯到厨房。

entries.example: Can you describe the man you saw last night?
entries.exampleZh: 你能描述一下你昨晚看到的那个男人吗？

entries.example: Her description of the village matched the old photo exactly.
entries.exampleZh: 她对那个村庄的描述与那张旧照片完全一致。

entries.example: He wants to design a simple chair for his new flat.
entries.exampleZh: 他想为他的新公寓设计一把简单的椅子。

entries.example: A quiet room near the library is a desirable place to study.
entries.exampleZh: 图书馆附近安静的房间是理想的学习场所。

entries.example: My books and pens are all over the desk.
entries.exampleZh: 我的书和笔摊满了书桌。

entries.example: After many failures, he fell into deep despair.
entries.exampleZh: 经过多次失败后，他陷入了深深的绝望。

entries.example: She was desperate for news about her missing brother.
entries.exampleZh: 她急切地想知道失踪弟弟的消息。

entries.example: I despise people who are cruel to animals.
entries.exampleZh: 我鄙视那些对动物残忍的人。

entries.example: Our final destination is a small town near the sea.
entries.exampleZh: 我们最终的目的地是海边的一座小镇。

entries.example: The heavy storm can destroy a small house in minutes.
entries.exampleZh: 这场猛烈的暴风雨几分钟内就能摧毁一座小房子。

entries.example: Small towns often develop into busy cities over time.
entries.exampleZh: 小镇常常随着时间发展成繁忙的城市。

entries.example: The development of this new park took two years.
entries.exampleZh: 这座新公园的开发花了两年时间。

entries.example: The story says a devil lives under the old bridge.
entries.exampleZh: 故事里说，一个魔鬼住在老桥下面。

entries.example: We must devise a simple plan to save water.
entries.exampleZh: 我们必须想出一个省水的简单方案。

entries.example: Every morning the grass is wet with dew.
entries.exampleZh: 每天早晨草上都沾着露水。

entries.example: The teacher drew a clear diagram of the water cycle.
entries.exampleZh: 老师画了一张清晰的水循环示意图。

entries.example: Please dial this number if you need any help.
entries.exampleZh: 如果你需要任何帮助，请拨打这个号码。

entries.example: My grandmother speaks a local dialect at home.
entries.exampleZh: 我奶奶在家说一种当地方言。

entries.example: The dialog in that film sounds very natural.
entries.exampleZh: 那部电影里的对白听起来很自然。

entries.example: The circle has a diameter of about ten centimeters.
entries.exampleZh: 这个圆的直径大约十厘米。

entries.example: She wore a small diamond ring on her finger.
entries.exampleZh: 她手指上戴着一枚小钻石戒指。

entries.example: He writes in his diary before going to bed.
entries.exampleZh: 他睡觉前会写日记。

entries.example: Our teacher gives us a short dictation every Friday.
entries.exampleZh: 我们老师每周五给我们做一段短听写。

entries.example: Look up the new word in your dictionary.
entries.exampleZh: 在你的词典里查一下这个生词。

entries.example: Many plants die without enough water and sunlight.
entries.exampleZh: 许多植物没有足够的水和阳光就会死。

entries.example: Their answers differ, but both of them are right.
entries.exampleZh: 他们的答案不同，但两个都对。

entries.example: There is a big difference between these two shirts.
entries.exampleZh: 这两件衬衫之间有很大的差别。

entries.example: Each student here comes from a different country.
entries.exampleZh: 这里的每个学生都来自不同的国家。

entries.example: This math problem is too difficult for young children.
entries.exampleZh: 这道数学题对小孩子来说太难了。

entries.example: This math problem is causing me a lot of difficulty today.
entries.exampleZh: 这道数学题今天给我带来了很大的困难。

entries.example: The children like to dig in the sand at the beach.
entries.exampleZh: 孩子们喜欢在海滩的沙子里挖着玩。

entries.example: I need some time to digest all this new information.
entries.exampleZh: 我需要一些时间来消化所有这些新信息。

entries.example: My new watch has a bright digital display on the front.
entries.exampleZh: 我的新手表正面有一个明亮的数字显示屏。

entries.example: The room was too dim for us to read clearly.
entries.exampleZh: 房间太暗了，我们看不清字。

entries.example: Please measure each dimension of the box before you buy it.
entries.exampleZh: 买之前请量一下这个盒子的每个尺寸。

entries.example: We usually have dinner together at seven in the evening.
entries.exampleZh: 我们通常晚上七点一起吃晚饭。

entries.example: She likes to dip her bread into the warm soup.
entries.exampleZh: 她喜欢把面包蘸进热汤里。

entries.example: There is a direct train from the airport to the city.
entries.exampleZh: 从机场到市区有一趟直达列车。

entries.example: He walked in the wrong direction and got lost.
entries.exampleZh: 他走错了方向，迷路了。

entries.example: Please come directly to my office after the meeting.
entries.exampleZh: 会议结束后请直接来我的办公室。

entries.example: The director asked us to finish the film by Friday.
entries.exampleZh: 导演要求我们在周五前完成这部电影。

entries.exampleZh: 你的新鞋上有很多泥土。

entries.example: His hands were dirty after working in the garden.
entries.exampleZh: 在花园里干完活后，他的手很脏。

entries.example: They had to disable the alarm before entering the room.
entries.exampleZh: 进房间之前他们不得不关掉警报器。

entries.exampleZh: 我不同意你的计划，但我仍然尊重它。

entries.exampleZh: 我真的希望考试结果不会让你失望。

entries.exampleZh: 大雨给这个村庄带来了可怕的灾难。

entries.example: Please discard any paper you do not need anymore.
entries.exampleZh: 请丢弃你不再需要的任何纸张。

entries.exampleZh: 良好的纪律有助于学生在每节课上学得更好。

entries.example: The company refused to disclose the details of the new plan.
entries.exampleZh: 公司拒绝透露新计划的细节。

entries.example: The discovery of the old coins excited the whole village.
entries.exampleZh: 这些旧硬币的发现让整个村子都很兴奋。

entries.example: We will discuss the problem with our teacher tomorrow.
entries.exampleZh: 我们明天会和老师讨论这个问题。

entries.example: Our discussion about the trip lasted for two hours.
entries.exampleZh: 我们关于这次旅行的讨论持续了两个小时。

entries.example: This disease can spread quickly among young children.
entries.exampleZh: 这种疾病能在幼儿中迅速传播。

entries.example: He wore a funny disguise to the party last night.
entries.exampleZh: 昨晚他戴着滑稽的伪装去参加聚会。

entries.example: She looked at the dirty kitchen with disgust.
entries.exampleZh: 她厌恶地看着脏乱的厨房。

entries.example: My mother made a delicious dish for the family.
entries.exampleZh: 妈妈为家人做了一道美味的菜。

entries.example: Lying to your friends brings dishonour to your name.
entries.exampleZh: 对朋友撒谎会给你的名声带来耻辱。

entries.example: Please save the file on this disk before you leave.
entries.exampleZh: 离开前请把文件保存在这张磁盘上。

entries.example: I dislike waiting in long lines at the bank.
entries.exampleZh: 我不喜欢在银行排长队等候。

entries.example: The teacher will dismiss the class ten minutes early.
entries.exampleZh: 老师会提前十分钟下课。

entries.example: The room was in complete disorder after the party.
entries.exampleZh: 聚会过后房间里一片混乱。

entries.example: I hope my answer will not displease the manager.
entries.exampleZh: 我希望我的回答不会让经理不高兴。

entries.example: The safe disposal of waste is important for our city.
entries.exampleZh: 安全地处理垃圾对我们城市很重要。

entries.example: Please dispose of your rubbish in the bin outside.
entries.exampleZh: 请把你的垃圾放进外面的垃圾桶里。

entries.example: Sugar will dissolve quickly in a cup of hot water.
entries.exampleZh: 糖会在一杯热水里迅速溶解。

entries.example: There is a clear distinction between these two words.
entries.exampleZh: 这两个词之间有明显的区别。

entries.example: The fair distribution of food helped everyone in the camp.
entries.exampleZh: 食物的公平分配帮助了营地里的每个人。

entries.example: Please do not disturb me while I am studying.
entries.exampleZh: 我学习的时候请不要打扰我。

entries.example: The farmer dug a ditch to bring water to his field.
entries.exampleZh: 农夫挖了一条沟渠，把水引到田里。

entries.example: She learned to dive from the high board last summer.
entries.exampleZh: 去年夏天她学会了从高板上跳水。

entries.example: Her parents' divorce changed the life of the whole family.
entries.exampleZh: 父母的离婚改变了整个家庭的生活。

entries.example: The small boat is waiting at the dock for its owner.
entries.exampleZh: 小船在码头等着它的主人。

entries.example: You should see a doctor if the pain does not stop.
entries.exampleZh: 如果疼痛不止，你应该去看医生。

entries.example: Our dog runs to the gate whenever the bell rings.
entries.exampleZh: 每当门铃响，我们的狗都会跑到门口。

entries.example: This book costs one dollar at the school sale.
entries.exampleZh: 这本书在学校义卖上卖一美元。

entries.example: The old farmer rides a donkey to the market each morning.
entries.exampleZh: 那位老农每天早上骑驴去集市。

entries.example: Please close the door quietly when you leave the room.
entries.exampleZh: 离开房间时请轻轻关上门。

entries.example: My brother lives in a dorm near the university.
entries.exampleZh: 我哥哥住在大学附近的一间宿舍里。

entries.example: Take one dose of this medicine after each meal.
entries.exampleZh: 每餐后服用一剂这种药。

entries.example: There is a small red dot on the map.
entries.exampleZh: 地图上有一个小红点。

entries.example: We booked a double room for the whole weekend.
entries.exampleZh: 我们订了一间双人房，住整个周末。

entries.example: I doubt whether he will come to the party tonight.
entries.exampleZh: 我怀疑他今晚是否会来参加聚会。

entries.example: It is doubtful that the match will start on time.
entries.exampleZh: 比赛能否准时开始还很难说。

entries.example: She will doubtless call you as soon as she arrives.
entries.exampleZh: 她一到无疑会给你打电话。

entries.example: He walked down the stairs to answer the phone.
entries.exampleZh: 他下楼去接电话。

entries.example: The kitchen is downstairs, next to the living room.
entries.exampleZh: 厨房在楼下，紧挨着客厅。

entries.example: The plane began a downward turn after the loud warning.
entries.exampleZh: 听到响亮的警报后，飞机开始向下转弯。

entries.example: She bought a dozen eggs and some bread this morning.
entries.exampleZh: 今天早上她买了一打鸡蛋和一些面包。

entries.example: She wrote a first draft of her letter last night.
entries.exampleZh: 她昨晚写了一封信的第一稿。

entries.example: Please do not drag that heavy box across the floor.
entries.exampleZh: 请不要把那个沉重的箱子拖过地板。

entries.example: The red dragon in the story breathes fire and smoke.
entries.exampleZh: 故事里的那条红龙会喷火和冒烟。

entries.example: The old drain in our garden is blocked with leaves.
entries.exampleZh: 我们花园里的旧排水沟被树叶堵住了。

entries.example: We watched a funny drama about a small village school.
entries.exampleZh: 我们看了一部关于乡村小学的搞笑戏剧。

entries.example: The film ends with a dramatic scene in the rain.
entries.exampleZh: 这部电影以雨中一场戏剧性的场景结束。

entries.example: Can you draw a map of the park for me?
entries.exampleZh: 你能为我画一张公园的地图吗？

entries.example: The knives are in the top drawer of the kitchen.
entries.exampleZh: 刀在厨房最上面的抽屉里。

entries.example: Her drawing of the old bridge won a small prize.
entries.exampleZh: 她那幅旧桥的画得了一个小奖。

entries.example: Many students dread the big exam at the end of term.
entries.exampleZh: 许多学生很怕学期末的那场大考。

entries.example: I had a strange dream about flying over the sea.
entries.exampleZh: 我做了一个在海上飞行的奇怪的梦。

entries.example: She wore a blue dress to her friend's birthday party.
entries.exampleZh: 她穿了一条蓝色的连衣裙去参加朋友的生日聚会。

entries.example: The small boat began to drift away from the shore.
entries.exampleZh: 小船开始从岸边漂走。

entries.example: The teacher used a short drill to practise new words.
entries.exampleZh: 老师用了一个简短的练习来操练新单词。

entries.example: You should drink more water when the weather is hot.
entries.exampleZh: 天气热的时候你应该多喝水。

entries.example: Water began to drip from the old kitchen pipe.
entries.exampleZh: 水开始从厨房的旧管子里滴下来。

entries.example: My father will drive us to the airport tomorrow morning.
entries.exampleZh: 我爸爸明天早上会开车送我们去机场。

entries.example: The bus driver stopped the car near the school gate.
entries.exampleZh: 公交车司机把车停在了学校大门附近。

entries.example: Be careful not to drop the glass on the floor.
entries.exampleZh: 小心别把玻璃杯掉到地板上。

entries.example: The long drought made it hard for farmers to grow food.
entries.exampleZh: 长时间的干旱使农民很难种植粮食。

entries.example: Be careful in the deep water, or you may drown.
entries.exampleZh: 在深水里要小心，不然你可能会淹死。

entries.example: This drug can help you sleep better at night.
entries.exampleZh: 这种药能帮你在夜里睡得更好。

entries.example: He plays the drum in a band with his friends.
entries.exampleZh: 他和朋友们在一个乐队里打鼓。

entries.example: He was too drunk to drive his car home last night.
entries.exampleZh: 昨晚他醉得太厉害，没法开车回家。

entries.example: Please keep your shoes dry on this rainy day.
entries.exampleZh: 今天下雨，请让你的鞋子保持干燥。

entries.example: A duck swam across the small lake this morning.
entries.exampleZh: 今天早上有一只鸭子游过了那个小湖。

entries.example: The long speech was dull and many people fell asleep.
entries.exampleZh: 那场长篇演讲很枯燥，许多人都睡着了。

entries.example: He stood there dumb with shock and could not speak.
entries.exampleZh: 他惊得哑口无言地站在那里，说不出话来。

entries.example: The duration of the film is about two hours.
entries.exampleZh: 这部电影的持续时间大约是两小时。

entries.example: Please turn off your phone during the whole class.
entries.exampleZh: 整节课期间请关掉你的手机。

entries.example: We walked home at dusk and saw the sunset.
entries.exampleZh: 黄昏时我们走路回家，看见了日落。

entries.example: It is my duty to help my younger sister.
entries.exampleZh: 帮助我妹妹是我的责任。

entries.example: Their small dwelling stands near the river and the woods.
entries.exampleZh: 他们的小住所位于河边和树林附近。

entries.example: She used a red dye to color the cloth.
entries.exampleZh: 她用一种红色染料给这块布上色。

entries.example: The dying plant needs water and more sunlight.
entries.exampleZh: 这株垂死的植物需要水和更多阳光。

entries.example: Our new teacher is young, dynamic and full of ideas.
entries.exampleZh: 我们的新老师年轻、有活力，而且满脑子想法。

entries.example: Each student must bring a pen and a notebook.
entries.exampleZh: 每个学生都必须带一支笔和一个笔记本。

entries.example: The children were eager to open their gifts.
entries.exampleZh: 孩子们热切地想打开他们的礼物。

entries.example: A large eagle flew over the mountains and disappeared.
entries.exampleZh: 一只大鹰飞过群山，随后消失了。

entries.example: He whispered a secret into her ear and smiled.
entries.exampleZh: 他在她耳边低声说了一个秘密，然后笑了。

entries.example: We arrived early to get good seats near the stage.
entries.exampleZh: 我们早到以便在舞台附近找到好座位。

entries.example: She works hard to earn enough money for her studies.
entries.exampleZh: 她努力工作，为学业挣足够的钱。

entries.example: He made an earnest effort to improve his speaking skills.
entries.exampleZh: 他认真地努力提升自己的口语能力。

entries.example: The earth looks beautiful from space, like a blue ball.
entries.exampleZh: 从太空看，地球像一颗蓝色的球，很美。

entries.example: A strong earthquake shook the city and damaged many old buildings.
entries.exampleZh: 一场强烈的地震震动了这座城市，损坏了许多旧建筑。

entries.example: You can easily find the station by following this map.
entries.exampleZh: 跟着这张地图，你可以很容易找到车站。

entries.example: The sun rises in the east every clear morning.
entries.exampleZh: 每个晴朗的早晨，太阳从东方升起。

entries.example: Many eastern cities have busy markets and beautiful old temples.
entries.exampleZh: 许多东方城市有繁忙的市场和美丽的古老寺庙。

entries.example: This book is easy to read, even for young students.
entries.exampleZh: 这本书很容易读，即使对年轻学生来说也是如此。

entries.example: We usually eat dinner together at seven in the evening.
entries.exampleZh: 我们通常晚上七点一起吃晚饭。

entries.example: I heard a strange echo from the empty hall.
entries.exampleZh: 我听到空荡荡的大厅里传来奇怪的回声。

entries.example: The country is facing serious economic problems this year.
entries.exampleZh: 这个国家今年面临严重的经济问题。

entries.example: This small car is very economical on fuel.
entries.exampleZh: 这辆小汽车非常省油。

entries.example: The local economy depends on farming and tourism.
entries.exampleZh: 当地经济依赖农业和旅游业。

entries.example: Be careful near the edge of the swimming pool.
entries.exampleZh: 在游泳池边缘附近要小心。

entries.example: I bought the latest edition of my favorite magazine.
entries.exampleZh: 我买了我最喜欢的杂志的最新一期。

entries.example: The editor checked my article before it went to print.
entries.exampleZh: 编辑在我的文章付印前检查了它。

entries.example: Parents and teachers should educate children about online safety.
entries.exampleZh: 家长和老师应该教育孩子注意网络安全。

entries.example: She believes education can change a person's life.
entries.exampleZh: 她相信教育能改变一个人的生活。

entries.example: This medicine is very effective against a common cold.
entries.exampleZh: 这种药对普通感冒非常有效。

entries.example: We should try to improve the efficiency of our work.
entries.exampleZh: 我们应该努力改进我们的工作效率。

entries.example: This new machine is very efficient and saves us a lot of time.
entries.exampleZh: 这台新机器效率很高，为我们节省了很多时间。

entries.example: He made a great effort to finish the work on time.
entries.exampleZh: 他付出了很大的努力，按时完成了工作。

entries.example: I had a boiled egg and some toast for breakfast.
entries.exampleZh: 早餐我吃了一个水煮蛋和一些吐司。

entries.example: The shop opens at eight every morning except Sunday.
entries.exampleZh: 这家店每天早上八点开门，星期天除外。

entries.example: My brother is eighteen years old and studies music.
entries.exampleZh: 我哥哥十八岁，正在学音乐。

entries.example: She lives on the eighth floor of that tall building.
entries.exampleZh: 她住在那栋高楼的第八层。

entries.example: My grandfather is eighty but still walks every day.
entries.exampleZh: 我爷爷八十岁了，但每天还散步。

entries.example: You can take either of these two tickets.
entries.exampleZh: 这两张票你可以随便拿一张。

entries.example: The wedding cake had an elaborate design with many flowers.
entries.exampleZh: 婚礼蛋糕有着带许多花朵的精致设计。

entries.example: The elastic in my trousers has become too loose.
entries.exampleZh: 我裤子里的松紧带变得太松了。

entries.example: He hurt his elbow while playing basketball yesterday.
entries.exampleZh: 他昨天打篮球时伤了肘部。

entries.example: My elder sister works in a hospital in the city.
entries.exampleZh: 我姐姐在市里的一家医院工作。

entries.example: The students will elect a new class leader next week.
entries.exampleZh: 学生们下周将选举一位新的班长。

entries.example: The election for class president will take place on Friday.
entries.exampleZh: 班长选举将于星期五举行。

entries.example: My father bought a new electric car last month.
entries.exampleZh: 我父亲上个月买了一辆新的电动汽车。

entries.example: The electrical system in this old building needs repairs.
entries.exampleZh: 这栋老楼的电气系统需要维修。

entries.example: We lost electricity for two hours during the storm.
entries.exampleZh: 暴风雨期间我们停电了两个小时。

entries.example: An electron is much smaller than the nucleus of an atom.
entries.exampleZh: 电子比原子核小得多。

entries.example: She bought an electronic dictionary for her English study.
entries.exampleZh: 她买了一个电子词典来学英语。

entries.example: My brother studies electronics at a university in the north.
entries.exampleZh: 我哥哥在北方的一所大学学习电子学。

entries.example: This book explains elementary math in a very simple way.
entries.exampleZh: 这本书用非常简单的方式讲解基础数学。

entries.example: The elephant at the zoo drank a lot of water today.
entries.exampleZh: 动物园里的大象今天喝了很多水。

entries.example: Please press the button for the elevator on your left.
entries.exampleZh: 请按你左边电梯的按钮。

entries.example: My little sister goes to bed at eleven every night.
entries.exampleZh: 我妹妹每天晚上十一点上床睡觉。

entries.example: Her birthday is on the eleventh of May this year.
entries.exampleZh: 她的生日在今年五月十一日。

entries.example: The elimination of waste is important for a clean city.
entries.exampleZh: 清除废物对一座整洁的城市很重要。

entries.example: Do you want anything else from the shop today?
entries.exampleZh: 你今天还想从店里买别的东西吗？

entries.example: She looked for her keys here but found them elsewhere.
entries.exampleZh: 她在这里找钥匙，却在别处找到了。

entries.example: He could not hide the emotion in his voice.
entries.exampleZh: 他无法掩饰声音里的情感。

entries.example: The old emperor lived in a huge palace long ago.
entries.exampleZh: 很久以前那位老皇帝住在一座巨大的宫殿里。

entries.example: Our teacher puts great emphasis on speaking practice every day.
entries.exampleZh: 我们老师每天都特别强调口语练习。

entries.example: The Roman empire was very large and strong long ago.
entries.exampleZh: 罗马帝国很久以前非常辽阔和强大。

entries.example: The company plans to employ ten new workers next month.
entries.exampleZh: 公司计划下个月雇用十名新工人。

entries.example: Every employee must wear a name badge at work.
entries.exampleZh: 每位员工上班时都必须佩戴名牌。

entries.example: My employer pays the workers on the last day of each month.
entries.exampleZh: 我的雇主在每月的最后一天给工人发工资。

entries.example: He is looking for employment in a big city now.
entries.exampleZh: 他现在正在大城市找工作。

entries.example: The bottle on the table is empty and very dry.
entries.exampleZh: 桌上的瓶子是空的，而且非常干。

entries.example: Please enclose a photo with your letter to the school.
entries.exampleZh: 请随你给学校的信附上一张照片。

entries.example: We had a strange encounter with a dog last night.
entries.exampleZh: 昨晚我们和一只狗有过一次奇怪的遭遇。

entries.example: We waited at the end of the long line.
entries.exampleZh: 我们在长队的末端等着。

entries.example: Nobody expected such a sad ending to the story.
entries.exampleZh: 没有人料到这个故事会有这样悲伤的结局。

entries.example: The baby's loud crying seemed endless to the tired parents.
entries.exampleZh: 在疲惫的父母听来，婴儿响亮的哭声似乎没完没了。

entries.example: The soldier refused to hurt his old enemy.
entries.exampleZh: 那名士兵拒绝伤害他的老仇敌。

entries.example: Children often have more energy than their tired parents.
entries.exampleZh: 孩子们常常比他们疲惫的父母更有精力。

entries.example: The police must enforce the new traffic rules carefully.
entries.exampleZh: 警察必须认真地执行新的交通规则。

entries.example: My cousin works as an engineer in a big company.
entries.exampleZh: 我表弟在一家大公司当工程师。

entries.example: She studies engineering at a famous university in Beijing.
entries.exampleZh: 她在北京一所著名大学学习工程学。

entries.example: My aunt moved to England three years ago.
entries.exampleZh: 我姑姑三年前搬到了英格兰。

entries.example: We speak English during our classes every day.
entries.exampleZh: 我们每天上课时都说英语。

entries.example: A tall Englishman helped me carry my heavy bag.
entries.exampleZh: 一位高个子英国男子帮我提了沉重的包。

entries.example: I really enjoy walking in the park after dinner.
entries.exampleZh: 我真的很喜欢晚饭后在公园散步。

entries.example: Could you enlarge this photo for my mother?
entries.exampleZh: 你能为我把这张照片放大吗？

entries.example: We don't have enough chairs for all the guests.
entries.exampleZh: 我们没有足够的椅子给所有的客人。

entries.example: Please knock before you enter the head teacher's office.
entries.exampleZh: 进班主任办公室前请先敲门。

entries.example: The clown tried to entertain the children at the party.
entries.exampleZh: 小丑在聚会上努力逗孩子们开心。

entries.example: She talked about her new job with great enthusiasm.
entries.exampleZh: 她满怀热情地谈论她的新工作。

entries.example: The students were very enthusiastic about the school trip.
entries.exampleZh: 学生们对学校旅行非常热情。

entries.example: He spent the entire morning cleaning his small flat.
entries.exampleZh: 他花了一整个上午打扫他的小公寓。

entries.example: Let's meet at the main entrance of the museum.
entries.exampleZh: 我们在博物馆正门入口见面吧。

entries.example: Please use the side entry near the garden gate.
entries.exampleZh: 请走花园大门旁边的那个侧门入口。

entries.example: She put the letter in a brown envelope and smiled.
entries.exampleZh: 她把信装进一个棕色的信封里，笑了。

entries.example: We must protect the environment for our children and grandchildren.
entries.exampleZh: 我们必须为子孙后代保护环境。

entries.example: Her new bike filled him with envy and sadness.
entries.exampleZh: 她的新自行车让他又羡慕又难过。

entries.example: The teacher wrote a simple equation on the blackboard.
entries.exampleZh: 老师在黑板上写了一个简单的方程式。

entries.example: The school will equip every classroom with new computers.
entries.exampleZh: 学校将为每间教室配备新电脑。

entries.example: The workers cleaned all the equipment after the long day.
entries.exampleZh: 漫长的一天之后，工人们清洗了所有设备。

entries.example: They plan to erect a small bridge over the river.
entries.exampleZh: 他们计划在河上架一座小桥。

entries.example: I found one small error in your second paragraph.
entries.exampleZh: 我在你的第二段里发现了一个小错误。

entries.example: The bird tried to escape from its cage again.
entries.exampleZh: 那只鸟又试着从笼子里逃出去。

entries.example: I like fruit, especially apples, pears and sweet grapes.
entries.exampleZh: 我喜欢水果，尤其是苹果、梨和甜葡萄。

entries.example: My cousin will travel to Europe next summer with her friends.
entries.exampleZh: 我表姐明年夏天要和朋友们去欧洲旅行。

entries.example: She speaks three European languages and loves their music.
entries.exampleZh: 她会说三种欧洲语言，也喜爱那些地方的音乐。

entries.example: The water will evaporate quickly in this hot sun.
entries.exampleZh: 水在这炎热的阳光下会很快蒸发。

entries.example: We arrived on the eve of the big holiday.
entries.exampleZh: 我们在这个盛大节日的前夕到达了。

entries.example: He did not even say goodbye before leaving.
entries.exampleZh: 他走之前甚至没有说再见。

entries.example: We took a long walk together in the cool evening.
entries.exampleZh: 傍晚凉爽的时候，我们一起散了很久的步。

entries.example: The concert was the biggest event of the year.
entries.exampleZh: 那场音乐会是这一年里最盛大的活动。

entries.example: After many delays, the train eventually arrived at noon.
entries.exampleZh: 经过多次延误，火车终于在中午到达了。

entries.example: Have you ever visited a farm in spring?
entries.exampleZh: 你曾经在春天参观过农场吗？

entries.example: I try to read a few pages every night before bed.
entries.exampleZh: 我尽量每天晚上睡觉前读几页书。

entries.example: Everybody in my class came to the party on Saturday.
entries.exampleZh: 我们班上每个人都来参加了周六的聚会。

entries.example: Wearing a uniform is part of our everyday school life.
entries.exampleZh: 穿校服是我们日常学校生活的一部分。

entries.example: Everyone in the room started to laugh at the joke.
entries.exampleZh: 房间里的每个人都开始为这个笑话大笑起来。

entries.example: She told me everything about her trip to Japan.
entries.exampleZh: 她把去日本旅行的一切都告诉了我。

entries.example: After the rain, we saw small flowers everywhere in the garden.
entries.exampleZh: 雨后，我们看到花园里到处都开着小小的花。

entries.example: Can you tell me the exact time of the meeting?
entries.exampleZh: 你能告诉我会议的准确时间吗？

entries.example: The train left at exactly eight in the morning.
entries.exampleZh: 火车在早上八点整开走了。

entries.example: I have a maths exam on Friday morning.
entries.exampleZh: 我周五上午有一场数学考试。

entries.example: The doctor did a careful examination of my left arm.
entries.exampleZh: 医生仔细检查了我的左臂。

entries.example: Scientists examine the rocks to learn about the past.
entries.exampleZh: 科学家们检查这些岩石，以了解过去的情况。

entries.example: Our teacher gave us an example to explain the rule.
entries.exampleZh: 老师给我们举了一个例子来解释这条规则。

entries.example: The total cost must not exceed one hundred dollars.
entries.exampleZh: 总费用不得超过一百美元。

entries.example: The soup was exceedingly hot, so we waited a while.
entries.exampleZh: 汤非常烫，所以我们等了一会儿。

entries.example: Everyone came to the party except my older brother.
entries.exampleZh: 除了我哥哥，大家都来参加聚会了。

entries.example: The good news will excite the whole team.
entries.exampleZh: 这个好消息会让整个团队兴奋起来。

entries.example: We watched an exciting football match last night.
entries.exampleZh: 昨晚我们看了一场激动人心的足球赛。

entries.example: The children began to exclaim when they saw the snow.
entries.exampleZh: 孩子们看到雪时开始欢呼起来。

entries.example: This room is used exclusively by the teachers.
entries.exampleZh: 这个房间只供老师们使用。

entries.example: Our class went on a short excursion to the hills.
entries.exampleZh: 我们班去山里进行了一次短途旅行。

entries.example: That is a poor excuse for being late again.
entries.exampleZh: 那又是一个迟到的糟糕借口。

entries.example: The team will execute the plan next Monday morning.
entries.exampleZh: 团队将在下周一上午执行这个计划。

entries.example: She is a senior executive at a large bank.
entries.exampleZh: 她是一家大银行的高级管理人员。

entries.example: Daily exercise helps you stay healthy and strong.
entries.exampleZh: 每天锻炼有助于你保持健康和强壮。

entries.example: You must exert more effort to finish this task.
entries.exampleZh: 你必须付出更多努力才能完成这项任务。

entries.example: The museum will exhibit these old paintings next month.
entries.exampleZh: 博物馆下个月将展出这些古老的画作。

entries.example: Many small shops still exist along this quiet street.
entries.exampleZh: 这条安静的街道上仍然存在许多小商店。

entries.example: Few people knew about the existence of that old bridge.
entries.exampleZh: 很少有人知道那座旧桥的存在。

entries.example: Please use the back exit when the film ends.
entries.exampleZh: 电影结束后请使用后面的出口。

entries.example: The rapid expansion of the city surprised many local people.
entries.exampleZh: 城市的快速扩张让许多当地人感到惊讶。

entries.example: We expect a lot of visitors this weekend.
entries.exampleZh: 我们预计这个周末会有很多游客。

entries.example: The company pays every travel expense for its workers.
entries.exampleZh: 公司为其员工支付所有差旅费用。

entries.example: That watch looks nice but it is far too expensive.
entries.exampleZh: 那块手表看起来不错，但实在太贵了。

entries.example: She has years of experience in teaching young children.
entries.exampleZh: 她有多年的幼儿教学经验。

entries.example: Our science class did a simple experiment with water today.
entries.exampleZh: 我们科学课今天用水做了一个简单的实验。

entries.example: The doctor offered him an experimental treatment last year.
entries.exampleZh: 去年医生给了他一种实验性治疗。

entries.example: Could you explain this rule to me once more?
entries.exampleZh: 你能再给我解释一遍这条规则吗？

entries.example: Her explanation for the mistake sounded quite believable.
entries.exampleZh: 她对这个错误的解释听起来相当可信。

entries.example: The old bomb could explode at any moment.
entries.exampleZh: 那枚旧炸弹随时可能爆炸。

entries.example: Workers found an old explosive near the railway bridge.
entries.exampleZh: 工人们在铁路桥附近发现了一枚旧炸药。

entries.example: They export coffee to many countries around the world.
entries.exampleZh: 他们把咖啡出口到世界上的许多国家。

entries.example: I will express my thanks with a small gift.
entries.exampleZh: 我会用一份小礼物来表达我的谢意。

entries.example: Her expression showed that she was very happy.
entries.exampleZh: 她的表情说明她非常开心。

entries.example: We plan to extend our stay by two more days.
entries.exampleZh: 我们打算把逗留时间再延长两天。

entries.example: The museum has an extensive collection of old maps.
entries.exampleZh: 这家博物馆收藏了大量古老的地图。

entries.example: I agree with you to a certain extent.
entries.exampleZh: 我在某种程度上同意你的看法。

entries.example: The exterior walls of the house need new paint.
entries.exampleZh: 这所房子的外墙需要重新刷漆。

entries.example: The company hired an external expert to check the numbers.
entries.exampleZh: 公司请了一位外部专家来核对数据。

entries.example: We need an extra chair for the guest tonight.
entries.exampleZh: 今晚我们需要多一把椅子给客人用。

entries.example: The desert has extreme heat during the summer months.
entries.exampleZh: 夏季的沙漠极其炎热。

entries.example: The final exam was extremely difficult for most students.
entries.exampleZh: 期末考试对大多数学生来说极其难。

entries.example: She closed one eye and looked through the small hole.
entries.exampleZh: 她闭上一只眼睛，从那个小孔看过去。

entries.example: His eyesight became worse after years of reading in dim light.
entries.exampleZh: 他多年在昏暗的光线下看书，视力变差了。

entries.example: My grandfather told me an old fable about a clever fox.
entries.exampleZh: 爷爷给我讲了一个关于聪明狐狸的古老寓言。

entries.example: This soft fabric feels very nice against my skin.
entries.exampleZh: 这种柔软的布料贴在皮肤上感觉很舒服。

entries.example: A big smile appeared on her face when she heard the news.
entries.exampleZh: 听到这个消息时，她脸上露出了灿烂的笑容。

entries.example: In fact, I have never visited that city before.
entries.exampleZh: 事实上，我以前从未去过那座城市。

entries.example: Money is not the only factor in choosing a good school.
entries.exampleZh: 钱并不是选择一所好学校的唯一因素。

entries.example: My uncle works in a car factory near the river.
entries.exampleZh: 我叔叔在河边的一家汽车厂工作。

entries.example: The faculty of law at this university is quite famous.
entries.exampleZh: 这所大学的法学院相当有名。

entries.example: The weather report said it would be ninety degrees fahrenheit today.
entries.exampleZh: 天气预报说今天会是华氏九十度。

entries.example: If you do not study, you may fail the test.
entries.exampleZh: 如果你不学习，你可能会考试不及格。

entries.example: His first try was a failure, but he did not stop.
entries.exampleZh: 他第一次尝试失败了，但他没有停下。

entries.example: We heard a faint sound coming from the old house.
entries.exampleZh: 我们听到从老房子里传来微弱的声音。

entries.example: The test was fairly easy, so we finished it early.
entries.exampleZh: 这次考试相当容易，所以我们很早就做完了。

entries.example: My dog is faithful and waits for me every day.
entries.exampleZh: 我的狗很忠诚，每天都等我。

entries.example: Be careful, or you will fall off the wet stairs.
entries.exampleZh: 小心点，否则你会从湿滑的楼梯上摔下来。

entries.example: The news on that small website was completely false.
entries.exampleZh: 那个小网站上的新闻完全是假的。

entries.example: The young singer found fame after her first song.
entries.exampleZh: 这位年轻歌手在她的第一首歌之后一举成名。

entries.example: My family likes to eat dinner together every evening.
entries.exampleZh: 我家人喜欢每天晚上一起吃晚饭。

entries.example: Many people died during the famine in that country.
entries.exampleZh: 在那个国家，许多人死于那场饥荒。

entries.example: This small town is famous for its beautiful old bridge.
entries.exampleZh: 这个小镇因其美丽的古桥而闻名。

entries.example: My brother is a big fan of that football team.
entries.exampleZh: 我哥哥是那支足球队的忠实球迷。

entries.example: The station is not far from our new apartment.
entries.exampleZh: 车站离我们的新公寓不远。

entries.example: The bus fare went up again at the start of May.
entries.exampleZh: 五月初公交车费又涨了。

entries.example: We said farewell at the airport and promised to write.
entries.exampleZh: 我们在机场道别，并答应写信。

entries.example: My uncle grows vegetables on a small farm near here.
entries.exampleZh: 我叔叔在这附近的一个小农场种蔬菜。

entries.example: The farmer gets up early to feed his animals.
entries.exampleZh: 这位农民早起喂他的牲畜。

entries.example: We walked farther than we had planned this morning.
entries.exampleZh: 今天早上我们走得比原计划更远。

entries.example: She likes to dress in a simple and comfortable fashion.
entries.exampleZh: 她喜欢以简单舒适的方式穿衣。

entries.example: She wears fashionable clothes to work every day.
entries.exampleZh: 她每天穿时髦的衣服上班。

entries.example: He drives too fast on this narrow road.
entries.exampleZh: 他在这条窄路上开得太快了。

entries.example: Please fasten your seat belt before the plane leaves.
entries.exampleZh: 飞机起飞前请系好安全带。

entries.example: My father taught me how to ride a bike.
entries.exampleZh: 我父亲教我怎样骑自行车。

entries.example: It was my fault that we missed the train.
entries.exampleZh: 我们错过火车是我的过错。

entries.example: The faulty heater made strange noises all night.
entries.exampleZh: 那台有故障的加热器整晚发出奇怪的响声。

entries.example: Could you do me a favour and close the door?
entries.exampleZh: 你能帮我个忙把门关上吗？

entries.example: The weather was favourable for our trip to the beach.
entries.exampleZh: 天气对我们的海滩之行很有利。

entries.example: Blue is my favourite colour for a winter coat.
entries.exampleZh: 蓝色是我冬天外套最喜欢的颜色。

entries.example: She has a great fear of speaking in public.
entries.exampleZh: 她非常害怕当众讲话。

entries.example: The small dog looked fearful of the loud noise.
entries.exampleZh: 那只小狗看起来害怕那巨大的响声。

entries.example: The family prepared a big feast for the holiday.
entries.exampleZh: 家人为节日准备了一顿丰盛的筵席。

entries.example: A white feather fell slowly from the sky.
entries.exampleZh: 一根白色的羽毛慢慢从天空飘落。

entries.example: The weather is usually cold here in february.
entries.exampleZh: 这里二月的天气通常很冷。

entries.example: The federal government announced a new plan yesterday.
entries.exampleZh: 联邦政府昨天宣布了一项新计划。

entries.example: The school charges a small fee for the bus.
entries.exampleZh: 学校收取少量校车费。

entries.example: The old man's voice was feeble and hard to hear.
entries.exampleZh: 那位老人的声音很微弱，很难听清。

entries.example: Please feed the cat before you leave home.
entries.exampleZh: 你离家前请喂一下猫。

entries.example: I feel much better after a good night's sleep.
entries.exampleZh: 好好睡了一晚后我感觉好多了。

entries.example: A strange feeling came over me in that room.
entries.exampleZh: 在那个房间里，一种奇怪的感觉涌上我心头。

entries.example: A friendly fellow in the shop showed me the way.
entries.exampleZh: 店里一位友好的家伙给我指了路。

entries.example: The female is usually larger than the male.
entries.exampleZh: 雌性通常比雄性更大。

entries.example: Our dog jumped over the fence and ran away.
entries.exampleZh: 我们的狗跳过栅栏跑走了。

entries.example: The soil near the river is very fertile.
entries.exampleZh: 河边的土壤非常肥沃。

entries.example: Farmers put fertilizer on the fields before the rain comes.
entries.exampleZh: 农民在下雨前给田里施肥。

entries.example: The music festival lasts three days and many people come.
entries.exampleZh: 这个音乐节持续三天，很多人来参加。

entries.example: She has a high fever and must stay in bed.
entries.exampleZh: 她发高烧，必须卧床休息。

entries.example: Few people came to the meeting on that cold day.
entries.exampleZh: 那天很冷，很少有人来参加会议。

entries.example: Fruit and vegetables give your body enough fibre.
entries.exampleZh: 水果和蔬菜给你的身体提供足够的纤维。

entries.example: The children are playing in the field behind our house.
entries.exampleZh: 孩子们正在我们房子后面的田野里玩耍。

entries.example: A fierce dog stood in front of the gate.
entries.exampleZh: 一只凶猛的狗站在大门前。

entries.example: My sister is fifteen years old and loves to read.
entries.exampleZh: 我妹妹十五岁，喜欢读书。

entries.example: This is the fifth time I have called you today.
entries.exampleZh: 这是我今天第五次给你打电话。

entries.example: There are fifty students in our class this year.
entries.exampleZh: 今年我们班有五十个学生。

entries.example: The soldiers fight for their country with great courage.
entries.exampleZh: 士兵们为了他们的国家英勇作战。

entries.example: Please keep my file in a safe place.
entries.exampleZh: 请把我的档案放在安全的地方。

entries.example: Please fill this glass with water for me.
entries.exampleZh: 请帮我给这个玻璃杯倒满水。

entries.example: We watched a funny film about a lost dog.
entries.exampleZh: 我们看了一部关于一只走失的狗的搞笑电影。

entries.example: This filter cleans the water before we drink it.
entries.exampleZh: 这个过滤器在我们喝水前净化水。

entries.example: Our final exam is next Monday morning at nine.
entries.exampleZh: 我们的期末考试是下周一上午九点。

entries.example: After a long wait, the bus finally arrived at the station.
entries.exampleZh: 等了很久之后，公共汽车终于到站了。

entries.example: I hope you can find your keys before we leave.
entries.exampleZh: 我希望你能在我们离开前找到你的钥匙。

entries.example: The finding of the study surprised many doctors.
entries.exampleZh: 这项研究的发现让许多医生感到惊讶。

entries.example: She pointed at the map with her finger.
entries.exampleZh: 她用手指指着地图。

entries.example: I need to finish my homework before dinner.
entries.exampleZh: 我需要在晚饭前完成作业。

entries.example: We sat around the fire and sang songs.
entries.exampleZh: 我们围着火坐着唱歌。

entries.example: The fireman carried the child out of the smoke.
entries.exampleZh: 消防员把孩子从烟雾中抱了出来。

entries.example: My father works for a small firm in the city.
entries.exampleZh: 我父亲在城里一家小公司工作。

entries.example: This is my first visit to the new library.
entries.exampleZh: 这是我第一次参观这座新图书馆。

entries.example: We caught a big fish in the river yesterday.
entries.exampleZh: 昨天我们在河里钓到了一条大鱼。

entries.example: The old fisherman takes his boat out every morning.
entries.exampleZh: 那位老渔夫每天早上都开船出海。

entries.example: He hit the table with his fist and left.
entries.exampleZh: 他用拳头捶了一下桌子，然后离开了。

entries.example: These shoes do not fit me very well.
entries.exampleZh: 这双鞋不太合我的脚。

entries.example: We need five more chairs for the guests.
entries.exampleZh: 我们还需要五把椅子给客人。

entries.example: Can you fix my bike before the weekend?
entries.exampleZh: 你能在周末前把我的自行车修好吗？

entries.example: A red flag was flying above the school gate.
entries.exampleZh: 一面红旗在学校大门上方飘扬。

entries.example: The small flame in the lamp moved in the wind.
entries.exampleZh: 灯里的小火苗在风中晃动着。

entries.example: The match began to flare in the wind.
entries.exampleZh: 火柴在风中开始闪亮起来。

entries.example: A bright flash of lightning lit up the sky.
entries.exampleZh: 一道明亮的闪电照亮了天空。

entries.example: The land near the river is flat and green.
entries.exampleZh: 河边的土地平坦而翠绿。

entries.example: This soup has a rich flavour that everyone at the table enjoys.
entries.exampleZh: 这汤味道浓郁，桌上的每个人都很喜欢。

entries.example: A large fleet of ships arrived at the port this morning.
entries.exampleZh: 今天早上，一支庞大的船队抵达了港口。

entries.example: The flesh of this fruit is sweet and very soft.
entries.exampleZh: 这种水果的果肉又甜又软。

entries.example: Our flight to Beijing leaves early tomorrow morning.
entries.exampleZh: 我们去北京的航班明天一早起飞。

entries.example: Small boats float slowly on the quiet river near our village.
entries.exampleZh: 小船在我们村子附近安静的河面上缓缓漂浮。

entries.example: A flock of sheep is walking across the green field.
entries.exampleZh: 一群羊正走过绿色的田野。

entries.example: The heavy rain caused a flood in the small town.
entries.exampleZh: 大雨在这个小镇引发了洪水。

entries.example: Please put the box on the floor next to the door.
entries.exampleZh: 请把箱子放在门旁边的地板上。

entries.example: She needs some flour to make bread for the family.
entries.exampleZh: 她需要一些面粉给家人做面包。

entries.example: These plants flourish in warm weather and plenty of sun.
entries.exampleZh: 这些植物在温暖和阳光充足的环境中长势很好。

entries.example: A yellow flower is growing beside the old stone wall.
entries.exampleZh: 一朵黄色的花正长在古老的石墙旁边。

entries.example: My brother has the flu and must stay in bed.
entries.exampleZh: 我弟弟得了流感，必须卧床休息。

entries.example: She is fluent in English and speaks with great confidence.
entries.exampleZh: 她英语说得很流利，说话时充满自信。

entries.example: The doctor told him to drink a lot of fluid.
entries.exampleZh: 医生让他多喝液体。

entries.example: His cheeks flush red when he runs for a long time.
entries.exampleZh: 他跑很长时间后，脸颊会发红。

entries.example: A fly is walking on the kitchen table.
entries.exampleZh: 一只苍蝇正在厨房的桌子上爬。

entries.example: Please focus on your homework and turn off the television.
entries.exampleZh: 请专心做作业，把电视关掉。

entries.example: Thick fog covered the road, so the drivers went slowly.
entries.exampleZh: 浓雾笼罩着道路，所以司机们开得很慢。

entries.example: Please fold the clean clothes and put them away.
entries.exampleZh: 请把干净的衣服叠好并收起来。

entries.example: The old folk in the village meet every Sunday morning.
entries.exampleZh: 村里的老人们每个星期天早上都会聚会。

entries.example: Please follow me to the office on the second floor.
entries.exampleZh: 请跟我去二楼的办公室。

entries.example: The following morning, we drove to the beach and swam.
entries.exampleZh: 第二天早上，我们开车去海滩游泳。

entries.example: I am very fond of my grandmother's apple pie.
entries.exampleZh: 我非常喜欢我奶奶做的苹果派。

entries.example: There is not enough food in the fridge for dinner.
entries.exampleZh: 冰箱里没有足够的食物做晚饭。

entries.example: He is not a fool, so listen to his advice.
entries.exampleZh: 他不是傻子，所以听听他的建议吧。

entries.example: It was foolish of him to leave the door open.
entries.exampleZh: 他让门开着，真是太愚蠢了。

entries.example: My left foot hurts after the long walk today.
entries.exampleZh: 今天走了很长的路，我的左脚很疼。

entries.example: The boys play football in the park every Sunday afternoon.
entries.exampleZh: 男孩们每个星期天下午都在公园里踢足球。

entries.example: I heard a quick footstep behind me on the stairs.
entries.exampleZh: 我听到楼梯上我身后有急促的脚步声。

entries.example: Thank you for the lovely flowers you sent me.
entries.exampleZh: 谢谢你送给我的漂亮鲜花。

entries.example: My parents forbid me to stay out late on school nights.
entries.exampleZh: 我父母不许我上学期间在外面待到很晚。

entries.example: They had to force the door open with a heavy stick.
entries.exampleZh: 他们不得不用一根粗棍子把门撬开。

entries.example: The weather forecast says it will rain all weekend.
entries.exampleZh: 天气预报说整个周末都会下雨。

entries.example: She touched her forehead and knew she had a fever.
entries.exampleZh: 她摸了摸额头，知道自己发烧了。

entries.example: Learning a foreign language takes time and a lot of practice.
entries.exampleZh: 学一门外语需要时间和大量的练习。

entries.example: A friendly foreigner asked me for directions to the station.
entries.exampleZh: 一位友好的外国人向我问去车站的路。

entries.example: Safety is our foremost concern when we plan school trips.
entries.exampleZh: 我们安排学校旅行时，安全是我们最关心的事。

entries.example: We walked through the quiet forest and saw many birds.
entries.exampleZh: 我们走过安静的森林，看见了许多鸟。

entries.example: I will remember that wonderful summer with you forever.
entries.exampleZh: 我会永远记得和你一起度过的那个美好夏天。

entries.example: Do not forget to bring your book to class tomorrow.
entries.exampleZh: 别忘了明天把书带到课堂上来。

entries.example: I hope you can forgive me for being late today.
entries.exampleZh: 我希望你能原谅我今天迟到了。

entries.example: Please put a fork and knife beside each plate.
entries.exampleZh: 请在每个盘子旁边放一把餐叉和一把刀。

entries.example: Water can take the form of ice when it freezes.
entries.exampleZh: 水在结冰时会呈现冰的形态。

entries.example: He wore a formal suit to the important meeting.
entries.exampleZh: 他穿着正式的西装去参加那个重要的会议。

entries.example: The formation of clouds in the sky was beautiful.
entries.exampleZh: 天空中云朵的形成过程非常美丽。

entries.example: My former teacher now lives in another city.
entries.exampleZh: 我以前的老师现在住在另一个城市。

entries.example: The math formula on the board looks quite simple.
entries.exampleZh: 黑板上的数学公式看起来相当简单。

entries.example: She stepped forth to accept the prize with a smile.
entries.exampleZh: 她微笑着走上前去领奖。

entries.example: We will travel abroad for a fortnight next summer.
entries.exampleZh: 明年夏天我们将出国旅行两个星期。

entries.example: You are fortunate to have such kind friends.
entries.exampleZh: 你很幸运，有这么善良的朋友。

entries.example: He made a large fortune through hard work.
entries.exampleZh: 他通过辛勤工作赚了一大笔财产。

entries.example: There are forty students in our new class.
entries.exampleZh: 我们的新班里有四十名学生。

entries.example: Please move forward and show your ticket.
entries.exampleZh: 请向前走并出示你的票。

entries.example: They plan to found a new club at school.
entries.exampleZh: 他们计划在学校里创办一个新社团。

entries.example: Children played happily near the fountain in the park.
entries.exampleZh: 孩子们在公园的喷泉旁开心地玩耍。

entries.example: I bought four apples at the small shop.
entries.exampleZh: 我在那家小店里买了四个苹果。

entries.example: My sister is fourteen years old this month.
entries.exampleZh: 我妹妹这个月满十四岁。

entries.example: She finished fourth in the running race.
entries.exampleZh: 她在跑步比赛中获得了第四名。

entries.example: A clever fox ran quickly across the empty road.
entries.exampleZh: 一只狡猾的狐狸飞快地跑过空荡的马路。

entries.example: Only a small fraction of students missed the test.
entries.exampleZh: 只有一小部分学生缺考了。

entries.example: A fragment of glass fell from the broken window.
entries.exampleZh: 一块玻璃碎片从破窗户上掉了下来。

entries.example: The steel framework of the building looks very strong.
entries.exampleZh: 这座建筑的钢框架看起来很结实。

entries.example: My cousin will study in France for two years.
entries.exampleZh: 我的表弟将在法国学习两年。

entries.example: To be frank, I do not like this plan.
entries.exampleZh: 坦白说，我不喜欢这个计划。

entries.example: Are you free this afternoon for a short walk?
entries.exampleZh: 你今天下午有空去散会儿步吗？

entries.example: Everyone should have the freedom to choose their own path.
entries.exampleZh: 每个人都应该有自由选择自己的道路。

entries.example: She always speaks freely about her problems at home.
entries.exampleZh: 她总是坦率地谈论家里遇到的问题。

entries.example: Please freeze the meat before it goes bad.
entries.exampleZh: 请把肉冷冻起来，以免变质。

entries.example: The freight arrived at the port early this morning.
entries.exampleZh: 这批货物今天一早到达了港口。

entries.example: My teacher can speak French and Spanish well.
entries.exampleZh: 我的老师会说法语和西班牙语。

entries.example: The frequency of buses here drops at night.
entries.exampleZh: 这里公交车的班次频率在夜里会下降。

entries.example: He is a frequent visitor to our small shop.
entries.exampleZh: 他是我们小店的常客。

entries.example: She frequently visits her grandmother on Sunday afternoons.
entries.exampleZh: 她经常在周日下午去看望祖母。

entries.example: We bought some fresh bread from the local bakery.
entries.exampleZh: 我们从当地的面包店买了一些新鲜面包。

entries.example: Wet roads can reduce friction between tires and the ground.
entries.exampleZh: 潮湿的路面会减少轮胎与地面之间的摩擦。

entries.example: We will meet again next Friday at the station.
entries.exampleZh: 我们下周五在车站再见面。

entries.example: There is some cold milk in the fridge.
entries.exampleZh: 冰箱里有一些冰牛奶。

entries.example: My best friend lives in a small village.
entries.exampleZh: 我最好的朋友住在一个小村庄里。

entries.example: The new neighbors are very friendly to everyone.
entries.exampleZh: 新邻居对每个人都很友好。

entries.example: Their friendship started during a school trip long ago.
entries.exampleZh: 他们的友谊始于很久以前的一次学校旅行。

entries.example: A small green frog jumped into the pond near our house.
entries.exampleZh: 一只绿色的小青蛙跳进了我们家附近的池塘。

entries.example: She borrowed three books from the school library yesterday.
entries.exampleZh: 她昨天从学校图书馆借了三本书。

entries.example: Please sit in the front row of the classroom.
entries.exampleZh: 请坐在教室的前排。

entries.example: The thick frost covered the grass this cold morning.
entries.exampleZh: 厚厚的霜在这个寒冷的早晨覆盖了草地。

entries.example: We bought fresh fruit at the market this morning.
entries.exampleZh: 我们今天早上在市场买了新鲜水果。

entries.example: Their long talk was fruitful and helped both teams.
entries.exampleZh: 他们长时间的交谈很有成效，帮助了两支队伍。

entries.example: I usually fry two eggs for breakfast on Sundays.
entries.exampleZh: 我星期天通常煎两个鸡蛋当早餐。

entries.example: The car needs fuel before we drive to the city.
entries.exampleZh: 汽车在开往城市之前需要燃料。

entries.example: He worked hard to fulfil all the promises he made.
entries.exampleZh: 他努力工作，履行了他许下的所有承诺。

entries.example: The bus was full, so we walked to school.
entries.exampleZh: 公共汽车满了，所以我们步行去学校。

entries.example: We had a lot of fun at the beach yesterday.
entries.exampleZh: 我们昨天在海滩上玩得很开心。

entries.example: Reading is a fundamental skill for every young student.
entries.exampleZh: 阅读是每个年轻学生的一项基本技能。

entries.example: Many people came to the funeral to support the family.
entries.exampleZh: 许多人来参加葬礼，支持这个家庭。

entries.example: That was a funny story about a talking cat.
entries.exampleZh: 那是一个关于会说话的猫的有趣故事。

entries.example: The cat has soft white fur and green eyes.
entries.exampleZh: 这只猫有柔软的白色毛皮和绿色的眼睛。

entries.example: My father was furious when I broke the window.
entries.exampleZh: 我打碎窗户时，父亲非常生气。

entries.example: The old furnace in the basement stopped working last winter.
entries.exampleZh: 地下室里的旧炉子去年冬天坏了。

entries.example: They will furnish the new flat with simple wooden chairs.
entries.exampleZh: 他们要用简单的木椅来布置新公寓。

entries.example: We bought new furniture for the living room last week.
entries.exampleZh: 我们上周为客厅买了新家具。

entries.example: We walked further down the road to find a shop.
entries.exampleZh: 我们沿着路继续往前走，想找一家商店。

entries.example: The room is small; furthermore, it is quite dark in the morning.
entries.exampleZh: 这个房间很小，而且早上相当暗。

entries.example: She hopes to become a doctor in the future.
entries.exampleZh: 她希望将来成为一名医生。

entries.example: You can gain useful skills from this summer job.
entries.exampleZh: 你能从这份暑期工作中获得有用的技能。

entries.example: One gallon of milk is enough for our family.
entries.exampleZh: 一加仑牛奶够我们全家喝了。

entries.example: The children are playing a fun game in the yard.
entries.exampleZh: 孩子们正在院子里玩一个有趣的游戏。

entries.example: A gang of young boys played near the river.
entries.exampleZh: 一帮小男孩在河边玩耍。

entries.example: Please take the garbage out before you go to bed.
entries.exampleZh: 请在睡觉前把垃圾拿出去。

entries.example: My grandmother grows tomatoes in her small garden.
entries.exampleZh: 我奶奶在她的小花园里种西红柿。

entries.example: The gardener comes to cut the grass every Friday morning.
entries.exampleZh: 园丁每周五早上来剪草。

entries.example: We need to pay the gas bill this week.
entries.exampleZh: 我们这周需要付煤气费。

entries.example: Water becomes gaseous when it is heated to a high temperature.
entries.exampleZh: 水加热到高温时会变成气态。

entries.example: The price of gasoline has gone up again.
entries.exampleZh: 汽油的价格又上涨了。

entries.example: She began to gasp for air after the long run.
entries.exampleZh: 长跑之后她开始大口喘气。

entries.example: Please close the gate when you leave the farm.
entries.exampleZh: 离开农场时请把大门关上。

entries.example: We gather in the kitchen every evening to talk.
