entries.exampleZh: 我们每天晚上在厨房聚在一起聊天。

entries.example: The gauge on the wall shows how much water we use.
entries.exampleZh: 墙上的计量表显示我们用多少水。

entries.example: Bright colours made the little room look gay and warm.
entries.exampleZh: 鲜艳的色彩让这个小房间显得欢快而温暖。

entries.example: He likes to gaze at the stars on clear nights.
entries.exampleZh: 他喜欢在晴朗的夜晚凝望星星。

entries.example: The general idea of the plan is quite simple.
entries.exampleZh: 这个计划的总体思路相当简单。

entries.example: I generally get up at seven on weekdays.
entries.exampleZh: 工作日我通常七点起床。

entries.example: Our new generator keeps the house warm during cold winter nights.
entries.exampleZh: 我们新买的发电机在寒冷的冬夜里让房子里保持温暖。

entries.example: My little sister is a genius at solving difficult math problems.
entries.exampleZh: 我妹妹在解数学难题方面是个天才。

entries.example: The nurse spoke in a gentle voice to the frightened child.
entries.exampleZh: 护士用温柔的声音对那个受惊的孩子说话。

entries.example: An old gentleman helped me carry my heavy bags home.
entries.exampleZh: 一位老先生帮我把沉重的包搬回了家。

entries.example: She gently closed the door so the baby would not wake.
entries.exampleZh: 她轻轻地关上门，以免吵醒婴儿。

entries.example: We study geography and learn about mountains, rivers and oceans.
entries.exampleZh: 我们学习地理，了解山脉、河流和海洋。

entries.example: In geometry class today we learned about triangles and circles.
entries.exampleZh: 今天在几何课上我们学习了三角形和圆。

entries.example: Wash your hands to keep every germ away from your food.
entries.exampleZh: 洗手可以让每个细菌远离你的食物。

entries.example: My neighbor is German and speaks three languages very well.
entries.exampleZh: 我的邻居是德国人，能说三种语言，说得很好。

entries.example: She will move to Germany next year to study art.
entries.exampleZh: 她明年将搬到德国学习艺术。

entries.example: I hope to get home before the rain starts tonight.
entries.exampleZh: 我希望今晚在下雨前到家。

entries.example: The children believe a friendly ghost lives in the old house.
entries.exampleZh: 孩子们相信那座老房子里住着一个友善的鬼魂。

entries.example: A kind giant helped the villagers build a new stone bridge.
entries.exampleZh: 一位善良的巨人帮助村民们建了一座新的石桥。

entries.example: The little girl smiled and waved at us from the window.
entries.exampleZh: 那个小女孩笑着从窗户向我们挥手。

entries.example: Please give this letter to your teacher after class today.
entries.exampleZh: 请今天下课后把这封信交给你的老师。

entries.example: I am glad you enjoyed the trip to the lake.
entries.exampleZh: 我很高兴你喜欢这次去湖边的旅行。

entries.example: She took a quick glance at the clock and left.
entries.exampleZh: 她飞快地看了一眼时钟就走了。

entries.example: The driver gave me an angry glare at the crossing.
entries.exampleZh: 那个司机在路口生气地瞪了我一眼。

entries.example: He poured cold water into a tall glass for me.
entries.exampleZh: 他往一个高玻璃杯里给我倒了凉水。

entries.example: We watched the swans glide slowly across the quiet lake.
entries.exampleZh: 我们看着天鹅慢慢地滑过平静的湖面。

entries.example: I caught a quick glimpse of the singer through the crowd.
entries.exampleZh: 我在人群中瞥见了那位歌手一眼。

entries.example: The stars glitter in the cold night sky above us.
entries.exampleZh: 星星在我们上方寒冷的夜空中闪闪发光。

entries.example: She found our country on the globe in the classroom.
entries.exampleZh: 她在教室里的地球仪上找到了我们的国家。

entries.example: The team won great glory for their small town.
entries.exampleZh: 这支队伍为他们的小镇赢得了巨大的荣誉。

entries.example: He lost one glove in the snow this morning.
entries.exampleZh: 今天早上他在雪地里丢了一只手套。

entries.example: The warm glow of the lamp made the room cozy.
entries.exampleZh: 灯光温暖的光晕让房间变得舒适。

entries.example: Please use glue to stick the paper on the wall.
entries.exampleZh: 请用胶水把纸粘在墙上。

entries.example: Our goal is to finish the project before Friday.
entries.exampleZh: 我们的目标是在周五之前完成这个项目。

entries.example: The goat ate grass near the old stone wall.
entries.exampleZh: 那只山羊在旧石墙附近吃草。

entries.example: In the story, a kind god helps the poor farmer.
entries.exampleZh: 在故事里，一位善良的神帮助了贫穷的农夫。

entries.example: She wore a simple ring made of pure gold.
entries.exampleZh: 她戴着一枚纯金制成的简单戒指。

entries.example: The golden light of the sunset filled the valley.
entries.exampleZh: 夕阳的金色光芒充满了山谷。

entries.example: My uncle plays golf with his friends every Sunday.
entries.exampleZh: 我叔叔每周日都和他的朋友们打高尔夫球。

entries.example: This is a good book for young readers.
entries.exampleZh: 这是一本适合年轻读者的好书。

entries.example: She was kind to us and full of goodness.
entries.exampleZh: 她对我们很好，充满善良。

entries.example: The truck carried goods from the port to the city.
entries.exampleZh: 那辆卡车把货物从港口运到城里。

entries.example: A white goose swam slowly across the quiet lake.
entries.exampleZh: 一只白鹅慢慢地游过平静的湖面。

entries.example: The government plans to build a new hospital here.
entries.exampleZh: 政府计划在这里建一所新医院。

entries.example: The governor spoke to the crowd after the storm.
entries.exampleZh: 州长在暴风雨后对人群讲话。

entries.example: She wore a long white gown to the party.
entries.exampleZh: 她穿着一件长长的白色礼服去参加聚会。

entries.example: She moved across the stage with great grace and confidence.
entries.exampleZh: 她带着极大的优雅与自信走过舞台。

entries.example: The dancer made a graceful turn and smiled at the crowd.
entries.exampleZh: 那位舞者优雅地转了个身，朝人群微笑。

entries.example: Our host was gracious and kind to every guest at dinner.
entries.exampleZh: 我们的主人对晚宴上的每位客人都彬彬有礼、和善亲切。

entries.example: My teacher will grade the tests before Friday afternoon.
entries.exampleZh: 老师会在周五下午之前给试卷评分。

entries.example: There was a gradual change in the weather last week.
entries.exampleZh: 上周天气有一个逐渐的变化。

entries.example: The old man gradually learned to use his new phone.
entries.exampleZh: 那位老人逐渐学会了使用他的新手机。

entries.example: My sister is a graduate of a small art school.
entries.exampleZh: 我姐姐是一所小型艺术学校的毕业生。

entries.example: English grammar is easier when you read simple stories.
entries.exampleZh: 当你读简单的故事时，英语语法会更容易。

entries.example: Please check your essay for grammatical mistakes before you send it.
entries.exampleZh: 寄出之前，请检查你的文章有没有语法错误。

entries.example: Add one gramme of salt to the hot soup.
entries.exampleZh: 往热汤里加一克盐。

entries.example: The old hotel has a grand entrance with tall white doors.
entries.exampleZh: 那家老酒店有一个高白色大门的气派入口。

entries.example: My granddaughter drew a funny picture of our cat.
entries.exampleZh: 我的孙女画了一幅关于我们猫的搞笑图画。

entries.example: My grandfather tells long stories about his childhood in the mountains.
entries.exampleZh: 我的祖父讲他童年在山里的漫长故事。

entries.example: My grandmother bakes sweet bread for us every Sunday morning.
entries.exampleZh: 我的祖母每个周日早上都给我们烤甜面包。

entries.example: Her grandson plays football with his friends after school.
entries.exampleZh: 她的孙子放学后和朋友们一起踢足球。

entries.example: She put a red grape on the small plate.
entries.exampleZh: 她把一颗红葡萄放在小盘子上。

entries.example: The graph shows how prices changed during the year.
entries.exampleZh: 这张图表显示了这一年里价格是如何变化的。

entries.example: He tried to grasp the heavy box with both hands.
entries.exampleZh: 他试着用双手抓紧那个沉重的箱子。

entries.example: The children played on the soft grass near the river.
entries.exampleZh: 孩子们在河边柔软的草地上玩耍。

entries.example: I am grateful for your help with my heavy bags.
entries.exampleZh: 我很感激你帮我拿这些沉重的包。

entries.example: I want to show my gratitude for all your kind help.
entries.exampleZh: 我想对你所有的热心帮助表达我的感激。

entries.example: The apple fell to the ground because of gravity.
entries.exampleZh: 苹果因为重力掉到了地上。

entries.example: My grandfather has a gray coat and a warm hat.
entries.exampleZh: 我爷爷有一件灰色外套和一顶暖和的帽子。

entries.example: We had a great time at the beach last Sunday.
entries.exampleZh: 上周日我们在海滩玩得很开心。

entries.example: Your help greatly improved the quality of our work.
entries.exampleZh: 你的帮助大大提高了我们的工作质量。

entries.example: The greedy boy ate all the cake by himself.
entries.exampleZh: 那个贪吃的男孩自己把蛋糕全吃光了。

entries.example: She is reading an old Greek story about the sea.
entries.exampleZh: 她正在读一个关于大海的古老希腊故事。

entries.example: The hills look very green after the spring rain.
entries.exampleZh: 春雨过后山丘看起来非常绿。

entries.example: My aunt grows tomatoes in a small greenhouse behind her house.
entries.exampleZh: 我姑姑在她房子后面的一个小温室里种西红柿。

entries.example: Please greet your parents for me when you go home.
entries.exampleZh: 你回家时请代我问候你的父母。

entries.example: He sent me a warm greeting on my birthday.
entries.exampleZh: 他在我生日时给我送来了温暖的问候。

entries.example: The sky turned grey before the heavy storm came.
entries.exampleZh: 暴风雨来临前天空变成了灰色。

entries.example: I know it will grieve her to hear this news.
entries.exampleZh: 我知道听到这个消息会使她伤心。

entries.example: Please grind the coffee beans before you make the drink.
entries.exampleZh: 请你做饮料之前先把咖啡豆磨碎。

entries.example: He held the rope with a strong grip and climbed up.
entries.exampleZh: 他紧紧抓住绳子，向上爬。

entries.example: The tired old man let out a low groan.
entries.exampleZh: 那位疲惫的老人发出一声低沉的呻吟。

entries.example: The grocer sells fresh fruit and vegetables at his small shop.
entries.exampleZh: 那个杂货商在他的小店里卖新鲜水果和蔬菜。

entries.example: The gross weight of the box is about ten kilos.
entries.exampleZh: 这个箱子的总重量大约是十公斤。

entries.example: The children sat on the ground and shared their lunch.
entries.exampleZh: 孩子们坐在地上分享他们的午餐。

entries.example: Our group will meet again next Friday after class.
entries.exampleZh: 我们小组下周五课后会再见面。

entries.example: These plants grow quickly in warm summer weather.
entries.exampleZh: 这些植物在温暖的夏季天气里长得很快。

entries.example: The city has seen strong growth in recent years.
entries.exampleZh: 近年来这座城市出现了强劲的增长。

entries.example: A guard stands at the gate every night.
entries.exampleZh: 一名卫兵每晚都站在大门口。

entries.example: Can you guess how old my sister is?
entries.exampleZh: 你能猜出我妹妹多大了吗？

entries.example: Our guest will arrive at the hotel this evening.
entries.exampleZh: 我们的客人今晚会到达酒店。

entries.example: Young students need guidance when they choose their classes.
entries.exampleZh: 年轻学生在选课时需要指导。

entries.example: Our guide showed us the oldest part of town.
entries.exampleZh: 我们的导游带我们看了镇上最古老的部分。

entries.example: He felt guilty about forgetting his friend's birthday.
entries.exampleZh: 他因为忘记朋友的生日而感到内疚。

entries.example: Many ships sail across the gulf every summer.
entries.exampleZh: 每年夏天都有许多船只驶过这个海湾。

entries.example: The police officer kept his gun in a locked box.
entries.exampleZh: 那名警察把他的枪放在一个上锁的盒子里。

entries.example: In the past, people used gunpowder to make fireworks.
entries.exampleZh: 过去人们用火药制作烟花。

entries.example: The school gymnasium is open after class on weekdays.
entries.exampleZh: 学校的体育馆在工作日下课后开放。

entries.example: Reading before bed is a good habit for many people.
entries.exampleZh: 睡前阅读对许多人来说是个好习惯。

entries.example: His habitual morning walk takes him past the river.
entries.exampleZh: 他惯常的晨间散步会带他经过河边。

entries.example: Her long hair shines in the bright morning sun.
entries.exampleZh: 她长长的头发在明亮的晨光中闪亮。

entries.example: I need a haircut before my sister's wedding.
entries.exampleZh: 我需要在我姐姐的婚礼前理个发。

entries.example: Half of the cake was gone before dinner.
entries.exampleZh: 晚饭前蛋糕已经少了一半。

entries.example: We waited in the hall until the rain stopped.
entries.exampleZh: 我们在门厅里一直等到雨停。

entries.example: The bus came to a sudden halt near the school.
entries.exampleZh: 公共汽车在学校附近突然停了下来。

entries.example: He ordered a hamburger and a cold drink for lunch.
entries.exampleZh: 他午餐点了一个汉堡包和一杯冷饮。

entries.example: I need a hammer to fix this wooden chair.
entries.exampleZh: 我需要一把锤子来修这把木椅。

entries.example: Please put your hand on the table for a moment.
entries.exampleZh: 请把你的手放在桌子上一下。

entries.example: She gave the birds a handful of rice this morning.
entries.exampleZh: 今天早上她给鸟儿一把米。

entries.example: He always carries a clean handkerchief in his pocket.
entries.exampleZh: 他总是在口袋里带一块干净的手帕。

entries.example: Her brother is a tall and handsome young man.
entries.exampleZh: 她哥哥是个又高又英俊的年轻人。

entries.example: Your handwriting is much clearer than it was last year.
entries.exampleZh: 你的字迹比去年清楚多了。

entries.example: Keep a small torch handy in case the power fails.
entries.exampleZh: 把一个小手电筒放在手边，以防停电。

entries.example: Please hang your coat on the hook by the door.
entries.exampleZh: 请把你的外套挂在门边的钩子上。

entries.example: Strange things happen when you least expect them.
entries.exampleZh: 奇怪的事情会在你最意想不到的时候发生。

entries.example: True happiness comes from good friends and simple moments.
entries.exampleZh: 真正的幸福来自好朋友和简单的时刻。

entries.example: The children were happy to see the snow this morning.
entries.exampleZh: 今天早上孩子们看到雪很高兴。

entries.example: Several small boats returned to the harbour before sunset.
entries.exampleZh: 几艘小船在日落前回到了港口。

entries.example: This math problem is too hard for me to solve.
entries.exampleZh: 这道数学题对我来说太难了，我解不出来。

entries.example: The clay will harden quickly in the hot sun.
entries.exampleZh: 黏土在烈日下会很快变硬。

entries.example: I could hardly hear his voice on the phone.
entries.exampleZh: 我在电话里几乎听不见他的声音。

entries.example: The family faced great hardship after the factory closed.
entries.exampleZh: 工厂关闭后，这家人面临巨大的艰难。

entries.example: We bought nails and other hardware at the local shop.
entries.exampleZh: 我们在当地商店买了钉子和别的五金用品。

entries.example: A brown hare ran across the field very quickly.
entries.exampleZh: 一只棕色野兔飞快地跑过田野。

entries.example: The farmer put a harness on the strong horse.
entries.exampleZh: 农民给那匹壮马套上了马具。

entries.example: In her haste she forgot to lock the front door.
entries.exampleZh: 她匆忙中忘了锁前门。

entries.example: Please hasten your steps or we will miss the train.
entries.exampleZh: 请快点走，不然我们会赶不上火车。

entries.example: A hasty decision often brings trouble later.
entries.exampleZh: 仓促的决定常常会在以后带来麻烦。

entries.example: He wears a warm hat when the wind is cold.
entries.exampleZh: 刮冷风的时候他会戴一顶暖和的帽子。

entries.example: The small eggs will hatch in about three weeks.
entries.exampleZh: 这些小蛋大约三周后会孵化。

entries.example: I hate cold coffee in the early morning.
entries.exampleZh: 我讨厌一大早喝凉咖啡。

entries.example: His hateful words hurt everyone in the room.
entries.exampleZh: 他那些可恶的话伤害了房间里的每个人。

entries.example: He felt deep hatred after the long, unfair fight.
entries.exampleZh: 在那场漫长又不公平的打斗之后，他心里充满了深深的仇恨。

entries.example: We have three cats and a small dog at home.
entries.exampleZh: 我们家里有三只猫和一只小狗。

entries.example: A hawk circled slowly above the open field.
entries.exampleZh: 一只鹰在开阔的田野上方慢慢盘旋。

entries.example: The farmer stored dry hay for the winter months.
entries.exampleZh: 农夫为冬天储存了干草。

entries.example: She turned her head and smiled at the baby.
entries.exampleZh: 她转过头，对婴儿笑了笑。

entries.example: I have a bad headache and need some rest.
entries.exampleZh: 我头疼得厉害，需要休息一下。

entries.example: The heading on the page was clear and bold.
entries.exampleZh: 这一页的标题清楚而且醒目。

entries.example: The morning headline spoke about the heavy rain.
entries.exampleZh: 早晨的大字标题讲的是那场大雨。

entries.example: The headmaster spoke to all the students this morning.
entries.exampleZh: 校长今天早上对全体学生讲了话。

entries.example: Their headquarters is in a tall building downtown.
entries.exampleZh: 他们的总部设在市中心一栋高楼里。

entries.example: The cut on my arm will heal in a week.
entries.exampleZh: 我手臂上的伤口一周内就会愈合。

entries.example: Good health is more important than money for most people.
entries.exampleZh: 对大多数人来说，健康比金钱更重要。

entries.example: She eats healthy food and walks every single day.
entries.exampleZh: 她吃健康的食物，而且每天都散步。

entries.example: A heap of old clothes lay beside the door.
entries.exampleZh: 门边放着一堆旧衣服。

entries.example: Can you hear the music from the next room?
entries.exampleZh: 你能听见隔壁房间传来的音乐吗？

entries.example: She has a kind heart and helps everyone in need.
entries.exampleZh: 她有一颗善良的心，总是帮助有需要的人。

entries.example: The heat in the kitchen made us open a window.
entries.exampleZh: 厨房里的热气让我们打开了窗户。

entries.example: Our heating broke down during the coldest night of winter.
entries.exampleZh: 我们家的暖气在冬天最冷的那个晚上坏了。

entries.example: The night sky looked like heaven full of bright stars.
entries.exampleZh: 夜空看起来就像布满明亮星星的天堂。

entries.example: It rained heavily all night, so the streets were empty.
entries.exampleZh: 雨下了一整夜，所以街上空无一人。

entries.example: My bag is too heavy for me to carry upstairs.
entries.exampleZh: 我的包太重了，我搬不上楼。

entries.example: A tall hedge around the garden keeps the noise out.
entries.exampleZh: 花园四周高高的树篱挡住了噪音。

entries.example: She hurt her heel while running on the beach.
entries.exampleZh: 她在沙滩上跑步时伤了脚后跟。

entries.example: The height of the new wall surprised us all.
entries.exampleZh: 新墙的高度让我们大家都很吃惊。

entries.example: The old man left his house to his only heir.
entries.exampleZh: 那位老人把房子留给了他唯一的继承人。

entries.example: A helicopter flew low over the trees near our school.
entries.exampleZh: 一架直升机低低地飞过我们学校附近的树。

entries.example: The long journey through the desert felt like hell.
entries.exampleZh: 穿越沙漠的漫长旅程感觉就像地狱。

entries.example: She said hello to every student as she walked in.
entries.exampleZh: 她走进来时向每位学生问好。

entries.example: You must wear a helmet when you ride a motorbike.
entries.exampleZh: 骑摩托车时你必须戴头盔。

entries.example: Can you help me carry these boxes to the car?
entries.exampleZh: 你能帮我把这些箱子搬到车上吗？

entries.example: The staff were very helpful when we asked for directions.
entries.exampleZh: 我们问路时，工作人员非常乐于助人。

entries.example: The little bird looked helpless after falling from its nest.
entries.exampleZh: 那只小鸟从巢里掉下来后看起来很无助。

entries.example: A brown hen laid three eggs in the wooden box.
entries.exampleZh: 一只棕色的母鸡在木箱里下了三个蛋。

entries.example: The road was closed, hence we had to take a bus.
entries.exampleZh: 那条路封了，因此我们只好坐公交车。

entries.example: I gave her a beautiful gift for the new year.
entries.exampleZh: 新年我送了她一份漂亮的礼物。

entries.example: A herd of wild horses ran across the open field.
entries.exampleZh: 一群野马跑过了开阔的田野。

entries.example: Please sit here and wait for your name to be called.
entries.exampleZh: 请坐在这里，等着叫你的名字。

entries.example: The young hero saved a child from the burning house.
entries.exampleZh: 这位年轻的英雄从着火的房子里救出了一个孩子。

entries.example: Her heroic act saved three people during the terrible storm.
entries.exampleZh: 在那场可怕的暴风雨中，她的英勇行为救了三个人。

entries.example: The heroine of this novel is a brave young doctor.
entries.exampleZh: 这部小说的女主人公是一位勇敢的年轻医生。

entries.example: That blue umbrella near the door is hers, not mine.
entries.exampleZh: 门边那把蓝色的伞是她的，不是我的。

entries.example: She made the whole birthday cake herself last night.
entries.exampleZh: 昨晚她一个人做了整个生日蛋糕。

entries.example: Do not hesitate to ask me if you need help.
entries.exampleZh: 如果你需要帮助，别犹豫，来问我。

entries.example: The children like to hide behind the big sofa.
entries.exampleZh: 孩子们喜欢藏在那张大沙发后面。

entries.example: The wall around the garden is very high.
entries.exampleZh: 花园周围的墙非常高。

entries.example: My teacher thinks highly of your recent hard work.
entries.exampleZh: 我的老师对你近来的努力评价很高。

entries.example: We drove along the empty highway for two hours.
entries.exampleZh: 我们沿着空荡荡的公路开了两个小时。

entries.example: Their small house stands on top of a green hill.
entries.exampleZh: 他们的小房子坐落在绿色小山的山顶上。

entries.example: Wild flowers grow all over the sunny hillside in spring.
entries.exampleZh: 春天，野花开满了阳光充足的山坡。

entries.example: I met him at the station early this morning.
entries.exampleZh: 今天一大早我在车站遇见了他。

entries.example: He built the wooden table himself without any help.
entries.exampleZh: 那张木桌是他自己一个人做的，没有让任何人帮忙。

entries.example: Please give me a small hint about the answer.
entries.exampleZh: 请给我一点关于答案的小提示。

entries.example: The boy lost his keys on the way home.
entries.exampleZh: 那个男孩在回家路上丢了钥匙。

entries.example: We visited a famous historical building near the river.
entries.exampleZh: 我们参观了河边一座著名的历史建筑。

entries.example: My grandfather often tells stories about the history of our town.
entries.exampleZh: 我祖父经常讲我们镇的历史故事。

entries.example: My favourite hobby is taking photos of birds in the park.
entries.exampleZh: 我最喜欢的爱好是在公园里拍鸟。

entries.example: Please hold this bag while I open the door.
entries.exampleZh: 请拿着这个包，我来开门。

entries.example: There is a small hole in the wall behind the door.
entries.exampleZh: 门后的墙上有一个小洞。

entries.example: We spent our summer holiday at a quiet beach last year.
entries.exampleZh: 去年我们在一个安静的海滩度过了暑假。

entries.example: The old tree is hollow inside, so birds live there.
entries.exampleZh: 那棵老树里面是空的，所以鸟儿住在那里。

entries.example: This ancient temple is a holy place for many people.
entries.exampleZh: 这座古老的寺庙对许多人来说是神圣的地方。

entries.example: My home is near the river, not far from the school.
entries.exampleZh: 我家在河边附近，离学校不远。

entries.example: She is an honest person and never tells lies to us.
entries.exampleZh: 她是个诚实的人，从不对我们撒谎。

entries.example: He puts honey in his tea every morning before work.
entries.exampleZh: 他每天早上上班前都会在茶里放蜂蜜。

entries.example: They went to Italy for their honeymoon last summer.
entries.exampleZh: 去年夏天他们去意大利度蜜月。

entries.example: It is a great honour to meet you today, sir.
entries.exampleZh: 先生，今天见到您是我的莫大荣幸。

entries.example: He is an honourable man who always keeps his word.
entries.exampleZh: 他是个诚实守信的人，总是说话算数。

entries.example: Hang your coat on the hook behind the door.
entries.exampleZh: 把你的外套挂在门后的钩子上。

entries.example: I hope you will feel better after a good sleep.
entries.exampleZh: 希望你好好睡一觉后会好一些。

entries.example: We are hopeful that the rain will stop this afternoon.
entries.exampleZh: 我们希望今天下午雨会停。

entries.example: He felt hopeless after failing the test twice.
entries.exampleZh: 两次考试不及格后他感到绝望。

entries.example: The sun went down below the horizon very quickly.
entries.exampleZh: 太阳很快落到地平线以下。

entries.example: Draw a horizontal line across the top of the page.
entries.exampleZh: 在页面顶部画一条水平线。

entries.example: The driver sounded his horn loudly near the busy crossing.
entries.exampleZh: 司机在繁忙的十字路口附近大声按喇叭。

entries.example: She watched the horror film with her hands over her eyes.
entries.exampleZh: 她双手遮住眼睛看那部恐怖电影。

entries.example: The brown horse ran across the field very fast.
entries.exampleZh: 那匹棕色的马飞快地跑过田野。

entries.example: This old car has only sixty horsepower, so it is slow.
entries.exampleZh: 这辆旧车只有六十马力，所以它很慢。

entries.example: My aunt works at a large hospital in the city.
entries.exampleZh: 我姑姑在市里一家大医院工作。

entries.example: Our host welcomed every guest with a warm smile.
entries.exampleZh: 我们的主人用温暖的微笑欢迎每位客人。

entries.example: The hostess helped each passenger find a seat on the plane.
entries.exampleZh: 空姐帮助每位乘客在飞机上找到座位。

entries.example: The crowd became hostile when the referee made that unfair call.
entries.exampleZh: 当裁判做出那个不公平的判罚时，人群变得不友善。

entries.example: It is very hot today, so we should drink plenty of water.
entries.exampleZh: 今天很热，所以我们应该多喝水。

entries.example: The hotel near the beach offers free breakfast to all its guests.
entries.exampleZh: 海滩附近的那家旅馆为所有客人提供免费早餐。

entries.example: We waited for an hour before the bus finally arrived.
entries.exampleZh: 我们等了一个小时，公交车才终于到了。

entries.example: Their new house has a small garden behind the kitchen.
entries.exampleZh: 他们的新房子厨房后面有一个小花园。

entries.example: The housewife cooks dinner for her family every evening.
entries.exampleZh: 这位家庭主妇每天晚上为家人做晚饭。

entries.example: Can you tell me how to get to the train station?
entries.exampleZh: 你能告诉我怎样去火车站吗？

entries.example: The rain was heavy; however, we still enjoyed our walk.
entries.exampleZh: 雨很大，然而我们仍然很享受散步。

entries.example: A huge elephant stood quietly beside the small river.
entries.exampleZh: 一头巨大的大象静静地站在小河边。

entries.example: Every human needs clean water and fresh air to stay healthy.
entries.exampleZh: 每个人都需要干净的水和新鲜空气来保持健康。

entries.example: He is a humble man who never talks about his success.
entries.exampleZh: 他是一个谦逊的人，从不谈论自己的成功。

entries.example: It is very humid today, so please open the window.
entries.exampleZh: 今天很潮湿，所以请打开窗户。

entries.example: My uncle tells humorous stories that make everyone laugh.
entries.exampleZh: 我叔叔讲幽默的故事，让每个人都笑了。

entries.example: Her gentle humour makes even difficult meetings feel much easier.
entries.exampleZh: 她温和的幽默使即使困难的会议也显得轻松许多。

entries.example: Our school library has more than one hundred new books.
entries.exampleZh: 我们学校的图书馆有一百多本新书。

entries.example: Many children in the world still suffer from hunger every day.
entries.exampleZh: 世界上许多孩子仍然每天忍受饥饿。

entries.example: After the long walk, we were hungry and wanted some food.
entries.exampleZh: 走了很长的路之后，我们饿了，想吃点东西。

entries.example: They went on a hunt for wild mushrooms in the forest.
entries.exampleZh: 他们去森林里寻找野蘑菇。

entries.example: We must hurry, or we will miss the last bus.
entries.exampleZh: 我们必须赶快，否则会错过最后一班公共汽车。

entries.example: Be careful with that knife, or you may hurt yourself.
entries.exampleZh: 小心那把刀，否则你可能会伤到自己。

entries.example: Her husband cooks dinner for the family every Friday evening.
entries.exampleZh: 她的丈夫每周五晚上为家人做晚饭。

entries.example: The old man lives in a small hut near the river.
entries.exampleZh: 那位老人住在河边的一间小屋里。

entries.example: Scientists say water is made of hydrogen and oxygen.
entries.exampleZh: 科学家说水由氢和氧组成。

entries.example: She put some ice in her glass of cold water.
entries.exampleZh: 她在她那杯冷水里放了一些冰。

entries.example: That is a great idea for our class project.
entries.exampleZh: 那是我们班级项目的一个好主意。

entries.example: This quiet room is ideal for reading and studying.
entries.exampleZh: 这个安静的房间很适合阅读和学习。

entries.example: Our teacher taught us a useful English idiom today.
entries.exampleZh: 我们老师今天教了我们一个有用的英语习语。

entries.example: The machines stood idle during the long summer holiday.
entries.exampleZh: 那些机器在漫长的暑假期间闲置着。

entries.example: My brother felt ill and stayed home from school.
entries.exampleZh: 我弟弟生病了，待在家里没去上学。

entries.example: Her illness kept her in bed for three long weeks.
entries.exampleZh: 她的病使她卧床三个星期。

entries.example: The book has a beautiful illustration of a mountain lake.
entries.exampleZh: 这本书有一幅美丽的山湖插图。

entries.example: Children often use their imagination when they draw pictures.
entries.exampleZh: 孩子们画画时常常运用想象力。

entries.example: I can imagine how happy you felt that day.
entries.exampleZh: 我能想象那天你有多开心。

entries.example: We need an immediate answer before the shop closes.
entries.exampleZh: 我们需要在商店关门前立即答复。

entries.example: Please call me immediately when you reach the station.
entries.exampleZh: 你到车站后请立刻给我打电话。

entries.example: The new stadium is immense and can hold thousands of fans.
entries.exampleZh: 这座新体育场巨大无比，能容纳数千名球迷。

entries.example: My neighbour is an immigrant from a small town in Italy.
entries.exampleZh: 我的邻居是一位来自意大利一个小镇的移民。

entries.example: The teacher gets impatient when students arrive late.
entries.exampleZh: 学生迟到时老师会变得不耐烦。

entries.example: She explained the importance of clean water to the class.
entries.exampleZh: 她向全班解释了干净水的重要性。

entries.example: This is an important lesson for every young student here.
entries.exampleZh: 对这里的每个年轻学生来说，这是重要的一课。

entries.example: It is impossible to finish this work in one day.
entries.exampleZh: 一天之内完成这项工作是不可能的。

entries.example: Her speech did impress everyone in the room.
entries.exampleZh: 她的演讲确实让房间里的每个人都印象深刻。

entries.example: My first impression of the city was very good.
entries.exampleZh: 我对这座城市的第一印象非常好。

entries.example: The team gave an impressive performance last night.
entries.exampleZh: 昨晚这支队伍的表现令人印象深刻。

entries.example: They did not imprison him because he was innocent.
entries.exampleZh: 他们没有关押他，因为他是无辜的。

entries.example: I want to improve my English before the exam.
entries.exampleZh: 我想在考试前提高我的英语。

entries.example: There is a clear improvement in your writing this month.
entries.exampleZh: 这个月你的写作有了明显的进步。

entries.example: The little box is just one inch wide and very light.
entries.exampleZh: 这个小盒子只有一英寸宽，非常轻。

entries.example: Nobody was hurt in the incident near the school gate.
entries.exampleZh: 校门口那起事件中没有人受伤。

entries.example: Her monthly income is just enough to pay the rent.
entries.exampleZh: 她每月的收入刚好够付房租。

entries.example: Your answer is incorrect, so please try the question again.
entries.exampleZh: 你的答案不正确，请再试一次这道题。

entries.example: We saw a big increase in sales last month.
entries.exampleZh: 上个月我们的销售额大幅增长。

entries.example: People are increasingly using phones to pay for things.
entries.exampleZh: 人们越来越多地用手机付款。

entries.example: The film was long, but it was indeed very funny.
entries.exampleZh: 这部电影很长，但确实非常有趣。

entries.example: After the accident, he took an indefinite break from work.
entries.exampleZh: 事故之后，他无限期地停下了工作。

entries.example: She moved to another city to gain her independence.
entries.exampleZh: 她搬到另一座城市去获得独立。

entries.example: Our youngest daughter is very independent and cooks her own meals.
entries.exampleZh: 我们最小的女儿很独立，自己做饭吃。

entries.example: You can find the word in the index at the back.
entries.exampleZh: 你可以在后面的索引里找到这个词。

entries.example: My cousin has been living in India for three years.
entries.exampleZh: 我的表姐在印度生活了三年。

entries.example: We had an Indian meal at a small restaurant last night.
entries.exampleZh: 昨晚我们在一家小餐馆吃了一顿印度菜。

entries.example: There is no indication that the weather will improve today.
entries.exampleZh: 没有迹象表明今天天气会好转。

entries.example: She was indignant when they blamed her for the mistake.
entries.exampleZh: 当他们把错误怪到她头上时，她非常愤慨。

entries.example: He gave an indirect answer that left us all confused.
entries.exampleZh: 他给了一个间接的回答，让我们都很困惑。

entries.example: Because of the rain, the children played indoors all day.
entries.exampleZh: 因为下雨，孩子们整天都在屋里玩。

entries.example: This city is famous for its large industrial area.
entries.exampleZh: 这座城市以它庞大的工业区而闻名。

entries.example: The government wants to industrialize the north within ten years.
entries.exampleZh: 政府想在十年内使北方实现工业化。

entries.example: The car industry provides many jobs in this region.
entries.exampleZh: 汽车工业在这个地区提供了许多工作岗位。

entries.example: The old heating system is slow and very inefficient.
entries.exampleZh: 这套旧的供暖系统又慢效率又低。

entries.example: We found an inexpensive hotel near the train station.
entries.exampleZh: 我们在火车站附近找到了一家便宜的旅馆。

entries.example: The infant slept quietly in her mother's arms.
entries.exampleZh: 婴儿在母亲的怀里安静地睡着了。

entries.example: This virus can infect people through tiny drops in the air.
entries.exampleZh: 这种病毒可以通过空气中的微小飞沫感染人。

entries.example: From his silence, we can infer that he disagrees.
entries.exampleZh: 从他的沉默中，我们可以推断他并不同意。

entries.example: This cheap model is clearly inferior to the older one.
entries.exampleZh: 这个便宜的型号明显不如那个旧的。

entries.example: Please inform the office if you change your address.
entries.exampleZh: 如果你更换了地址，请通知办公室。

entries.example: Please send me more information about the summer English course.
entries.exampleZh: 请把暑期英语课程的更多信息发给我。

entries.example: Few animals can inhabit this cold and dry desert.
entries.exampleZh: 很少有动物能栖息在这片寒冷干燥的沙漠里。

entries.example: Every inhabitant of the small island knows my name.
entries.exampleZh: 这个小岛上的每个居民都知道我的名字。

entries.example: My initial plan was to study law in London.
entries.exampleZh: 我最初的计划是在伦敦学法律。

entries.example: The nurse gave me an injection in my left arm.
entries.exampleZh: 护士在我左臂上打了一针。

entries.example: He missed three games because of a knee injury.
entries.exampleZh: 因为膝伤他错过了三场比赛。

entries.example: The pen on my desk has run out of ink.
entries.exampleZh: 我桌上的那支笔没墨水了。

entries.example: We stayed at a small inn near the river.
entries.exampleZh: 我们住在河边一家小旅店里。

entries.example: She keeps her inner feelings hidden from everyone.
entries.exampleZh: 她把内心的感受藏着，不让任何人知道。

entries.example: This project needs more input from the local government.
entries.exampleZh: 这个项目需要当地政府更多的投入。

entries.example: A small insect landed on my hand this morning.
entries.exampleZh: 今天早上有一只小昆虫落在我手上。

entries.example: Please insert your card and then enter your code.
entries.exampleZh: 请插入您的卡，然后输入密码。

entries.example: It was cold outside, so we waited inside the station.
entries.exampleZh: 外面很冷，所以我们在车站里面等。

entries.example: Workers came to inspect the bridge after the strong wind.
entries.exampleZh: 大风过后工人们来检查这座桥。

entries.example: The kitchen passed its safety inspection without any problems.
entries.exampleZh: 厨房顺利通过了安全检查，没有任何问题。

entries.example: When she heard the news, she instantly called her mother.
entries.exampleZh: 听到这个消息，她立刻给母亲打了电话。

entries.example: The shop was closed, so we went home instead.
entries.exampleZh: 商店关门了，所以我们改为回家了。

entries.example: Her instinct told her that something was wrong.
entries.exampleZh: 她的直觉告诉她有些不对劲。

entries.example: There was insufficient food for all the hungry children.
entries.exampleZh: 食物不足以供所有饥饿的孩子们吃。

entries.example: My father pays for car insurance every January.
entries.exampleZh: 我父亲每年一月都付汽车保险费。

entries.example: Please insure your bags before you travel to another country.
entries.exampleZh: 出国旅行前请给你的行李投保。

entries.example: The old professor is a well-known intellectual in our city.
entries.exampleZh: 这位老教授是我们城市里一位有名的知识分子。

entries.example: The intensity of the storm surprised everyone in the small town.
entries.exampleZh: 暴风雨的强度让小镇上的每个人都感到惊讶。

entries.example: She took an intensive course in English before her exam.
entries.exampleZh: 考试前她上了一门英语强化课程。

entries.example: I think his rude comment was intentional and very unkind.
entries.exampleZh: 我觉得他那句粗鲁的评论是故意的，而且很不友善。

entries.example: The interaction between the two groups was friendly and calm.
entries.exampleZh: 这两个群体之间的互动友好而平和。

entries.example: He has a strong interest in old Chinese music and art.
entries.exampleZh: 他对中国古代音乐和艺术有浓厚的兴趣。

entries.example: It was an interesting book about life in a small village.
entries.exampleZh: 那是一本关于小村庄生活的有趣的书。

entries.example: Please do not interfere with my work when I am busy.
entries.exampleZh: 我忙的时候请不要干扰我的工作。

entries.example: The bad weather caused interference with the radio signal.
entries.exampleZh: 恶劣的天气对无线电信号造成了干扰。

entries.example: The interior walls of the house are painted light blue.
entries.exampleZh: 这栋房子的内墙被漆成了浅蓝色。

entries.example: She joined an intermediate class after passing the first test.
entries.exampleZh: 通过第一次考试后，她加入了一个中级班。

entries.example: The company holds an internal meeting every Monday morning.
entries.exampleZh: 这家公司每周一上午举行一次内部会议。

entries.example: Our school invites international students to join the summer camp.
entries.exampleZh: 我们学校邀请国际学生参加夏令营。

entries.example: She works as an interpreter at important meetings in Beijing.
entries.exampleZh: 她在北京的重要会议上担任口译员。

entries.example: Sorry to interrupt, but your taxi is waiting outside now.
entries.exampleZh: 抱歉打断一下，你的出租车现在在外面等着。

entries.example: There is a short interval between the two acts of the play.
entries.exampleZh: 这部戏的两幕之间有一个短暂的休息。

entries.example: They shared an intimate dinner and talked about their childhood.
entries.exampleZh: 他们共进了一顿亲密的晚餐，还聊起了各自的童年。

entries.example: She put the fresh milk into the fridge and closed the door.
entries.exampleZh: 她把新鲜牛奶放进冰箱，然后关上了门。

entries.example: Let me introduce my new teacher to all of you.
entries.exampleZh: 让我把我的新老师介绍给你们大家。

entries.example: The teacher gave a short introduction before the lesson began.
entries.exampleZh: 老师在课程开始前做了简短的介绍。

entries.example: The old book describes an invasion of a peaceful island.
entries.exampleZh: 这本旧书描述了对一个和平岛屿的侵略。

entries.example: Scientists try to invent new machines that help people every day.
entries.exampleZh: 科学家们每天努力发明帮助人们的新机器。

entries.example: The invention of the telephone changed the world forever.
entries.exampleZh: 电话的发明永远地改变了世界。

entries.example: The young inventor built a small robot in his garage.
entries.exampleZh: 这位年轻的发明家在车库里造了一个小机器人。

entries.example: The police started an investigation after the shop was robbed.
entries.exampleZh: 商店被盗后，警方展开了调查。

entries.example: My uncle made a wise investment in a small local company.
entries.exampleZh: 我叔叔在一家当地小公司做了一笔明智的投资。

entries.example: The bird is almost invisible against the green leaves.
entries.exampleZh: 那只鸟在绿叶的映衬下几乎看不见。

entries.example: She sent me a beautiful invitation to her birthday party.
entries.exampleZh: 她给我寄来一张漂亮的请柬，邀请我参加她的生日聚会。

entries.example: I want to invite all my friends to the picnic.
entries.exampleZh: 我想邀请我所有的朋友来参加野餐。

entries.example: She felt an inward calm before the big exam.
entries.exampleZh: 大考之前，她内心感到一种平静。

entries.example: My mother uses a hot iron to press my school shirts.
entries.exampleZh: 我妈妈用热熨斗熨我的校服衬衫。

entries.example: We spent a lovely week on a small Greek island.
entries.exampleZh: 我们在一个希腊小岛上度过了愉快的一周。

entries.example: Doctors had to isolate the sick man from other patients.
entries.exampleZh: 医生们不得不把那个病人与其他病人隔离。

entries.example: We ate italian food at a small restaurant near the river.
entries.exampleZh: 我们在河边一家小餐馆吃了意大利菜。

entries.example: The cat licked its paws after eating the fish.
entries.exampleZh: 那只猫吃完鱼后舔了舔它的爪子。

entries.example: The little door closed itself when the wind blew.
entries.exampleZh: 风吹过来时，那扇小门自己关上了。

entries.example: He put on a warm jacket before leaving the house.
entries.exampleZh: 他出门前穿上了一件暖和的夹克。

entries.example: The thief spent two years in jail for stealing cars.
entries.exampleZh: 那个小偷因偷车在监狱里待了两年。

entries.example: My grandmother makes sweet jam from fresh garden berries.
entries.exampleZh: 我奶奶用园子里新鲜的浆果做甜甜的果酱。

entries.example: We plan to visit our grandparents in January for a few days.
entries.exampleZh: 我们计划在一月去看望祖父母，待几天。

entries.example: My cousin lives in Japan and teaches English at a school.
entries.exampleZh: 我的表弟住在日本，在一所学校教英语。

entries.example: She speaks Japanese very well and loves the food there.
entries.exampleZh: 她日语说得很好，也很喜欢那里的食物。

entries.example: There is a jar of honey on the kitchen shelf.
entries.exampleZh: 厨房的架子上有一罐蜂蜜。

entries.example: He hurt his jaw while playing football last Saturday afternoon.
entries.exampleZh: 上周六下午他踢足球时伤了颌部。

entries.example: My father listens to jazz every evening after dinner.
entries.exampleZh: 我父亲每天晚饭后听爵士乐。

entries.example: She felt jealous when her best friend won the prize.
entries.exampleZh: 当她最好的朋友获奖时，她感到嫉妒。

entries.example: The jet landed smoothly at the small airport this morning.
entries.exampleZh: 那架喷气式飞机今天早上平稳地降落在小机场。

entries.example: The queen wore a beautiful jewel on her golden crown.
entries.exampleZh: 女王在她的金色王冠上戴了一颗美丽的宝石。

entries.example: My neighbor is Jewish and celebrates many special holidays with family.
entries.exampleZh: 我的邻居是犹太人，和家人庆祝许多特别的节日。

entries.example: He found a new job at a bank near his home.
entries.exampleZh: 他在家附近的一家银行找到了一份新工作。

entries.example: Would you like to join our chess club this year?
entries.exampleZh: 你今年想参加我们的国际象棋俱乐部吗？

entries.example: Everyone laughed at the funny joke he told us yesterday.
entries.exampleZh: 大家都被他昨天讲的有趣笑话逗笑了。

entries.example: Our teacher is a jolly man who loves telling stories.
entries.exampleZh: 我们的老师是个快活的人，喜欢讲故事。

entries.example: She writes in her journal every night before bed.
entries.exampleZh: 她每天晚上睡觉前都写日志。

entries.example: The journalist asked the mayor several difficult questions yesterday.
entries.exampleZh: 那位记者昨天向市长提了几个难以回答的问题。

entries.example: The journey to the mountains took almost four hours by bus.
entries.exampleZh: 去山里的旅程坐公共汽车花了将近四个小时。

entries.example: Her face was full of joy when she opened the gift.
entries.exampleZh: 她打开礼物时，脸上满是喜悦。

entries.example: The children sang a joyful song at the school concert.
entries.exampleZh: 孩子们在学校音乐会上唱了一首欢快的歌。

entries.example: The judge listened carefully to both sides of the story.
entries.exampleZh: 法官仔细听了双方的说法。

entries.example: She drinks a glass of orange juice every morning.
entries.exampleZh: 她每天早上喝一杯橙汁。

entries.example: School ends in July, so we have a long summer holiday.
entries.exampleZh: 学校七月放假，所以我们有一个长长的暑假。

entries.example: The children jump over the small puddles after the rain.
entries.exampleZh: 雨后孩子们跳过那些小水坑。

entries.example: Our summer camp starts in June and lasts three weeks.
entries.exampleZh: 我们的夏令营六月开始，持续三个星期。

entries.example: Many wild animals live in the thick jungle near the river.
entries.exampleZh: 许多野生动物生活在河边茂密的丛林里。

entries.example: He is a junior player on our school football team.
entries.exampleZh: 他是我们校足球队的一名少年队员。

entries.example: The jury listened carefully to every word of the story.
entries.exampleZh: 陪审团仔细听了这个故事的每一个字。

entries.example: I have just finished my homework and now I can relax.
entries.exampleZh: 我刚做完作业，现在可以放松一下了。

entries.example: She is keen on swimming and goes to the pool daily.
entries.exampleZh: 她热衷于游泳，每天都去游泳池。

entries.example: Please keep your voice down while the baby sleeps.
entries.exampleZh: 宝宝睡觉时请把声音放低。

entries.example: The zoo keeper feeds the lions twice every day.
entries.exampleZh: 动物园的饲养员每天喂狮子两次。

entries.example: Put the kettle on and we will have some tea.
entries.exampleZh: 把水壶烧上，我们喝点茶。

entries.example: I lost my house key and cannot open the door.
entries.exampleZh: 我丢了我家的钥匙，打不开门。

entries.example: He types quickly on the new keyboard at his desk.
entries.exampleZh: 他在桌上的新键盘上打字很快。

entries.example: The little boy can kick the ball very far.
entries.exampleZh: 这个小男孩能把球踢得很远。

entries.example: Every kid in the class brought a small gift today.
entries.exampleZh: 今天班里每个孩子都带来了一份小礼物。

entries.example: He did not kill the spider but carried it outside.
entries.exampleZh: 他没有杀死那只蜘蛛，而是把它搬到了外面。

entries.example: This bag of rice weighs exactly one kilogram.
entries.exampleZh: 这袋大米正好重一千克。

entries.example: The school is only one kilometre from our new house.
entries.exampleZh: 学校离我们的新房子只有一公里。

entries.example: What kind of music do you like to listen to?
entries.exampleZh: 你喜欢听哪种音乐？

entries.example: Her kindness helped the new student feel at home.
entries.exampleZh: 她的好心让这位新同学感到了家的温暖。

entries.example: The king built a large garden behind his castle.
entries.exampleZh: 国王在城堡后面建了一个大花园。

entries.example: The old kingdom was famous for its gold and music.
entries.exampleZh: 这个古老的王国以黄金和音乐闻名。

entries.example: She gave her baby a gentle kiss goodnight.
entries.exampleZh: 她轻轻地吻了吻宝宝，道了声晚安。

entries.example: My mother is cooking soup in the kitchen now.
entries.exampleZh: 我妈妈现在正在厨房里煮汤。

entries.example: The children flew a red kite in the park.
entries.exampleZh: 孩子们在公园里放了一只红色的风筝。

entries.example: He hurt his knee while playing football yesterday.
entries.exampleZh: 他昨天踢足球时伤了膝盖。

entries.example: We had to kneel down to look under the bed.
entries.exampleZh: 我们不得不跪下来看看床底下。

entries.example: Cut the bread with a sharp knife, please.
entries.exampleZh: 请用一把锋利的刀把面包切开。

entries.example: My aunt can knit warm socks for the family.
entries.exampleZh: 我姑姑会给家人织暖和的袜子。

entries.example: Turn the small knob to open the old door.
entries.exampleZh: 转动那个小旋钮就能打开这扇旧门。

entries.example: Someone will knock on the door at eight.
entries.exampleZh: 八点钟会有人敲门。

entries.example: He tied a strong knot in the long rope.
entries.exampleZh: 他在那根长绳子上打了一个结实的结。

entries.example: I know a good place to eat near here.
entries.exampleZh: 我知道这附近有个吃饭的好地方。

entries.example: Her knowledge of history really surprised the whole class.
entries.exampleZh: 她的历史知识着实让全班同学感到惊讶。

entries.example: The students did a simple test in the lab.
entries.exampleZh: 学生们在实验室里做了一个简单的测试。

entries.example: The label on the box shows the price.
entries.exampleZh: 盒子上的标签标明了价格。

entries.example: The new laboratory has modern machines for science lessons.
entries.exampleZh: 新实验室里有供科学课使用的现代化机器。

entries.example: Building the wall was hard labour for the men.
entries.exampleZh: 砌这堵墙对这些男人来说是艰苦的劳动。

entries.example: She tied the lace on her shoe carefully.
entries.exampleZh: 她仔细地系好了鞋上的带子。

entries.example: There is a lack of clean water in this village.
entries.exampleZh: 这个村庄缺乏干净的饮用水。

entries.example: He climbed the ladder to fix the roof.
entries.exampleZh: 他爬上梯子去修屋顶。

entries.example: The old lady gave me a warm smile.
entries.exampleZh: 那位老太太给了我一个温暖的微笑。

entries.example: Our team began to lag behind in the second half.
entries.exampleZh: 我们队在下半场开始落后了。

entries.example: We walked slowly around the lake after dinner.
entries.exampleZh: 晚饭后我们沿着湖边慢慢散步。

entries.example: The little lamb stayed close to its mother.
entries.exampleZh: 小羊羔紧紧跟着它的妈妈。

entries.example: The lame horse could not run very fast.
entries.exampleZh: 那匹跛脚的马跑不快。

entries.example: She turned on the lamp and started reading.
entries.exampleZh: 她打开灯，开始看书。

entries.example: The plane will land in about twenty minutes.
entries.exampleZh: 飞机大约二十分钟后着陆。

entries.example: The pilot made a smooth landing on the runway.
entries.exampleZh: 飞行员在跑道上平稳着陆。

entries.example: Our landlady fixed the broken heater this morning.
entries.exampleZh: 我们的女房东今早修好了坏掉的暖气。

entries.example: The landlord raised the rent again last month.
entries.exampleZh: 房东上个月又涨了房租。

entries.example: The bicycle lane is narrow but very safe.
entries.exampleZh: 这条自行车道很窄，但非常安全。

entries.example: English is a useful language for travel and work.
entries.exampleZh: 英语是一门很有用的语言，适合旅行和工作。

entries.example: A paper lantern hung above the old door.
entries.exampleZh: 一盏纸灯笼挂在旧门上方。

entries.example: They live in a large house near the park.
entries.exampleZh: 他们住在公园附近的一所大房子里。

entries.example: The success was largely due to her hard work.
entries.exampleZh: 这次成功主要归功于她的努力。

entries.example: The doctor used a laser to treat his eye.
entries.exampleZh: 医生用激光治疗他的眼睛。

entries.example: This is the last bus to the city centre.
entries.exampleZh: 这是去市中心的最后一班公交车。

entries.example: Sorry, I am late because of the traffic.
entries.exampleZh: 抱歉，我因为交通拥堵迟到了。

entries.example: I have not seen my old friend lately.
entries.exampleZh: 我最近没有见到我的老朋友。

entries.example: We will talk about the plan later today.
entries.exampleZh: 我们今天晚些时候再谈这个计划。

entries.example: She is studying Latin at school this year.
entries.exampleZh: 她今年在学校学习拉丁语。

entries.example: Of the two plans, I prefer the latter one.
entries.exampleZh: 在两个方案中，我更喜欢后一个。

entries.example: His joke made the whole class laugh loudly.
entries.exampleZh: 他的笑话让全班大声笑了起来。

entries.example: The room was full of laughter and happy voices.
entries.exampleZh: 房间里充满了笑声和欢快的声音。

entries.example: Excuse me, where is the nearest lavatory, please?
entries.exampleZh: 打扰一下，请问最近的盥洗室在哪里？

entries.example: Everyone must follow the law in this country.
entries.exampleZh: 在这个国家，每个人都必须遵守法律。

entries.example: The children are playing football on the lawn.
entries.exampleZh: 孩子们正在草坪上踢足球。

entries.example: My sister works as a lawyer in the city.
entries.exampleZh: 我姐姐在城里当律师。

entries.example: Please lay all the books gently on the wooden table.
entries.exampleZh: 请把所有书轻轻放在木桌上。

entries.example: A thin layer of snow covered the whole garden.
entries.exampleZh: 一层薄雪覆盖了整个花园。

entries.example: The layout of this new office looks very good.
entries.exampleZh: 这个新办公室的布局看起来很不错。

entries.example: My brother is too lazy to clean his room.
entries.exampleZh: 我弟弟太懒了，不愿意打扫他的房间。

entries.example: Old pipes may contain lead and other harmful metals.
entries.exampleZh: 旧管道可能含有铅和其他有害金属。

entries.example: She is a strong leader with a clear plan.
entries.exampleZh: 她是一位有明确计划的坚强领导者。

entries.example: Good leadership helps the whole team work together well.
entries.exampleZh: 良好的领导力有助于整个团队很好地合作。

entries.example: He is a leading expert on ancient Chinese history.
entries.exampleZh: 他是一位研究中国古代史的顶尖专家。

entries.example: A yellow leaf fell slowly from the tall tree.
entries.exampleZh: 一片黄叶从高高的树上慢慢落下。

entries.example: Our team won the game in the local league.
entries.exampleZh: 我们队在本地联赛中赢得了比赛。

entries.example: There is a small leak under the kitchen sink.
entries.exampleZh: 厨房水槽下面有个小漏洞。

entries.example: Please do not lean against the glass door.
entries.exampleZh: 请不要靠在玻璃门上。

entries.example: The cat made a big leap onto the table.
entries.exampleZh: 猫猛地一跳，跳上了桌子。

entries.example: I want to learn how to cook Chinese food.
entries.exampleZh: 我想学做中国菜。

entries.example: My grandfather is a learned man who loves old books.
entries.exampleZh: 我的祖父是个爱读旧书的有学问的人。

entries.example: Online learning is becoming more popular these days.
entries.exampleZh: 如今在线学习正变得越来越流行。

entries.example: This is the least expensive bag in the shop.
entries.exampleZh: 这是店里最便宜的包。

entries.example: He bought a brown leather jacket last winter.
entries.exampleZh: 去年冬天他买了一件棕色皮夹克。

entries.example: We must leave the house before eight o'clock.
entries.exampleZh: 我们必须在八点前离开家。

entries.example: The professor gave a long lecture about climate change.
entries.exampleZh: 教授做了一场关于气候变化的冗长讲座。

entries.example: Turn left at the next corner and walk straight.
entries.exampleZh: 在下一个路口向左转，然后直走。

entries.example: My right leg hurts after the long walk.
entries.exampleZh: 走了很长的路后我的右腿疼。

entries.example: She added a slice of lemon to her tea.
entries.exampleZh: 她往茶里加了一片柠檬。

entries.example: Can you lend me your bike for the afternoon?
entries.exampleZh: 下午你能把自行车借给我吗？

entries.example: The length of this river is about ten miles.
entries.exampleZh: 这条河的长度大约是十英里。

entries.example: I need a new lens for my old camera.
entries.exampleZh: 我的旧相机需要一个新镜头。

entries.example: Try to spend less money on snacks this month.
entries.exampleZh: 这个月尽量少花钱买零食。

entries.example: Our first lesson today starts at nine o'clock.
entries.exampleZh: 我们今天的第一节课九点开始。

entries.example: Speak quietly lest you wake the sleeping baby.
entries.exampleZh: 小声说话，以免吵醒睡着的婴儿。

entries.example: Please let me help you carry those heavy boxes.
entries.exampleZh: 请让我帮你搬那些重箱子。

entries.example: I wrote a long letter to my grandmother last night.
entries.exampleZh: 昨晚我给祖母写了一封长信。

entries.example: The water level in the river is higher than last year.
entries.exampleZh: 河里的水位比去年高。

entries.example: Pull the metal lever to open the heavy door.
entries.exampleZh: 拉动金属杆来打开那扇沉重的门。

entries.example: These old roads are liable to flood after heavy rain.
entries.exampleZh: 这些旧路在大雨过后容易积水。

entries.example: Nobody trusts him because he is a known liar.
entries.exampleZh: 没人相信他，因为他是个出了名的说谎者。

entries.example: My uncle has liberal views about modern art.
entries.exampleZh: 我叔叔对现代艺术持开明的看法。

entries.example: The soldiers helped liberate the small town at dawn.
entries.exampleZh: 士兵们在黎明时帮助解放了这座小镇。

entries.example: People here value their liberty more than money.
entries.exampleZh: 这里的人们珍视自由胜过金钱。

entries.example: The librarian helped me find an old map.
entries.exampleZh: 图书管理员帮我找到了一张旧地图。

entries.example: Our town library opens at nine every morning.
entries.exampleZh: 我们镇上的图书馆每天早上九点开门。

entries.example: You need a license to drive this small truck.
entries.exampleZh: 你需要执照才能开这辆小卡车。

entries.example: The happy dog tried to lick my hand.
entries.exampleZh: 那只开心的狗想舔我的手。

entries.example: Please put the lid back on the pot.
entries.exampleZh: 请把盖子盖回锅上。

entries.example: Cats like to lie in the warm sun.
entries.exampleZh: 猫喜欢躺在温暖的阳光下。

entries.example: The young lieutenant gave the orders to his men.
entries.exampleZh: 那位年轻的中尉向他的部下下达了命令。

entries.example: My grandfather had a long and happy life.
entries.exampleZh: 我祖父度过了漫长而幸福的一生。

entries.example: She spent a lifetime teaching children in the village.
entries.exampleZh: 她一辈子都在村里教孩子。

entries.example: The old lift in our building makes strange noises.
entries.exampleZh: 我们楼里的旧电梯发出奇怪的响声。

entries.example: This bag is light enough for a child.
entries.exampleZh: 这个包很轻，小孩都拿得动。

entries.example: These bright curtains will lighten the whole room.
entries.exampleZh: 这些明亮的窗帘会让整个房间亮起来。

entries.example: She closed the door lightly so the baby would not wake.
entries.exampleZh: 她轻轻地关上门，以免吵醒婴儿。

entries.example: Thunder and lightning frightened the little dog during the storm.
entries.exampleZh: 暴风雨中，雷电吓坏了那只小狗。

entries.example: I like to read books before going to sleep at night.
entries.exampleZh: 我喜欢在晚上睡觉前看书。

entries.example: It is likely to rain later this afternoon, so take an umbrella.
entries.exampleZh: 今天下午晚些时候可能会下雨，所以带把伞吧。

entries.example: He works hard, and his sister does likewise every day.
entries.exampleZh: 他工作很努力，他妹妹每天也同样如此。

entries.example: After the fall, he could not move his injured limb.
entries.exampleZh: 摔倒之后，他无法移动受伤的肢体。

entries.example: Workers added lime to the soil to help the plants grow.
entries.exampleZh: 工人们在土壤里加了石灰，帮助植物生长。

entries.example: There is a limit to how much I can carry today.
entries.exampleZh: 我今天能搬多少是有个限度的。

entries.example: One limitation of this plan is the high cost.
entries.exampleZh: 这个计划的一个局限是成本很高。

entries.example: We have only limited time, so please hurry up.
entries.exampleZh: 我们的时间有限，所以请快点。

entries.example: Please stand in a straight line behind the yellow rope.
entries.exampleZh: 请站在黄绳后面排成一条直线。

entries.example: She wore a white linen shirt on that hot summer day.
entries.exampleZh: 那个炎热的夏日，她穿了一件白色亚麻衬衫。

entries.example: The ocean liner sailed slowly past the small island.
entries.exampleZh: 那艘远洋班轮缓缓驶过小岛。

entries.example: This old chain has one broken link near the end.
entries.exampleZh: 这条旧链子在靠近末端的地方有一个坏掉的环。

entries.example: A huge lion slept quietly under the shade of a tree.
entries.exampleZh: 一头大狮子在树阴下安静地睡着。

entries.example: She bit her lower lip while waiting for the result.
entries.exampleZh: 她在等结果的时候咬着下嘴唇。

entries.example: Please pour the hot liquid into a clean glass cup.
entries.exampleZh: 请把热液体倒进一个干净的玻璃杯里。

entries.example: My uncle never drinks strong liquor before driving his car.
entries.exampleZh: 我叔叔开车前从不喝烈酒。

entries.example: Please write a list of things we need to buy.
entries.exampleZh: 请写一份我们需要买的东西的清单。

entries.example: Please listen carefully to the teacher during the whole lesson.
entries.exampleZh: 整堂课请认真听老师讲课。

entries.example: She is a good listener and always helps her friends.
entries.exampleZh: 她是个好的倾听者，总是帮助她的朋友们。

entries.example: This large bottle holds exactly one liter of cold water.
entries.exampleZh: 这个大瓶子正好能装一升冷水。

entries.example: She enjoys literary magazines more than fashion ones.
entries.exampleZh: 相比时尚杂志，她更喜欢文学杂志。

entries.example: A little cat is sleeping under the old table.
entries.exampleZh: 一只小猫正在旧桌子下面睡觉。

entries.example: My grandparents live in a small house near the river.
entries.exampleZh: 我的祖父母住在河边的一座小房子里。

entries.example: The children are lively and full of happy energy.
entries.exampleZh: 孩子们很活泼，充满了快乐的活力。

entries.example: The doctor said his liver is healthy and strong.
entries.exampleZh: 医生说他肝脏健康而强壮。

entries.example: She makes a living by selling fresh bread.
entries.exampleZh: 她靠卖新鲜面包谋生。

entries.example: The farmer will load the boxes onto the truck.
entries.exampleZh: 农民会把箱子装上卡车。

entries.example: I bought a fresh loaf of bread this morning.
entries.exampleZh: 今天早上我买了一条新鲜的面包。

entries.example: We buy fresh fruit at the local market every Saturday.
entries.exampleZh: 我们每周六在当地市场买新鲜水果。

entries.example: The hotel has a quiet location near the beach.
entries.exampleZh: 这家酒店位于海滩附近，环境安静。

entries.example: Please lock the front door before you leave tonight.
entries.exampleZh: 今晚离开前请把前门锁上。

entries.example: The old locomotive pulled six heavy cars up the hill.
entries.exampleZh: 那台旧火车头拉着六节沉重的车厢上了山。

entries.example: He put another log on the fire to keep warm.
entries.exampleZh: 他又往火里添了一根原木来取暖。

entries.example: Her answer was logical and easy for everyone to follow.
entries.exampleZh: 她的回答合乎逻辑，大家都容易理解。

entries.example: The old man feels lonely without his family nearby.
entries.exampleZh: 这位老人由于家人不在身边而感到孤独。

entries.example: Please look at the map before we start walking.
entries.exampleZh: 我们出发走路前请看一下地图。

entries.example: She tied the rope in a loop around the tree.
entries.exampleZh: 她把绳子绕树系成一个圈。

entries.example: This shirt is loose and very comfortable in summer.
entries.exampleZh: 这件衬衫很宽松，夏天穿非常舒服。

entries.example: Please loosen the lid on this jar for me.
entries.exampleZh: 请帮我把这个罐子的盖子拧松。

entries.example: The lord lived in a large castle near the river.
entries.exampleZh: 这位贵族住在河边一座大城堡里。

entries.example: A heavy lorry blocked the narrow road this morning.
entries.exampleZh: 今天早上，一辆重型卡车堵住了这条狭窄的路。

entries.example: I don't want to lose my keys again.
entries.exampleZh: 我不想再把钥匙弄丢了。

entries.example: The loss of his old dog made him very sad.
entries.exampleZh: 失去那只老狗让他非常伤心。

entries.example: A lot of students take the bus to school.
entries.exampleZh: 很多学生坐公交车上学。

entries.example: The music was too loud for the small room.
entries.exampleZh: 这音乐对这个小房间来说太吵了。

entries.example: The teacher used a loudspeaker so everyone could hear.
entries.exampleZh: 老师用了扬声器，好让每个人都能听见。

entries.example: I love walking in the park after dinner.
entries.exampleZh: 我喜欢晚饭后在公园里散步。

entries.example: We had a lovely time at the beach yesterday.
entries.exampleZh: 昨天我们在海滩度过了一段愉快的时光。

entries.example: My sister is a great lover of classical music.
entries.exampleZh: 我姐姐非常喜欢古典音乐。

entries.example: The table is too low for my tall brother.
entries.exampleZh: 这张桌子对我高个子的弟弟来说太矮了。

entries.example: Please lower your voice, the baby is sleeping.
entries.exampleZh: 请把声音放低，宝宝在睡觉。

entries.example: He has been a loyal friend to me for years.
entries.exampleZh: 多年来他一直是我忠诚的朋友。

entries.example: I wish you good luck with your exam tomorrow.
entries.exampleZh: 祝你明天考试好运。

entries.example: You are very lucky to have such kind neighbors.
entries.exampleZh: 你很幸运，有这么善良的邻居。

entries.example: Please keep your luggage close to you at the station.
entries.exampleZh: 在车站请把你的行李放在身边。

entries.example: They bought enough lumber to build a small wooden table.
entries.exampleZh: 他们买了足够的木材来做一张小木桌。

entries.example: There is a small lump of sugar in my tea.
entries.exampleZh: 我的茶里有一小块方糖。

entries.example: We usually have lunch at noon on Sundays.
entries.exampleZh: 我们星期天通常中午吃午饭。

entries.example: Smoking is very bad for your lung and your heart.
entries.exampleZh: 吸烟对你的肺和心脏都很有害。

entries.example: A warm bath is a real luxury after a long day.
entries.exampleZh: 漫长的一天之后，洗个热水澡真是奢侈的享受。

entries.example: This machine washes our clothes in just twenty minutes.
entries.exampleZh: 这台机器只要二十分钟就能把我们的衣服洗好。

entries.example: My father was mad when I broke the window.
entries.exampleZh: 我打碎窗户的时候，父亲很生气。

entries.example: Excuse me, madam, could you tell me the way?
entries.exampleZh: 打扰一下，女士，您能告诉我去那儿怎么走吗？

entries.example: She reads a fashion magazine on the train every morning.
entries.exampleZh: 她每天早上在火车上读一本时尚杂志。

entries.example: The children love stories about magic and brave heroes.
entries.exampleZh: 孩子们喜欢关于魔法和勇敢英雄的故事。

entries.example: He put a small magnet on the fridge door.
entries.exampleZh: 他在冰箱门上放了一块小磁铁。

entries.example: The box has a magnetic lid that closes by itself.
entries.exampleZh: 这个盒子有一个能自动合上的磁性盖子。

entries.example: From the hill we saw a magnificent view of the lake.
entries.exampleZh: 我们从山上看到了湖的壮丽景色。

entries.example: The maid cleans our rooms every morning before nine.
entries.exampleZh: 女佣每天早上九点前打扫我们的房间。

entries.example: I check my mail when I get home from work.
entries.exampleZh: 我下班回家后会查看我的邮件。

entries.example: The main problem is that we have very little time.
entries.exampleZh: 主要问题是我们时间非常少。

entries.example: Her family moved to the mainland when she was ten.
entries.exampleZh: 她十岁时全家搬到了大陆。

entries.example: The guests were mainly friends from my old school.
entries.exampleZh: 客人主要是我以前学校的朋友。

entries.example: The old bridge needs regular maintenance and careful checks.
entries.exampleZh: 这座老桥需要定期维护和仔细检查。

entries.example: Can you make a cake for her birthday party?
entries.exampleZh: 你能为她的生日聚会做一个蛋糕吗？

entries.example: The male bird has bright blue and green feathers.
entries.exampleZh: 这只雄鸟有亮蓝色和绿色的羽毛。

entries.example: An old man sat on the bench reading a paper.
entries.exampleZh: 一位老人坐在长椅上读报纸。

entries.example: I hope we can manage without a car this week.
entries.exampleZh: 我希望这周我们没有车也能应付。

entries.example: Good management of time helps students finish their work on schedule.
entries.exampleZh: 良好的时间管理能帮助学生按时完成作业。

entries.example: Our new manager speaks to every worker with great respect.
entries.exampleZh: 我们的新经理非常尊重地跟每位工人说话。

entries.example: This great discovery will help all mankind in the future.
entries.exampleZh: 这项伟大的发现将来会帮助全人类。

entries.example: He gave a manly answer and did not hide his fear.
entries.exampleZh: 他给出了果断的回答，没有掩饰自己的恐惧。

entries.example: She spoke in a calm manner and answered every question.
entries.exampleZh: 她以平静的方式说话，回答了每一个问题。

entries.example: Please read the manual before you start the new machine.
entries.exampleZh: 启动这台新机器前请阅读手册。

entries.example: The manufacturer sent us a letter about the broken parts.
entries.exampleZh: 制造商给我们寄了一封关于损坏零件的信。

entries.example: Many students in our class walk to school every morning.
entries.exampleZh: 我们班许多学生每天早上步行上学。

entries.example: She drew a small map to show us the way.
entries.exampleZh: 她画了一张小地图给我们指路。

entries.example: The old hall has a floor made of white marble.
entries.exampleZh: 那座旧大厅的地板是白色大理石做的。

entries.example: The weather in march is often cold and windy here.
entries.exampleZh: 这里三月的天气常常寒冷多风。

entries.example: Many kinds of marine animals live near these warm waters.
entries.exampleZh: 许多种海洋动物生活在这些温暖的水域附近。

entries.example: Please put a mark next to the correct answer.
entries.exampleZh: 请在正确答案旁边做一个记号。

entries.example: We buy fresh fruit at the market every Saturday morning.
entries.exampleZh: 我们每周六早上在市场买新鲜水果。

entries.example: Their marriage has lasted for more than forty years.
entries.exampleZh: 他们的婚姻已经持续了四十多年。

entries.example: My sister is married and lives in another city.
entries.exampleZh: 我姐姐已婚，住在另一个城市。

entries.example: They plan to marry next spring in a small church.
entries.exampleZh: 他们打算明年春天在一座小教堂结婚。

entries.example: We had a marvellous time at the beach last weekend.
entries.exampleZh: 上周末我们在海滩玩得非常开心。

entries.example: Our teacher talked about marxism in history class today.
entries.exampleZh: 我们老师今天在历史课上谈到了马克思主义。

entries.example: He wrote a marxist view of modern history.
entries.exampleZh: 他写了一篇关于现代史的马克思主义观点。

entries.example: A mass of dark clouds covered the sky before the storm.
entries.exampleZh: 暴风雨来临前，一大团乌云遮住了天空。

entries.example: The dog ran back to its master at the gate.
entries.exampleZh: 那只狗跑回大门口的主人身边。

entries.example: Many people think this novel is his greatest masterpiece.
entries.exampleZh: 许多人认为这部小说是他最伟大的杰作。

entries.example: Please put the wet mat outside the kitchen door.
entries.exampleZh: 请把湿垫子放到厨房门外。

entries.example: Our team won the football match by two goals.
entries.exampleZh: 我们队以两球之差赢得了那场足球比赛。

entries.example: My old school mate lives in the same building.
entries.exampleZh: 我的一位老同学住在同一栋楼里。

entries.example: This soft material is perfect for a winter coat.
entries.exampleZh: 这种柔软的材料非常适合做冬季外套。

entries.example: He often talks about materialism in his history classes.
entries.exampleZh: 他在历史课上经常谈论唯物主义。

entries.example: She solved the mathematical problem in just two minutes.
entries.exampleZh: 她只用两分钟就解出了那道数学题。

entries.example: Mathematics is my favourite subject at school this year.
entries.exampleZh: 今年数学是我在学校最喜欢的科目。

entries.example: We have maths on Monday morning before lunch.
entries.exampleZh: 我们星期一上午午餐前有数学课。

entries.example: You may leave the classroom when you finish.
entries.exampleZh: 你完成后可以离开教室。

entries.example: Maybe we can meet at the park after lunch.
entries.exampleZh: 也许我们午饭后可以在公园见面。

entries.example: The mayor opened the new library on Friday morning.
entries.exampleZh: 市长在星期五上午为新图书馆揭幕。

entries.example: Cows were eating grass in the green meadow.
entries.exampleZh: 奶牛们正在绿色的草地上吃草。

entries.example: We enjoyed a warm meal after the long walk.
entries.exampleZh: 长途步行之后，我们享用了一顿热饭。

entries.example: What does this strange word mean in English?
entries.exampleZh: 这个奇怪的词在英语里是什么意思？

entries.example: I do not understand the meaning of this sign.
entries.exampleZh: 我不明白这个标志的意思。

entries.example: In the meantime, she prepared tea for her guests.
entries.exampleZh: 在此期间，她为客人们准备了茶。

entries.example: She cooked dinner; meanwhile, her brother set the table.
entries.exampleZh: 她做晚饭，与此同时，她弟弟摆好了餐桌。

entries.example: The teacher said our progress is measurable in just a few weeks.
entries.exampleZh: 老师说，我们的进步在短短几周内就能测量出来。

entries.example: The tailor took my measurement before making the new suit.
entries.exampleZh: 裁缝在做新西装之前量了我的尺寸。

entries.example: She does not eat meat because she loves animals.
entries.exampleZh: 她不吃肉，因为她喜爱动物。

entries.example: The old clock has a mechanical problem inside it.
entries.exampleZh: 这座旧钟里面有一个机械故障。

entries.example: He answered the question mechanically, without really thinking.
entries.exampleZh: 他机械地回答了这个问题，并没有真正思考。

entries.example: My brother studies mechanics at a famous university.
entries.exampleZh: 我哥哥在一所著名的大学学习力学。

entries.example: She won a gold medal in the swimming race.
entries.exampleZh: 她在游泳比赛中赢得了一枚金牌。

entries.example: His medical records are kept in a safe place.
entries.exampleZh: 他的病历被保存在一个安全的地方。

entries.example: Take this medicine twice a day after meals.
entries.exampleZh: 这种药一天吃两次，饭后服用。

entries.example: The Mediterranean is warm and beautiful in summer.
entries.exampleZh: 地中海在夏天温暖而美丽。

entries.example: Please choose a medium size for your new shirt.
entries.exampleZh: 请为你的新衬衫选择一个中号。

entries.example: I hope to meet your sister at the party.
entries.exampleZh: 我希望在聚会上见到你的姐姐。

entries.example: The meeting starts at nine in the morning.
entries.exampleZh: 会议早上九点开始。

entries.example: We bought a sweet melon at the market today.
entries.exampleZh: 我们今天在市场买了一个甜瓜。

entries.example: Every member of the club pays a small fee.
entries.exampleZh: 俱乐部的每位成员都要交一小笔费用。

entries.example: They built a memorial for the soldiers in the park.
entries.exampleZh: 他们在公园里为士兵们建了一座纪念碑。

entries.example: My memory of that summer is still very clear.
entries.exampleZh: 我对那个夏天的记忆仍然非常清晰。

entries.example: Can you mend this hole in my old coat?
entries.exampleZh: 你能补一下我旧外套上的这个洞吗？

entries.example: Playing chess is good mental exercise for children.
entries.exampleZh: 下棋对孩子们来说是很好的脑力锻炼。

entries.example: He did not mention the problem at dinner.
entries.exampleZh: 他在晚饭时没有提到这个问题。

entries.example: The merchant sold fresh fruit and bread in the busy market.
entries.exampleZh: 这位商人在热闹的市场上卖新鲜水果和面包。

entries.example: The old thermometer broke, and mercury ran onto the floor.
entries.exampleZh: 旧温度计打碎了，水银流到了地板上。

entries.example: The kind king showed mercy and let the prisoner go home.
entries.exampleZh: 仁慈的国王发了慈悲，放那个囚犯回家了。

entries.example: The mere thought of losing my dog makes me sad.
entries.exampleZh: 仅仅是想到失去我的狗就让我难过。

entries.example: I merely asked a simple question, but he got angry.
entries.exampleZh: 我只不过问了一个简单的问题，可他却生气了。

entries.example: The children sang a merry song at the winter party.
entries.exampleZh: 孩子们在冬季聚会上唱了一首欢快的歌。

entries.example: Your room is a mess, so please clean it before dinner.
entries.exampleZh: 你的房间乱七八糟，请在晚饭前收拾干净。

entries.example: I left a message on your desk this morning.
entries.exampleZh: 今天早上我在你桌上留了一张便条。

entries.example: A messenger brought the letter to our door at noon.
entries.exampleZh: 一名信使在中午把那封信送到了我们家门口。

entries.example: The box is made of metal and looks quite old.
entries.exampleZh: 这个盒子是金属做的，看起来很旧了。

entries.example: The water meter in our kitchen shows a very high number.
entries.exampleZh: 我们厨房里的水表显示的数字很高。

entries.example: This new method helps students learn words much faster.
entries.exampleZh: 这种新方法帮助学生更快地记单词。

entries.example: The rope is one metre long, maybe a little more.
entries.exampleZh: 这根绳子有一米长，也许还长一点。

entries.example: Please write your weight in metric units on this form.
entries.exampleZh: 请在这张表上用公制单位写下你的体重。

entries.example: My father used a microcomputer at work many years ago.
entries.exampleZh: 很多年前我父亲在工作时用过一台微型计算机。

entries.example: Please speak into the microphone so everyone can hear you.
entries.exampleZh: 请对着麦克风说话，好让大家都能听见。

entries.example: We looked at tiny cells through a microscope in class today.
entries.exampleZh: 今天上课时我们用显微镜观察了微小的细胞。

entries.example: The sun is very strong at midday in summer here.
entries.exampleZh: 夏天这里正午的太阳很烈。

entries.example: My seat is in the middle of the front row.
entries.exampleZh: 我的座位在前排中间。

entries.example: The train arrived at midnight, so we took a taxi home.
entries.exampleZh: 火车午夜到达，所以我们打车回了家。

entries.example: A small house stood in the midst of the green forest.
entries.exampleZh: 一座小房子坐落在绿色森林的中央。

entries.example: We might visit the museum on Saturday morning.
entries.exampleZh: 我们星期六早上也许会去参观博物馆。

entries.example: The weather is mild and pleasant in spring.
entries.exampleZh: 春天天气温和宜人。

entries.example: Our school is about a mile from the station.
entries.exampleZh: 我们学校离车站大约一英里。

entries.example: She drinks a glass of milk every morning.
entries.exampleZh: 她每天早上喝一杯牛奶。

entries.example: The thin wire is only one millimetre thick.
entries.exampleZh: 这根细金属丝只有一毫米粗。

entries.example: More than a million people live in this city.
entries.exampleZh: 超过一百万人住在这座城市里。

entries.example: Keep your mind open when you learn new things.
entries.exampleZh: 学习新事物时，要让自己的头脑保持开放。

entries.example: That blue umbrella near the door is mine.
entries.exampleZh: 门旁那把蓝色的雨伞是我的。

entries.example: The old miner worked underground for many years.
entries.exampleZh: 这位老矿工在地下工作了很多年。

entries.example: The minimum age for this job is eighteen.
entries.exampleZh: 这份工作的最低年龄是十八岁。

entries.example: The foreign minister will visit our country next week.
entries.exampleZh: 外交部长下周将访问我国。

entries.example: The health ministry opened a new hospital yesterday.
entries.exampleZh: 卫生部昨天启用了一家新医院。

entries.example: Only a small minority of students disagreed with the plan.
entries.exampleZh: 只有少数学生不同意这个计划。

entries.example: The temperature outside is minus five degrees today.
entries.exampleZh: 今天外面的气温是零下五度。

entries.example: Please wait a minute while I find my keys.
entries.exampleZh: 请等一分钟，我找一下钥匙。

entries.example: It was a miracle that nobody was hurt.
entries.exampleZh: 没有人受伤，这真是个奇迹。

entries.example: She looked at herself in the bathroom mirror.
entries.exampleZh: 她照着浴室里的镜子看自己。

entries.example: Good morning, Miss Lee, how are you today?
entries.exampleZh: 早上好，李小姐，你今天怎么样？

entries.example: The army tested a new missile last week.
entries.exampleZh: 军队上周测试了一枚新导弹。

entries.example: My keys are missing, so I cannot open the front door.
entries.exampleZh: 我的钥匙不见了，所以我打不开前门。

entries.example: A thin mist covered the lake early this morning.
entries.exampleZh: 今天清晨，一层薄雾笼罩着湖面。

entries.example: Everyone makes a mistake sometimes, so do not feel bad.
entries.exampleZh: 每个人有时都会犯错，所以别难过。

entries.example: Mister Brown is our new teacher at the local school.
entries.exampleZh: 布朗先生是我们当地学校的新老师。

entries.example: The mistress of the house welcomed every guest warmly.
entries.exampleZh: 这家的女主人热情地欢迎了每一位客人。

entries.example: Please mix the eggs and sugar in a large bowl.
entries.exampleZh: 请把鸡蛋和糖在一个大碗里混合。

entries.example: Pour the mixture into a pan and bake it for ten minutes.
entries.exampleZh: 把混合物倒进烤盘里，烤十分钟。

entries.example: The old man gave a low moan and closed his eyes.
entries.exampleZh: 老人低声呻吟了一下，然后闭上了眼睛。

entries.example: My mobile phone is broken, so I cannot call you.
entries.exampleZh: 我的手机坏了，所以我不能给你打电话。

entries.example: Please switch your phone to silent mode during the class.
entries.exampleZh: 上课期间请把手机调成静音模式。

entries.example: He built a small model of a ship with his son.
entries.exampleZh: 他和儿子一起做了一个小船模型。

entries.example: The weather here is moderate, neither too hot nor too cold.
entries.exampleZh: 这里的天气温和，既不太热也不太冷。

entries.example: This modern kitchen has a big oven and two sinks.
entries.exampleZh: 这个现代化的厨房有一个大烤箱和两个水槽。

entries.example: She is modest about her success and rarely talks about it.
entries.exampleZh: 她对自己的成功很谦虚，很少谈起。

entries.example: We may modify the plan after the meeting tomorrow.
entries.exampleZh: 明天会议之后我们可能会修改这个计划。

entries.example: The cake is soft and moist, just as I like it.
entries.exampleZh: 这蛋糕松软湿润，正合我的口味。

entries.example: Plants need light, warmth and moisture to grow well.
entries.exampleZh: 植物需要光、温暖和水分才能长得好。

entries.example: A water molecule has two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.
entries.exampleZh: 一个水分子有两个氢原子和一个氧原子。

entries.example: Please wait a moment; the doctor will see you soon.
entries.exampleZh: 请稍等片刻，医生很快就会给你看诊。

entries.example: We will start our new English course next Monday morning.
entries.exampleZh: 我们下星期一上午开始新的英语课程。

entries.example: I save some money every week to buy a new bike.
entries.exampleZh: 我每周存一些钱，想买一辆新自行车。

entries.example: The little monkey took a banana from my hand.
entries.exampleZh: 那只小猴子从我手里拿走了一根香蕉。

entries.example: We will move to a new flat next month.
entries.exampleZh: 下个月我们将搬进一套新公寓。

entries.example: My father pays the rent monthly, on the first day.
entries.exampleZh: 我父亲每月第一天交房租。

entries.example: Many tourists visit the old monument near the river.
entries.exampleZh: 许多游客参观河边那座古老的纪念碑。

entries.example: The moon looks very bright and round tonight.
entries.exampleZh: 今晚的月亮看起来又亮又圆。

entries.example: Could you give me more time to finish this?
entries.exampleZh: 你能多给我一些时间完成这件事吗？

entries.example: The room is small; moreover, it has no window.
entries.exampleZh: 这个房间很小，而且没有窗户。

entries.example: I drink a cup of tea every morning before work.
entries.exampleZh: 我每天上班前都喝一杯茶。

entries.example: Every mortal person must face the end of life.
entries.exampleZh: 每一个终有一死的人都必须面对生命的终点。

entries.example: A mosquito bit my arm while I was sleeping outside.
entries.exampleZh: 我睡在户外时，一只蚊子咬了我的胳膊。

entries.example: She spends most of her free time reading books.
entries.exampleZh: 她把大部分空闲时间都用来读书。

entries.example: The students in my class are mostly from small towns.
entries.exampleZh: 我们班的学生大多来自小城镇。

entries.example: My mother cooks wonderful soup on cold winter days.
entries.exampleZh: 我母亲在寒冷的冬天会煮美味的汤。

entries.example: The gentle motion of the boat made me sleepy.
entries.exampleZh: 小船轻柔的晃动让我昏昏欲睡。

entries.example: The police could not find a motive for the crime.
entries.exampleZh: 警方找不到这起犯罪的动机。

entries.example: The small motor makes a strange noise at night.
entries.exampleZh: 那台小马达夜里发出奇怪的响声。

entries.example: We poured the hot metal into a stone mould.
entries.exampleZh: 我们把滚烫的金属倒进一个石头模子里。

entries.example: He tried to mount the horse but fell down.
entries.exampleZh: 他试着骑上那匹马，却摔了下来。

entries.example: We climbed a high mountain and saw the sea.
entries.exampleZh: 我们爬上一座高山，看见了大海。

entries.example: Many people mourn the loss of a good friend.
entries.exampleZh: 许多人为失去一位好朋友而哀悼。

entries.example: A small mouse ran across the kitchen floor last night.
entries.exampleZh: 昨晚一只小老鼠跑过厨房地板。

entries.example: Please close your mouth when you eat your lunch.
entries.exampleZh: 吃午饭时请闭上嘴。

entries.example: He took a big mouthful of rice and smiled.
entries.exampleZh: 他吃了一大口米饭，笑了。

entries.example: Please move your chair a little closer to the window.
entries.exampleZh: 请把你的椅子往窗户那边挪近一点。

entries.example: The dancer made a slow movement with her left arm.
entries.exampleZh: 那位舞者用左臂做了一个缓慢的动作。

entries.example: We watched a funny movie at home on Sunday evening.
entries.exampleZh: 周日晚上我们在家看了一部有趣的电影。

entries.example: I do not have much time to finish this work today.
entries.exampleZh: 我今天没有多少时间完成这项工作。

entries.example: The children got mud on their shoes after the rain.
entries.exampleZh: 雨后孩子们的鞋上沾了泥。

entries.example: My boots are muddy after walking through the wet field.
entries.exampleZh: 走过湿漉漉的田野后，我的靴子上全是泥。

entries.example: She poured hot coffee into a large white mug.
entries.exampleZh: 她把热咖啡倒进一个白色的大杯子里。

entries.example: The test has multiple questions about grammar and vocabulary.
entries.exampleZh: 这次测验有多道关于语法和词汇的题目。

entries.example: If you multiply five by three, you get fifteen.
entries.exampleZh: 如果你用五乘以三，就得到十五。

entries.example: The police are investigating a murder in the old town.
entries.exampleZh: 警方正在调查老城区的一起谋杀案。

entries.example: The murderer was caught by police two days later.
entries.exampleZh: 两天后，凶手被警方抓住了。

entries.example: He hurt a muscle in his leg during the race.
entries.exampleZh: 比赛中他拉伤了腿上的一块肌肉。

entries.example: We visited a history museum with our class last Friday.
entries.exampleZh: 上周五我们和全班一起参观了一座历史博物馆。

entries.example: She found a big mushroom under the tree in the garden.
entries.exampleZh: 她在花园的树下发现了一个大蘑菇。

entries.example: They played soft music during dinner in the garden.
entries.exampleZh: 晚饭时他们在花园里放着轻柔的音乐。

entries.example: My sister has great musical talent and plays the piano.
entries.exampleZh: 我姐姐很有音乐天赋，会弹钢琴。

entries.example: My sister is a talented musician in the city band.
entries.exampleZh: 我姐姐是市乐队里一位有才华的音乐家。

entries.example: You must finish your homework before dinner tonight.
entries.exampleZh: 你今晚必须在晚饭前完成作业。

entries.example: He stayed mute during the whole meeting yesterday.
entries.exampleZh: 昨天整个会议期间他一直沉默不语。

entries.example: She began to mutter something under her breath.
entries.exampleZh: 她开始低声嘀咕些什么。

entries.example: My grandmother cooks mutton with potatoes every Sunday.
entries.exampleZh: 我奶奶每个星期天都用土豆炖羊肉。

entries.example: I made this cake myself for your birthday.
entries.exampleZh: 这个蛋糕是我为你的生日亲手做的。

entries.example: A mysterious stranger left a letter at our door.
entries.exampleZh: 一个神秘的陌生人把一封信放在了我们门口。

entries.example: Please hammer that nail into the wooden board.
entries.exampleZh: 请把那根钉子敲进这块木板里。

entries.example: The baby ran naked across the warm sand.
entries.exampleZh: 婴儿光着身子跑过温暖的沙滩。

entries.example: Please write your name at the top of the page.
entries.exampleZh: 请把你的名字写在这页纸的顶端。

entries.example: I take a short nap after lunch every day.
entries.exampleZh: 我每天午饭后都会小睡一会儿。

entries.example: That was a nasty comment about her new dress.
entries.exampleZh: 那是对她新裙子的一句恶毒的评论。

entries.example: The whole nation watched the final game on television together.
entries.exampleZh: 全国上下一起在电视上观看了这场决赛。

entries.example: Our national team won the gold medal yesterday.
entries.exampleZh: 我们国家队昨天赢得了金牌。

entries.example: Please write your nationality clearly on the first line of this form.
entries.exampleZh: 请在这张表格的第一行清楚地写下你的国籍。

entries.example: She speaks English like a native speaker from London.
entries.exampleZh: 她说英语就像来自伦敦的本地人一样。

entries.example: The park is full of natural beauty in spring.
entries.exampleZh: 春天的这个公园里充满了自然之美。

entries.example: Her hair curls naturally in the warm summer air.
entries.exampleZh: 她的头发在温暖的夏日空气中自然卷曲。

entries.example: Walking in nature helps me relax after busy days.
entries.exampleZh: 在大自然中散步能帮我在忙碌的日子后放松。

entries.example: The naughty boy hid his sister's shoes again.
entries.exampleZh: 那个淘气的男孩又把他妹妹的鞋子藏了起来。

entries.example: The naval officer visited our school and talked about his work.
entries.exampleZh: 那位海军军官参观了我们的学校并谈了他的工作。

entries.example: Modern ships use advanced navigation systems to cross the ocean safely.
entries.exampleZh: 现代船只使用先进的导航系统安全地横渡海洋。

entries.example: My cousin joined the navy after he finished high school.
entries.exampleZh: 我表哥高中毕业后加入了海军。

entries.example: The train station is quite near, so we can walk there.
entries.exampleZh: 火车站很近，所以我们可以走路去那里。

entries.example: There is a nearby shop that sells fresh bread every morning.
entries.exampleZh: 附近有一家商店每天早上卖新鲜面包。

entries.example: I am nearly ready to leave for the school bus.
entries.exampleZh: 我差不多准备好去坐校车了。

entries.example: Her bedroom is always neat and very clean in the morning.
entries.exampleZh: 她的卧室早上总是整洁又干净。

entries.example: You do not necessarily need to finish it today.
entries.exampleZh: 你不一定需要今天完成它。

entries.example: It is necessary to bring your book to class.
entries.exampleZh: 上课必须带上你的书。

entries.example: Water is a basic necessity for all living things.
entries.exampleZh: 水是所有生物的基本必需品。

entries.example: He wore a warm scarf around his neck.
entries.exampleZh: 他脖子上围着一条暖和的围巾。

entries.example: She wore a silver necklace to the party.
entries.exampleZh: 她戴着一条银项链去参加聚会。

entries.example: Plants need water and sunlight to grow well.
entries.exampleZh: 植物需要水和阳光才能长得好。

entries.example: She used a thin needle to fix my coat.
entries.exampleZh: 她用一根细针补好了我的外套。

entries.example: Needless to say, we were very happy about it.
entries.exampleZh: 不用说，我们对此非常高兴。

entries.example: In old books, negro was a common word for black people.
entries.exampleZh: 在旧时的书里，那个词常用来指黑人。

entries.example: My neighbour helped me carry the heavy box upstairs.
entries.exampleZh: 我的邻居帮我搬了沉重的箱子上楼。

entries.example: Our neighbourhood is quiet and safe at night.
entries.exampleZh: 我们这一带晚上安静又安全。

entries.example: Neither of my two brothers likes coffee or tea.
entries.exampleZh: 我两个兄弟都不喜欢咖啡或茶。

entries.example: My nephew is coming to visit us next week.
entries.exampleZh: 我侄子下周要来看我们。

entries.example: She did not have the nerve to tell him the truth.
entries.exampleZh: 她没有胆量把真相告诉他。
