entries.example: He felt nervous before his first day at the new school.
entries.exampleZh: 在新学校的第一天之前，他感到很紧张。

entries.example: A small bird built a nest in the tree outside my window.
entries.exampleZh: 一只小鸟在我窗外的树上筑了一个巢。

entries.example: The ball went over the net and landed on the grass.
entries.exampleZh: 球越过了网，落在了草地上。

entries.example: Our school has a fast computer network for all students.
entries.exampleZh: 我们学校为所有学生配备了一个快速的计算机网络。

entries.example: I have never seen such a beautiful sunset before.
entries.exampleZh: 我以前从未见过这么美的日落。

entries.example: It was raining hard; nevertheless, we walked to the park.
entries.exampleZh: 雨下得很大；然而，我们还是步行去了公园。

entries.example: She bought a new coat for the cold winter months.
entries.exampleZh: 她买了一件新外套，用来度过寒冷的冬季。

entries.example: The newly built library opens to the public today.
entries.exampleZh: 新建的图书馆今天向公众开放。

entries.example: I heard the good news from my sister this morning.
entries.exampleZh: 今天早上我从姐姐那里听到了这个好消息。

entries.example: My father reads a newspaper every morning at breakfast.
entries.exampleZh: 我父亲每天早餐时都会看报纸。

entries.example: We will visit our grandparents next weekend if the weather is fine.
entries.exampleZh: 如果天气好，我们下个周末去看望祖父母。

entries.example: It was nice to meet your family yesterday evening.
entries.exampleZh: 昨晚见到你的家人真是太好了。

entries.example: My niece loves to draw pictures of animals and flowers.
entries.exampleZh: 我的侄女喜欢画动物和花朵。

entries.example: The stars look very bright in the sky at night.
entries.exampleZh: 夜里天空中的星星看起来非常明亮。

entries.example: There are nine students waiting outside the classroom door.
entries.exampleZh: 有九个学生在教室门外等着。

entries.example: My brother turned nineteen last week and got a new bike.
entries.exampleZh: 我弟弟上周满十九岁，还得到了一辆新自行车。

entries.example: My grandmother is ninety years old and still very active.
entries.exampleZh: 我的祖母九十岁了，仍然非常活跃。

entries.example: Her office is on the ninth floor of that building.
entries.exampleZh: 她的办公室在那栋楼的第九层。

entries.example: Plants need nitrogen from the soil to grow well.
entries.exampleZh: 植物需要土壤中的氮才能长得好。

entries.example: The noble family lived in a large house near the river.
entries.exampleZh: 那个贵族家庭住在河边的一所大房子里。

entries.example: Nobody in my class knew the answer to that question.
entries.exampleZh: 我们班没有人知道那个问题的答案。

entries.example: Please nod if you agree with my plan.
entries.exampleZh: 如果你同意我的计划，请点点头。

entries.example: The loud noise from the street woke me up early.
entries.exampleZh: 街上很大的噪音很早就把我吵醒了。

entries.example: Our classroom is very noisy before the teacher arrives.
entries.exampleZh: 老师到来之前，我们的教室非常嘈杂。

entries.example: None of my friends came to the party last night.
entries.exampleZh: 昨晚我的朋友一个也没来参加聚会。

entries.example: Stop talking nonsense and finish your homework right now.
entries.exampleZh: 别胡说八道了，现在就完成你的作业。

entries.example: We usually eat lunch at noon on school days.
entries.exampleZh: 上学的日子我们通常中午吃午饭。

entries.example: He did not call me, nor did he send a message.
entries.exampleZh: 他没有给我打电话，也没有发消息。

entries.example: It is normal to feel tired after a long trip.
entries.exampleZh: 长途旅行后感到疲倦是正常的。

entries.example: I normally walk to school with my sister.
entries.exampleZh: 我通常和妹妹一起走路去学校。

entries.example: Their farm is in the north of the country.
entries.exampleZh: 他们的农场在这个国家的北部。

entries.example: A cold wind comes from the northeast in winter.
entries.exampleZh: 冬天有一股冷风从东北方吹来。

entries.example: Many birds fly to northern countries in the spring.
entries.exampleZh: 春天许多鸟飞往北方的国家。

entries.example: The small town lies in the northwest of our city.
entries.exampleZh: 那个小镇位于我们城市的西北部。

entries.example: My little brother has a red nose in winter.
entries.exampleZh: 我弟弟冬天鼻子红红的。

entries.example: She is not ready to answer your question yet.
entries.exampleZh: 她还没有准备好回答你的问题。

entries.example: I wrote a short note to my teacher this morning.
entries.exampleZh: 今天早上我给老师写了一张简短的便条。

entries.example: Please bring your notebook and a pen to class.
entries.exampleZh: 请把你的笔记本和一支笔带到课堂上。

entries.example: There is nothing in the fridge for dinner tonight.
entries.exampleZh: 今晚冰箱里没有什么可以做晚饭的。

entries.example: I did not notice the small sign on the door.
entries.exampleZh: 我没有注意到门上的小牌子。

entries.example: There was a noticeable change in his voice today.
entries.exampleZh: 今天他的声音有了明显的变化。

entries.example: Please write a sentence where the noun comes first.
entries.exampleZh: 请写一个名词放在前面的句子。

entries.example: She is reading a new novel about life at sea.
entries.exampleZh: 她正在读一本关于海上生活的新小说。

entries.example: My birthday is in November, near the end of the year.
entries.exampleZh: 我的生日在十一月，接近年底。

entries.example: I am busy now, so please call back later.
entries.exampleZh: 我现在很忙，请稍后再打来。

entries.example: Nowadays many people read the news on their phones.
entries.exampleZh: 如今许多人在手机上看新闻。

entries.example: We looked everywhere, but the keys were nowhere in the room.
entries.exampleZh: 我们到处找，但钥匙在房间里哪儿都找不到。

entries.example: The country built a large nuclear power station last year.
entries.exampleZh: 这个国家去年建了一座大型核电站。

entries.example: The nucleus is the central part of a living cell.
entries.exampleZh: 细胞核是活细胞的核心部分。

entries.example: The loud music from next door is a real nuisance.
entries.exampleZh: 隔壁传来的吵闹音乐真是让人讨厌。

entries.example: Please write your phone number at the top of the page.
entries.exampleZh: 请把你的电话号码写在页面顶端。

entries.example: He has visited numerous cities in Europe over the years.
entries.exampleZh: 这些年来他游览过欧洲的许多城市。

entries.example: The nurse checked my temperature and gave me some water.
entries.exampleZh: 护士量了我的体温，还给了我一些水。

entries.example: Our little son goes to a nursery near our home.
entries.exampleZh: 我们的小儿子在我家附近的一家托儿所。

entries.example: He ate a small nut and then drank some juice.
entries.exampleZh: 他吃了一颗小坚果，然后喝了些果汁。

entries.example: This bag is made of strong nylon and lasts for years.
entries.exampleZh: 这个包是用结实的尼龙做的，能用很多年。

entries.example: An old oak stands in the middle of the field.
entries.exampleZh: 田野中央立着一棵老橡树。

entries.example: He pulled the oar hard and the boat moved forward.
entries.exampleZh: 他用力划桨，船向前移动了。

entries.example: Students must obey the rules of the school library.
entries.exampleZh: 学生必须遵守学校图书馆的规定。

entries.example: A strange object appeared in the sky last night.
entries.exampleZh: 昨晚天空中出现了奇怪的物体。

entries.example: A good judge must stay objective during every trial.
entries.exampleZh: 好的法官在每次审判中都必须保持客观。

entries.example: Heavy rain will oblige us to cancel the picnic.
entries.exampleZh: 大雨将迫使我们取消野餐。

entries.example: Her careful observation helped the team solve the problem.
entries.exampleZh: 她仔细的观察帮助团队解决了问题。

entries.example: An observer watched the match from the back row.
entries.exampleZh: 一位观察员从后排观看了比赛。

entries.example: The answer to this question seems quite obvious.
entries.exampleZh: 这道题的答案似乎相当明显。

entries.example: She obviously enjoyed the whole concert last night.
entries.exampleZh: 她显然很享受昨晚的整场音乐会。

entries.example: We take occasional trips to the mountains each year.
entries.exampleZh: 我们每年偶尔去山里旅行。

entries.example: I occasionally walk to work when the weather is nice.
entries.exampleZh: 天气好的时候我偶尔步行去上班。

entries.example: Two large tables occupy most of the small room.
entries.exampleZh: 两张大的桌子占了这个小房间的大部分空间。

entries.example: Accidents often occur on this busy road at night.
entries.exampleZh: 事故常常在这条繁忙的路上夜间发生。

entries.example: Power cuts are a rare occurrence in our town.
entries.exampleZh: 停电在我们镇上很少见。

entries.example: The ocean looks calm and blue this morning.
entries.exampleZh: 今天早上海洋看起来平静而蔚蓝。

entries.example: Australia is a large country located in oceania.
entries.exampleZh: 澳大利亚是大洋洲的一个大国。

entries.example: Our school holiday starts in october this year.
entries.exampleZh: 我们学校的假期今年十月开始。

entries.example: Seven is an odd number, but eight is not.
entries.exampleZh: 七是奇数，但八不是。

entries.example: A strange odour came from the old kitchen.
entries.exampleZh: 一股奇怪的气味从旧厨房里传来。

entries.example: Please turn off the lights before you leave the room.
entries.exampleZh: 离开房间前请把灯关掉。

entries.example: I did not mean to offend anyone at the party.
entries.exampleZh: 我无意在聚会上冒犯任何人。

entries.example: They offer free tea and coffee in the office.
entries.exampleZh: 他们在办公室里免费提供茶和咖啡。

entries.example: My mother works in a small office near the station.
entries.exampleZh: 我妈妈在车站附近的一间小办公室里工作。

entries.example: The police officer helped the lost child find her mother.
entries.exampleZh: 警察帮助走失的孩子找到了她的妈妈。

entries.example: We received an official letter from the city government today.
entries.exampleZh: 我们今天收到了市政府的一封官方信件。

entries.example: I often walk to school with my best friend.
entries.exampleZh: 我经常和最好的朋友一起走路去学校。

entries.example: Please add some oil to the pan before you cook.
entries.exampleZh: 做饭前请往锅里加一些油。

entries.example: Are you okay to carry that heavy box alone?
entries.exampleZh: 你一个人搬那个重箱子没问题吗？

entries.example: My grandfather is eighty years old and very healthy.
entries.exampleZh: 我爷爷八十岁了，身体非常健康。

entries.example: Please do not omit any names from the class list.
entries.exampleZh: 请不要从班级名单上遗漏任何名字。

entries.example: I visit my grandparents once a month by train.
entries.exampleZh: 我每个月坐火车去看一次祖父母。

entries.example: Only one student knew the answer to that question.
entries.exampleZh: 只有一个学生知道那个问题的答案。

entries.example: It is important to take care of oneself every day.
entries.exampleZh: 每天照顾好自己很重要。

entries.example: My father cuts an onion and cries every time.
entries.exampleZh: 我爸爸每次切洋葱都会哭。

entries.example: I have only ten minutes before the bus leaves.
entries.exampleZh: 离公交车出发我只剩十分钟了。

entries.example: The cat jumped onto the table and knocked over a cup.
entries.exampleZh: 猫跳上桌子，撞倒了一个杯子。

entries.example: Could you open the window for a little fresh air?
entries.exampleZh: 你能打开窗户透点新鲜空气吗？

entries.example: The opening of the new library is next Friday.
entries.exampleZh: 新图书馆的开幕仪式在下周五。

entries.example: We watched a famous opera at the theatre last night.
entries.exampleZh: 我们昨晚在剧院看了一部著名的歌剧。

entries.example: Only a doctor can operate this machine safely.
entries.exampleZh: 只有医生才能安全地操作这台机器。

entries.example: The new machine is now operational after a long repair.
entries.exampleZh: 经过长时间的修理，这台新机器现在可以使用了。

entries.example: The phone operator answered my call after two minutes.
entries.exampleZh: 电话接线员在两分钟后接了我的电话。

entries.example: In my opinion, this book is better than the film.
entries.exampleZh: 在我看来，这本书比那部电影更好。

entries.example: This job is a great opportunity for you to learn new skills.
entries.exampleZh: 这份工作是你学习新技能的好机会。

entries.example: Many people oppose the plan to build a new road here.
entries.exampleZh: 很多人反对在这里修一条新路的计划。

entries.example: The new laws oppress poor families in many small villages.
entries.exampleZh: 这些新法律压迫着许多小村庄里的贫困家庭。

entries.example: He bought a new optical mouse for his computer yesterday.
entries.exampleZh: 他昨天为他的电脑买了一个新的光学鼠标。

entries.example: The swimming class is optional for students in grade nine.
entries.exampleZh: 游泳课对九年级的学生来说是可选的。

entries.example: The teacher gave us an oral test on Friday morning.
entries.exampleZh: 老师星期五早上给我们做了一次口头测验。

entries.example: She put a sweet orange in her lunch bag today.
entries.exampleZh: 她今天往午餐袋里放了一个甜橙。

entries.example: The small moon moves in a strange orbit around the planet.
entries.exampleZh: 这颗小卫星以奇怪的轨道绕着行星运行。

entries.example: The school orchestra will play three songs at the concert.
entries.exampleZh: 学校管弦乐队将在音乐会上演奏三首歌曲。

entries.example: Please put these books in order on the shelf.
entries.exampleZh: 请把这些书按顺序放在书架上。

entries.example: Her desk is always clean and orderly before class starts.
entries.exampleZh: 上课前她的书桌总是干净又整洁。

entries.example: It was just an ordinary day at school for everyone.
entries.exampleZh: 对每个人来说，这只是学校里平常的一天。

entries.example: They found iron ore deep under the hill last year.
entries.exampleZh: 去年他们在山下深处发现了铁矿石。

entries.example: This farm grows organic vegetables without any chemicals.
entries.exampleZh: 这个农场种植不含任何化学品的有机蔬菜。

entries.example: A tiny organism lives in the water of this lake.
entries.exampleZh: 一种微小的生物生活在这个湖的水里。

entries.example: She works for a large organization that helps homeless people.
entries.exampleZh: 她为一个帮助无家可归者的大型机构工作。

entries.example: We need to organize a party for our teacher next week.
entries.exampleZh: 我们需要在下周为老师组织一次聚会。

entries.example: The museum shows oriental art from China and Japan.
entries.exampleZh: 这家博物馆展出中国和日本的东方艺术。

entries.example: A small glass ornament hangs on the Christmas tree.
entries.exampleZh: 圣诞树上挂着一个小玻璃装饰品。

entries.example: The kind woman took the orphan into her home last year.
entries.exampleZh: 那位善良的女士去年把这个孤儿带回了家。

entries.example: Some students like math, but the other students prefer art.
entries.exampleZh: 有些学生喜欢数学，但其余的学生更喜欢美术。

entries.example: Leave now, otherwise you will miss the last bus home.
entries.exampleZh: 现在就走吧，要不然你会错过回家的末班车。

entries.example: You ought to see a doctor about that cough today.
entries.exampleZh: 你今天应该去看看医生，治一下那个咳嗽。

entries.example: She added one ounce of sugar to the cake mix.
entries.exampleZh: 她往蛋糕糊里加了一盎司糖。

entries.example: Our teacher gave us a lot of homework today.
entries.exampleZh: 我们的老师今天给我们布置了很多作业。

entries.example: That blue car near the gate is ours.
entries.exampleZh: 大门附近那辆蓝色的车是我们的。

entries.example: We built the small wooden shelf ourselves last weekend.
entries.exampleZh: 上周末我们自己动手做了那个小木架。

entries.example: The children ran out of the classroom when the bell rang.
entries.exampleZh: 铃响的时候，孩子们跑出了教室。

entries.example: They bought a new outdoor table for the garden.
entries.exampleZh: 他们为花园买了一张新的户外桌。

entries.example: The kids love to play outdoors after school every day.
entries.exampleZh: 孩子们每天放学后都喜欢在户外玩耍。

entries.example: The outer wall of the old house needs fresh paint.
entries.exampleZh: 这座老房子的外墙需要重新刷漆。

entries.example: The shop is a popular outlet for cheap sports shoes.
entries.exampleZh: 这家店是卖便宜运动鞋的热门销路。

entries.example: Her outlook on life changed after the long trip abroad.
entries.exampleZh: 在国外长途旅行之后，她对生活的看法改变了。

entries.example: The factory increased its output by ten percent this year.
entries.exampleZh: 这家工厂今年的产量提高了百分之十。

entries.example: He warned us about the risks at the outset.
entries.exampleZh: 他一开始就提醒过我们这些风险。

entries.example: The outside of the old building looks very clean now.
entries.exampleZh: 这栋老楼的外部现在看起来很干净。

entries.example: They live on the outskirt of a quiet little town.
entries.exampleZh: 他们住在一个安静小镇的郊区。

entries.example: She did an outstanding job on the science project.
entries.exampleZh: 她在这个科学项目上做得非常出色。

entries.example: The outward journey took about three hours by train.
entries.exampleZh: 去程坐火车大约花了三个小时。

entries.example: The doors of the old bus open outwards.
entries.exampleZh: 旧公共汽车的车门向外开。

entries.example: She put the cake into the hot oven for twenty minutes.
entries.exampleZh: 她把蛋糕放进热烤箱里烤了二十分钟。

entries.example: A bright lamp hangs over the old kitchen table.
entries.exampleZh: 一盏明亮的灯悬挂在旧厨房的桌子上方。

entries.example: The overall cost of the trip was lower than we expected.
entries.exampleZh: 这次旅行的总费用比我们预想的要低。

entries.example: He wore a long grey overcoat on that cold day.
entries.exampleZh: 在那个寒冷的日子里，他穿着一件灰色的长大衣。

entries.example: The overhead lights in the hall were too bright.
entries.exampleZh: 大厅里的顶灯太亮了。

entries.example: Our hotel room can overlook the quiet blue sea.
entries.exampleZh: 我们酒店的房间可以眺望宁静的蓝色大海。

entries.example: We stayed overnight at a small hotel near the station.
entries.exampleZh: 我们在车站附近的一家小旅馆住了一夜。

entries.example: My cousin works overseas and comes home each summer.
entries.exampleZh: 我表哥在海外工作，每年夏天回家。

entries.example: The workers got extra pay for their overtime hours.
entries.exampleZh: 工人们因为加班时间得到了额外的报酬。

entries.example: I still owe my sister ten dollars from last week.
entries.exampleZh: 我上星期还欠我姐姐十美元。

entries.example: A large owl sat quietly on the barn roof.
entries.exampleZh: 一只大猫头鹰静静地停在谷仓屋顶上。

entries.example: They own a small farm near the river.
entries.exampleZh: 他们在河边拥有一座小农场。

entries.example: The owner of the shop greeted us with a smile.
entries.exampleZh: 店主微笑着迎接我们。

entries.example: She has full ownership of the small family business.
entries.exampleZh: 她完全拥有这家小型家族企业。

entries.example: He walked at a slow pace along the beach.
entries.exampleZh: 他沿着海滩慢慢地走着。

entries.example: We enjoyed a pacific evening by the lake.
entries.exampleZh: 我们在湖边度过了一个平静的夜晚。

entries.example: Please pack your books in this big brown box.
entries.exampleZh: 请把你的书装进这个大棕色的盒子里。

entries.example: A large package arrived for you this morning.
entries.exampleZh: 今天早上有一个大包裹送到给你。

entries.example: He opened a small packet of biscuits in the kitchen.
entries.exampleZh: 他在厨房里打开了一小包饼干。

entries.example: She wrote her name on a small pad of paper.
entries.exampleZh: 她把名字写在一小本便签纸上。

entries.example: Please turn to the next page of your book.
entries.exampleZh: 请翻到这本书的下一页。

entries.example: He felt a sharp pain in his left knee.
entries.exampleZh: 他感到左膝盖一阵剧痛。

entries.example: They will paint the kitchen walls a bright yellow.
entries.exampleZh: 他们要把厨房的墙刷成亮黄色。

entries.example: The painter worked on the old wall all morning.
entries.exampleZh: 那位油漆工整个上午都在那面旧墙上干活。

entries.example: That beautiful painting on the wall is very old.
entries.exampleZh: 墙上那幅漂亮的油画非常古老。

entries.example: I bought a new pair of shoes yesterday.
entries.exampleZh: 我昨天买了一双新鞋。

entries.example: The old king lived in a huge palace.
entries.exampleZh: 那位年迈的国王住在一座巨大的宫殿里。

entries.example: Her face turned pale after hearing the bad news.
entries.exampleZh: 听到那个坏消息后，她的脸变得苍白。

entries.example: He held the small stone in his palm.
entries.exampleZh: 他把那块小石头握在手心里。

entries.example: Put the eggs into the hot pan slowly.
entries.exampleZh: 把鸡蛋慢慢放进热锅里。

entries.example: A panel of three teachers chose the best story.
entries.exampleZh: 一个由三位老师组成的评审小组选出了最好的故事。

entries.example: She wrote the answer on a clean sheet of paper.
entries.exampleZh: 她把答案写在一张干净的纸上。

entries.example: We watched the big parade go down the street.
entries.exampleZh: 我们看着盛大的游行队伍沿街走过。

entries.example: Please read the first paragraph of this story aloud.
entries.exampleZh: 请大声朗读这个故事的的第一段。

entries.example: The two roads run parallel to the river.
entries.exampleZh: 这两条路与那条河平行。

entries.example: A large parcel arrived for my brother this morning.
entries.exampleZh: 今天上午有一个大包裹寄给我弟弟。

entries.example: I beg your pardon, could you repeat that?
entries.exampleZh: 对不起，您能再说一遍吗？

entries.example: Every parent wants their child to be happy.
entries.exampleZh: 每位家长都希望自己的孩子快乐。

entries.example: We took the children to the park after lunch.
entries.exampleZh: 午饭后我们带孩子们去了公园。

entries.example: The parliament passed a new law about clean water last week.
entries.exampleZh: 议会上周通过了一项关于清洁用水的新法律。

entries.example: This is only a small part of the whole story.
entries.exampleZh: 这只是整个故事的一小部分。

entries.example: The teacher gave us a partial answer to the question.
entries.exampleZh: 关于这个问题，老师只给了我们一部分答案。

entries.example: I particularly enjoy reading books about animals and nature.
entries.exampleZh: 我特别喜欢读关于动物和自然的书。

entries.example: The sky was partly cloudy when we left home.
entries.exampleZh: 我们离开家时，天空部分多云。

entries.example: My partner and I cook dinner together every evening.
entries.exampleZh: 我和我的伴侣每天晚上一起做晚饭。

entries.example: We had a birthday party for my sister last night.
entries.exampleZh: 昨晚我们为我妹妹办了一个生日聚会。

entries.example: Could you please pass the salt to your father now?
entries.exampleZh: 你能现在把盐递给你父亲吗？

entries.example: A narrow passage leads from the kitchen to the garden.
entries.exampleZh: 一条狭窄的通道从厨房通向花园。

entries.example: Every passenger must show a ticket before boarding the train.
entries.exampleZh: 每位乘客在登上火车前都必须出示车票。

entries.example: Do not forget your passport when you travel abroad.
entries.exampleZh: 出国旅行时不要忘记你的护照。

entries.example: In the past, people wrote letters by hand.
entries.exampleZh: 过去，人们用手写信。

entries.example: She mixed flour and water into a thick paste.
entries.exampleZh: 她把面粉和水混合成浓稠的糊。

entries.example: He gave the dog a gentle pat on the head.
entries.exampleZh: 他轻轻地拍了拍狗的头。

entries.example: My mother sewed a patch onto my old jeans.
entries.exampleZh: 我母亲在我的旧牛仔裤上缝了一块补丁。

entries.example: We walked along a narrow path through the forest.
entries.exampleZh: 我们沿着一条穿过森林的小路走。

entries.example: Learning a new language takes time and patience.
entries.exampleZh: 学一门新语言需要时间和耐心。

entries.example: The doctor spoke to the patient in a calm voice.
entries.exampleZh: 医生用平静的声音和病人说话。

entries.example: After a short pause, she continued her story.
entries.exampleZh: 短暂的停顿之后，她继续讲她的故事。

entries.example: The cat hurt its paw and could not walk.
entries.exampleZh: 那只猫伤了爪子，走不了路。

entries.example: I will pay for the tickets with my card.
entries.exampleZh: 我会用我的卡支付这些票的钱。

entries.example: Your monthly payment is due at the end of this week.
entries.exampleZh: 你这个月的付款在本周周末到期。

entries.example: She put one small pea on her plate and smiled.
entries.exampleZh: 她把一颗小豌豆放在盘子里，笑了笑。

entries.example: The two countries finally signed a peace agreement last year.
entries.exampleZh: 这两个国家去年终于签署了一项和平协议。

entries.example: This peach is sweet and full of juice.
entries.exampleZh: 这个桃子又甜又多汁。

entries.example: We reached the peak of the mountain before sunset.
entries.exampleZh: 我们在日落前到达了山顶。

entries.example: He ate a juicy pear after lunch today.
entries.exampleZh: 他今天午饭吃了一颗多汁的梨。

entries.example: The old peasant worked in the fields from morning to night.
entries.exampleZh: 那位老农民从早到晚在地里干活。

entries.example: There was a peculiar smell coming from the old kitchen.
entries.exampleZh: 老厨房里传来一股奇怪的气味。

entries.example: Please write your name with a black pen.
entries.exampleZh: 请用一支黑色钢笔写下你的名字。

entries.example: I drew a small house with my new pencil.
entries.exampleZh: 我用我的新铅笔画了一座小房子。

entries.example: The sunlight can penetrate the thin curtains in the morning.
entries.exampleZh: 早晨的阳光能穿透薄薄的窗帘。

entries.example: I found a shiny penny on the street yesterday.
entries.exampleZh: 我昨天在街上发现了一枚亮闪闪的便士。

entries.example: Many people came to the park to enjoy the sunshine.
entries.exampleZh: 许多人来到公园享受阳光。

entries.example: The apples cost two dollars per kilo at this shop.
entries.exampleZh: 这家店的苹果每公斤两美元。

entries.example: About twenty percent of the students walk to school.
entries.exampleZh: 大约百分之二十的学生步行上学。

entries.example: A large percentage of the class passed the exam.
entries.exampleZh: 班里很大比例的学生通过了考试。

entries.example: The weather was perfect for a picnic in the park.
entries.exampleZh: 天气非常适合在公园野餐。

entries.example: The children will perform a short play on Friday evening.
entries.exampleZh: 孩子们星期五晚上将表演一出短剧。

entries.example: Perhaps we can meet for coffee tomorrow afternoon.
entries.exampleZh: 也许我们明天下午可以见面喝咖啡。

entries.example: We had a short rest period after the long test.
entries.exampleZh: 漫长的考试之后，我们短暂休息了一段时间。

entries.example: You need permission from your parents to join this trip.
entries.exampleZh: 你需要得到父母的允许才能参加这次旅行。

entries.example: A parking permit is required if you leave your car here.
entries.exampleZh: 如果你把车停在这里，就需要一张停车许可证。

entries.example: If the pain continues to persist, please visit a doctor soon.
entries.exampleZh: 如果疼痛持续不退，请尽快去看医生。

entries.example: The first person to answer the question wins a small gift.
entries.exampleZh: 第一个回答问题的人会得到一份小礼物。

entries.example: She keeps her personal letters in a wooden box.
entries.exampleZh: 她把私人信件放在一个木盒子里。

entries.example: The company personnel must wear a badge at all times.
entries.exampleZh: 公司全体职员必须始终佩戴工牌。

entries.example: He feels pessimistic about the result of the exam.
entries.exampleZh: 他对考试结果感到悲观。

entries.example: My little sister has a pet rabbit in her room.
entries.exampleZh: 我妹妹在她的房间里养了一只宠物兔。

entries.example: The car stopped because we had no petrol left.
entries.exampleZh: 汽车停了下来，因为我们没汽油了。

entries.example: This factory turns petroleum into many kinds of plastic.
entries.exampleZh: 这家工厂把石油变成许多种塑料。

entries.example: The first phase of the project will start next week.
entries.exampleZh: 这个项目的第一阶段将于下周开始。

entries.example: She studies philosophy at a famous university in the north.
entries.exampleZh: 她在北方一所著名大学学习哲学。

entries.example: Please put your phone on the table before dinner.
entries.exampleZh: 请在晚饭前把手机放在桌上。

entries.example: I took a photo of the old bridge yesterday.
entries.exampleZh: 我昨天给那座老桥拍了一张照片。

entries.example: This photograph shows my grandparents in front of their house.
entries.exampleZh: 这张照片上是我的祖父母站在他们房子前。

entries.example: This English phrase is hard for me to remember.
entries.exampleZh: 这个英语短语我很难记住。

entries.example: The physician asked me to rest and drink enough water.
entries.exampleZh: 医生让我休息并多喝水。

entries.example: Her brother is a famous physicist in our city.
entries.exampleZh: 她的哥哥是我们城里一位著名的物理学家。

entries.example: My sister plays the piano every evening after school.
entries.exampleZh: 我姐姐每天放学后弹钢琴。

entries.example: The old man used a pick to break the hard rock.
entries.exampleZh: 老人用一把镐敲开了坚硬的岩石。

entries.example: We had a picnic near the lake last Sunday.
entries.exampleZh: 上周日我们在湖边野餐了。

entries.example: She hung a picture of her family on the wall.
entries.exampleZh: 她把一张全家福挂在了墙上。

entries.example: My mother made an apple pie for the party.
entries.exampleZh: 妈妈为聚会做了一个苹果馅饼。

entries.example: He gave me a piece of chocolate after lunch.
entries.exampleZh: 午饭后他给了我一块巧克力。

entries.example: The sharp needle can pierce the thick cloth easily.
entries.exampleZh: 这根尖针能轻易刺穿厚布。

entries.example: The little pig ran across the muddy field.
entries.exampleZh: 那头小猪跑过了泥泞的田野。

entries.example: A grey pigeon landed on our garden wall.
entries.exampleZh: 一只灰鸽子落在了我们花园的墙上。

entries.example: There is a pile of books beside my bed.
entries.exampleZh: 我床边有一堆书。

entries.example: The doctor told him to take one pill daily.
entries.exampleZh: 医生叫他每天吃一片药丸。

entries.example: A tall stone pillar stands in front of the church.
entries.exampleZh: 教堂前立着一根高大的石柱。

entries.example: She put a soft pillow under her head.
entries.exampleZh: 她把一个柔软的枕头放在头下。

entries.example: The pilot landed the plane safely in the rain.
entries.exampleZh: 飞行员在雨中安全地降落了飞机。

entries.example: She used a small pin to fix the paper.
entries.exampleZh: 她用一枚小针把纸固定住。

entries.example: Do not pinch the baby's cheek so hard.
entries.exampleZh: 别那么用力捏婴儿的脸颊。

entries.example: A tall pine grows beside the small house.
entries.exampleZh: 一棵高大的松树长在小房子旁边。

entries.example: She wore a pink dress to the birthday party.
entries.exampleZh: 她穿了一条粉红色的连衣裙去参加生日聚会。

entries.example: He bought a pint of milk at the shop.
entries.exampleZh: 他在商店买了一品脱牛奶。

entries.example: Water flows through the long pipe under the street.
entries.exampleZh: 水流过街道下面的长管子。

entries.example: The workers dug a deep pit in the ground.
entries.exampleZh: 工人们在地上挖了一个深坑。

entries.example: The workers used hot pitch to fill the hole in the road.
entries.exampleZh: 工人们用滚烫的沥青填补路上的洞。

entries.example: It is a pity that you cannot come to my party.
entries.exampleZh: 你不能来参加我的聚会，真是遗憾。

entries.example: This is a quiet place for reading and thinking.
entries.exampleZh: 这是一个安静的地方，适合阅读和思考。

entries.example: The plain was covered with tall grass and wild flowers.
entries.exampleZh: 平原上长满了高高的草和野花。

entries.example: We need a better plan before we start the work.
entries.exampleZh: 在开始工作之前，我们需要一个更好的计划。

entries.example: The plane landed safely at the small airport.
entries.exampleZh: 飞机安全地降落在那个小机场。

entries.example: My uncle works on a tea plantation in the hills.
entries.exampleZh: 我叔叔在山里的一个茶园种植园工作。

entries.example: He washed each plate carefully after dinner last night.
entries.exampleZh: 昨晚晚饭后，他把每个盘子都仔细洗了。

entries.example: We waited on the platform for the early train.
entries.exampleZh: 我们在站台上等早班火车。

entries.example: The children play football in the park every Sunday.
entries.exampleZh: 孩子们每个星期天都在公园里踢足球。

entries.example: Our best player scored two goals in the match.
entries.exampleZh: 我们最好的球员在比赛中进了两个球。

entries.example: Young children love the new playground near our house.
entries.exampleZh: 小孩子喜欢我们家附近的新操场。

entries.example: We had a pleasant walk along the river today.
entries.exampleZh: 今天我们在河边散步，走得很愉快。

entries.example: Her kind words always please the old man next door.
entries.exampleZh: 她亲切的话语总能让隔壁的老人高兴。

entries.example: It is a great pleasure to meet you today.
entries.exampleZh: 今天见到你非常荣幸。

entries.example: Fresh fruit is plentiful in the market this month.
entries.exampleZh: 这个月市场上的新鲜水果很充足。

entries.example: We have plenty of time before the train leaves.
entries.exampleZh: 火车开走之前我们还有充足的时间。

entries.example: They grow vegetables on a small plot behind the house.
entries.exampleZh: 他们在房子后面的小块土地上种蔬菜。

entries.example: The farmer used a plough to turn the hard soil.
entries.exampleZh: 农民用犁翻开了坚硬的土壤。

entries.example: He pulled the plug out of the wall socket.
entries.exampleZh: 他把插头从墙上的插座里拔了出来。

entries.example: The bad news may plunge the whole team into deep sadness.
entries.exampleZh: 这个坏消息可能会使整个团队陷入深深的悲伤之中。

entries.example: Please write the plural form of each noun on your paper.
entries.exampleZh: 请把每个名词的复数形式写在你的纸上。

entries.example: Three plus four is seven, as every child here knows.
entries.exampleZh: 三加四等于七，这在这里每个孩子都知道。

entries.example: He put the small key into his coat pocket and left.
entries.exampleZh: 他把那把小小的钥匙放进大衣口袋，然后离开了。

entries.example: She wrote a short poem about the river near her home.
entries.exampleZh: 她写了一首关于她家附近那条河的短诗。

entries.example: The old poet read his work to a small crowd.
entries.exampleZh: 那位老诗人向一小群人朗读了他的作品。

entries.example: We study poetry and music in our afternoon class this term.
entries.exampleZh: 这学期我们在下午的课上学习诗歌和音乐。

entries.example: Your main point is clear, but I need one more example.
entries.exampleZh: 你的主要观点很清楚，但我还需要一个例子。

entries.example: A tall wooden pole stands beside the gate of our school.
entries.exampleZh: 我们学校大门旁边立着一根高高的木杆。

entries.example: The police came quickly after someone called them for help.
entries.exampleZh: 有人打电话求助后，警察很快就来了。

entries.example: A kind policeman showed us the way to the train station.
entries.exampleZh: 一位和善的警察给我们指了去火车站的路。

entries.example: The new school policy says students must wear a uniform.
entries.exampleZh: 新的学校政策规定学生必须穿校服。

entries.example: Please polish your shoes before the family dinner tonight.
entries.exampleZh: 今晚家庭聚餐前请把你的鞋子擦亮。

entries.example: It is polite to say thank you when someone helps you.
entries.exampleZh: 别人帮助你时说声谢谢是有礼貌的。

entries.example: The meeting turned into a long political argument between two groups.
entries.exampleZh: 会议变成了两个群体之间一场漫长的政治争论。

entries.example: The young politician spoke about jobs and schools in our town.
entries.exampleZh: 那位年轻的政治家谈到了我们镇上的工作和学校。

entries.example: My brother studies politics at a university in the north.
entries.exampleZh: 我哥哥在北方的一所大学学习政治学。

entries.example: Factories near the river pollute the water and kill many fish.
entries.exampleZh: 河边的工厂污染了河水，还害死了许多鱼。

entries.example: Air pollution in the city makes it hard to breathe sometimes.
entries.exampleZh: 城市里的空气污染有时让人难以呼吸。

entries.example: Ducks swim in the small pond behind the old farm house.
entries.exampleZh: 鸭子在旧农舍后面的小池塘里游来游去。

entries.example: The children are swimming in the pool behind our house.
entries.exampleZh: 孩子们正在我们家后面的游泳池里游泳。

entries.example: The poor family lives in a small house near the river.
entries.exampleZh: 这个贫穷的家庭住在河边的一所小房子里。

entries.example: This song is very popular among young people in our city.
entries.exampleZh: 这首歌在我们城市的年轻人中非常流行。

entries.example: The population of this small town is growing very fast.
entries.exampleZh: 这个小镇的人口增长得非常快。

entries.example: My mother cooked pork with vegetables for dinner last night.
entries.exampleZh: 昨晚我妈妈做了猪肉炒蔬菜当晚餐。

entries.example: The ship arrived at the port early this morning.
entries.exampleZh: 那艘船今天一早到达了港口。

entries.example: This portable radio is small enough to carry anywhere.
entries.exampleZh: 这台便携式收音机很小，可以带到任何地方。

entries.example: Please give me a small portion of that rice.
entries.exampleZh: 请给我一小份那种米饭。

entries.example: She painted a beautiful portrait of her grandmother.
entries.exampleZh: 她画了一幅她祖母的美丽画像。

entries.example: I am positive that I locked the door this morning.
entries.exampleZh: 我确定今天早上我锁了门。

entries.example: They possess a large garden behind their old house.
entries.exampleZh: 他们的老房子后面有一个大花园。

entries.example: This old watch is my most valuable possession.
entries.exampleZh: 这块旧手表是我最珍贵的财产。

entries.example: There is a possibility of rain later this afternoon.
entries.exampleZh: 今天下午晚些时候可能会下雨。

entries.example: It is possible to finish this work before noon.
entries.exampleZh: 中午之前完成这项工作是有可能的。

entries.example: She will possibly arrive a little late tonight.
entries.exampleZh: 她今晚可能会稍微晚一点到。

entries.example: Please post this letter on your way to work.
entries.exampleZh: 请在你上班的路上把这封信寄出去。

entries.example: The postage for this heavy parcel is quite high.
entries.exampleZh: 这个重包裹的邮费相当高。

entries.example: The postman brings our letters every morning at eight.
entries.exampleZh: 邮递员每天早上八点送来我们的信。

entries.example: We had to postpone the meeting until next Friday.
entries.exampleZh: 我们不得不把会议推迟到下周五。

entries.example: She boiled some water in a large pot.
entries.exampleZh: 她在一个大锅里烧了一些水。

entries.example: She put a large potato into the hot soup.
entries.exampleZh: 她把一个大土豆放进了热汤里。

entries.example: This bag of rice weighs about one pound.
entries.exampleZh: 这袋米大约重一磅。

entries.example: Please pour the milk into these clean glasses.
entries.exampleZh: 请把牛奶倒进这些干净的杯子里。

entries.example: Many families in this area still live in poverty.
entries.exampleZh: 这个地区的许多家庭仍然生活在贫困之中。

entries.example: Mix the white powder with warm water first.
entries.exampleZh: 先把这种白色粉末和温水混合。

entries.example: The storm cut the power to our whole village.
entries.exampleZh: 暴风雨切断了我们整个村子的电力。

entries.example: This small car has a very powerful engine.
entries.exampleZh: 这辆小汽车有一台非常强劲的发动机。

entries.example: Her advice about saving money is very practical.
entries.exampleZh: 她关于省钱的建议非常实用。

entries.example: The old bridge is practically empty on winter mornings.
entries.exampleZh: 冬天早晨那座旧桥几乎空无一人。

entries.example: Daily practice will improve your spoken English quickly.
entries.exampleZh: 每天练习会很快提高你的英语口语。

entries.example: You should practise the piano for an hour daily.
entries.exampleZh: 你应该每天练一小时钢琴。

entries.example: They pray together before dinner every single evening.
entries.exampleZh: 他们每天晚饭前都一起祈祷。

entries.example: Wearing a helmet is a simple safety precaution.
entries.exampleZh: 戴头盔是一项简单的安全预防措施。

entries.example: The preceding chapter explains how the machine works.
entries.exampleZh: 前一章解释了这台机器是如何工作的。

entries.example: Water is more precious than gold in the desert.
entries.exampleZh: 在沙漠里，水比黄金更珍贵。

entries.example: Can you give me the precise time of arrival?
entries.exampleZh: 你能告诉我到达的精确时间吗？

entries.example: The watch is made with great precision and skill.
entries.exampleZh: 这块手表是以极高的精密度和技艺制成的。

entries.example: The author thanks his family in the short preface.
entries.exampleZh: 作者在简短的序言中感谢了他的家人。

entries.example: I prefer tea to coffee in the early morning.
entries.exampleZh: 清早我更喜欢喝茶而不是咖啡。

entries.example: Walking to school is preferable to taking the crowded bus.
entries.exampleZh: 步行上学比坐拥挤的公共汽车更可取。

entries.example: We made a preliminary plan before the meeting started.
entries.exampleZh: 会议开始前我们做了一个初步的计划。

entries.example: Good preparation makes the exam much easier for every student.
entries.exampleZh: 充分的准备让每个学生的考试都轻松很多。

entries.example: Please find the correct preposition for this sentence.
entries.exampleZh: 请为这个句子找到正确的介词。

entries.example: Doctors sometimes prescribe medicine when you feel very sick.
entries.exampleZh: 当你病得很重时，医生有时会开药。

entries.example: Your presence at the party made everyone very happy.
entries.exampleZh: 你出席聚会让大家都很开心。

entries.example: The present situation is difficult for many small shops.
entries.exampleZh: 目前的情况对许多小商店来说很困难。

entries.example: The bus will arrive presently, so please wait here.
entries.exampleZh: 公共汽车一会儿就到，请在这里等。

entries.example: The president gave a short speech to the students.
entries.exampleZh: 总统向学生们做了简短的讲话。

entries.example: Please press this button to open the door.
entries.exampleZh: 请按这个按钮开门。

entries.example: My parents put too much pressure on my studies.
entries.exampleZh: 我父母对我的学习施加了太多压力。

entries.example: The children pretend to be pirates on the beach.
entries.exampleZh: 孩子们在海滩上假装是海盗。

entries.example: She wore a pretty dress to the birthday party.
entries.exampleZh: 她穿着一条漂亮的裙子去参加生日聚会。

entries.example: The price of this bike is too high for me.
entries.exampleZh: 这辆自行车的价格对我来说太高了。

entries.example: He takes great pride in his work at school.
entries.exampleZh: 他对自己在学校的工作感到非常自豪。

entries.example: Safety is our prime concern on every school trip.
entries.exampleZh: 安全是我们每次学校旅行的首要关注。

entries.example: The young prince rode a white horse through the town.
entries.exampleZh: 年轻的王子骑着白马穿过小镇。

entries.example: The little princess smiled and waved at the crowd.
entries.exampleZh: 小公主微笑着向人群挥手。

entries.example: Rice is the principal food in many Asian countries.
entries.exampleZh: 米饭是许多亚洲国家的主要食物。

entries.example: Please print your name clearly at the top.
entries.exampleZh: 请在上方清楚地用印刷体写上你的名字。

entries.example: You need prior experience before you join this class.
entries.exampleZh: 你需要先前的经验才能加入这个班。

entries.example: The thief was sent to prison for two years.
entries.exampleZh: 那个小偷被判入狱两年。

entries.example: The prisoner was allowed to see his family.
entries.exampleZh: 那名囚犯被允许见他的家人。

entries.example: It is a great privilege to work with these students.
entries.exampleZh: 和这些学生一起工作是一种莫大的荣幸。

entries.example: She won first prize in the school singing competition.
entries.exampleZh: 她在学校歌唱比赛中获得了一等奖。

entries.example: There is a high probability of rain this weekend.
entries.exampleZh: 这个周末下雨的可能性很大。

entries.example: It is probable that they will arrive before noon.
entries.exampleZh: 他们大概会在中午前到达。

entries.example: He will probably be late because of the traffic.
entries.exampleZh: 因为交通，他可能会迟到。

entries.example: We solved the math problem together after lunch.
entries.exampleZh: 午饭后我们一起解出了那道数学题。

entries.example: Please proceed to the front desk to check in.
entries.exampleZh: 请前往前台办理入住手续。

entries.example: A long procession moved slowly through the narrow streets.
entries.exampleZh: 一支长长的队伍缓慢地穿过狭窄的街道。

entries.example: These factories produce thousands of cars every year.
entries.exampleZh: 这些工厂每年生产数千辆汽车。

entries.example: This new product sells well in many countries.
entries.exampleZh: 这款新产品在许多国家都很畅销。

entries.example: The company increased production by ten percent last year.
entries.exampleZh: 公司去年把产量提高了百分之十。

entries.example: Teaching is a profession that requires great patience.
entries.exampleZh: 教学是一门需要极大耐心的职业。

entries.example: Our professor explained the lesson in a simple way.
entries.exampleZh: 我们的教授用简单的方式讲解了那节课。

entries.example: The small shop made a profit last month.
entries.exampleZh: 那家小店上个月获得了利润。

entries.example: I watched a funny program about animals last night.
entries.exampleZh: 昨晚我看了一个关于动物的有趣节目。

entries.example: Your English has made great progress this term.
entries.exampleZh: 这学期你的英语取得了很大进步。

entries.example: The school has a progressive way of teaching art.
entries.exampleZh: 这所学校在艺术教学上有一种很先进的方法。

entries.example: She kept her promise and came back the next day.
entries.exampleZh: 她信守诺言，第二天回来了。

entries.example: The teacher asked us to find the pronoun in each sentence.
entries.exampleZh: 老师让我们找出每个句子中的代词。

entries.example: Can you pronounce this difficult word for me?
entries.exampleZh: 你能为我读出这个难词吗？

entries.example: Her pronunciation of English words is very clear.
entries.exampleZh: 她英语单词的发音非常清楚。

entries.example: Do you have any proof that he took the money?
entries.exampleZh: 你有任何证据证明他拿了那些钱吗？

entries.example: Please wear proper clothes for the interview tomorrow morning.
entries.exampleZh: 明天上午面试请穿合适的衣服。

entries.example: This land is the property of a rich family.
entries.exampleZh: 这块土地是一个富裕家庭的财产。

entries.example: The cost is proportional to the size of the room.
entries.exampleZh: 费用与房间的大小成比例。

entries.example: I propose that we meet again next Friday afternoon.
entries.exampleZh: 我提议我们下周五下午再见面。

entries.example: This small town became very prosperous after the new road opened.
entries.exampleZh: 新路开通后，这个小镇变得非常繁荣。

entries.example: We must protect the little animals in this forest.
entries.exampleZh: 我们必须保护这片森林里的小动物。

entries.example: These trees need protection from the strong winter wind.
entries.exampleZh: 这些树需要保护，以免受冬天强风的伤害。

entries.example: She wears protective glasses when she works in the lab.
entries.exampleZh: 她在实验室工作时戴着防护眼镜。

entries.example: Eggs and fish are good sources of protein.
entries.exampleZh: 鸡蛋和鱼是蛋白质的良好来源。

entries.example: My parents are proud of my work this term.
entries.exampleZh: 我父母为我这学期的表现感到自豪。

entries.example: Can you prove that you were at home last night?
entries.exampleZh: 你能证明你昨晚在家吗？

entries.example: The school will provide free lunch for every student.
entries.exampleZh: 学校将为每个学生提供免费午餐。

entries.example: You can go out provided you finish your homework first.
entries.exampleZh: 只要你先完成作业，就可以出去。

entries.example: My uncle lives in a small province in the north.
entries.exampleZh: 我叔叔住在北方的一个小省份。

entries.example: They made provision for more guests than they expected.
entries.exampleZh: 他们为比预想更多的客人做了准备。

entries.example: The park is open to the public all year.
entries.exampleZh: 这个公园全年向公众开放。

entries.example: The publication of her first book made her very happy.
entries.exampleZh: 她第一本书的出版让她非常高兴。

entries.example: They plan to publish the results next month.
entries.exampleZh: 他们计划下个月公布结果。

entries.example: Please pull the door gently instead of pushing it hard.
entries.exampleZh: 请轻轻拉门，不要用力推。

entries.example: The nurse checked my pulse after the long run.
entries.exampleZh: 长跑之后护士检查了我的脉搏。

entries.example: The old pump in the garden stopped working yesterday.
entries.exampleZh: 花园里那台旧水泵昨天停止工作了。

entries.example: This punch makes a small hole in the paper.
entries.exampleZh: 这个打孔器能在纸上打一个小孔。

entries.example: The teacher will punish anyone who cheats in the exam.
entries.exampleZh: 老师会惩罚任何在考试中作弊的人。

entries.example: Every pupil in the class received a new book.
entries.exampleZh: 班里每个学生都收到了一本新书。

entries.example: She decided to purchase a new bike for her son.
entries.exampleZh: 她决定给儿子买一辆新自行车。

entries.example: The water in this mountain spring is pure and cold.
entries.exampleZh: 这条山泉里的水纯净而清凉。

entries.example: She wore a purple dress to the party last night.
entries.exampleZh: 昨晚她穿了一条紫色连衣裙去参加聚会。

entries.example: The purpose of this meeting is to plan the trip.
entries.exampleZh: 这次会议的目的是安排这次旅行。

entries.example: She found her lost purse under the sofa.
entries.exampleZh: 她在沙发下面找到了丢失的钱包。

entries.example: Please push the table closer to the window.
entries.exampleZh: 请把桌子推到更靠近窗户的地方。

entries.example: Please put the milk back in the fridge.
entries.exampleZh: 请把牛奶放回冰箱里。

entries.example: They had a small quarrel about the money.
entries.exampleZh: 他们为了钱小小地吵了一架。

entries.example: A quarter of the students walk to school every day.
entries.exampleZh: 四分之一的学生每天步行上学。

entries.example: The queen smiled at the crowd from the balcony.
entries.exampleZh: 女王从阳台上向人群微笑。

entries.example: May I ask you a quick question about the homework?
entries.exampleZh: 我可以就作业快速问你一个问题吗？

entries.example: A long queue formed outside the new shop.
entries.exampleZh: 新商店外面排起了长队。

entries.example: She gave a quick answer and then left the room.
entries.exampleZh: 她很快回答了一句，然后就离开了房间。

entries.example: The library was very quiet after the students went home.
entries.exampleZh: 学生们回家以后，图书馆里非常安静。

entries.example: The test was quite easy for most of the class.
entries.exampleZh: 这次考试对班上大多数人来说相当容易。

entries.example: Please quote the exact words from the article in your report.
entries.exampleZh: 请在你的报告里引用这篇文章的原话。

entries.example: A small rabbit ran across the field behind our house.
entries.exampleZh: 一只小兔子跑过我们家后面的田野。

entries.example: He won the race by less than one second.
entries.exampleZh: 他以不到一秒的优势赢得了这场比赛。

entries.example: The school has rules against racial jokes and unfair treatment.
entries.exampleZh: 这所学校有规定，禁止种族玩笑和不公平对待。

entries.example: Put your coat on the rack near the front door.
entries.exampleZh: 把你的外套放在前门旁边的架子上。

entries.example: The ship used radar to find the way through thick fog.
entries.exampleZh: 这艘船用雷达在浓雾中寻找航路。

entries.example: The doctor said the radiation level in the room was safe.
entries.exampleZh: 医生说房间里的辐射水平是安全的。

entries.example: My father listens to the radio every morning at breakfast.
entries.exampleZh: 我父亲每天早饭时都听收音机。

entries.example: Workers must wear special clothes near the radioactive waste.
entries.exampleZh: 工人在放射性废料附近必须穿特殊的衣服。

entries.example: The fence stands within a radius of five meters from the tree.
entries.exampleZh: 这道篱笆位于距那棵树五米半径的范围内。

entries.example: He cleaned the dirty table with an old rag.
entries.exampleZh: 他用一块旧抹布擦干净了脏桌子。

entries.example: She held the rail tightly as the bus turned the corner.
entries.exampleZh: 公共汽车拐弯时，她紧紧抓住扶手。

entries.example: The old railroad still carries goods across the valley.
entries.exampleZh: 这条老铁路仍然运送货物穿过山谷。

entries.example: A new railway will connect the two towns next year.
entries.exampleZh: 一条新铁路明年将连接这两座城镇。

entries.example: Heavy rain kept us inside the house all weekend.
entries.exampleZh: 大雨让我们整个周末都待在屋里。

entries.example: A bright rainbow appeared over the hills after the storm.
entries.exampleZh: 暴风雨过后，一道明亮的彩虹出现在山丘上方。

entries.example: It was a rainy day, so we stayed at home.
entries.exampleZh: 那天下雨，所以我们待在家里。

entries.example: The rapid water carried the small boat down the river.
entries.exampleZh: 湍急的水流把小船冲向下游。

entries.example: She rarely eats meat because she prefers fresh vegetables.
entries.exampleZh: 她很少吃肉，因为她更喜欢新鲜蔬菜。

entries.example: A big rat ran across the kitchen floor last night.
entries.exampleZh: 昨晚一只大老鼠跑过厨房地板。

entries.example: I would rather stay home tonight than go out.
entries.exampleZh: 今晚我宁愿待在家里也不愿出去。

entries.example: The ratio of boys to girls in our class is two to one.
entries.exampleZh: 我们班男生和女生的比例是二比一。

entries.example: Wash your hands after you touch raw meat.
entries.exampleZh: 摸过生肉后要洗手。

entries.example: A thin ray of light came through the small window.
entries.exampleZh: 一道细细的光线从小窗户照了进来。

entries.example: We hope to reach the top of the hill before noon.
entries.exampleZh: 我们希望中午前到达山顶。

entries.example: His reaction to the news surprised everyone in the room.
entries.exampleZh: 他对这个消息的反应让屋里所有人都很惊讶。

entries.example: I like to read a book before I go to sleep.
entries.exampleZh: 我喜欢睡前读一本书。

entries.example: The reader sent a kind letter to the young writer.
entries.exampleZh: 这位读者给那位年轻作家寄了一封善意的信。

entries.example: My sister enjoys reading stories to the children.
entries.exampleZh: 我妹妹喜欢给孩子们读故事。

entries.example: Are you ready to leave for the airport now?
entries.exampleZh: 你现在准备好去机场了吗？

entries.example: Is that a real diamond in your ring?
entries.exampleZh: 你戒指里那颗是真钻石吗？

entries.example: The reality of city life is harder than his dream.
entries.exampleZh: 城市生活的现实比他的梦想更艰难。

entries.example: I did not realize how late it was until now.
entries.exampleZh: 直到现在我才意识到已经这么晚了。

entries.example: I really enjoyed the concert last night with my friends.
entries.exampleZh: 昨晚我和朋友们真的非常享受那场音乐会。

entries.example: The king ruled his realm with fairness and great care.
entries.exampleZh: 国王以公正和极大的用心治理他的王国。

entries.example: The rear door of the bus would not close.
entries.exampleZh: 公交车的后门关不上了。

entries.example: Please tell me the reason you were late this morning.
entries.exampleZh: 请告诉我你今天早上迟到的原因。

entries.example: The price of this meal seems very reasonable to me.
entries.exampleZh: 这顿饭的价格对我来说非常合理。

entries.example: The young rebel refused to follow the old rules.
entries.exampleZh: 那个年轻的造反者拒绝遵守旧规则。

entries.example: I cannot recall where I put my keys yesterday.
entries.exampleZh: 我想不起来昨天把钥匙放在哪里了。

entries.example: Please keep the receipt in case you need to return it.
entries.exampleZh: 请保留收据，以防你需要退货。

entries.example: You will receive a letter from the school next week.
entries.exampleZh: 你下周会收到学校的一封信。

entries.example: The receiver of the package must sign this form.
entries.exampleZh: 包裹的收件人必须在这张表格上签名。

entries.example: This recent change in the weather surprised many people.
entries.exampleZh: 最近天气的这种变化让很多人感到惊讶。

entries.example: She has recently started working at a new bank.
entries.exampleZh: 她最近开始在一家新银行工作。

entries.example: His face looked familiar, but I felt no recognition at first.
entries.exampleZh: 他的脸看起来很熟悉，但我一开始没有认出他。

entries.example: I did not recognize you with your new haircut.
entries.exampleZh: 你换了新发型，我都没认出你。

entries.example: My teacher wrote a strong recommendation for my university application.
entries.exampleZh: 我的老师为我的大学申请写了一封很有力的推荐信。

entries.example: Please record the meeting so everyone can listen later.
entries.exampleZh: 请把会议录下来，这样大家以后可以听。

entries.example: She used a small recorder to save the interview.
entries.exampleZh: 她用一个小录音机保存了那次采访。

entries.example: The doctor says his recovery will take several more weeks.
entries.exampleZh: 医生说他还要再过几周才能康复。

entries.example: She wore a bright red coat to the party last night.
entries.exampleZh: 她昨晚穿了一件鲜红色的外套去参加聚会。

entries.example: The store announced a small reduction in all prices today.
entries.exampleZh: 商店今天宣布所有商品小幅降价。

entries.example: When you have questions, please refer to the first page.
entries.exampleZh: 有问题时，请参阅第一页。

entries.example: This book is useful as a reference for new students.
entries.exampleZh: 这本书可以作为新生的参考。

entries.example: I saw my reflection in the calm water of the lake.
entries.exampleZh: 我在平静的湖水中看到了自己的倒影。

entries.example: A clear reflexion appeared on the surface of the quiet pond.
entries.exampleZh: 平静的池塘表面出现了一个清晰的倒影。

entries.example: The new leader promised to reform the school system.
entries.exampleZh: 新领导人承诺改革学校制度。

entries.example: A cold drink will refresh you after the long walk.
entries.exampleZh: 长途步行后，一杯冷饮会让你精神恢复。

entries.example: Please put the milk back in the refrigerator.
entries.exampleZh: 请把牛奶放回冰箱里。

entries.example: I refuse to answer such a rude question.
entries.exampleZh: 我拒绝回答这么无礼的问题。

entries.example: Many people regard him as a kind teacher.
entries.exampleZh: 许多人把他看作一位和善的老师。

entries.example: She asked a question regarding the new class schedule.
entries.exampleZh: 她问了一个关于新课程安排的问题。

entries.example: He went out in the rain regardless of his cold.
entries.exampleZh: 他不顾感冒，还是冒雨出去了。

entries.example: This region is famous for its fresh fruit and warm people.
entries.exampleZh: 这个地区以新鲜水果和热情的人们而闻名。

entries.example: Please sign your name in the register before you enter the hall.
entries.exampleZh: 进大厅前请在登记簿上签名。

entries.example: I regret not calling my grandmother last weekend.
entries.exampleZh: 我后悔上周末没有给祖母打电话。

entries.example: Can you relate this story to your own life?
entries.exampleZh: 你能把这个故事和你自己的生活联系起来吗？

entries.example: The relation between diet and health is very important.
entries.exampleZh: 饮食与健康之间的关系非常重要。

entries.example: Their relationship became stronger after they started working together.
entries.exampleZh: 他们开始一起工作后，关系变得更强了。

entries.example: Einstein's theory of relativity changed how we understand space and time.
entries.exampleZh: 爱因斯坦的相对论改变了我们对空间和时间的理解。

entries.example: You should relax and enjoy the warm afternoon in the garden.
entries.exampleZh: 你应该放松一下，享受花园里温暖的下午。

entries.example: The reliability of this old car surprises everyone in our town.
entries.exampleZh: 这辆旧车的可靠性让我们镇上的每个人都很惊讶。

entries.example: It was a great relief to hear that she was safe.
entries.exampleZh: 听说她平安无事，我大大松了一口气。

entries.example: Many people study religion to learn about different cultures.
entries.exampleZh: 许多人学习宗教以了解不同的文化。

entries.example: She comes from a very religious family in the countryside.
entries.exampleZh: 她来自乡下一个非常虔诚的家庭。

entries.example: You can rely on me to help you with this task.
entries.exampleZh: 你可以依靠我帮你完成这项任务。

entries.example: Please remain quiet while the students are taking their test.
entries.exampleZh: 学生们考试时请保持安静。

entries.example: His remark about the weather made everyone laugh loudly.
entries.exampleZh: 他关于天气的评论让大家哈哈大笑。

entries.example: She has made remarkable progress in English this school year.
entries.exampleZh: 这个学年她的英语取得了显著进步。

entries.example: I still remember the first day we met at school.
entries.exampleZh: 我仍然记得我们在学校相遇的第一天。

entries.example: Please remind me to call my mother after dinner tonight.
entries.exampleZh: 请提醒我今晚晚饭后给妈妈打电话。

entries.example: Our small village is remote, but the people there are very friendly.
entries.exampleZh: 我们的小村庄很偏远，但那里的人非常友好。

entries.example: The removal of the old tree made the garden much brighter.
entries.exampleZh: 那棵老树被移走后，花园亮堂多了。

entries.example: We pay the rent on the first day of each month.
entries.exampleZh: 我们在每个月的第一天交房租。

entries.example: My bike broke down, so I need to repair it today.
entries.exampleZh: 我的自行车坏了，所以我今天需要修一下它。

entries.example: Please repeat the question, because I did not hear you.
entries.exampleZh: 请把问题再说一遍，因为我没听见你说的话。

entries.example: She asked repeatedly for a glass of water.
entries.exampleZh: 她一再要一杯水。

entries.example: Learning a foreign language needs patience and lots of repetition.
entries.exampleZh: 学习一门外语需要耐心和大量的重复。

entries.example: I sent him a message but he did not reply.
entries.exampleZh: 我给他发了消息，但他没有回复。

entries.example: You must report the accident to the police at once.
entries.exampleZh: 你必须立刻把这次事故报告给警察。

entries.example: A young reporter asked the singer several difficult questions.
entries.exampleZh: 一位年轻记者问了那位歌手几个很难的问题。

entries.example: France is a republic with a long and interesting history.
entries.exampleZh: 法国是一个历史悠久的共和国。

entries.example: Good English is a basic requirement for this job.
entries.exampleZh: 英语好是这份工作的一个基本要求。

entries.example: The city built a new reservior to store water for the summer.
entries.exampleZh: 这座城市新建了一座水库，为夏天储水。

entries.example: Their new residence is close to the river and the park.
entries.exampleZh: 他们的新住所靠近河流和公园。

entries.example: My resolution is to study English for twenty minutes every day.
entries.exampleZh: 我的决心是每天学二十分钟英语。

entries.example: We should not resort to violence when we argue with friends.
entries.exampleZh: 和朋友争吵时，我们不应该诉诸暴力。

entries.example: After the meeting, they returned to their respective offices.
entries.exampleZh: 会议结束后，他们回到了各自的办公室。

entries.example: Please respond to my email before Friday afternoon.
entries.exampleZh: 请在周五下午之前回复我的邮件。

entries.example: The children felt restless after three hours in the car.
entries.exampleZh: 在车里待了三个小时后，孩子们感到焦躁不安。

entries.example: He could not restrain his anger during the long argument.
entries.exampleZh: 在那场长时间的争吵中，他无法抑制自己的怒火。

entries.example: He showed great restraint and did not shout at the angry customer.
entries.exampleZh: 他表现出极大的克制，没有对那位愤怒的顾客大喊。

entries.example: We will resume our meeting after a short coffee break.
entries.exampleZh: 我们将在短暂的咖啡休息后恢复会议。

entries.example: My father plans to retire from his job next spring.
entries.exampleZh: 我父亲计划明年春天退休。

entries.example: The peasants began a revolt against the cruel king.
entries.exampleZh: 农民们开始反抗残酷的国王。

entries.example: The revolutionary leader gave a powerful speech to the crowd.
entries.exampleZh: 那位革命领袖向人群发表了有力的演讲。

entries.example: The song has a slow rhythm that helps me relax.
entries.exampleZh: 这首歌节奏缓慢，有助于我放松。

entries.example: He broke a rib while playing football with his friends.
entries.exampleZh: 他和朋友踢足球时摔断了一根肋骨。

entries.example: She tied a red ribbon around the gift box.
entries.exampleZh: 她用一条红丝带系在礼品盒上。

entries.example: We must rid the garden of these harmful insects.
entries.exampleZh: 我们必须清除花园里的这些有害昆虫。

entries.example: We walked along the narrow ridge above the green valley.
entries.exampleZh: 我们沿着绿色山谷上方的狭窄山脊行走。

entries.example: His ridiculous excuse made everyone in the room laugh.
entries.exampleZh: 他荒谬的借口让房间里的每个人都笑了。

entries.example: The soldier cleaned his rifle after the long training day.
entries.exampleZh: 经过漫长的训练日，士兵擦拭了他的步枪。

entries.example: The tent has a rigid frame that stands in strong wind.
entries.exampleZh: 这顶帐篷有一个坚硬的框架，能在强风中立住。

entries.example: These bananas are ripe and ready to eat today.
entries.exampleZh: 这些香蕉熟了，今天就可以吃。

entries.example: There is a small risk of rain this afternoon.
entries.exampleZh: 今天下午有小雨的风险。

entries.example: We heard the lion roar loudly in the distance.
entries.exampleZh: 我们听到狮子在远处大声吼叫。

entries.example: My mother will roast a chicken for Sunday dinner.
entries.exampleZh: 我妈妈将为周日晚餐烤一只鸡。

entries.example: This small robot can clean the floor by itself.
entries.exampleZh: 这个小机器人能自己打扫地板。

entries.example: The fisherman fixed a new rod before the trip.
entries.exampleZh: 渔夫在出发前修好了一根新鱼竿。

entries.example: The ball will roll down the hill very fast.
entries.exampleZh: 球会很快滚下山坡。

entries.example: The heavy roller flattened the soft ground in the garden.
entries.exampleZh: 沉重的滚筒把花园里松软的地面压平了。

entries.example: The museum shows a roman coin found near the river.
entries.exampleZh: 博物馆展出了一枚在河边发现的古罗马硬币。

entries.example: They had a romantic dinner by the sea last night.
entries.exampleZh: 他们昨晚在海边吃了一顿浪漫的晚餐。

entries.example: The rotary phone on the desk still works very well.
entries.exampleZh: 桌上那部转盘电话仍然很好用。

entries.example: Please rotate the wheel slowly with your left hand.
entries.exampleZh: 请用左手慢慢转动这个轮子。

entries.example: The Earth's rotation gives us day and night.
entries.exampleZh: 地球的自转给我们带来白天和黑夜。

entries.example: The rotten fruit in the basket smells very bad.
entries.exampleZh: 篮子里腐烂的水果闻起来很臭。

entries.example: The rough road made the bus shake a lot.
entries.exampleZh: 崎岖的道路让公共汽车颠簸得很厉害。

entries.example: The loud noise will rouse the baby from sleep.
entries.exampleZh: 巨大的噪音会把婴儿从睡梦中惊醒。

entries.example: This bus route takes us past the old market.
entries.exampleZh: 这条公交路线带我们经过老市场。

entries.example: My morning routine starts with a short walk outside.
entries.exampleZh: 我的早晨例行活动从户外短暂散步开始。

entries.example: We sat in the front row at the cinema.
entries.exampleZh: 我们坐在电影院的头排。

entries.example: The royal family waved to the crowd from the balcony.
entries.exampleZh: 王室成员在阳台上向人群挥手。

entries.example: A soft rug lies on the floor near my bed.
entries.exampleZh: 我床边地板上铺着一块柔软的小地毯。

entries.example: Life in the rural area is quiet and very slow.
entries.exampleZh: 农村地区的生活安静而非常缓慢。

entries.example: We must rush to catch the last train home.
entries.exampleZh: 我们必须赶快去赶回家的末班火车。

entries.example: The old gate is covered with brown rust.
entries.exampleZh: 旧大门上覆盖着褐色的锈。

entries.example: He carried a heavy sack of rice on his back.
entries.exampleZh: 他背着一袋沉重的大米。

entries.example: Her parents made a big sacrifice to pay for school.
entries.exampleZh: 她的父母为了支付学费做出了很大的牺牲。

entries.example: He put the saddle on the horse before riding.
entries.exampleZh: 他在骑马前把马鞍放在了马背上。

entries.example: The white sail moved slowly across the quiet blue water.
entries.exampleZh: 白色的帆在平静的蓝色水面上缓缓移动。

entries.example: For the sake of your health, please stop smoking now.
entries.exampleZh: 为了你的健康，请现在就戒烟。

entries.example: The doctor took a small sample of blood this morning.
entries.exampleZh: 医生今天早上取了一小份血液样本。

entries.example: The new satellite sends clear pictures back to Earth every day.
entries.exampleZh: 这颗新卫星每天把清晰的图像传回地球。

entries.example: Her answer was not satisfactory, so we asked again.
entries.exampleZh: 她的回答不令人满意，所以我又问了一遍。

entries.example: She put the wet cup on a small white saucer.
entries.exampleZh: 她把湿杯子放在一个小白茶托上。

entries.example: I ate a hot sausage with bread for lunch today.
entries.exampleZh: 我今天午饭吃了一根热香肠和面包。

entries.example: He used a sharp saw to cut the old wood.
entries.exampleZh: 他用一把锋利的锯子锯开旧木头。

entries.example: Take some fruit, say an apple or a pear.
entries.exampleZh: 拿些水果吧，比如说一个苹果或一个梨。

entries.example: Please scan this page and send it to me.
entries.exampleZh: 请扫描这一页并把它发给我。

entries.example: We had scarcely arrived when the rain began to fall.
entries.exampleZh: 我们刚到，雨就开始下了。

entries.example: The wind will scatter the dry leaves across the yard.
entries.exampleZh: 风会把干树叶吹散到院子各处。

entries.example: The mountain scenery looked beautiful in the early morning light.
entries.exampleZh: 清晨的光线下山间风景显得很美。

entries.example: Our school started a new scheme to help young readers.
entries.exampleZh: 我们学校启动了一项帮助年轻读者的新计划。

entries.example: The old scholar wrote many books about ancient Chinese history.
entries.exampleZh: 这位老学者写了许多关于中国古代历史的书。

entries.example: The report explains the scientific reasons behind the sudden change.
entries.exampleZh: 这份报告解释了这一突然变化背后的科学原因。

entries.example: I need a pair of scissors to cut this paper.
entries.exampleZh: 我需要一把剪刀来剪这张纸。

entries.example: The final score was three to two after a close game.
entries.exampleZh: 比赛十分接近，最终比分是三比二。

entries.example: The scout moved quietly through the trees and watched the road.
entries.exampleZh: 侦察员悄悄穿过树林，观察着道路。

entries.example: Be careful not to scrape the car against the wall.
entries.exampleZh: 小心别让车蹭到墙上。

entries.example: Please turn this screw to the left until the lid is tight.
entries.exampleZh: 请把这个螺丝向左拧，直到盖子拧紧。

entries.example: The king pressed his seal into the hot wax on the letter.
entries.exampleZh: 国王把他的印章按在信上滚烫的封蜡上。

entries.example: For us, money is secondary and good health comes first.
entries.exampleZh: 对我们来说，金钱是次要的，健康才是第一位的。

entries.example: The secretary answered the phone and wrote down the message.
entries.exampleZh: 秘书接了电话，并把留言记了下来。

entries.example: This section of the book is about plants and animals.
entries.exampleZh: 这本书的这一部分讲的是植物和动物。

entries.example: She put one small seed into the soil and waited.
entries.exampleZh: 她把一粒小种子放进土里，然后等待着。

entries.example: We should seek help when the work is too hard.
entries.exampleZh: 当工作太难时，我们应该寻求帮助。

entries.example: This small semiconductor is used in phones and computers.
entries.exampleZh: 这种小型半导体被用于手机和电脑中。

entries.example: The senate voted on the new law last Friday.
entries.exampleZh: 参议院上周五对这项新法律进行了投票。

entries.example: My brother and I sleep in two separate rooms.
entries.exampleZh: 我和弟弟睡在两个分开的房间里。

entries.example: Please put these pictures in the right sequence.
entries.exampleZh: 请把这些图片按正确的顺序排好。

entries.example: She wrote a series of short stories for children.
entries.exampleZh: 她为孩子们写了一系列短篇故事。

entries.example: They serve hot soup to every guest in winter.
entries.exampleZh: 冬天他们给每位客人端上热汤。

entries.example: We must settle this problem before the meeting starts.
entries.exampleZh: 我们必须在会议开始前解决这个问题。

entries.example: The two sides reached a peaceful settlement after long talks.
entries.exampleZh: 经过长时间会谈，双方达成了和平解决。

entries.example: My grandmother can sew a button on my coat.
entries.exampleZh: 我奶奶能在我的外套上缝一颗纽扣。

entries.example: He needs to shave before he goes to the interview.
entries.exampleZh: 他去面试之前需要刮胡子。

entries.example: Farmers shear the sheep once a year in spring.
entries.exampleZh: 农民们每年春天给羊剪一次毛。

entries.example: These trees shed their leaves in the cold autumn.
entries.exampleZh: 这些树在寒冷的秋天落叶。

entries.example: She wrote her name on a clean sheet of paper.
entries.exampleZh: 她在一张干净的纸上写下了自己的名字。

entries.example: Please put the books back on the top shelf after reading.
entries.exampleZh: 读完书后，请把书放回最上面的架子上。

entries.example: We found shelter under a big tree when the rain started.
entries.exampleZh: 下雨时，我们在一棵大树下找到了避雨的地方。

entries.example: He used a wooden shield to protect himself during the fight.
entries.exampleZh: 打斗时他用一块木盾保护自己。

entries.example: My mother works the night shift at the hospital every week.
entries.exampleZh: 我妈妈每周在医院上夜班。

entries.example: I began to shiver in the cold wind without a coat.
entries.exampleZh: 没穿外套，我在冷风中开始发抖。

entries.example: Please do not shoot the birds in this quiet park.
entries.exampleZh: 请不要在这个安静的公园里射鸟。

entries.example: We walked along the shore and collected some pretty shells.
entries.exampleZh: 我们沿着岸边散步，捡了一些漂亮的贝壳。

entries.example: There is a serious shortage of clean water in that village.
entries.exampleZh: 那个村庄严重缺少干净的水。

entries.example: The train will arrive shortly, so please wait on the platform.
entries.exampleZh: 火车马上就要到了，请在站台上等候。

entries.example: His first shot hit the target right in the middle.
entries.exampleZh: 他第一枪就正中了靶心。

entries.example: I take a quick shower before breakfast every morning.
entries.exampleZh: 我每天早上早饭前都快速冲个澡。

entries.example: She gave a loud shriek when she saw the mouse.
entries.exampleZh: 她看到老鼠时发出了一声尖叫。

entries.example: The sign on the door says the shop is closed today.
entries.exampleZh: 门上的牌子写着这家店今天关门。

entries.example: This old letter has great significance for our whole family.
entries.exampleZh: 这封旧信对我们全家来说意义重大。

entries.example: A strange silence filled the room after his sudden question.
entries.exampleZh: 他突然发问之后，房间里一片奇怪的寂静。

entries.example: The whole class stayed silent while the teacher read the letter.
entries.exampleZh: 老师读信的时候，全班都保持沉默。

entries.example: She wore a beautiful red silk dress to the party.
entries.exampleZh: 她穿了一条漂亮的红丝绸裙子去参加聚会。

entries.example: It was silly of me to forget my keys again.
entries.exampleZh: 我又忘了带钥匙，真是太傻了。

entries.example: He gave her a silver ring for their tenth anniversary.
entries.exampleZh: 他在他们十周年纪念日送给她一枚银戒指。

entries.example: My sister loves music, and similarly, I enjoy playing the piano.
entries.exampleZh: 我姐姐喜欢音乐，同样地，我也喜欢弹钢琴。

entries.example: She simply smiled and thanked everyone for their kind help.
entries.exampleZh: 她只是微笑着感谢大家的善意帮助。

entries.example: Please accept my sincere thanks for all your help this week.
entries.exampleZh: 请接受我对你这周所有帮助的真诚感谢。

entries.example: A singular idea can sometimes change a whole community.
entries.exampleZh: 一个非凡的想法有时能改变整个社区。

entries.example: He drew a quick sketch of the old bridge.
entries.exampleZh: 他画了一幅那座老桥的速写。

entries.example: She is a skilled cook and can make wonderful meals.
entries.exampleZh: 她是一位熟练的厨师，能做出美味的饭菜。

entries.example: His skillful hands fixed the broken chair in minutes.
entries.exampleZh: 他灵巧的双手几分钟内就修好了那把坏椅子。

entries.example: I like to skim the news before breakfast each morning.
entries.exampleZh: 我喜欢每天早餐前浏览一下新闻。

entries.example: Please do not slam the door when you leave.
entries.exampleZh: 你离开时请不要使劲关门。

entries.example: The little boy wiped his nose on his sleeve.
entries.exampleZh: 小男孩用袖子擦了擦鼻子。

entries.example: The dancer has long slender arms and a graceful walk.
entries.exampleZh: 那位舞者手臂细长，步态优雅。

entries.example: Would you like another slice of apple pie?
entries.exampleZh: 你还想再来一片苹果派吗？

entries.example: The children love to slide down the hill in winter.
entries.exampleZh: 孩子们喜欢冬天从山坡上滑下来。

entries.example: A narrow slit in the curtains let in some light.
entries.exampleZh: 窗帘上的一道窄缝透进了一些光。

entries.example: The steep slope was hard for the old man.
entries.exampleZh: 那个陡坡对那位老人来说很难走。

entries.example: That was a smart way to solve the problem.
entries.exampleZh: 那是解决这个问题的一个巧妙办法。

entries.example: Let the beans soak in water overnight before cooking.
entries.exampleZh: 让豆子在水中浸泡一夜再煮。

entries.example: Be careful not to soil your clean shirt at lunch.
entries.exampleZh: 午饭时小心别弄脏你干净的衬衫。

entries.example: The school installed solar panels on the new roof.
entries.exampleZh: 学校在新屋顶上安装了太阳能电池板。

entries.example: There is a small hole in the sole of my shoe.
entries.exampleZh: 我鞋底上有一个小洞。

entries.example: The ceremony was quiet and solemn from start to finish.
entries.exampleZh: 仪式从头到尾安静而庄严。

entries.example: Sugar is soluble in warm water, so it mixes quickly.
entries.exampleZh: 糖在温水中是可溶的，所以很快就混合了。

entries.example: Somebody left a bag on the chair near the door.
entries.exampleZh: 有人把包落在门边的椅子上了。

entries.example: Somehow I lost my keys on the way home today.
entries.exampleZh: 不知怎么的，我今天在回家路上把钥匙丢了。

entries.example: Please come and visit us sometime next month.
entries.exampleZh: 请下个月找个时间来拜访我们。

entries.example: The test was somewhat harder than I expected.
entries.exampleZh: 这次考试比我预想的要难一些。

entries.example: My throat is sore, so I will stay home today.
entries.exampleZh: 我喉咙痛，所以今天我要待在家里。

entries.example: Her eyes were full of sorrow after the bad news.
entries.exampleZh: 听到坏消息后，她眼里充满了悲伤。

entries.example: What sort of music do you like to listen to?
entries.exampleZh: 你喜欢听哪种音乐？

entries.example: The old bridge is still sound and safe to use.
entries.exampleZh: 这座老桥依然完好，可以安全使用。

entries.example: This milk tastes sour, so please do not drink it.
entries.exampleZh: 这牛奶尝起来酸了，所以请不要喝。

entries.example: Farmers sow seeds in the fields every spring.
entries.exampleZh: 农民每年春天在田里播种。

entries.example: The spacecraft landed safely on the moon this morning.
entries.exampleZh: 这艘航天器今天早上安全地降落在月球上。

entries.example: He used a spade to dig a hole in the garden.
entries.exampleZh: 他用铁锹在花园里挖了一个洞。

entries.example: She lived in Paris for a short span of time.
entries.exampleZh: 她曾在巴黎短暂地住过一段时间。

entries.example: A small spark from the fire flew into the air.
entries.exampleZh: 一团小火星从火里飞到了空中。

entries.example: The doctor sent me to a specialist for more tests.
entries.exampleZh: 医生把我送到一位专家那里做更多检查。

entries.example: The teacher showed us a small specimen under the microscope.
entries.exampleZh: 老师给我们看了显微镜下的一个小标本。

entries.example: Please be careful not to spill the hot soup.
entries.exampleZh: 请小心别把热汤洒了。

entries.example: The wheels of the bike began to spin very fast.
entries.exampleZh: 自行车的轮子开始飞快地旋转。

entries.example: In spite of the rain, we enjoyed our walk.
entries.exampleZh: 尽管下雨，我们散步还是很开心。

entries.example: Please split the cake into eight equal pieces for us.
entries.exampleZh: 请帮我们把蛋糕分成八块一样大的。

entries.example: Too much rain can spoil the fruit before we pick it.
entries.exampleZh: 雨水太多会在我们采摘之前把水果糟蹋掉。

entries.example: The young sportsman trains hard every morning before school.
entries.exampleZh: 这位年轻运动员每天早上上学前都刻苦训练。

entries.example: We felt the cold spray from the waves on the boat.
entries.exampleZh: 我们在船上感受到了浪花打来的冰冷水雾。

entries.example: The cat can spring over that low wall easily.
entries.exampleZh: 那只猫能轻松地跳过那堵矮墙。

entries.example: Good friends often spur each other to try new things.
entries.exampleZh: 好朋友常常激励彼此去尝试新事物。

entries.example: The children drew a big square on the playground.
entries.exampleZh: 孩子们在操场上画了一个大正方形。

entries.example: The new government brought peace and stability to the region.
entries.exampleZh: 新政府给这个地区带来了和平与稳定。

entries.example: The old bridge is not stable enough for trucks.
entries.exampleZh: 这座旧桥不够稳固，卡车不能通行。

entries.example: He put a stack of books beside his bed.
entries.exampleZh: 他把一摞书放在床边。

entries.example: All the staff at the hotel were very kind.
entries.exampleZh: 这家旅馆的所有员工都非常友善。

entries.example: The singer walked onto the stage and smiled at us.
entries.exampleZh: 歌手走上舞台，朝我们微笑。

entries.example: Be careful not to stain your white shirt with juice.
entries.exampleZh: 小心别让果汁把你的白衬衫弄脏了。

entries.example: She sat on the bottom stair and tied her shoes.
entries.exampleZh: 她坐在最下面一级楼梯上系鞋带。

entries.example: The car remained static for hours in the heavy snow.
entries.exampleZh: 那辆车在大雪中好几个小时一动不动。

entries.example: We used statistical data to explain the changes in our town.
entries.exampleZh: 我们用统计数据来解释我们镇上的变化。

entries.example: A bronze statue of a horse stands in the park.
entries.exampleZh: 公园里立着一座马的青铜雕像。

entries.example: Hot steam rose from the pot on the stove.
entries.exampleZh: 炉子上的锅里冒出热腾腾的蒸汽。

entries.example: The old steamer carried passengers across the lake every day.
entries.exampleZh: 那艘旧汽船每天载着乘客穿过湖面。

entries.example: This knife is made of strong steel from Japan.
entries.exampleZh: 这把刀是用来自日本的坚固钢铁制成的。

entries.example: The flower has a long green stem and two small leaves.
entries.exampleZh: 这朵花有一根长长的绿色茎和两片小叶子。

entries.example: My new shoes feel stiff, so I cannot walk very fast.
entries.exampleZh: 我的新鞋很硬，所以我走不快。

entries.example: A bee can sting your arm if you move too quickly.
entries.exampleZh: 如果你动得太快，蜜蜂会蜇你的手臂。

entries.example: One stocking fell out of the bag onto the floor.
entries.exampleZh: 一只长袜从包里掉到了地板上。

entries.example: He had to stoop to pick up the small toy.
entries.exampleZh: 他不得不弯下腰去捡那个小玩具。

entries.example: We keep old books in storage under the stairs.
entries.exampleZh: 我们把旧书存放在楼梯下面。

entries.example: The store on the corner sells fresh bread every morning.
entries.exampleZh: 街角的商店每天早上卖新鲜面包。

entries.example: Their house has a third storey with two small bedrooms.
entries.exampleZh: 他们的房子有第三层，里面有两间小卧室。

entries.example: Please put the hot pot on the stove to keep it warm.
entries.exampleZh: 请把热锅放在炉子上保温。

entries.example: I heard a strange noise coming from the empty room.
entries.exampleZh: 我听到空房间里传来一种奇怪的声音。

entries.example: A stranger asked me for directions to the train station.
entries.exampleZh: 一个陌生人向我问去火车站的路。

entries.example: The strap on my bag broke during the long walk.
entries.exampleZh: 我包上的带子在长途步行中断了。

entries.example: She drank the juice through a paper straw.
entries.exampleZh: 她用一根纸吸管喝了果汁。

entries.example: These simple exercises will strengthen your back and improve your posture.
entries.exampleZh: 这些简单的锻炼会增强你的背部并改善你的姿势。

entries.example: A short stretch before running can help prevent injuries.
entries.exampleZh: 跑步前做短暂伸展有助于预防受伤。

entries.example: The balloon floated away because the string was too short.
entries.exampleZh: 气球飘走了，因为绳子太短。

entries.example: A narrow strip of paper fell from the old book.
entries.exampleZh: 一条窄纸片从旧书里掉了出来。

entries.example: The white shirt has a thin blue stripe down the back.
entries.exampleZh: 这件白衬衫背后有一条细蓝条纹。

entries.example: My uncle had a stroke last year but recovered very well.
entries.exampleZh: 我叔叔去年中风了，但恢复得很好。

entries.example: The engineer found a structural problem in the old bridge.
entries.exampleZh: 工程师在旧桥上发现了一个结构问题。

entries.example: Please put your stuff in the box near the door.
entries.exampleZh: 请把你的东西放在门边的盒子里。

entries.example: The submarine went down slowly into the deep blue sea.
entries.exampleZh: 潜水艇慢慢下沉，进入湛蓝的深海。

entries.example: Do not submerge the wood in water for too long.
entries.exampleZh: 不要把这块木头泡在水里太久。

entries.example: The subsequent test was much easier than the first one.
entries.exampleZh: 随后的考试比第一次容易得多。

entries.example: This strange substance feels soft and cold in my hand.
entries.exampleZh: 这种奇怪的物质在我手里摸起来又软又凉。

entries.example: Please subtract five from twenty and tell me the answer.
entries.exampleZh: 请从二十里减去五，然后告诉我答案。

entries.example: We took the subway to the museum last Sunday morning.
entries.exampleZh: 上周日早上我们坐地铁去了博物馆。

entries.example: A succession of small problems made the long trip difficult.
entries.exampleZh: 一连串小问题让这次长途旅行变得艰难。

entries.example: Three successive wins gave the team great confidence this year.
entries.exampleZh: 三连胜让这支队伍今年信心大增。

entries.example: Babies suck milk through a small hole in the bottle.
entries.exampleZh: 婴儿通过奶瓶上的小孔吸奶。

entries.example: That dark blue suit looks very good on you.
entries.exampleZh: 那套深蓝色西装穿在你身上很好看。

entries.example: The hot spring smells of sulfur and old rotten eggs.
entries.exampleZh: 这个温泉闻起来有硫磺和臭鸡蛋的味道。

entries.example: The yellow sulphur powder smelled strong near the old factory.
entries.exampleZh: 那黄色硫磺粉在旧工厂附近散发出浓烈的气味。

entries.example: He paid a large sum of money for that old car.
entries.exampleZh: 他为那辆旧车付了一大笔钱。

entries.example: Please summarize the story in five short sentences for us.
entries.exampleZh: 请用五个短句为我们总结这个故事。

entries.example: She takes a vitamin supplement with breakfast every single morning.
entries.exampleZh: 她每天早上吃早餐时服用一种维生素补充剂。

entries.example: The supreme court will review this important case next month.
entries.exampleZh: 最高法院下个月将审理这起重要案件。

entries.example: My father needs surgery on his knee later this year.
entries.exampleZh: 我父亲今年晚些时候需要做膝盖手术。

entries.example: The soldiers did not surrender even after a long fight.
entries.exampleZh: 士兵们经过长时间战斗后仍未投降。

entries.example: The children quickly got used to their new surroundings.
entries.exampleZh: 孩子们很快就适应了他们的新环境。

entries.example: Cacti can survive for months without any water in the desert.
entries.exampleZh: 仙人掌在沙漠里没有水也能存活好几个月。

entries.example: Workers will suspend a new sign above the door tomorrow.
entries.exampleZh: 工人们明天会把一块新牌子悬挂在门上方。

entries.example: A dark suspicion grew in his mind after he found the letter.
entries.exampleZh: 他发现那封信后，一个阴暗的怀疑在他心中滋长。

entries.example: The police became suspicious when the man changed his story twice.
entries.exampleZh: 那名男子两次改口后，警察开始起疑。

entries.example: I swear I will keep your secret safe from everyone.
entries.exampleZh: 我发誓我会对你这个秘密守口如瓶，不让任何人知道。

entries.example: She wore a warm sweater because the classroom was very cold today.
entries.exampleZh: 她穿了一件暖和的毛衣，因为今天教室很冷。

entries.example: Please sweep the kitchen floor before our guests arrive tonight.
entries.exampleZh: 今晚客人到之前，请把厨房地板扫一扫。

entries.example: My ankle began to swell after I fell off the bike.
entries.exampleZh: 我从自行车上摔下来后，脚踝开始肿起来。

entries.example: The children love to swing in the park after school.
entries.exampleZh: 孩子们喜欢放学后在公园里荡秋千。

entries.example: The old sword on the wall belonged to a famous king.
entries.exampleZh: 墙上的那把旧剑曾属于一位著名的国王。

entries.example: The nurse gave me a sympathetic smile when I felt nervous.
entries.exampleZh: 当我感到紧张时，护士给了我一个同情的微笑。

entries.example: I truly sympathize with you after hearing about your difficult week.
entries.exampleZh: 听说了你艰难的一周后，我真的很同情你。

entries.example: Her systematical way of studying helped her pass every test this year.
entries.exampleZh: 她有系统的学习方法帮助她今年通过了每一场考试。

entries.example: The price tag on this shirt is too high for me.
entries.exampleZh: 这件衬衫上的价签对我来说太高了。

entries.example: My grandmother told us a funny tale about her childhood.
entries.exampleZh: 我的祖母给我们讲了一个关于她童年的有趣故事。

entries.example: She has a real talent for drawing animals and flowers.
entries.exampleZh: 她在画动物和花朵方面有真正的才能。

entries.example: We need to talk about our plan before the meeting starts.
entries.exampleZh: 会议开始前我们需要谈谈我们的计划。

entries.example: The tame rabbit sat quietly in the child's hands.
entries.exampleZh: 那只温顺的兔子安静地坐在孩子的手里。

entries.example: She gave a gentle tap on the window to get my attention.
entries.exampleZh: 她轻轻敲了一下窗户以引起我的注意。

entries.example: This soup has a strange taste, but I still like it.
entries.exampleZh: 这汤味道有点奇怪，但我还是喜欢。

entries.example: My grandfather sent a telegram from the ship.
entries.exampleZh: 我的祖父从船上发来了一封电报。

entries.example: We used a telescope to watch the stars last night.
entries.exampleZh: 昨晚我们用望远镜观看星星。

entries.example: The old temple stands on top of the hill.
entries.exampleZh: 那座古老的庙宇矗立在山顶上。

entries.example: He found a temporary job for the summer holiday.
entries.exampleZh: 他找了一份暑假的临时工作。

entries.example: The sweet smell of cake may tempt him to eat.
entries.exampleZh: 蛋糕的甜香可能会诱惑他去吃。

entries.example: She will tend the garden while we are away.
entries.exampleZh: 我们不在的时候她会照管花园。

entries.example: He has a tendency to forget things at home.
entries.exampleZh: 他有一种把东西忘在家里的倾向。

entries.example: This meat is very tender and easy to cut.
entries.exampleZh: 这块肉很嫩，很容易切开。

entries.example: Please write this sentence in the past tense.
entries.exampleZh: 请用过去时写这个句子。

entries.example: The weather was terrible during our trip to the mountains.
entries.exampleZh: 我们去山里旅行期间天气糟透了。

entries.example: The loud noise filled the small children with terror.
entries.exampleZh: 巨大的噪音使小孩子们充满了恐惧。

entries.example: This factory sells textile products to many countries.
entries.exampleZh: 这家工厂向许多国家出售纺织品。

entries.example: His answer was too theoretical for our simple question.
entries.exampleZh: 对于我们的简单问题来说，他的回答太理论化了。

entries.example: He arrived early, thereby getting a seat near the front.
entries.exampleZh: 他到得很早，因此坐到了靠前的座位。

entries.example: It rained hard, therefore the game was cancelled.
entries.exampleZh: 雨下得很大，因此比赛被取消了。

entries.example: The doctor used a thermometer to check my temperature.
entries.exampleZh: 医生用温度计给我量体温。

entries.example: The thickness of the ice was about ten centimeters.
