entries.exampleZh: 冰的厚度大约是十厘米。

entries.example: The doctor gave him a thorough check before the race.
entries.exampleZh: 比赛前医生给他做了一次彻底的检查。

entries.example: It was thoughtful of you to bring flowers for her.
entries.exampleZh: 你给她带花真是太体贴了。

entries.example: She used a thin thread to sew the button.
entries.exampleZh: 她用一根细线缝上了纽扣。

entries.example: His angry words were a threat to everyone in the room.
entries.exampleZh: 他愤怒的话对房间里的每个人都是威胁。

entries.example: Plants thrive when they get enough light and water.
entries.exampleZh: 只要有充足的光和水，植物就会长得很旺盛。

entries.example: My throat hurts after singing for two hours.
entries.exampleZh: 唱了两个小时的歌，我的喉咙很痛。

entries.example: The heavy rain continued throughout the whole night.
entries.exampleZh: 大雨持续了整个晚上。

entries.example: He thrust the key into the lock and turned it.
entries.exampleZh: 他把钥匙插进锁里，然后转动了一下。

entries.example: The thunder woke my little sister during the night.
entries.exampleZh: 夜里的雷声把我妹妹吵醒了。

entries.example: The road was closed, and thus we took another way.
entries.exampleZh: 道路封闭了，因此我们走了另一条路。

entries.example: Her desk is always tidy and free of dust.
entries.exampleZh: 她的书桌总是很整洁，一点灰尘也没有。

entries.example: He opened a tin of soup for lunch.
entries.exampleZh: 他打开一罐头汤当午饭。

entries.example: Please tip the taxi driver a few extra dollars.
entries.exampleZh: 请给出租车司机几美元小费。

entries.example: Long walks in the heat tire my old dog quickly.
entries.exampleZh: 在高温下长时间散步很快就让我的老狗累了。

entries.example: He wiped his nose with a soft tissue.
entries.exampleZh: 他用一张柔软的纸巾擦了擦鼻子。

entries.example: I like toast with butter and jam for breakfast.
entries.exampleZh: 我早餐喜欢吃涂了黄油和果酱的烤面包。

entries.example: He hurt his big toe while playing football.
entries.exampleZh: 他踢足球时伤了大脚趾。

entries.example: The toilet is at the end of the hall.
entries.exampleZh: 厕所在走廊的尽头。

entries.example: I cannot tolerate loud music late at night.
entries.exampleZh: 我无法忍受深夜的吵闹音乐。

entries.example: Her tone of voice told us she was angry.
entries.exampleZh: 她的语气告诉我们她生气了。

entries.example: He used a torch to find the small path.
entries.exampleZh: 他用手电筒找到了那条小路。

entries.example: Waiting for the exam results was pure torture.
entries.exampleZh: 等待考试结果纯粹是一种折磨。

entries.example: The total cost of the trip was under fifty dollars.
entries.exampleZh: 这次旅行的总费用不到五十美元。

entries.example: Please do not touch the paintings in this room.
entries.exampleZh: 请不要触摸这个房间里的画。

entries.example: We took a short tour of the old city yesterday.
entries.exampleZh: 昨天我们对这座古城进行了短暂的游览。

entries.example: A tourist asked me where the train station was.
entries.exampleZh: 一位游客问我火车站在哪里。

entries.example: She dried her hands with a clean towel.
entries.exampleZh: 她用一条干净的毛巾擦干了手。

entries.example: The old tower stands at the top of the hill.
entries.exampleZh: 那座古老的塔立在山顶上。

entries.example: My uncle drives a tractor on his farm every morning.
entries.exampleZh: 我叔叔每天早上在他的农场里开拖拉机。

entries.example: Trade between the two countries has grown a lot.
entries.exampleZh: 两国之间的贸易增长了很多。

entries.example: The traffic is very heavy in the morning.
entries.exampleZh: 早上交通非常拥挤。

entries.example: The fire was a terrible tragedy for the whole town.
entries.exampleZh: 那场火灾对整个小镇来说是一场可怕的悲剧。

entries.example: We followed a narrow trail through the forest.
entries.exampleZh: 我们沿着一条狭窄的小径穿过森林。

entries.example: The change brought a complete transformation of the old factory.
entries.exampleZh: 这一变化给旧工厂带来了彻底的改造。

entries.example: A transformer near the station broke down last night.
entries.exampleZh: 车站附近的一台变压器昨晚坏了。

entries.example: This small transistor is used in many radios.
entries.exampleZh: 这个小晶体管被用在许多收音机里。

entries.example: The transmission of the match was stopped by the storm.
entries.exampleZh: 比赛的转播被暴风雨中断了。

entries.example: The radio can transmit news to the whole village.
entries.exampleZh: 这台收音机能把新闻传送到整个村庄。

entries.example: The box has a transparent lid so you can see inside.
entries.exampleZh: 这个盒子有一个透明的盖子，所以你能看到里面。

entries.example: Trucks transport food from the farm to the city.
entries.exampleZh: 卡车把食物从农场运到城市。

entries.example: The farmer set a trap for the rats.
entries.exampleZh: 农民设了一个陷阱来捉老鼠。

entries.example: She carried the cups on a large tray.
entries.exampleZh: 她把杯子放在一个大托盘上端着。

entries.example: My parents treat my little brother like a baby.
entries.exampleZh: 我父母把我弟弟当婴儿一样对待。

entries.example: The two countries signed a treaty after many years of talks.
entries.exampleZh: 经过多年会谈，两国签署了一项条约。

entries.example: There is a clear trend toward smaller homes in this city.
entries.exampleZh: 这座城市明显有一种住小房子的趋势。

entries.example: The judge will begin the trial early next Monday morning.
entries.exampleZh: 法官将于下周一早开始审判。

entries.example: Draw a small triangle on the paper with your blue pen.
entries.exampleZh: 用你的蓝色笔在纸上画一个小三角形。

entries.example: He used a clever trick to open the old wooden box.
entries.exampleZh: 他用了一个巧妙的窍门打开那个旧木箱。

entries.example: My father will trim the tall grass near the front gate.
entries.exampleZh: 我父亲会修剪前门附近长高的草。

entries.example: A troop of happy children walked down the quiet road.
entries.exampleZh: 一群快乐的孩子沿着安静的路走去。

entries.example: This tropical fruit tastes sweet and fresh in hot weather.
entries.exampleZh: 这种热带水果在炎热天气里吃起来又甜又新鲜。

entries.example: The noisy dog next door is really troublesome at night.
entries.exampleZh: 隔壁那只吵闹的狗在夜里真让人烦恼。

entries.example: She plays the trumpet in our school band every Friday.
entries.exampleZh: 她每周五在我们学校乐队里吹小号。

entries.example: The old tree trunk was too wide for my arms.
entries.exampleZh: 那棵老树的树干太粗了，我的双臂都抱不过来。

entries.example: I trust my best friend with all my secret plans.
entries.exampleZh: 我把我所有秘密的计划都托付给我最好的朋友。

entries.example: Please tell me the truth about what happened last night.
entries.exampleZh: 请告诉我昨晚发生事情的真相。

entries.example: A small tube of hand cream is in my bag.
entries.exampleZh: 我的包里有一小管护手霜。

entries.example: My grandfather can play that old tune on the piano.
entries.exampleZh: 我祖父能用钢琴弹奏那首老曲子。

entries.example: The train went through a long tunnel under the mountain.
entries.exampleZh: 火车穿过山下一段长长的隧道。

entries.example: The factory uses a large turbine to make electricity.
entries.exampleZh: 这家工厂用一台大型汽轮机来发电。

entries.example: My twin brother looks just like me but is taller.
entries.exampleZh: 我的孪生哥哥长得和我一模一样，但个子更高。

entries.example: What type of music do you like to listen to?
entries.exampleZh: 你喜欢听哪种类型的音乐？

entries.example: An old typewriter sits on the desk in the small room.
entries.exampleZh: 一台旧打字机放在小房间的书桌上。

entries.example: This is a typical breakfast in my home town.
entries.exampleZh: 这是我家乡一种典型的早餐。

entries.example: The typist finished the long report before lunch.
entries.exampleZh: 打字员在午饭前打完了那份长报告。

entries.example: The front tyre of my bike is flat again.
entries.exampleZh: 我自行车的前胎又没气了。

entries.example: Her ultimate goal is to study medicine in Beijing.
entries.exampleZh: 她最终的目标是在北京学医。

entries.example: The boy was unconscious after falling from the tree.
entries.exampleZh: 那个男孩从树上摔下来后不省人事。

entries.example: Please uncover the pot before you serve the soup.
entries.exampleZh: 盛汤之前请把锅盖揭开。

entries.example: My sister is an undergraduate at a small college.
entries.exampleZh: 我姐姐是一所小学院的在校大学生。

entries.example: The cat is sleeping underneath the old wooden table.
entries.exampleZh: 猫正在那张旧木桌子底下睡觉。

entries.example: Can you undo this button for me, please?
entries.exampleZh: 你能帮我解开这颗扣子吗？

entries.example: I felt uneasy when the phone rang late at night.
entries.exampleZh: 深夜电话响起时我感到心神不安。

entries.example: His visit was completely unexpected but very welcome to us.
entries.exampleZh: 他的来访完全出乎意料，但我们非常欢迎。

entries.example: Every student here must wear a blue uniform.
entries.exampleZh: 这里的每个学生都必须穿蓝色制服。

entries.example: The workers formed a union to protect their jobs.
entries.exampleZh: 工人们成立了一个工会来保护自己的工作。

entries.example: This unit of the book is about healthy food.
entries.exampleZh: 这本书的这个单元讲的是健康食品。

entries.example: The two small teams will unite for this project.
entries.exampleZh: 这两个小团队将为了这个项目联合起来。

entries.example: Our class showed great unity during the sports day.
entries.exampleZh: 在运动会那天我们班表现出了极大的团结。

entries.example: The writer of this old song is still unknown.
entries.exampleZh: 这首老歌的作者仍然不为人知。

entries.example: We will stay at home unless the rain stops soon.
entries.exampleZh: 除非雨很快停，否则我们就待在家里。

entries.example: Unlike my brother, I really enjoy cold winter mornings.
entries.exampleZh: 和我哥哥不同，我很喜欢寒冷的冬日早晨。

entries.example: It is unlikely that we will finish the work today.
entries.exampleZh: 我们今天不太可能完成这项工作。

entries.example: Please help me unload these boxes from the truck before noon.
entries.exampleZh: 请帮我在中午前把这些箱子从卡车上卸下来。

entries.example: The upper shelf is too high for the children to reach.
entries.exampleZh: 最上面的架子太高，孩子们够不到。

entries.example: Please keep the box upright while you carry it downstairs.
entries.exampleZh: 搬箱子下楼时请保持箱子直立。

entries.example: Be careful not to upset the glass of water on the table.
entries.exampleZh: 小心别打翻桌上的那杯水。

entries.example: The plane began a slow upward turn after takeoff.
entries.exampleZh: 飞机起飞后开始缓慢向上转弯。

entries.example: Many young people move to urban areas to find better jobs.
entries.exampleZh: 许多年轻人搬到城市地区寻找更好的工作。

entries.example: My friends urge me to join the school running club.
entries.exampleZh: 我的朋友们催促我加入学校跑步俱乐部。

entries.example: I need to send an urgent message to my teacher now.
entries.exampleZh: 我现在需要给老师发一条紧急消息。

entries.example: The usage of this old machine is quite simple.
entries.exampleZh: 这台旧机器的使用方法相当简单。

entries.example: We can utilize the empty room for our art class.
entries.exampleZh: 我们可以利用空房间来上美术课。

entries.example: I will do my utmost to finish the work on time.
entries.exampleZh: 我会尽最大努力按时完成工作。

entries.example: The room was in utter darkness after the lights went out.
entries.exampleZh: 灯灭后，房间里一片漆黑。

entries.example: There is a vacant seat near the window on the bus.
entries.exampleZh: 公交车上靠窗有一个空座位。

entries.example: My mother uses a vacuum to clean the living room floor.
entries.exampleZh: 我妈妈用吸尘器打扫客厅地板。

entries.example: His answer was vague, so we asked him again.
entries.exampleZh: 他的回答很含糊，所以我又问了他一遍。

entries.example: All our efforts to save the plant were in vain.
entries.exampleZh: 我们挽救那株植物的所有努力都白费了。

entries.example: The workers put the boxes into a white van outside.
entries.exampleZh: 工人们把箱子放进外面一辆白色货车里。

entries.example: Water turns into vapour when it gets very hot.
entries.exampleZh: 水变得很热时会变成蒸气。

entries.example: The weather in this city is very variable in spring.
entries.exampleZh: 这座城市春天的天气变化很大。

entries.example: There is a small variation in price between the two shops.
entries.exampleZh: 这两家店的价格有一点小差异。

entries.example: The shop sells various kinds of tea and fresh bread.
entries.exampleZh: 这家店卖各种各样的茶和新鲜面包。

entries.example: A vast desert covers much of the country in the south.
entries.exampleZh: 一片广阔的沙漠覆盖了这个国家南部的大部分地区。

entries.example: The wind's velocity increased as the storm moved closer.
entries.exampleZh: 随着风暴逼近，风速加大了。

entries.example: She did not venture outside during the heavy rain.
entries.exampleZh: 大雨期间她没有冒险外出。

entries.example: Please verify your address before you send the form.
entries.exampleZh: 寄出表格之前请核实你的地址。

entries.example: Draw a vertical line from the top to the bottom.
entries.exampleZh: 从上到下画一条垂直线。

entries.example: The wooden vessel was full of cold water.
entries.exampleZh: 那个木容器里装满了冷水。

entries.example: My grandfather is a veteran and often tells us stories.
entries.exampleZh: 我爷爷是一位老兵，常常给我们讲故事。

entries.example: My phone will vibrate when a message arrives.
entries.exampleZh: 有消息来时我的手机就会震动。

entries.example: Greed is a vice that can ruin a good person.
entries.exampleZh: 贪婪是一种能毁掉好人的恶习。

entries.example: He takes a vigorous walk every morning before work.
entries.exampleZh: 他每天早上上班前都会精神抖擞地散一会儿步。

entries.example: Add a little vinegar to the soup for better taste.
entries.exampleZh: 往汤里加一点醋，味道会更好。

entries.example: A violent storm hit the village last night.
entries.exampleZh: 昨晚一场猛烈的风暴袭击了那个村庄。

entries.example: A small violet grew beside the old stone wall.
entries.exampleZh: 一朵小紫罗兰长在旧石墙边。

entries.example: Patience is a virtue that helps us in hard times.
entries.exampleZh: 耐心是一种在困难时期帮助我们的美德。

entries.example: His vision of the future filled everyone with hope.
entries.exampleZh: 他对未来的设想让每个人都充满希望。

entries.example: The teacher used visual aids to explain the lesson.
entries.exampleZh: 老师用视觉辅助工具来讲解这堂课。

entries.example: The doctor told me to take a vitamin pill daily.
entries.exampleZh: 医生让我每天吃一片维生素药片。

entries.example: She gave a vivid description of her trip to Africa.
entries.exampleZh: 她生动地描述了她的非洲之行。

entries.example: The volcano has not erupted for over a hundred years.
entries.exampleZh: 这座火山已经一百多年没有喷发了。

entries.example: A small battery like this gives about one volt.
entries.exampleZh: 像这样的一节小电池大约提供一伏特的电压。

entries.example: The voltage in this old house is too high for that machine.
entries.exampleZh: 这座老房子里的电压对那台机器来说太高了。

entries.example: She turned up the volume and danced around the room.
entries.exampleZh: 她把音量调大，在房间里跳起舞来。

entries.example: The voyage across the ocean took almost three weeks.
entries.exampleZh: 这次横渡大洋的航行花了将近三个星期。

entries.example: The villagers plan to wage a campaign against the new road.
entries.exampleZh: 村民们计划开展一场反对修建这条新路的运动。

entries.example: A farmer loaded the hay onto the old waggon.
entries.exampleZh: 一位农民把干草装上了那辆旧四轮马车。

entries.example: Please do not waken the baby while she sleeps.
entries.exampleZh: 她睡觉的时候请不要弄醒宝宝。

entries.example: We like to wander through the quiet streets after dinner.
entries.exampleZh: 晚饭后我们喜欢在安静的街道上闲逛。

entries.example: The old school closed for want of money and teachers.
entries.exampleZh: 那所老学校因为缺少资金和教师而关闭了。

entries.example: The warmth of the fire made everyone feel sleepy.
entries.exampleZh: 火的温暖让每个人都感到困倦。

entries.example: Please water the plants while I am away.
entries.exampleZh: 我不在的时候请给这些植物浇水。

entries.example: Bring a waterproof jacket because it may rain tomorrow.
entries.exampleZh: 带一件防水外套吧，因为明天可能会下雨。

entries.example: A big wave hit the small boat near the shore.
entries.exampleZh: 一个大浪拍中了岸边的那条小船。

entries.example: The candle is made of wax and smells like honey.
entries.exampleZh: 这根蜡烛是用蜡做的，闻起来像蜂蜜。

entries.example: His greatest weakness is that he never listens to advice.
entries.exampleZh: 他最大的弱点是从不听别人的建议。

entries.example: The old stairs wear away a little more each year.
entries.exampleZh: 这些旧楼梯每年都会多磨损一点。

entries.example: My grandmother can weave a basket from dry grass.
entries.exampleZh: 我奶奶能用干草编一个篮子。

entries.example: He pulled every weed out of the small garden.
entries.exampleZh: 他把小花园里的每一棵杂草都拔掉了。

entries.example: She began to weep when she heard the sad news.
entries.exampleZh: 听到那个悲伤的消息时，她开始哭泣。

entries.example: The worker used heat to weld the two metal pipes.
entries.exampleZh: 那名工人用高温把两根金属管焊接在一起。

entries.example: The farmer grows wheat in his large field every year.
entries.exampleZh: 这位农民每年在他大片田地里种小麦。

entries.example: The front wheel of my bike makes a strange noise.
entries.exampleZh: 我自行车的前轮发出奇怪的响声。

entries.example: I read a book whilst my brother cooked dinner.
entries.exampleZh: 我读书的时候，我弟弟做了晚饭。

entries.example: The rider used a long whip to guide the horse.
entries.exampleZh: 骑手用一条长鞭引导马。

entries.example: Please whisper the answer so the others cannot hear.
entries.exampleZh: 请低声说出答案，这样其他人就听不到。

entries.example: The referee blew his whistle and the game began.
entries.exampleZh: 裁判吹响口哨，比赛开始了。

entries.example: I am wholly sure that this plan will work well.
entries.exampleZh: 我完全相信这个计划会顺利奏效。

entries.example: The wicked king treated his poor people very badly.
entries.exampleZh: 那个邪恶的国王对待他的穷苦百姓非常恶劣。

entries.example: They plan to widen the road near our school next year.
entries.exampleZh: 他们计划明年加宽我们学校附近的那条路。

entries.example: The old widow lives alone in a small house.
entries.exampleZh: 那位老寡妇独自住在一间小房子里。

entries.example: Please measure the width of the table before we buy it.
entries.exampleZh: 在我们买下这张桌子之前，请量一下它的宽度。

entries.example: She is willing to help us with the project today.
entries.exampleZh: 她愿意今天帮助我们做这个项目。

entries.example: Please wind the rope around the post twice.
entries.exampleZh: 请把绳子绕在那根柱子上两圈。

entries.example: The bird hurt its left wing and could not fly.
entries.exampleZh: 那只鸟伤了左翅，不能飞了。

entries.example: A thin wire connects the lamp to the wall socket.
entries.exampleZh: 一根细电线把台灯连接到墙上的插座。

entries.example: Her quick wit made everyone laugh during the long meeting.
entries.exampleZh: 她机敏的才智让每个人在漫长的会议中都笑了。

entries.example: The bank will withdraw the fee after your final payment.
entries.exampleZh: 银行会在你最后付款后收回这笔费用。

entries.example: This strong bridge can withstand very heavy trucks and storms.
entries.exampleZh: 这座坚固的桥能抵挡很重的卡车和暴风雨。

entries.example: My father made a wooden box for my old books.
entries.exampleZh: 我父亲为我的旧书做了一个木箱子。

entries.example: This warm sweater is made of soft wool from sheep.
entries.exampleZh: 这件温暖的毛衣是由绵羊的柔软羊毛制成的。

entries.example: The workman fixed the broken pipe in our kitchen this morning.
entries.exampleZh: 今天早上，那位工人在我们厨房修好了破裂的管道。

entries.example: My father keeps his tools in a small workshop behind the house.
entries.exampleZh: 我父亲把工具放在房子后面的一个小车间里。

entries.example: A tiny worm crawled across the wet garden path after the rain.
entries.exampleZh: 雨后，一条小虫爬过潮湿的花园小径。

entries.example: Many people go to church for worship on Sunday mornings.
entries.exampleZh: 许多人星期天早上去教堂做礼拜。

entries.example: That was the worst movie I have seen all year.
entries.exampleZh: 那是我全年看过的最糟糕的电影。

entries.example: This old bike is still worth a lot to me.
entries.exampleZh: 这辆旧自行车对我来说仍然很有价值。

entries.example: The broken radio is worthless, so please throw it away.
entries.exampleZh: 那台坏收音机毫无价值，请把它扔掉。

entries.example: Her hard work is worthy of praise from the whole team.
entries.exampleZh: 她的努力值得全队表扬。

entries.example: The nurse cleaned the wound on his arm very carefully.
entries.exampleZh: 护士非常小心地清洗了他手臂上的伤口。

entries.example: Please wrap the gift in this blue paper before dinner.
entries.exampleZh: 请在晚饭前用这张蓝纸把礼物包起来。

entries.example: The old ship became a wreck on the rocky shore.
entries.exampleZh: 那艘旧船在岩石海岸上成了一具残骸。

entries.example: She wears a silver watch on her left wrist every day.
entries.exampleZh: 她每天左手腕上戴着一块银表。

entries.example: The children are playing football in the yard after school.
entries.exampleZh: 放学后孩子们在院子里踢足球。

entries.example: He tried to hide a yawn during the long meeting.
entries.exampleZh: 在漫长的会议中，他试图掩饰一个哈欠。

entries.example: Our school holds a yearly sports event in early October.
entries.exampleZh: 我们学校每年十月初举办一次运动会。

entries.example: He spent his youth working on a small family farm.
entries.exampleZh: 他的青年时期是在一个小家庭农场里劳作度过的。

entries.example: Please do not park your car in this safety zone.
entries.exampleZh: 请不要把你的车停在这个安全区域内。

entries.example: His new job offers a good salary and free lunch.
entries.exampleZh: 他的新工作提供不错的薪水和免费午餐。

entries.meaning: 发出咔嗒声；点击；咔嗒声
entries.example: You can click the green button to save your work.
entries.exampleZh: 你可以点击绿色按钮来保存你的工作。

entries.meaning: 韧度；心情，情绪；调和， 使缓和； 【冶】使回火
entries.example: He lost his temper when the train was late again.
entries.exampleZh: 火车又晚点时他发了脾气。

entries.example: Our city is multicultural, with food and music from many countries.
entries.exampleZh: 我们的城市是多元文化的，有来自许多国家的食物和音乐。

entries.meaning: 承认， 承认…为真； 承认失败； 允许， 让予；
entries.example: He had to concede that his plan was not perfect.
entries.exampleZh: 他不得不承认他的计划并不完美。

entries.example: We have a weekly meeting every Monday morning.
entries.exampleZh: 我们每周一上午开一次周会。

entries.meaning: 发生； 结果；结果；成果；比分
entries.example: The test result will be online tomorrow morning.
entries.exampleZh: 考试结果明天上午会在网上公布。

entries.meaning: 性别偏见， 性别歧视
entries.example: We must fight sexism in schools and at work.
entries.exampleZh: 我们必须在学校和职场中反对性别歧视。

entries.meaning: 编辑的，主笔的，编者的；社论的，社论式的；社论，
entries.example: The newspaper published an editorial about clean water.
entries.exampleZh: 报纸发表了一篇关于清洁水源的社论。

entries.meaning: 重建， 改造； 复原
entries.example: Workers will rebuild the old bridge next spring.
entries.exampleZh: 工人们明年春天将重建这座旧桥。

entries.example: We watched the sunset from the beach last night.
entries.exampleZh: 昨晚我们在海滩上看了日落。

entries.meaning: 拥有优势；在…中占首要地位；支配，统治，控制；耸
entries.example: One big company seems to dominate the local phone market.
entries.exampleZh: 一家大公司似乎支配着当地的手机市场。

entries.meaning: 激怒， 刺激； 挑衅， 挑拨
entries.example: He hit the wall after great provocation from his brother.
entries.exampleZh: 在哥哥的极大挑衅之后，他捶了墙。

entries.example: The teacher told a story about christ and his followers.
entries.exampleZh: 老师讲了一个关于基督及其追随者的故事。

entries.meaning: 想象， 幻想； 想象的产物
entries.example: She wrote a fantasy novel about a magic forest.
entries.exampleZh: 她写了一部关于魔法森林的奇幻小说。

entries.meaning: 使沮丧， 使灰心； 挫败， 使受挫折
entries.example: Long delays can frustrate even the most patient travelers.
entries.exampleZh: 长时间的延误甚至会使最有耐心的旅客感到沮丧。

entries.example: We used a strong rope to pull the boat.
entries.exampleZh: 我们用一根结实的绳子拉船。

entries.meaning: 智慧， 才智； 名言
entries.example: My grandmother shared her wisdom with all of us.
entries.exampleZh: 我的祖母把她的人生智慧分享给了我们所有人。

entries.example: Take an umbrella with you because it may rain.
entries.exampleZh: 带把伞吧，因为可能会下雨。

entries.meaning: 半路地； 在中途， 在半途；中途的；部分的；不彻
entries.example: The hotel is halfway between the airport and the beach.
entries.exampleZh: 这家酒店位于机场和海滩之间的中途。

entries.meaning: 翻译； 译文， 译本
entries.example: Her translation of the poem sounds beautiful in English.
entries.exampleZh: 她对这首诗的翻译用英语读起来很美。

entries.meaning: 碰，撞；颠簸着前进；碰撞， 猛撞； 肿块； 隆起
entries.example: I heard a loud bump from the room upstairs.
entries.exampleZh: 我听到楼上房间传来一声巨响。

entries.meaning: 鉴于， 考虑到， 顾及
entries.example: We should stay home today considering the bad weather.
entries.exampleZh: 考虑到天气不好，我们今天应该待在家里。

entries.meaning: 穿堂风，冷风；〔啤酒〕桶装的，散装的
entries.example: A cold draught came through the open window last night.
entries.exampleZh: 昨晚一股冷风从开着的窗户吹了进来。

entries.example: The integration of these two systems will save us time.
entries.exampleZh: 这两个系统的整合将为我们节省时间。

entries.example: That guy at the front desk was very helpful.
entries.exampleZh: 前台那个小伙子非常乐于助人。

entries.meaning: 猛烈， 激烈； 暴力
entries.example: The storm hit the coast with terrible violence.
entries.exampleZh: 那场风暴以可怕的威力袭击了海岸。

entries.example: A friendly cop helped us find the train station.
entries.exampleZh: 一位友好的警察帮我们找到了火车站。

entries.example: The young lad carried his father's bag to the car.
entries.exampleZh: 那个小男孩把他父亲的包搬到了车上。

entries.meaning: 蜂拥而出；洋溢，奔放；汹涌，奔腾；大浪， 波涛；
entries.example: A sudden surge of electricity damaged the old computer.
entries.exampleZh: 一股突然的电流损坏了旧电脑。

entries.meaning: 当…导师， 当…家庭教师；导师；家庭教师，私人教
entries.example: My tutor helps me with math every Tuesday afternoon.
entries.exampleZh: 我的家庭教师每周二下午帮我学数学。

entries.example: The senator spoke to the crowd about the new law.
entries.exampleZh: 那位参议员向人群谈论了新法律。

entries.example: After the long walk, the children were very thirsty.
entries.exampleZh: 走了很长的路后，孩子们非常渴。

entries.example: It is our obligation to keep the park clean.
entries.exampleZh: 保持公园清洁是我们的义务。

entries.meaning: 战争，斗争，格斗；与…斗争， 与…战斗
entries.example: Soldiers train hard to combat fear during dangerous missions.
entries.exampleZh: 士兵们刻苦训练，以在危险任务中与恐惧作斗争。

entries.example: The victim reported the stolen bike to the local police.
entries.exampleZh: 受害者向当地警方报告了自行车被盗。

entries.example: Please add some garlic to the soup for more flavor.
entries.exampleZh: 请往汤里加点大蒜，让它更有味道。

entries.meaning: 极好的， 极出色的， 了不起的； 极大的； 难以
entries.example: We had a fantastic time at the beach yesterday.
entries.exampleZh: 我们昨天在海滩玩得非常开心。

entries.example: The shop has a large supply of fresh fruit today.
entries.exampleZh: 这家商店今天有大量新鲜水果供应。

entries.meaning: 秘密的， 机密的； 亲信的
entries.example: Please keep this confidential report away from other people.
entries.exampleZh: 请把这份机密报告放在别人看不到的地方。

entries.example: The heavy snow caused chaos at the airport this morning.
entries.exampleZh: 大雪今天早上在机场造成了混乱。

entries.meaning: 暗示，信号；提示；提示； 暗示
entries.example: Wait for my cue before you start the music.
entries.exampleZh: 等我给你提示后再开始放音乐。

entries.example: We climbed the hill to watch the sunrise together.
entries.exampleZh: 我们一起爬上山去看日出。

entries.example: Many wild animals starve when the winter is long and very cold.
entries.exampleZh: 当冬天漫长又寒冷时，许多野生动物会饿死。

entries.meaning: 通货， 货币； 通行， 流行
entries.example: The local currency is strong, so tourists can buy many things here.
entries.exampleZh: 当地货币很坚挺，所以游客在这里能买很多东西。

entries.meaning: 法律， 法规； 立法， 法律的制定
entries.example: New legislation protects workers who must travel far to their jobs.
entries.exampleZh: 新法规保护那些必须长途通勤去上班的工人。

entries.meaning: 条款； 从句， 分句
entries.example: Please read the last clause before you sign this rental agreement.
entries.exampleZh: 在签署这份租赁协议之前，请阅读最后一条条款。

entries.meaning: 智力竞赛，问答比赛；小测验；考查， 盘问
entries.example: Our teacher gave us a short quiz about the history of China.
entries.exampleZh: 老师给我们做了一次关于中国历史的简短小测验。

entries.meaning: 过剩的， 多余的；过剩，剩余，盈余
entries.example: The farm had a surplus of apples, so they sold them cheaply.
entries.exampleZh: 农场苹果过剩，所以他们便宜地卖掉了。

entries.meaning: 信件， 函件； 通信， 通信联系； 符合， 一致
entries.example: She keeps all her business correspondence in a locked wooden box.
entries.exampleZh: 她把所有商业信件都保存在一个上锁的木箱里。

entries.meaning: 宣布， 宣告； 宣言， 声明； 申报
entries.example: His public declaration of love surprised everyone in the small room.
entries.exampleZh: 他公开的爱情宣言让小屋里的每个人都感到惊讶。

entries.meaning: 祷告， 祈祷； 祷文； 祈求， 祈望
entries.example: She said a quiet prayer before the long and difficult exam began.
entries.exampleZh: 在漫长而艰难的考试开始前，她静静地做了一次祷告。

entries.meaning: 迷人的特性，魅力；符咒，咒文；吸引， 迷住
entries.example: The old village has a special charm that visitors always remember.
entries.exampleZh: 这个古老的村庄有一种特别的魅力，游客总是记得。

entries.meaning: 欺骗； 诡计， 骗局
entries.example: His kind smile was only a deception to hide his real plan.
entries.exampleZh: 他和善的微笑只是掩饰真实计划的欺骗手段。

entries.meaning: 规定的，特定的；假设的；已知的；有癖好的，有倾向
entries.example: Under the given rules, students may not use phones during class.
entries.exampleZh: 在规定的规则下，学生上课时不得使用手机。

entries.example: We asked a solicitor to check the papers before we signed them.
entries.exampleZh: 我们请了一位律师在我们签字前检查这些文件。

entries.meaning: 胡椒，胡椒粉；在…上撒； 使布满
entries.example: Add some salt and pepper to the soup and stir it well.
entries.exampleZh: 在汤里加些盐和胡椒，然后好好搅拌。

entries.example: He is writing his doctoral thesis about ancient Chinese poetry.
entries.exampleZh: 他正在写关于中国古代诗歌的博士论文。

entries.example: She showed us a short video about life under the sea.
entries.exampleZh: 她给我们看了一段关于海底生活的短片。

entries.example: The police found a strange weapon hidden under the old bed.
entries.exampleZh: 警方在老床下发现了一件奇怪的武器。

entries.example: Do not stare at people on the bus; it makes them uncomfortable.
entries.exampleZh: 不要在公交车上盯着别人看，那会让他们不舒服。

entries.meaning: 圆心， 正中； 中心
entries.example: There is a small fountain in the center of the town square.
entries.exampleZh: 在城镇广场的中心有一个小喷泉。

entries.meaning: 【生物】 属的， 类的； 一般的， 普通的
entries.example: This generic medicine works as well as the more costly brand.
entries.exampleZh: 这种普通的药和那个更贵的牌子一样有效。

entries.meaning: 画室， 摄影室； 播音室， 录音室， 摄影棚
entries.example: She paints large pictures in a quiet studio near the river.
entries.exampleZh: 她在河边一间安静的工作室里画大幅画。

entries.meaning: 谁； 无论谁； 究竟是谁
entries.example: I will give this book to whoever wants it.
entries.exampleZh: 我会把这本书给任何想要它的人。

entries.meaning: 特别地， 特定地； 明确地， 具体地
entries.example: This book is specifically written for young readers who love animals.
entries.exampleZh: 这本书是专门为喜欢动物的年轻读者写的。

entries.meaning: 引起争论的， 有争议的
entries.example: The new school rule is controversial among many parents this year.
entries.exampleZh: 这项新校规今年在许多家长中引起争议。

entries.meaning: 副职， 副手； 代表， 代理人
entries.example: The deputy manager will lead the meeting while she is away.
entries.exampleZh: 她不在时，副经理将主持会议。

entries.example: Regular hand washing is a simple preventive habit for everyone.
entries.exampleZh: 经常洗手是每个人都能做到的一个简单预防习惯。

entries.meaning: 分配， 分派， 把…拨给
entries.example: The teacher will allocate ten minutes for questions at the end.
entries.exampleZh: 老师将在最后分配十分钟用于提问。

entries.example: The main theme of the story is love and friendship.
entries.exampleZh: 这个故事的主题是爱与友谊。

entries.meaning: 粉碎，打烂；狠打，猛击；破灭，失败；猛撞，猛冲；
entries.example: The loud smash of the glass woke everyone in the house.
entries.exampleZh: 玻璃的响亮碎裂声吵醒了屋里的每个人。

entries.meaning: 财富， 财产； 丰富
entries.example: His great wealth did not bring him true happiness or peace.
entries.exampleZh: 他巨大的财富并没有给他带来真正的幸福或平静。

entries.example: We missed the last bus and unfortunately had to walk home.
entries.exampleZh: 我们错过了末班车，不幸的是只好步行回家。

entries.meaning: 异种， 异质， 不同成分
entries.example: The heterogeneity of the student group makes teaching both interesting and hard.
entries.exampleZh: 学生群体的异质性使教学既有趣又困难。

entries.example: The two small towns formed an alliance to share water and power.
entries.exampleZh: 两个小镇结成联盟以共享水和电力。

entries.example: She fell on the ice and hurt her left hip badly.
entries.exampleZh: 她在冰上摔倒，严重伤到了左髋部。

entries.meaning: 设计，安排；格式，样式，版式；使格式化
entries.example: Please save the file in the format your teacher asked for.
entries.exampleZh: 请按你老师要求的格式保存文件。

entries.example: The salesman explained how the new machine could save us time.
entries.exampleZh: 推销员解释了这台新机器如何能节省我们的时间。

entries.meaning: 四轮马车， 大篷车； 铁路货车， 客货两用车
entries.example: The farmer loaded hay onto the old wooden wagon.
entries.exampleZh: 农夫把干草装到那辆旧木车上。

entries.meaning: 碳酸钠， 纯碱； 汽水， 苏打水
entries.example: I bought a cold soda and a sandwich for lunch today.
entries.exampleZh: 我今天午饭买了一杯冷苏打水和一份三明治。

entries.example: The school offers special help for children with developmental problems.
entries.exampleZh: 学校为有发育问题的儿童提供特别帮助。

entries.example: Her compassion for animals led her to work at the shelter.
entries.exampleZh: 她对动物的同情心使她到收容所工作。

entries.example: My dental appointment is on Friday morning at the city clinic.
entries.exampleZh: 我的牙科预约在周五上午，地点是市里的诊所。

entries.example: The story was too predictable, so the children guessed the ending early.
entries.exampleZh: 这个故事太容易预料了，所以孩子们很早就猜到了结局。

entries.meaning: 集合， 团结； 恢复， 重新振作；集会；公路汽车
entries.example: The school held a rally to support the local food bank.
entries.exampleZh: 学校举办了一场集会来支持当地的食品银行。

entries.meaning: 侧面；人物简介；轮廓，形象；姿态，引人注目的状态
entries.example: Her online profile shows a photo and a short description of her work.
entries.exampleZh: 她的网上个人资料展示了一张照片和一段关于她工作的简短介绍。

entries.meaning: 无论哪个， 无论哪些
entries.example: You can take whichever seat you like near the window.
entries.exampleZh: 你可以坐窗边任何一个你喜欢的座位。

entries.meaning: 多重性； 兼职， 兼任
entries.example: The city's cultural pluralism makes it a lively place to live.
entries.exampleZh: 这座城市的文化多元性使它成为一个充满活力的居住地。

entries.example: His involvement in the project helped the whole team finish on time.
entries.exampleZh: 他对这个项目的参与帮助整个团队按时完成了任务。

entries.meaning: 听力， 听觉； 听力所及之距离； 意见听取会；
entries.example: Her hearing is very sharp, so she notices every small sound.
entries.exampleZh: 她的听力非常敏锐，所以能注意到每一个细微的声音。

entries.meaning: 取得， 获得， 习得； 获得物， 增添的人
entries.example: The library announced the acquisition of many new children's books.
entries.exampleZh: 图书馆宣布购置了许多新的儿童读物。

entries.meaning: 屑片， 碎片； 炸土豆条； 集成电路片， 集成块
entries.example: A small chip of wood fell onto the clean floor.
entries.exampleZh: 一小片木屑掉到了干净的地板上。

entries.example: My aunt works as an accountant in a large bank downtown.
entries.exampleZh: 我姑妈在市中心一家大银行做会计。

entries.example: The park offers many recreational activities for families during the summer.
entries.exampleZh: 这个公园在夏天为家庭提供许多娱乐活动。

entries.example: Please put the date in a bracket after the title.
entries.exampleZh: 请在标题后面的括号里写上日期。

entries.meaning: 确信； 坚定的信仰； 说服， 信服； 定罪， 判
entries.example: She spoke with deep conviction about the need for clean water.
entries.exampleZh: 她满怀坚定信念地谈到清洁用水的必要性。

entries.meaning: 认为， 估计； 指望， 盼望； 测算， 测量
entries.example: I reckon we will need more chairs for the meeting.
entries.exampleZh: 我估计我们开会还需要更多椅子。

entries.meaning: 标题， 题目； 称号， 头衔； 权利， 权益
entries.example: The title of her new book is quite long and strange.
entries.exampleZh: 她那本新书的标题又长又奇怪。

entries.meaning: [用于加强语气]非常，很；[用于加强语气]非常的
entries.example: He was bloody tired after the long walk home.
entries.exampleZh: 长途步行回家后他累极了。

entries.meaning: 拼字， 拼法， 拼写法
entries.example: Our teacher gave us a short spelling test this morning.
entries.exampleZh: 今天早上老师给我们做了一次简短的拼写测验。

entries.example: The priest spoke kindly to everyone after the Sunday service.
entries.exampleZh: 周日礼拜后，神父和蔼地和大家交谈。

entries.meaning: 宇宙， 世界； 领域， 范围
entries.example: Scientists study the universe to learn how stars and planets form.
entries.exampleZh: 科学家研究宇宙，以了解恒星和行星如何形成。

entries.meaning: 壮观的，引人注目的；壮观的演出； 惊人之举
entries.example: The view from the mountain was spectacular at sunset.
entries.exampleZh: 日落时从山上看到的景色非常壮观。

entries.meaning: 不能征服的， 无敌的
entries.example: Our team felt invincible after winning three games in a row.
entries.exampleZh: 我们队连赢三场后觉得自己不可战胜。

entries.meaning: 厚厚地；厚的，密的，浓的；不清楚的，口音重的
entries.example: A thick blanket of snow covered the entire garden last night.
entries.exampleZh: 昨晚一层厚厚的雪覆盖了整个花园。

entries.example: He sat on the porch and slowly smoked a cigar.
entries.exampleZh: 他坐在门廊上慢慢地抽着一支雪茄。

entries.example: The new stadium will open to the public next month.
entries.exampleZh: 新体育场将于下个月向公众开放。

entries.meaning: 然而， 但是， 尽管
entries.example: I enjoy tea, whereas my brother only drinks coffee.
entries.exampleZh: 我喜欢茶，而我弟弟只喝咖啡。

entries.meaning: 收养关系的； 采用的
entries.example: Her adoptive parents moved to a small town last year.
entries.exampleZh: 她的养父母去年搬到了一个小镇。

entries.meaning: 在地下，往地下；秘密地，不公开地；地下的；秘密的
entries.example: The city built a new underground station near the river.
entries.exampleZh: 这座城市在河边建了一个新的地下车站。

entries.example: My cousin plays baseball every Saturday with his friends.
entries.exampleZh: 我表哥每周六都和朋友打棒球。

entries.example: The factory bought new machinery to increase its production speed.
entries.exampleZh: 工厂购买了新机器以提高生产速度。

entries.meaning: 推断结果， 结论； 推论， 推理， 推断
entries.example: From these facts, we can draw a careful inference.
entries.exampleZh: 根据这些事实，我们可以得出一个谨慎的推断。

entries.meaning: 通知， 告知， 报告
entries.example: Please notify the office if your address changes.
entries.exampleZh: 如果你的地址有变，请通知办公室。

entries.meaning: 流出， 涌出；河，溪流；一股，一串
entries.example: A clear stream runs behind our old farmhouse.
entries.exampleZh: 一条清澈的小溪流过我们老农舍的后面。

entries.meaning: 起伏，隆起；呕吐，恶心；举起，提起，拉起，拖；扔
entries.example: They had to heave the heavy box up the stairs.
entries.exampleZh: 他们不得不把那个重箱子抬上楼梯。

entries.example: Fresh vegetables and fruit nourish the body and keep us healthy.
entries.exampleZh: 新鲜的蔬菜和水果滋养身体，让我们保持健康。

entries.example: Tall trees surround the lake on all sides.
entries.exampleZh: 高大的树木环绕着湖的四周。

entries.meaning: 香烟， 纸烟， 卷烟
entries.example: The man put out his cigarette before entering the building.
entries.exampleZh: 那个男人在进入大楼前熄灭了香烟。

entries.example: The refugee found a safe home in a new country.
entries.exampleZh: 这名难民在一个新国家找到了安全的家。

entries.meaning: 可比较的； 类似的； 比得上的
entries.example: The two phones are comparable in price and screen size.
entries.exampleZh: 这两部手机在价格和屏幕尺寸上相当。

entries.meaning: 大概， 可能， 据推测
entries.example: The train is late, so presumably we will miss dinner.
entries.exampleZh: 火车晚点了，所以大概我们会错过晚饭。

entries.meaning: 题目； 学科； 主语；使隶属
entries.example: My favourite subject at school is history.
entries.exampleZh: 我在学校最喜欢的科目是历史。

entries.example: Green plants give us oxygen and help keep the air clean.
entries.exampleZh: 绿色植物为我们提供氧气，并帮助保持空气清洁。

entries.meaning: 举止， 风度； 方位， 方向感； 影响
entries.example: His calm and cheerful bearing made everyone feel welcome here.
entries.exampleZh: 他沉着而愉快的举止让每个人都感到受欢迎。

entries.example: We watched a funny comedy about a small village.
entries.exampleZh: 我们看了一部关于小村庄的搞笑喜剧。

entries.meaning: 垃圾，废物；拙劣的文学作品；没用的人，社会渣滓，
entries.example: Please put your trash in the bin outside.
entries.exampleZh: 请把垃圾放进外面的垃圾桶里。

entries.example: A company spokesman answered questions after the meeting.
entries.exampleZh: 一位公司发言人在会议后回答了问题。

entries.meaning: 循环； 流传； 发行， 流通
entries.example: Regular exercise improves blood circulation in your body.
entries.exampleZh: 经常锻炼能改善你体内的血液循环。

entries.meaning: 郊区， 郊外， 近郊
entries.example: They moved to a quiet suburb near the river.
entries.exampleZh: 他们搬到了河边一个安静的郊区。

entries.example: The writer spent three years on this book.
entries.exampleZh: 这位作家在这本书上花了三年时间。

entries.example: We heard a loud scream from the garden.
entries.exampleZh: 我们听到花园里传来一声尖叫。

entries.example: Everyone has at least one shortcoming they want to change.
entries.exampleZh: 每个人至少有一个想改掉的缺点。

entries.meaning: 全球的， 全世界的； 总的， 完整的
entries.example: The internet makes global communication fast and easy today.
entries.exampleZh: 互联网使如今的全球交流变得快捷方便。

entries.example: A lone wolf walked slowly across the snowy field.
entries.exampleZh: 一匹孤狼慢慢走过雪地。

entries.example: He gave a small shrug and said nothing.
entries.exampleZh: 他轻轻耸了耸肩，什么也没说。

entries.example: Good coordination between teams makes the work much faster.
entries.exampleZh: 团队之间良好的协调使工作快得多。

entries.meaning: 提供， 显示； 外观， 图像； 授予， 赠送；
entries.example: She gave a short presentation about our new project.
entries.exampleZh: 她就我们的新项目做了一个简短的演示。

entries.example: Heavy rain may ruin our picnic this afternoon.
entries.exampleZh: 今天下午的大雨可能会破坏我们的野餐。

entries.example: Twenty dollars is still owing on your account.
entries.exampleZh: 你的账户上还欠二十美元。

entries.meaning: 业余爱好的， 业余的； 外行的；业余爱好者；外行
entries.example: He plays football as an amateur on weekends.
entries.exampleZh: 他周末作为业余爱好者踢足球。

entries.example: Please ask a nurse if you need any assistance.
entries.exampleZh: 如果你需要任何帮助，请询问护士。

entries.meaning: 概括的， 概要的； 实时的， 即决的；摘要，概要
entries.example: The teacher asked us to write a short summary of the story.
entries.exampleZh: 老师让我们写一个简短的故事摘要。

entries.example: He plays the guitar every evening after dinner with his friends.
entries.exampleZh: 他每天晚饭后和朋友们弹吉他。

entries.example: The children played outside in the warm sunshine all afternoon.
entries.exampleZh: 孩子们整个下午都在温暖的阳光下玩耍。

entries.meaning: 阳台； 楼厅， 楼座
entries.example: We drank tea on the balcony and watched the sunset.
entries.exampleZh: 我们在阳台上喝茶并看日落。

entries.meaning: 合作的， 协作的， 协力完成的
entries.example: Our team finished the collaborative project ahead of schedule.
entries.exampleZh: 我们团队提前完成了这个合作项目。

entries.example: I will always cherish the memories of our summer trip.
entries.exampleZh: 我会永远珍惜我们夏日旅行的回忆。

entries.example: We decided not to prolong the meeting after lunch.
entries.exampleZh: 我们决定午饭后不延长会议。

entries.example: She raised her thumb to ask for a ride.
entries.exampleZh: 她竖起拇指请求搭车。

entries.meaning: 共和政体的；共和党的；共和党人
entries.example: The republican candidate spoke about taxes at the town meeting.
entries.exampleZh: 这位共和党候选人在镇民会议上谈到了税收。

entries.example: Her writing is clear and easy for young readers to follow.
entries.exampleZh: 她的写作清晰易懂，适合年轻读者。

entries.meaning: 在旁边，沿着边，并排地；在…旁边， 沿着…的边；
entries.example: A small cafe stands alongside the river near the old bridge.
entries.exampleZh: 一家小咖啡馆位于老桥附近的河边。

entries.meaning: 礼券， 优惠券， 配给券； 联票； 票证
entries.example: I used a coupon to buy this shirt at a lower price.
entries.exampleZh: 我用一张优惠券以更低的价格买了这件衬衫。

entries.meaning: 迷人的， 有极大吸引力的
entries.example: The museum has a fascinating display about ancient Egyptian life.
entries.exampleZh: 博物馆有一个关于古埃及生活的迷人展览。

entries.example: The first item on our agenda is the new budget.
entries.exampleZh: 我们议程上的第一项是新预算。

entries.meaning: 献身， 奉献； 忠实； 热爱； 虔诚
entries.example: Her devotion to teaching inspired many students over the years.
entries.exampleZh: 她对教学的热忱多年来激励了许多学生。

entries.meaning: 匿名的； 无名的； 无特色的
entries.example: An anonymous donor gave the school a new computer room.
entries.exampleZh: 一位匿名捐赠者给学校捐了一间新电脑室。

entries.meaning: 四倍， 四重；四倍的，四重的
entries.example: The company's profits increased fourfold in just three years.
entries.exampleZh: 这家公司的利润在短短三年内增长到原来的四倍。

entries.meaning: 公众的注意， 名声； 宣传， 宣扬
entries.example: The new film received a lot of publicity before its release.
entries.exampleZh: 这部新电影在上映前获得了大量宣传。

entries.meaning: 相等的， 一致的， 依…而定的
entries.example: Everything went according to plan during the school trip.
entries.exampleZh: 学校旅行期间一切按计划进行。

entries.meaning: 会员身份， 会籍； 全体会员， 会员数
entries.example: My membership at the sports club ends next month.
entries.exampleZh: 我在体育俱乐部的会员资格下个月到期。

entries.example: The city has changed a lot since its modernization began ten years ago.
entries.exampleZh: 自从十年前开始现代化以来，这座城市变化很大。

entries.example: She studies criminology at a large university in the north.
entries.exampleZh: 她在北方一所大型大学学习犯罪学。

entries.example: The new school rule caused a lot of controversy among parents.
entries.exampleZh: 这条新校规在家长中引起了很大争议。

entries.example: I bought a newspaper from a small newsstand near the station.
entries.exampleZh: 我在车站附近的一个小报摊买了一份报纸。

entries.meaning: 大使， 使节， 派驻国际组织的代表
entries.example: The ambassador spoke to the students about life in another country.
entries.exampleZh: 大使向学生们讲述了另一个国家的生活。

entries.meaning: 风景，景色；风景画；全景；美化…的景观
entries.example: The mountain landscape looked beautiful in the soft morning light.
entries.exampleZh: 在柔和的晨光中，山间景色看起来很美。

entries.meaning: 体谅的， 宽容的， 通情达理的；理解，理解力；谅
entries.example: Her understanding of the problem helped the whole team move forward.
entries.exampleZh: 她对问题的理解帮助整个团队向前推进。

entries.example: The little girl believed a fairy lived in the garden.
entries.exampleZh: 小女孩相信花园里住着一个小仙子。

entries.example: Children played games in the quiet courtyard behind the old house.
entries.exampleZh: 孩子们在老房子后面安静的庭院里玩游戏。

entries.example: You can use my bike providing you bring it back tonight.
entries.exampleZh: 你可以用我的自行车，前提是你今晚把它还回来。

entries.example: We should minimize noise while the baby is sleeping.
entries.exampleZh: 宝宝睡觉时我们应该尽量减小噪音。

entries.example: She left her handbag on the chair next to the door.
entries.exampleZh: 她把她的手提包落在门边的椅子上。

entries.meaning: 浅的；浅薄的；浅滩， 浅水处
entries.example: The river is shallow here, so children can play safely.
entries.exampleZh: 这条河这里很浅，所以孩子们可以安全地玩耍。

entries.meaning: 租约，租契；出租； 租得， 租有
entries.example: They signed a two-year lease for the apartment near the park.
entries.exampleZh: 他们为公园附近的公寓签了一份两年的租约。

entries.meaning: 掴，掌击，拍；啪的一声放；掴， 掌击， 拍
entries.example: He gave the table a light slap to get attention.
entries.exampleZh: 他轻轻拍了一下桌子以引起注意。

entries.meaning: 吐唾沫，吐出；唾沫， 唾液
entries.example: Please do not spit on the street; it is rude.
entries.exampleZh: 请不要在街上吐痰；这很不礼貌。

entries.example: My parents will celebrate their thirtieth anniversary next month.
entries.exampleZh: 我父母下个月将庆祝他们的三十周年纪念日。

entries.meaning: 劝诱的； 有说服力的
entries.example: Her persuasive speech made many people change their minds.
entries.exampleZh: 她富有说服力的演讲让许多人改变了想法。

entries.meaning: 尊敬；尊重；问候；方面；尊敬； 尊重
entries.example: We should show respect to people from different cultures.
entries.exampleZh: 我们应该尊重来自不同文化的人。

entries.meaning: 壳，贝壳；外壳，框架；炮弹；剥…的壳； 炮击
entries.example: The child picked up a white shell on the beach.
entries.exampleZh: 孩子在沙滩上捡起了一个白色的贝壳。

entries.meaning: 垮， 衰竭； 损坏， 故障； 倒塌
entries.example: The old car had a breakdown on the way to town.
entries.exampleZh: 那辆旧车在去镇上的路上抛锚了。

entries.example: She wore blue jeans and a white shirt to the party.
entries.exampleZh: 她穿蓝色牛仔裤和白色衬衫去参加聚会。

entries.meaning: 水库， 蓄水池； 储藏， 汇集
entries.example: The city built a new reservoir to store water for summer.
entries.exampleZh: 这座城市建了一座新水库，为夏天储水。

entries.example: The writer kept the copyright for all of her books.
entries.exampleZh: 这位作家保留了她所有书籍的版权。

entries.example: Modern biotechnology helps farmers grow stronger plants with less water.
entries.exampleZh: 现代生物技术帮助农民用更少的水种植更强壮的植物。

entries.meaning: 包租的， 租用的；宪章，共同纲领；特许状，许可证
entries.example: The group wrote a charter with clear rules for its members.
entries.exampleZh: 该团体写了一份附有明确规则的章程。

entries.meaning: 苗条的；薄的；少的；减轻体重， 变苗条
entries.example: My sister wants to slim down before her summer holiday.
entries.exampleZh: 我妹妹想在暑假前瘦下来。

entries.example: The succeeding chapter explains how the machine works.
entries.exampleZh: 接下来的那一章解释了这台机器如何运作。

entries.meaning: 观点， 看法， 见解
entries.example: From my viewpoint, the new plan is too expensive.
entries.exampleZh: 在我看来，新计划太贵了。

entries.meaning: 人行横道， 交叉口； 横渡
entries.example: Please use the crossing near the school on your way home.
entries.exampleZh: 请在你回家的路上使用学校附近的人行横道。

entries.meaning: 剧本， 广播稿； 书写用的字母； 笔迹， 手迹
entries.example: The actor read the script before the first day of filming.
entries.exampleZh: 演员在拍摄第一天之前读了剧本。

entries.meaning: 系统； 制度， 体制； 方法， 做法； 身体
entries.example: Our school system gives students many choices each year.
entries.exampleZh: 我们的学校制度每年给学生许多选择。

entries.meaning: 点，斑点；地点，处所；少量；认出， 发现； 玷污
entries.example: There is a small spot on your blue shirt.
entries.exampleZh: 你的蓝衬衫上有一个小斑点。

entries.example: We plan to take a long vacation by the sea.
entries.exampleZh: 我们计划去海边度一个长假。

entries.example: The school added coding to its curriculum this year.
entries.exampleZh: 学校今年把编程加入了课程。

entries.meaning: 滑跤，滑落，溜；下降，跌落；悄悄放进；疏漏， 差
entries.example: Be careful not to slip on the wet floor.
entries.exampleZh: 小心别在湿滑的地板上滑倒。

entries.example: This rare species lives only in the mountains of Asia.
entries.exampleZh: 这种稀有物种只生活在亚洲的山区。

entries.meaning: 实习生身份； 实习医师期
entries.example: She found an internship at a local newspaper this summer.
entries.exampleZh: 今年夏天她在一家当地报社找到了实习机会。

entries.meaning: 土地， 住宅区， 地产； 财产， 遗产； 庄园，
entries.example: The old estate has a large garden and many trees.
entries.exampleZh: 这座旧庄园有一个大花园和许多树木。

entries.example: There is a rumour that the shop will close soon.
entries.exampleZh: 有传言说这家商店很快就会关门。

entries.example: Two men tried to rob the small bank near my house.
entries.exampleZh: 两个男人试图抢劫我家附近的那家小银行。

entries.meaning: 较老的，年长的；到了晚年的人， 老年人
entries.example: My elderly neighbor needs help carrying her heavy bags upstairs.
entries.exampleZh: 我年长的邻居需要帮忙把她沉重的袋子搬上楼。

entries.meaning: 新闻媒介， 传播媒介
entries.example: The news media reported the story on every channel last night.
entries.exampleZh: 新闻媒体昨晚在每个频道都报道了这件事。

entries.meaning: 根本的，基本的；激进的，激进派的；激进分子
entries.example: Some radical ideas can frighten people who prefer the old ways.
entries.exampleZh: 一些激进的想法会吓到喜欢旧方式的人。

entries.example: She plans to study abroad during the next semester.
entries.exampleZh: 她打算下学期出国学习。

entries.meaning: 让步， 妥协； 特许， 特许权； 承认， 认可
entries.example: The manager made a small concession to keep the workers happy.
entries.exampleZh: 为了让大家高兴，经理做出了一个小小的让步。

entries.meaning: 选举的，有选举权的；可任意选择的；选修课程
entries.example: My favorite course this term is an elective about modern art.
entries.exampleZh: 这学期我最喜欢的课程是一门关于现代艺术的选修课。

entries.example: His angry accusation surprised everyone in the quiet meeting room.
entries.exampleZh: 他愤怒的指责让安静的会议室里所有人都很吃惊。

entries.meaning: 奢华的，高级的；独有的，独享的；排斥的，排他的；
entries.example: This exclusive club only accepts members with very old names.
entries.exampleZh: 这家高档俱乐部只接纳有古老家族背景的会员。

entries.meaning: 房屋， 住宅； 住房建筑， 住房供给； 外壳，
entries.example: The city needs more housing for young families and students.
entries.exampleZh: 这座城市需要为年轻家庭和学生提供更多的住房。

entries.meaning: 概念， 观念； 意图， 想法， 念头
entries.example: He had no notion of how hard the test would be.
entries.exampleZh: 他完全不知道这场考试会有多难。

entries.example: Add one gram of salt to the soup and stir it.
entries.exampleZh: 往汤里加一克盐，然后搅拌一下。

entries.example: Good teachers empower students to ask their own questions.
entries.exampleZh: 好的老师能让学生有能力提出自己的问题。

entries.meaning: 令人厌烦的， 乏味的， 无聊的
entries.example: The film was so boring that I fell asleep twice.
entries.exampleZh: 这部电影太无聊了，我睡了两次。

entries.meaning: 最优秀的，典型的，标准的；传统式样的，典雅的；文
entries.example: This novel is a classic of modern Chinese literature.
entries.exampleZh: 这部小说是中国现代文学的一部经典。

entries.example: She began to rub her eyes when the light turned on.
entries.exampleZh: 灯亮起来时，她开始揉眼睛。

entries.example: A wealthy businessman donated a new library to our school.
entries.exampleZh: 一位富有的商人向我们学校捐了一座新图书馆。

entries.example: This segment of the road is closed for repairs today.
entries.exampleZh: 今天这段路因维修而封闭。

entries.meaning: 统计数值， 统计资料； 统计学
entries.example: One statistic shows that more people walk to work now.
entries.exampleZh: 一项统计数据显示，现在有更多人步行上班。

entries.example: The view from the mountain top was simply superb.
entries.exampleZh: 从山顶看到的景色简直棒极了。

entries.meaning: 霉，霉菌；模型，铸模；性格；用模子制作， 塑造；
entries.example: A dark mold grows on the old bread in the kitchen.
entries.exampleZh: 厨房里那块旧面包上长着黑色的霉菌。

entries.meaning: [用于否定句中以加强语气]任何； 无论什么
entries.example: You can choose whatever drink you like from the menu.
entries.exampleZh: 你可以从菜单上选择任何你喜欢的饮料。

entries.meaning: 自愿提供； 自愿， 志愿；志愿者；志愿兵
entries.example: My sister will volunteer at the animal shelter this Saturday.
entries.exampleZh: 我姐姐这个星期六会去动物收容所做志愿者。

entries.meaning: 激增， 繁荣， 迅速发展； 发出隆隆声；激增，繁
entries.example: The city saw a boom in new shops last year.
entries.exampleZh: 去年这座城市新商店的数量激增。

entries.meaning: 最高点， 峰顶； 最高级会议
entries.example: The climbers reached the snowy summit before noon.
entries.exampleZh: 登山者在中午前到达了白雪覆盖的峰顶。

entries.meaning: 结盟， 联合；同盟国， 同盟者； 支持者
entries.example: France was a strong ally during the long war.
entries.exampleZh: 在漫长的战争中，法国是一个强大的盟友。

entries.meaning: 陈述， 声明； 结算单， 报表
entries.example: The manager read a short statement to the waiting reporters.
entries.exampleZh: 经理向等候的记者宣读了一份简短声明。

entries.meaning: 目标；把…作为目标； 瞄准
entries.example: The arrow hit the target near the center.
entries.exampleZh: 箭射中了靠近中心的靶子。

entries.example: I am truly sorry for the trouble I caused.
entries.exampleZh: 我对我造成的麻烦深感抱歉。

entries.example: A single gene can affect the color of your eyes.
entries.exampleZh: 一个基因可以影响你眼睛的颜色。

entries.example: The film sadly shows a young man thinking about suicide.
entries.exampleZh: 这部电影令人难过地展示了一个年轻人想着自杀。

entries.meaning: 节省， 节约； 储蓄金， 存款
entries.example: Her monthly saving helped her buy a small car.
entries.exampleZh: 她每月的储蓄帮助她买了一辆小汽车。

entries.example: The belt around his waist was too tight.
entries.exampleZh: 他腰上的腰带太紧了。

entries.example: There is a weak connexion between the two radio towers.
entries.exampleZh: 两座无线电塔之间的联系很弱。

entries.example: My mother will scold me if I come home late.
entries.exampleZh: 如果我回家晚了，我妈妈会责骂我。

entries.meaning: 狂吹； 汹涌； 激烈进行； 发怒， 发火；狂怒，
entries.example: His sudden rage frightened the children in the room.
entries.exampleZh: 他突然的暴怒吓坏了房间里的孩子们。

entries.meaning: 礼仪， 礼节； 草案， 议定书
entries.example: The guests followed the protocol at the formal dinner.
entries.exampleZh: 客人们在正式晚宴上遵循了礼仪。

entries.example: We saw a huge whale jump out of the sea.
entries.exampleZh: 我们看到一头巨大的鲸跃出海面。

entries.example: She plays the violin in our school music group.
entries.exampleZh: 她在我们学校的音乐小组里拉小提琴。

entries.example: The workers began to remonstrate against the new rules.
entries.exampleZh: 工人们开始抗议新规定。

entries.meaning: 航游，巡航；缓慢巡行；航游， 游弋
entries.example: We took a short cruise along the coast last summer.
entries.exampleZh: 去年夏天我们沿着海岸进行了一次短途航游。

entries.meaning: 题目， 论题， 话题
entries.example: The topic of today's lesson is very interesting.
entries.exampleZh: 今天这节课的话题非常有趣。

entries.example: His erroneous answer made the whole class laugh.
entries.exampleZh: 他错误的回答让全班都笑了。

entries.meaning: 袭击； 突入查抄， 突入搜捕； 劫掠
entries.example: The sudden raid on the village frightened many people.
entries.exampleZh: 对村庄的突然袭击让许多人感到害怕。

entries.example: My little sister started kindergarten at a new school this September.
entries.exampleZh: 我妹妹今年九月在一所新学校开始上幼儿园。

entries.example: The cashier gave me the wrong change again.
entries.exampleZh: 收银员又给我找错了零钱。

entries.meaning: 垂直地，陡峭地；急转向， 偏离
entries.example: The small boat had to sheer away from the rocks.
entries.exampleZh: 小船不得不急转方向避开岩石。

entries.meaning: 抑郁， 沮丧； 不景气， 萧条； 洼地， 凹陷
entries.example: Many people lost their jobs during the economic depression.
entries.exampleZh: 在经济萧条期间，许多人失去了工作。

entries.example: The thief was sent to gaol for two years.
entries.exampleZh: 那个小偷被送进监狱两年。

entries.example: She added a little tomato sauce to the pasta.
entries.exampleZh: 她在意面里加了一点番茄酱。

entries.meaning: 起皱； 收缩； 退缩， 畏缩
entries.example: Wool sweaters may shrink if you wash them in hot water.
entries.exampleZh: 羊毛衫如果用热水洗可能会缩水。

entries.meaning: 竞争的， 比赛的； 好竞争的， 求胜心切的； 有
entries.example: The job market is very competitive these days.
entries.exampleZh: 如今就业市场的竞争非常激烈。

entries.example: I made an enquiry about the train times.
entries.exampleZh: 我询问了火车的时刻。

entries.example: Loud applause filled the hall after the performance.
entries.exampleZh: 演出结束后，大厅里响起了热烈的掌声。

entries.example: The old sailor told us stories about the sea.
entries.exampleZh: 那位老水手给我们讲了关于大海的故事。

entries.example: I called to enquire about the price of the tickets.
entries.exampleZh: 我打电话询问了票价。

entries.meaning: 普及， 流行； 声望
entries.example: The band's popularity grew quickly after their first song.
entries.exampleZh: 这支乐队的第一首歌之后人气迅速上升。

entries.example: The table in the dining room is oval.
entries.exampleZh: 餐厅里的那张桌子是椭圆形的。

entries.example: Our school tries to integrate new students into the class.
entries.exampleZh: 我们学校努力让新同学融入班级。

entries.example: The only survivor of the crash was a young child.
entries.exampleZh: 这场事故中唯一的生还者是一个年幼的孩子。

entries.example: The doctor could not diagnose her illness without more tests.
entries.exampleZh: 没有更多检查，医生无法诊断她的病。

entries.example: The spider made a small web between two green plants.
entries.exampleZh: 蜘蛛在两棵绿色植物之间结了一张小网。

entries.meaning: 吓， 使害怕； 受惊吓， 感到害怕；惊恐，恐慌
entries.example: The loud noise gave the little boy a big scare.
entries.exampleZh: 那声巨响把小男孩吓了一大跳。

entries.example: The old empty house looks really scary at night.
entries.exampleZh: 那座空荡荡的老房子在夜里看起来很吓人。

entries.example: She works for a small consultancy in the city center.
entries.exampleZh: 她在市中心一家小型咨询公司工作。

entries.meaning: 同种类的， 同性质的， 有相同特征的
entries.example: The group was fairly homogeneous in age and background.
entries.exampleZh: 这个群体在年龄和背景上相当一致。

entries.example: They hope to popularize the sport among young students.
entries.exampleZh: 他们希望在年轻学生中普及这项运动。

entries.meaning: 发生冲突；不协调；砰地相撞，发出刺耳的撞击声；冲
entries.example: The two teams clash again in the final next week.
entries.exampleZh: 两支队伍下周将在决赛中再次交锋。

entries.meaning: 批准，认可；批准， 认可； 约束因素， 约束力；
entries.example: The new rule needs official sanction before it can start.
entries.exampleZh: 新规定在开始实施前需要官方批准。

entries.meaning: 犯戒律， 犯过失；罪，罪孽
entries.example: Lying to your parents is a serious sin in many cultures.
entries.exampleZh: 在许多文化中，对父母撒谎是一种严重的罪过。

entries.meaning: 历史上著名的， 具有重大历史意义的
entries.example: The city held a historic meeting last spring.
entries.exampleZh: 这座城市去年春天举行了一次具有历史意义的会议。

entries.meaning: 精选的， 挑选出来的； 优等的， 第一流的；选择
entries.example: Please select three books from this list before Friday.
entries.exampleZh: 请在周五前从这份名单中挑选三本书。

entries.meaning: 履行， 实现， 完成； 满足， 使满意
entries.example: She worked hard to fulfill her dream of teaching children.
entries.exampleZh: 她努力实现了教孩子们读书的梦想。

entries.meaning: 显著的， 突出的； 惹人注目的， 容貌出众的
entries.example: Her new painting has a striking use of bright colors.
entries.exampleZh: 她的新画作对明亮色彩的运用十分醒目。

entries.meaning: 青年， 年轻人， 孩子
entries.example: Every youngster in the village plays football after school.
entries.exampleZh: 村里的每个孩子放学后都踢足球。

entries.meaning: 深思的， 有理性的；想法，意见，见解
entries.example: Her thinking on this subject changed after the trip.
entries.exampleZh: 旅行之后，她对这个问题的想法变了。

entries.meaning: 代表， 代表团成员；委派…为代表； 授 ， 把…
entries.example: Each country sent one delegate to the peace meeting.
entries.exampleZh: 每个国家派了一名代表参加和平会议。

entries.example: In our family, it is a tradition to eat together.
entries.exampleZh: 在我们家，一起吃饭是一个传统。

entries.meaning: 建议， 意见； 细微的迹象； 暗示
entries.example: Her suggestion about the new plan sounded very helpful.
entries.exampleZh: 她关于新计划的建议听起来很有帮助。

entries.meaning: 有系统的， 有计划的
entries.example: We need a systematic way to check all these numbers.
entries.exampleZh: 我们需要一种系统的方法来核对这些数字。

entries.example: He cooked bacon and eggs for breakfast on Sunday morning.
entries.exampleZh: 星期天早上他做了咸肉和鸡蛋当早餐。

entries.example: She let out a sigh when the long meeting finally ended.
entries.exampleZh: 漫长会议终于结束时，她叹了口气。

entries.meaning: 长裤， 便裤； 内裤
entries.example: These black pants are too long for me to wear.
entries.exampleZh: 这条黑色长裤太长了，我穿不了。

entries.example: My cousin studies astrophysics at a famous university in Canada.
entries.exampleZh: 我表弟在加拿大一所著名大学学习天体物理学。

entries.meaning: 消费者， 用户， 消耗者
entries.example: Every consumer should read the label before buying this medicine.
entries.exampleZh: 每位消费者在购买这种药之前都应阅读标签。

entries.meaning: 社会的； 交际的， 社交的
entries.example: She enjoys social events but needs quiet time on weekends.
entries.exampleZh: 她喜欢社交活动，但周末需要安静的时间。

entries.example: The doctor said this medication must be taken after dinner.
entries.exampleZh: 医生说这种药必须在晚饭后服用。

entries.meaning: 精神的， 心灵的； 宗教的
entries.example: Many people find spiritual meaning in nature and quiet walks.
entries.exampleZh: 许多人在大自然和安静的散步中找到精神上的意义。

entries.example: I made a fresh salad with tomatoes, lettuce, and cheese.
entries.exampleZh: 我做了一份新鲜的色拉，里面有西红柿、生菜和奶酪。

entries.meaning: 对全局有重要意义的， 关键的； 战略的
entries.example: The team made a strategic plan for the next three years.
entries.exampleZh: 团队为未来三年制定了战略计划。

entries.meaning: 乐意地， 欣然地； 容易地； 很快地， 立即
entries.example: He readily agreed to help us move the heavy boxes.
entries.exampleZh: 他欣然同意帮我们搬那些沉重的箱子。

entries.example: The garden looked splendid in the warm evening light.
entries.exampleZh: 花园在温暖的晚霞中显得格外壮丽。

entries.meaning: 回答者； 响应者； 被告
entries.example: Each respondent answered all the questions on the survey form.
entries.exampleZh: 每位回答者都回答了调查表上的所有问题。

entries.meaning: 一个事件； 插曲， 片段； 连续剧的一集
entries.example: The last episode of the series was really exciting.
entries.exampleZh: 这部剧的最后一集真的很精彩。

entries.example: He was evidently tired after working all day in the sun.
entries.exampleZh: 他在太阳下工作了一整天，显然很累了。

entries.example: Some people try to victimize those who seem weak or different.
entries.exampleZh: 有些人试图欺负那些看起来软弱或与众不同的人。

entries.meaning: 丑事， 丑闻； 流言蜚语； 反感， 愤慨
entries.example: The news about the bank scandal shocked many local people.
entries.exampleZh: 那起银行丑闻的新闻令许多当地人震惊。

entries.meaning: 令人恐惧的， 可怕的； 骇人听闻的； 极讨厌的，
entries.example: The food at that restaurant tasted horrible and made me sick.
entries.exampleZh: 那家餐馆的食物味道很糟糕，让我恶心。

entries.example: Swimming and hiking are popular forms of recreation in this area.
entries.exampleZh: 游泳和远足是这个地区很受欢迎的娱乐活动。

entries.meaning: 津贴， 补贴； 零用钱
entries.example: My parents give me a small allowance every month for bus fares.
entries.exampleZh: 父母每月给我一点零用钱用于公交车费。

entries.example: The attorney asked my sister a few simple questions.
entries.exampleZh: 律师问了我姐姐几个简单的问题。

entries.example: The old mainframe in our office still works perfectly.
entries.exampleZh: 我们办公室里的那台旧大型机仍然运行良好。

entries.example: The audio quality of this old radio is quite poor.
entries.exampleZh: 这台旧收音机的音质相当差。

entries.example: A teenager next door helps me carry heavy bags.
entries.exampleZh: 隔壁的一个青少年帮我搬重袋子。

entries.meaning: 冒犯的，无礼的；进攻的，攻击性的；进攻， 攻势
entries.example: His joke was offensive, so nobody laughed at it.
entries.exampleZh: 他的笑话很无礼，所以没有人笑。

entries.meaning: 卡通画， 幽默画； 动画片， 卡通片
entries.example: My little brother watches a cartoon every morning before school.
entries.exampleZh: 我弟弟每天早上上学前都看一部动画片。

entries.meaning: 推测， 推断； 投机， 做投机买卖
entries.example: Experts speculate that prices will rise again next year.
entries.exampleZh: 专家推测明年物价会再次上涨。

entries.meaning: 在…中间， 在…之中， 被…围绕
entries.example: She smiled amid the noise and busy crowd.
entries.exampleZh: 她在喧闹拥挤的人群中微笑着。

entries.meaning: 单一的；独身的；单程的；单程票；
entries.example: He bought a single ticket for the morning train.
entries.exampleZh: 他买了一张早班列车的单程票。

entries.example: Please acquaint yourself with the safety rules before we start.
entries.exampleZh: 在我们开始之前，请先熟悉一下安全规则。

entries.meaning: 干涉， 调停， 干预； 插入， 介入； 干扰，
entries.example: The teacher had to intervene when the boys began shouting.
entries.exampleZh: 当男孩们开始大喊时，老师不得不干预。

entries.meaning: 不平常的， 少有的； 独特的， 与众不同的
entries.example: It is unusual to see snow here in early spring.
entries.exampleZh: 在这里早春看到雪是不寻常的。

entries.meaning: 部门， 部分； 防御地段， 防区； 扇形
entries.example: She works in the private sector of the city bank.
entries.exampleZh: 她在城市银行的私营部门工作。

entries.meaning: 流行性的；传染的；流行病； 传播
entries.example: The flu epidemic kept many students away from class.
entries.exampleZh: 流感疫情使许多学生缺课。

entries.example: My cousin studies accountancy at a college near her home.
entries.exampleZh: 我表姐在她家附近的一所学院学习会计。

entries.meaning: 打制， 锻造； 伪造
entries.example: Someone tried to forge my name on the old letter.
entries.exampleZh: 有人试图在那封旧信上伪造我的名字。

entries.meaning: 支撑；支持；供养；证实；支持， 支撑物， 支持者
entries.example: Her family gave her strong support during the difficult year.
entries.exampleZh: 在那艰难的一年里，她的家人给了她坚定的支持。

entries.example: It is a common misconception that cats cannot swim.
entries.exampleZh: 认为猫不会游泳是一个常见的误解。

entries.example: My uncle is a socialist and reads many political books.
entries.exampleZh: 我叔叔是社会主义者，读很多政治类的书。

entries.meaning: 轻微的，微小的；侮慢；轻视，冷落
entries.example: There was a slight delay before the train finally arrived.
entries.exampleZh: 火车最终到达之前有一点轻微的延误。

entries.example: Many people in that country support socialism and public health care.
entries.exampleZh: 那个国家的许多人支持社会主义和公共医疗。

entries.meaning: 工艺学； 工艺， 技术
entries.example: Modern technology helps students learn faster in many classrooms today.
entries.exampleZh: 现代技术帮助学生在许多课堂上更快地学习。

entries.meaning: 该死，见鬼〔表示很生气或失望〕；非常，很
entries.example: Oh damn, I forgot my keys inside the car again.
entries.exampleZh: 见鬼，我又把钥匙忘在车里了。

entries.meaning: 为…做广告， 宣传； 公告； 登广告
entries.example: They plan to advertise their new shop on local radio.
entries.exampleZh: 他们计划在当地广播上为他们的新店做广告。

entries.example: This software makes it easy to edit photos on my laptop.
entries.exampleZh: 这个软件让在我的笔记本电脑上编辑照片变得容易。

entries.example: I attended a useful seminar about writing skills last Friday.
entries.exampleZh: 上周五我参加了一个关于写作技巧的有用研讨会。

entries.meaning: 犹豫的； 吞吞吐吐的
entries.example: She felt hesitant about speaking in front of the whole class.
entries.exampleZh: 她对于在全班面前发言感到犹豫。

entries.meaning: 木材， 原木； 大木料， 栋木
entries.example: The old house was built with strong timber from local trees.
entries.exampleZh: 那座老房子是用当地树木的结实木材建造的。

entries.example: The surrounding hills look beautiful in the soft morning light.
entries.exampleZh: 周围的群山在柔和的晨光中看起来很美。

entries.example: Our team needs an innovative plan to solve this old problem.
entries.exampleZh: 我们的团队需要一个创新的计划来解决这个老问题。

entries.meaning: 在室内， 在户内；室内的
entries.example: We played indoor games because the rain was very heavy.
entries.exampleZh: 因为雨很大，我们玩了室内游戏。

entries.meaning: 性的， 两性的； 性别的
entries.example: The school teaches students about sexual health and safe choices.
entries.exampleZh: 学校教学生有关性健康和安全选择的知识。

entries.example: Bright sunlight came through the window and woke me up.
entries.exampleZh: 明亮的阳光透过窗户照进来，把我弄醒了。

entries.meaning: 缺乏的， 不足的； 稀少的， 罕见的
entries.example: Clean water is scarce in some dry parts of Africa.
entries.exampleZh: 在非洲一些干旱地区，干净的水很稀缺。

entries.meaning: 资源； 财力； 应付办法， 谋略
entries.example: Water is our most important resource, so we must save it.
entries.exampleZh: 水是我们最重要的资源，所以我们必须节约它。

entries.example: That ugly old building should be pulled down this year.
entries.exampleZh: 那座丑陋的旧楼今年应该被拆掉。

entries.meaning: 税，税款；负担；对…征税； 使负担重， 使费尽力
entries.example: The new tax on sweet drinks made many people angry.
entries.exampleZh: 对含糖饮料征收的新税让很多人很生气。

entries.meaning: 刺激， 激动， 兴奋； 令人兴奋的事， 刺激的因
entries.example: The children jumped with excitement when the snow began to fall.
entries.exampleZh: 当雪开始下时，孩子们兴奋地跳了起来。

entries.meaning: 噩梦； 可怕的事物， 无法摆脱的恐惧
entries.example: Driving through that storm was a real nightmare for us.
entries.exampleZh: 开车穿过那场暴风雨对我们来说真是一场噩梦。

entries.meaning: 大使馆； 大使馆全体成员
entries.example: The embassy helped my sister get a new passport quickly.
entries.exampleZh: 大使馆帮我妹妹很快办到了一本新护照。

entries.example: She studies sociology at a small university in the north.
entries.exampleZh: 她在北方一所小型大学学习社会学。

entries.meaning: 逃走， 逃掉， 逃离； 避开， 逃避
entries.example: The birds flee when the old cat walks into the garden.
entries.exampleZh: 那只老猫走进花园时，鸟儿们都逃走了。

entries.meaning: 软的；不强壮的；〔因一腿受伤而〕跛行，一瘸一拐地
entries.example: After the fall, he had to limp slowly back home.
entries.exampleZh: 摔倒之后，他只好一瘸一拐地慢慢走回家。

entries.meaning: 响应的； 敏感的， 易受影响的
entries.example: The new boss is very responsive to ideas from her team.
entries.exampleZh: 新老板对团队提出的想法反应很积极。

entries.example: Which category does this strange little animal belong to?
entries.exampleZh: 这只奇怪的小动物属于哪一类？

entries.meaning: 咔嚓折断，啪地绷断；吧嗒一声；猛咬；厉声说话，怒
entries.example: The dry twig will snap if you step on it.
entries.exampleZh: 如果你踩上去，那根干树枝会咔嚓一声断掉。

entries.example: The new algorithm sorts our photos in just a few seconds.
entries.exampleZh: 这个新算法只需几秒钟就能把我们的照片分类整理好。

entries.example: Scientists study neural activity in the sleeping brain.
entries.exampleZh: 科学家研究睡眠中大脑的神经活动。

entries.example: This large dataset holds weather records from forty small towns.
entries.exampleZh: 这个大型数据集收录了四十个小镇的天气记录。

entries.example: Please check every parameter before you run the program.
entries.exampleZh: 运行程序之前请检查每一个参数。

entries.example: The model turns each word into a small embedding.
entries.exampleZh: 这个模型把每个词转换成一个小的嵌入。

entries.example: The path climbs a steep gradient near the top.
entries.exampleZh: 这条小路在接近顶部的地方坡度很陡。

entries.example: We can optimize the website so it loads much faster.
entries.exampleZh: 我们可以优化这个网站，让它加载得快得多。

entries.example: A bright cluster of stars shines above the dark hills.
entries.exampleZh: 一簇明亮的星星在黑暗的山丘上方闪耀。

entries.example: You need one token to ride the small ferry.
entries.exampleZh: 乘坐那条小渡船需要一枚代币。

entries.example: The high latency makes video calls hard to follow.
entries.exampleZh: 高延迟让人很难跟上视频通话的内容。

entries.example: Our office bandwidth is too low for large video meetings.
entries.exampleZh: 我们办公室的带宽太低，无法支持大型视频会议。

entries.example: She keeps all the student records in one database.
entries.exampleZh: 她把所有学生记录都保存在一个数据库里。

entries.example: Good encryption keeps your private messages safe from strangers.
entries.exampleZh: 良好的加密能让你的私人信息不被陌生人获取。

entries.example: This autonomous little robot cleans the whole kitchen floor.
entries.exampleZh: 这个自主的小机器人会打扫整个厨房的地面。

entries.example: Engineers will deploy the new software on Monday morning.
entries.exampleZh: 工程师们将在周一上午部署新软件。

entries.example: Our new system is scalable, so it can grow with the business.
entries.exampleZh: 我们的新系统是可扩展的，因此它能随着业务增长。

entries.example: The team built a robust plan that handles many problems.
entries.exampleZh: 团队制定了一个稳健的计划，能处理许多问题。

entries.example: Data moves through the pipeline before it reaches the final report.
entries.exampleZh: 数据在到达最终报告之前会经过这条流水线。

entries.example: This test gives us a clear benchmark for future work.
entries.exampleZh: 这项测试为我们今后的工作提供了一个清晰的基准。
